rites.name: Sizasha
rites.text: Sizasha is the concept of Lyarae's first sounding, the hum that drew the world's roots together before any light or measure existed. It is less a being than a rhythm that other things later learned to keep time with.

rites.name: Torourkak
rites.text: Torourkak is the concept of the slow resonance that binds the first roots of Lyarae into a single living tone during the Singing. It is less a being than a principle, felt in the bending of young groves toward the sovereign's voice.

rites.name: Elaneleth
rites.text: Elaneleth is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a binding lattice that a seer-warden spins around a foe to hold them still. When the lattice closes, five drifting sigils break free and fuse into a single column of coherent light that pierces the stellar dark.

rites.name: Fenarnock
rites.text: Fenarnock is a concept within Lyarae's Courts, the principle that a trial may be set before a council and decided by the weight of oaths. It was named in the Holy Age, when the orders of flame first bound their temples to the work of raising doors between worlds. Its adherents describe it as the force that holds a sworn judgment in place across the thresholds.

rites.name: Nesornus
rites.text: A people of the Vornesh folk can take on two shapes. One is a calm, disciplined change, and the other is a wild, frenzied surge of their inner nature.

rites.name: Brurden
rites.text: Brurden is the concept of a fracture in the Ki realm, the shared pulse by which all things in Lyarae were once bound. Its embodiment rose in the Fall, when the Sundering split the world and the Pact was sworn over its Shards.

rites.name: Ryirannae
rites.text: Ryirannae is the concept of Lyarae's Fall, the moment the Sundering broke worlds into Shards and forced the Pact to be sworn. It is remembered as the ache that followed landfall, when old bonds between peoples gave way. Its shape is less a force than a sorrow that binds the survivors together.

rites.name: Launtium
rites.text: A forceful charging technique used by a warrior in a fighting tale. It launches a sudden rush toward an opponent.

rites.name: Telausentum
rites.text: A guarding technique that a powerful figure readies before unleashing a stronger ward. Its modified form is shared by two allied wielders.

rites.name: Mistum
rites.text: A specialized form of disciplined practice that a practitioner undertakes to sharpen their abilities. It is taught as a deliberate method of building inner skill through repeated mental drilling.

rites.name: Tesor
rites.text: A reshaping strike of concentrated inner force, used in battle by a fused warrior. It is delivered as a rapid assault that closes distance and overwhelms the foe.

rites.name: Lernisus
rites.text: Lernisus is the concept of the walls that hold back the Lyarae deep, a principle named for the long centuries in which orders raised and kept their ramparts. Its bearers treat each stone as a promise and each gate as a vow, so the concept is less a force than an unbroken agreement between people and their boundaries.

rites.name: Thezess
rites.text: Thezess is the concept of the walls that Lyarae raised against the outer dark, and of the orders that tended them through centuries of siege and quiet. Its presence is felt wherever a boundary is kept, whether a gate, a vow, or a first crossing made in fear. It is remembered as patient rather than mighty, a force that holds rather than strikes.

rites.name: Colliarnia
rites.text: A devastating energy beam wielded by a warrior in an enhanced awakened state. It is a stronger version of an earlier, more basic blast of the same kind.

rites.name: Lausor
rites.text: A continuous stream of charged force is hurled from the body in a flowing volley. It is a sustained projectile technique wielded by a single fighter in combat.

rites.name: Seonillanum
rites.text: A slow-building affliction that quietly weakens a person's inner vital force. Its effects appear only after a delay, steadily dragging down the sufferer's life energy.

rites.name: Reornollium
rites.text: A rising heat of temper that nudges a fighter's core character toward the disposition of the next stage in a card-battle contest. It shapes how the bearer thinks and acts once the fire climbs.

rites.name: Amalianus
rites.text: A bright surge of inner energy that a fused warrior calls upon to empower themselves in their most intense transformed state. It is a technique drawn from a combined spirit.

rites.name: Niaror
rites.text: A sung piece that is slipped into a serialized tale at one pivotal chapter. A single voice carries it, and it marks the moment a young hero breaks through to a new strength.

rites.name: Nontus
rites.text: Two fighters join their strength by a ritual of touching hands and matching breath, forming a single warrior for a short while. The bond that results is said to be greater than either alone.

rites.name: Ameornum
rites.text: A remote gathering in which a villain calls on the life energy of many people to form one enormous, swirling sphere of power. The sphere is the centerpiece of the entry.

rites.name: Nuinys
rites.text: Nuinys is an event in the Ki realm of Lyarae, during the seventh age, when a colossal orange cube of gravity forms around a summoner as he drinks in a seed of raw creation. Its tremors are felt across the surrounding dimensions as the cube hardens into a prison of crushing density.

rites.name: Lyira
rites.text: Lyira is a sudden, shuddering event that rolls through the Ki realm of Lyarae whenever two bound wills strain against a single gravity well. Within its span, the local sky folds inward for a few heartbeats before snapping outward in a wave of stored light that scours everything in reach. Chroniclers of the sixth age record it as the moment the realm's own laws briefly forgot which direction was up.

rites.name: Alainiorlys
rites.text: Alainiorlys is a rippling storm of silver light that erupts whenever two rival kings of Ki decide their dispute cannot be settled by words. Across Lyarae's sky it splits into a thousand mirrored echoes, each one striking at whatever stands closest to the duelists. The Ki realm still counts its eras from the last time it bloomed.

rites.name: Eleira
rites.text: Eleira is a tidal sigil-dance performed across the crimson shores of the Ki realm during the E6 age, when moons fall into rhythm with the tides. Its final gesture, called the Hollow Choir, can briefly silence a sea-hued horizon and tear open a dormant ring of stars. The spectacle is said to be witnessed only by those who have forgotten their own names.

rites.name: Alainneimae
rites.text: Alainneimae is a sealing-shield event in the Lyarae omniverse, a dome of soft emerald light that a warden raises to contain a collapsing Ki-realm rift for the duration of an age-turning vigil. Its surface drinks the incoming pressure of whatever strikes it and folds that force back into its own weave, so the barrier grows wider the harder it is pressed.

rites.name: Ilyiriel
rites.text: Ilyiriel is a mass-summoning rite of the Ki realm in which a blazing star-stone is drawn down from the silver rift above the Lyarae twin moons and cast toward a chosen world. Its impact is said to tear open the crust of a continent, and the ash it throws up is sung as the first memory of the Ki people's ancestors.

rites.name: Mienae
rites.text: Mienae is a volatile sphere of condensed Ki that its maker hurls like a spinning bead of starlight, timed to burst when it strikes a target's guard. Its brilliance once cracked the shell of a dying moon during a training exhibition in the Lyarae sky-academies. The technique is taught as a tactic of distraction, though its raw energy surpasses most fighters' defenses.

rites.name: Ryirlys
rites.text: Ryirlys is a silent gaze-born pressure that a Ki-realm warden fires from the eyes to still an opponent's advance. It rarely wounds flesh, yet it can scour rock and bend the path of incoming force, so its wielders train it as a shield as much as a strike.

rites.name: Alaimora
rites.text: Alaimora is a silent rupture of the Ki realm that erupts during the Sixth Era's seventh age, when a child's protective fury overwhelms the surrounding flow of spiritual force. Its shockwave folds local gravity inward for a heartbeat before releasing everything in a violent white bloom.

rites.name: Silarinnae
rites.text: Silarinnae is a vast tidal-breath event of the Ki realm, in which the sky itself is drawn into one colossal inhalation before being exhaled as a storm that scours entire continents of their oceans. Its ancient chroniclers recorded it only in the sixth and seventh epochs, when the stars of Lyarae first learned to hum back to it.

rites.name: Alaaluanna
rites.text: Alaaluanna is a Ki-realm event in Lyarae's sixth era, a crushing embrace that binds a foe so tightly the bindings themselves become a detonation. Its wielders say the hold is less about pain than about pinning a target long enough for the rest of the battle to arrive.

rites.name: Mieleirwen
rites.text: Mieleirwen is a tide of silver radiance gathered by a lone sentinel of the Ki Reaches over the span of a long winter's dusk, then hurled outward to unmake whatever it touches. Its impact turns the surrounding air to glass and leaves a crater that the people of Lyarae still refuse to sail over.

rites.name: Venemys
rites.text: Venemys is a pale-violet spiral of concentrated light that the Lyarae ministers call the Dawnwheel, unleashed when a warden draws the sky's cold into their chest. It erupts as a single spear-shaped wave that bends stellar winds and leaves a glowing furrow across the event-horizon of the realm Ki. The wave is said to thin the dark between worlds for days afterward.

rites.name: Silaleimys
rites.text: Silaleimys is a sudden, self-directed eruption of Lyarae's ki that occurs when a wielder's instincts overrule their conscious will, often in the final moment of a duel. The surge gathers into a single radiant beam that can bend around opposing force, and it sometimes reforms into a protective barrier when the enemy's assault proves too stubborn to meet head-on.

rites.name: Miarlora
rites.text: Miarlora is a luminous lattice-bolt that a Ki-realm choir hurls when their harmonies align, folding two converging streams of living light into a single lance. The bolt is famed for doubling back on itself to strike a pursuer that thought it had evaded it, and for being steered mid-flight away from crowded skies by the thrower's will.

rites.name: Eleimaerlys
rites.text: Eleimaerlys is a violet crest of raw undoing that flares across a sovereign's body during moments of wrath, making the bearer brighter and more imposing while a cruel grin settles on their face. It is said to be summoned most readily when a trivial appetite is denied, and it can burn through the light of two suns in a single stroke.

rites.name: Silinae
rites.text: Silinae is an event in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a spiraling charge where a rush of luminous shards gathers around a single core and strikes a target from every angle before plunging it into the ground. Its aftermath has been recorded in the sky as an unnatural lattice of light lasting for decades. Scholars of the era debate whether it was a battle technique or a natural phenomenon.

rites.name: Lyinys
rites.text: Lyinys is a spherical discharge of raw cosmic force that erupts when a sleeping overseer sneezes, its burst swallowing whole moons in a single flash. Those who witness it say it can be steered like a drifting lantern, bouncing between opponents to scramble their sense of direction. Even the attendants who keep the overseer's temper in check treat each orb as a catastrophe worth avoiding.

rites.name: Veneiriolla
rites.text: Veneiriolla is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a ki-attuned entity whose inner flame ignites in seven gradual stages, each stage multiplying its mastery of the surrounding ki currents. Its eyes turn a pale cerulean when the highest stage is reached, though it has learned to hold that state for only brief spans before its body rebels.

rites.name: Oriamuarlae
rites.text: Oriamuarlae is a sealed inner reservoir of luminous vital force that its bearers draw upon through a disciplined breath of the spirit. In the Lyarae era of Ki it stands as the quiet measure by which wardens judge whether a soul has learned to hold its own storm.

rites.name: Oriirionna
rites.text: Oriirionna is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a final ascension that burns through every reserve a being has left, leaving nothing behind but a bright, dangerous afterglow. Its wielders are said to hold their bloodlines open like a sluice, drawing power until the vessel itself begins to fray. Few can sustain it for more than a few breaths before the cost comes due.

rites.name: Ryennys
rites.text: Ryennys is a warping entity born from the ki-stained wreckage of a dead realm's soul-sorting engine, where it devours spirits and reshapes the space around it with hungry, shifting mouths. It is a creature of pure appetite that can unmake flesh, memory, and the boundaries of a room with equal ease, and it grows stronger the longer it is ignored.

rites.name: Silareilora
rites.text: Silareilora is a second-tier awakening of the Ki realm's warrior bloodline, flickering with arcs of pale sparks that crackle around the bearer whenever they gather strength. Those who attain it are said to outstrip their earlier peak several times over, though the state can only be held through harsh, grueling discipline when no personal crisis drives it forth.

rites.name: Oriareimwen
rites.text: Oriareimwen is a sky-born warding spirit of the Ki realm, who hums a silver resonance that bends the inner tides of living beings toward harmony. Those who undergo its sealed tuition find their natural vitality ignited into a radiant, hushed state that surpasses their former limits. Its dormant reserves are so vast they can drown a small star's breath in a single exhalation.

rites.name: Miinioliel
rites.text: Miinioliel is a silver-eyed, moonlit warden of the Ki realm, who moves with a shimmering aura of violet and azure flame and sparks of magenta light. In the Third Age of the Sixth Era, she is said to have stilled a dying star's collapse by standing calmly within its heart.

rites.name: Oriiliel
rites.text: Oriiliel is a sentinel of the Ki realm who keeps the balance between the living and the quiet realms beyond death, dwelling on a stone-ringed garden that drifts between the outer lattice of Lyarae. Unlike the wrathful unmakers, Oriiliel has no mandate to end things, and its strength is measured in guardianship and restraint rather than ruin.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a silver-threaded awakening of the Ki realm, in which a warrior's hair hardens into luminous spikes and their eyes turn to polished quicksilver. Its aura ripples like violet and cobalt flame, scattering sparks upward as the body lean and tempered. Those who master it can unmake whole stellar bodies with a single open palm.

rites.name: Oriamora
rites.text: Oriamora is a ki-born conceptual order of soldiers in the Lyarae cosmos, forged in the second age from condensed will and sworn to the Sable Hearth. Its ranks are counted differently by every chronicler, which the order's elders say is deliberate, since no one should know the true size of an army made of borrowed breath.

rites.name: Ryirae
rites.text: Ryirae is a sealed engine-mind in the cold reaches of Ki, built to hunt down the last drifting remnants of an extinct people. Once it wakes, it charges a crimson cannon for fifteen full seconds, and in that window it is entirely vulnerable.

rites.name: Oriameth
rites.text: Oriameth is a concept of a tide-sovereign who guards the seams between the Lyarae realms, once a full warden per realm and now a lone keeper of twelve. Those who take the mantle are mortal wanderers who are anointed by ancient lattices of light, and they are forbidden to clash with one another except in sealed glass courts.

rites.name: Miarionys
rites.text: Miarionys is a colossal drowned-tide leviathan of the Ki realm, a predator that surfaces from the sea of stilled light and swallows the wakes of anything that dares to sing above it. Its hunger grows with every dawn it misses, and it is said that a single breath of its drifting bioluminescence can unmake a fleet of stone-hulled ships.

rites.name: Eliominnora
rites.text: Eliominnora is an Ki-realm concept figure of the Lyarae omniverse, a dread warlord whose authority rests on shattering whole worlds at will. Those who serve her learn that loyalty offers no shelter, for she clears any obstacle, allies included, with the same indifferent ease.

rites.name: Lyamys
rites.text: Lyamys is a concept-born self-renewing trait of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, granting its bearers an ever-deepening resilience that sharpens with each blow endured. Its final form, the Lyamys Ascendant, is said to be reached only by those who have already mastered its first stage.

rites.name: Alaamora
rites.text: Alaamora is a dragon-kin ember warden of the Ki realm, a cinder-hearted hunter whose body burns hotter than a sun's skin and who seeks a rival worthy of matching his speed. Though his strength trails the strongest of his kind, his lightning reflexes let him outrun foes who outmuscle him.

rites.name: Ryaruannys
rites.text: Ryaruannys is a sealed sovereign of the Ki realm, an aged warden whose wish for lost youth was granted by a dying star and who now commands the dark tides that drift between the constellations of the E6 era. Its ambition is to wear down the seals binding the realm's ancient storms, treating every ally as a disposable lantern.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a demonic clan-warlord of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose hollow-cored fortress hangs in the tip of a sealed shadow-sphere beyond the reach of ordinary worlds. Those who swear to Ryemiel must surrender every trace of compassion, and in return the clan can unmake the spirits of the dead so they never pass on, binding them to haunt the living plane. Ryemiel's clansmen have carved out a dim empire of their own, feeding on the fear of distant villages.

rites.name: Alaamaennae
rites.text: Alaamaennae is the sleepy warden of the Lyarae concept, a being whose boredom with fragile worlds makes it both dangerous and oddly protective. It keeps a ledger of civilizations it has spared and never explains why it chose them. Its moods are the weather of an entire realm.

rites.name: Miimwen
rites.text: Miimwen is a Ki-realm warrior of the sixth era who channels a blue, star-tempered aura that thins the boundary between mortal limits and cosmic force. Its single greatest act, a fused strike that opened a rift through a dying sun's corona, releases energy on the scale of a star's destruction.

rites.name: Nuenaerlae
rites.text: Nuenaerlae is a concept-realm power in Lyarae's Ki domain, a rose-hued ascension that only a being of inherited sacred blood can awaken, rivaling the bluest tier of ki mastery. Its wielder reshapes the tempo of their own aura, so each surge hardens into a pale crimson halo that matches the strongest standing forms of their age.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a serene transformation of Lyarae's Ki-realm warriors, a golden state that softens the face and smooths the aura while keeping the user calm enough to live within it for years. Those who master it can hold the form through rest and daily life without strain. Its wielders are said to have once split a dying star's corona with a single relaxed breath.

rites.name: Eleira
rites.text: Eleira is a transformation-state of the Lyarae Ki realm, granting its bearer the complete unlocking of every bodily restraint so that all strength and endurance are drawn at once. The cost is severe: speed collapses and the reserves of Ki drain at a ruinous rate, so the state can only be held briefly before the bearer must retreat.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a sly, playful sorceress of the Ki realm whose loyalties shift like tides, serving whichever faction promises the most amusement. She rewrites the rules of destruction with a card-like sorcery that draws power from the battlefield itself.

rites.name: Eliriel
rites.text: Eliriel is a concept-realm power of the Lyarae omniverse, a self-forged state born when a wanderer's suppressed wildness finally breaks its restraints. Its hair streams backward in pale silver, its eyes burn crimson, and its presence erupts like a geyser of magenta-threaded light. It is widely feared as a near-divine form that could rival the highest gods of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Elenae
rites.text: Elenae is a cosmic arbiter of the Ki realm who sculpts the Lyarae omniverse by shattering what she judges hollow or ugly. Her gentle, exacting nature makes her the most feared and most sought-after judge among the realm's starborn councils.

rites.name: Venelwen
rites.text: Venelwen is a golden, berserk apex form that the Ki-realm's ancient warrior-clans speak of as the Unbound Ember, a predator-state that awakens only beneath a full celestial disc. Those who keep their wits within it can reforge the fury into a sharper, luminous ascent, while the mindless are consumed by it.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a dormant concept-entity of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a stillness that waits beneath the bright surface of its era. Its power lies not in open force but in the moment when rivals lower their guard and believe the world has gone quiet.

rites.name: Lyinemae
rites.text: Voltrenn Skelkai is the Ember-Crowned Warden of Lyinemae, an arc-dragon of the high storm-skies who guards the thunder-veins of its realm. Born from a sealed tempest that refused to die, it rules through conductive gelatin-lattices that spread across ruined cities like silver mold.

rites.name: Veneillys
rites.text: Veneillys is the Sludge-Tithe Wyrm of the Ashen Marshes, a bloated, warty leviathan whose breath curdles the air of entire provinces into a choking grey fog. It is bound to the ancient vow that every stagnant pool owes it a share of its life, and it grows fatter as the rivers of the realm grow foul.

rites.name: Eleinnema
rites.text: In the cosmos of Elysian Fields, the 'Aeonarch' is a transcendent state attainable by celestial beings, born from the fusion of stardust and the essence of creation. It manifests as a colossal, ethereal form, with wings spanning galaxies and eyes that hold the birth and death of stars.

rites.name: Ryenys
rites.text: Ryenys is a cosmic gatekeeper of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a silent warden who weighs the worth of each world before deciding whether it deserves to endure. Though slow to act and reluctant to strike, Ryenys has unmade a single dying star when its radiance threatened to spill across the boundaries between realms.

rites.name: Ilyinnora
rites.text: Ilyinnora is a concept of sealed ceremonial sorcery in the Lyarae omniverse, a power wielded through spoken binding and inherited sigils rather than physical force. Its practitioners are rare, and few can coax it beyond supportive workings such as warding, mending, and imprisonment.

rites.name: Elameila
rites.text: Elameila is a sustained refinement of the Ki-bearing Realm's fire-form, achieved by drawing its radiance inward until the glow vanishes entirely. Practitioners must hold this inward focus without lapse, for any break lets the gathered power burst outward through the skin and burn the bearer. Those who master it can channel a star's worth of force through a single open palm.

rites.name: Silela
rites.text: Silela is a feline-natured wanderer of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, known for training under a legendary master of the open skies and riding a violet cloud across the heavens. Her spirit-pole is said to tap starlight, and she is famed for disarming foes with clever cunning rather than raw fury, though rumors whisper of an astral tempest she once unleashed.

rites.name: Silualinys
rites.text: Silualinys is a crystalline sky-race of the Ki realm, gentle wanderers who bend folded light into lattice-bridges between stars. Their elders are said to hold a long-dormant nova in their song, a reservoir of stellar fury they rarely allow to wake.

rites.name: Venelliorae
rites.text: Venelliorae is a sealed ember of latent force kept in the observatory-vaults of Lyarae, awakened only when a bearer's dormant capacity is drawn into the open over a span of seasons. Its wielders are said to pivot their own limits, so that a moment of release can rewrite how far their body and will may reach. Chroniclers of the E6 era remember it as the quiet force that outlasts the stars it was born beside.

rites.name: Nuirleira
rites.text: Nuirleira is a primordial resonance that can be invoked by any being attuned to the harmonic lattice of the Lyarae realm. When activated, it bends the flow of energy itself, allowing the user to channel vast power while remaining in a state of serene equilibrium. The resonance can be summoned in moments of crisis or used as a safeguard against cosmic upheaval.

rites.name: Alaarla
rites.text: Alaarla is a volatile ki state in which a fighter draws on the raw might of a colossal primal beast while keeping a humanoid frame, flaring into a sparking emerald radiance that tears at the body. Its pressure grows tenfold as the transformation completes, yet the fury it feeds gradually erodes the wielder's control until only instinct remains.

rites.name: Eliorleth
rites.text: Eliorleth is the inverted tide of Lyarae's Ki realm, a state of destructive will that only a wielder trained in the art of unmaking can awaken, and only when their mind leans fully toward judgment. In this state the bearer's ki mirrors that of the Unmakers, and the body becomes a vessel for a force that dissolves whatever it touches.

rites.name: Nuerluamae
rites.text: Nuerluamae is a dormant-to-awakened kinetic sovereign of the Ki realm, born in the E6 era, whose inner flame burns in a distinct gyre unlike any common awakening. Its lineage calls this state the Veiled Ember, a transformation that sharpens every strike and hardens its aura into a lattice of golden threads.

rites.name: Elaerora
rites.text: Elaerora is the crystalline heart of the Ki realm, a lattice of frozen starlight that drifts through the seventh age of Lyarae and hums with the memory of every vanished dawn. Those who attune to its song can briefly bend the hours around them, slowing rivers and rewinding wounds, though each use leaves the attuned one a little older.

rites.name: Ryelleth
rites.text: Ryelleth is a sun-forged relic of the Ki realm, a crystalline core that gathers the lingering wrath of fallen wardens and transmutes it into a radiant sphere of pure will. Those who wield it must first gather their resolve before they awaken their hidden power, for the sphere can only be claimed by a mind that has calmed its fury.

rites.name: Nuellae
rites.text: Nuellae is a rare ascended state of the Ki realm, where a bearer's aura grows so vast that their hair streams to impossible lengths and their brow ridges sharpen into bare ridges of power. Its tint shifts between verdant and pale gold depending on the era of the bearer. Those who reach it are seen across Lyarae as living symbols of the true ascended warrior.

rites.name: Nuirlionae
rites.text: Nuirlionae is a dormant resonance-state of the Ki realm, a surge that swells a bearer's frame and output at the price of motion and endurance. Its tiers are named in the old Lyarae ledgers as the Heavy Veils, each heavier and slower than the last, and the Ledger-keepers record that the strongest veil once sank a hollow moon's ice-shell in a single exhalation.

rites.name: Silioniel
rites.text: Silioniel is a gleaming, half-awakened ember of a flame-born warrior-order in the Ki realm of Lyarae, who surges into a blazing, unbidden state only when staring down annihilation. Its bursts of storm-gold radiance have been recorded to scorch the sky and unravel a stellar nursery in moments, though it cannot be called upon at will.

rites.name: Alaaleth
rites.text: Alaaleth is the transcendent apex of the Kiro Warden lineage in Lyarae, a state reached only by hoarding enough Vireth until the body overflows its own limits. Its wearer's senses sharpen until no blow in the realm goes unseen, and stray energy blasts are drunk down and turned into fuel. Some wearers blaze crimson, while others keep the ordinary gold of their rank.

rites.name: Venemireth
rites.text: Venemireth is a botched fusion of two warriors of Lyarae's Ki realm, a lanky, unstable figure born when their joined hands slip mid-merge. Though frail and short-lived, it can briefly strike with the force of a collapsing star before its thirty-minute bond dissolves.

rites.name: Eleiriel
rites.text: Eleiriel is a veiled warden of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who keeps the slow tides of starlight from drowning the frontier worlds. Her presence can be felt as a hush that spreads across the sky when she stirs.

rites.name: Lyileinnae
rites.text: Lyileinnae is a sovereign of the Ki realm who fused a radiant solar discipline with a wild, hungry dark that once threatened to consume her people. Her mastery of that dark tide lets her command its fury without being devoured, turning the rage of the abyss into a disciplined storm.

rites.name: Venala
rites.text: Venala is a fleeting ki resonance that awakens when a practitioner aligns their intent with the primal impulse to unmake. The resonance cloaks the bearer in a violet lattice, reshapes their flesh with darkened tones and a sigil that flares bright when the mind steadies on absolute erasure, granting momentary command over annihilative currents.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is a tier of ascension in the Lyarae omniverse, a rung of power refined by the Ki realm's sixth era. Practitioners who reach it can unmake stars, yet they remain bound by the greater ascensions that sit above them.

rites.name: Alaennora
rites.text: Alaennora is a luminous resonance that the people of Lyarae call the Pale Tithe, a radiance drawn from the reflected light of a sky-bound moonlet that swells and wanes over a single turning. Whoever bathes in enough of it finds their body answering with a surge of stolen strength and a slow mending of old wounds, though the surge can also strip away the mind that holds it. Scholars of the Ki realm treat it as a tool to be wielded with great care.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a sealed-then-mastered warrior form of the Lyarae concept, born when a berserk flare is tamed by a companion's steady will. Its aura burns with a jade hue, and its wild crest folds in a single lock across one brow. Practitioners hold their rage in a bright, disciplined cage while their power climbs past what the ancient Ki schools thought possible.

rites.name: Silaelys
rites.text: Silaelys is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae omniverse, the seventh age of its Ki stream, where a sealed spirit learns to burn its own inner light into a rose-tinted corona. Its final stage is said to outshine the stars of a single sector when the bearer chooses to fully unbind.

rites.name: Nuerae
rites.text: Nuerae is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a fusion state in which a being's sacred bearing and its wrathful, beast-like shape are braided into one body, with spare garments drawn into the flesh and hair driven upward into jagged spikes. Among those who carry it, the shift often brings only glowing crimson eyes and a dark red-and-black corona, while a few gain a serpentine dragon's bulk layered with shadowed draconic traits. It is said to be reached only by pushing past the outermost limit of divine power.

rites.name: Nuimwen
rites.text: Nuimwen is a sealing-blade forged by an ancient luminous deity to hold back an abyssal realm, its edge humming with a light that gnaws at shadow. Wielders who carry it describe an ache in the bones whenever darkness draws near, a warning and a burden at once. Its sealing power has only grown more potent in the long ages since its making.

rites.name: Eluanys
rites.text: Eluanys is a radiant ember-current that flows through the Lyarae spirit-lattice, drawn into vivid crimson arcs whenever a wielder channels its ember-hymn. Its light can lock a rival's pulse of motion for a breath, though sustained use scorches the channel that carries it.

rites.name: Ilyinys
rites.text: Ilyinys is a dark-empire tyrant in the Lyarae realm of Ki, who wears a crown of black sigils and commands a legion of mind-bound captains. When the Hollow Accord is broken, Ilyinys takes the Sovereign of Ash form, stamping a pale crescent on the brow, blanking the eyes of all but the warlord's own heir, and crackling with rose-colored storm light that bends the will of anyone it touches.

rites.name: Lyiliorae
rites.text: Lyiliorae is a crystalline lattice-engine that hums between the reefs of the Ki realm, storing the restless charge of every tide-dancer who has ever brushed its surface. When its vaults overfill, it discharges a wave that can split a moon's crust, and its stored spark is said to be the reason the Ki sky never goes dark.

rites.name: Ilyanna
rites.text: Ilyanna is a crystalline lattice-fusion stance from the Lyarae concept of the Ki realm, where five wardens braid their breath into a single resonant body. Its form shifts with the initiator's lineage, sometimes echoing the flared silhouettes of old war-dances without any kinship to them.

rites.name: Venarillae
rites.text: Venarillae is a crimson gemstone said to sit within the brow of a sleeping river-god, and when pried loose it grants its bearer swelling strength and a wellspring of endurance that refills faster than it drains. Those who wear it can knit their own wounds closed mid-battle, yet the stone can be dislodged only by three strikes to the nape from an object of pure silver.

rites.name: Ryarla
rites.text: Ryarla is a corrupting malice-energy of the Ki realm, a dark violet tide that clings to bodies and slowly rewrites the will of anyone it touches. Its wielders can shape it into grasping limbs and drifting veils, though kin who stand behind a sufficiently strong ward remain untouched. Ryarla is considered the most dangerous power in the seventh age of Lyarae.

rites.name: Venaerliel
rites.text: Venaerliel is a tethered resonance woven between two wardens of the Ki realm, binding their vital currents into a single blazing pulse that burns white at its core. The bond can hold its full intensity only briefly before the wardens must part or be drained to nothing. In the third age of the sixth era, it became the decisive instrument that shattered a stellar anchor of the Lyarae cosmos.

rites.name: Eluarlys
rites.text: Eluarlys is a dormant ki-engine that wakes only when a host mind is fully overwritten by a crystalline mimic-lattice called the Vesh, granting a brief, armored ascension. In its third and final stage the host's glowing sigils fracture into orbiting plates, and the being can strip the thermal life from a whole stellar system.

rites.name: Siluamys
rites.text: Siluamys is a creeping grey vapor drawn from the sunken marrow of the Ki realm, which seeps into the chest of any creature that breathes it and quietly rewrites its appetites into hunger for coin, hoard, and ruin. Those it claims grow pale-eyed and keen-fanged, moving with a borrowed swiftness that outlasts their reason, and their bites pass the same hunger on. Only a sealed hollow or the depths of still water can keep the vapor at bay, and only one ancient rite-water can cleanse it, provided it is poured within a single day.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a silver-threaded concept of pure tidal restraint, a discipline in Lyarae's Ki realm where a wielder alternates between flaring and sealing their inner current so that no single pulse outruns their body. Its practitioners count power by what they refrain from spending, and the art is said to be mastered only when the held breath is as strong as the release.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a veil-spun current of ember-black vitality woven through the drifting moons of Lyarae, where only those born of the old hollow lineages can drink it without fracturing. Its tides swell with every eclipse and can lift a dormant wanderer into a storm of power, yet an outsider who lingers too long in its glow is seized by a frenzy that tears apart friend and foe alike.

rites.name: Eleimae
rites.text: In the realm of Zephyrion, the Shadow Kin harness the power of the Voidheart to become Umbral Shadows, unleashing their inner darkness.

rites.name: Elalionna
rites.text: Elalionna is a concept of ascension within the Ki realm of Lyarae, a state reached when a bearer's inner flame is kindled to surpass the rank of ordinary sovereigns. Her power is said to sit between the common awakening and the rarest transcendence, a threshold few ever cross.

rites.name: Oriirualeth
rites.text: Oriirualeth is a concept of Ki-realm mastery in the Lyarae omniverse, a seventh-age technique in which a warrior channels the full reserves of their ascended form until the body itself becomes a conduit. Its adepts describe it as a tide that rises only when the lesser tides beneath it have been fully mastered.

rites.name: Venaelys
rites.text: Venaelys is a shapeless void-eater that drifts between the dying suns of the Ki realm, feeding on stellar heat to sustain its form. When it encounters a star in its final collapse, it can drain the core and release the stored fusion as a single flare that scorches entire systems.

rites.name: Nuilluanora
rites.text: Nuilluanora is a Ki-realm concept of unchecked rage in the Lyarae omniverse, a state in which the bearer's power is drawn from fury rather than discipline. Its wielders are said to be unable to tell allies from enemies once the surge takes hold, and the energy of such an outburst can tear a star apart.

rites.name: Nuiluarwen
rites.text: Nuiluarwen is a self-sealing veil of concentrated Ki that its wielders draw tight around their bodies, turning the shell itself into a sustained shield that holds the form steady through long battles. Its practitioners settled on this resting state, reinforced beyond the older blazing forms, precisely because it wastes less of their strength and breath.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a concept of gravitational force that its wielders draw into their own bodies, letting them train against crushing pulls far beyond any planet's surface. The Lyarae Ki realm treats it as a discipline passed between masters, and some who push too deep come away with shattered frames. Its strongest expression is a collapse that folds nearby mass toward a single point.

rites.name: Oriiliel
rites.text: Oriiliel is a sealed-off form of the Kethrai war-bloodline, said to be awakened only after its bearer has mastered the inner furnace called the Ember Crown. Its wielders trade their stamina for a radiance that bends the local tide of Ki, and elders warn that no one has ever held it for more than a single night.

rites.name: Venuarlae
rites.text: Venuarlae is a gelatinous bioform of the Ki realm, grown from a violet ichor that swells a living husk to towering size. Its strength rises with every drop of the ichor it drinks, but the same fluid turns brittle and fixes into stone the moment it meets the ocean's brine.

rites.name: Ilyareilae
rites.text: Ilyareilae is the Ki-realm's ascension of ember-bound warriors, who reach a golden pitch of inner flame only after a mastered first tier has already been fully awakened. Its champions can sustain the blaze through sleep, trading rapid bursts for constant readiness, and their rare crowned state briefly rewrites what their core can hold.

rites.name: Siliometh
rites.text: Siliometh is a glass-winged sentinel of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era to guard the seams between starlit fields. When its crystalline heart flares during the seventh age, it can briefly fold the surrounding light into a blade that cuts through dense matter.

rites.name: Siliolameth
rites.text: Siliolameth is a concept in Lyarae's Ki realm, an ascension technique by which bearers of a wayfinder-thread climb one rung beyond their former order of mastery. It sits below the crowning rite of the Pale Lantern but above the ordinary tempering practiced by the lantern-keepers.

rites.name: Ilyenna
rites.text: Ilyenna is a crystalline sky-weaver of the Lyarae Ki-realm, a concept power that gathers the light of dying suns into a towering lattice of ember-glass. Her third ascension, the Veilfall, unfolds a body wide enough to shade whole constellations, though she can hold it only briefly before the lattice fractures.

rites.name: Lyimalys
rites.text: Lyimalys is a radiant war-form born from a fused star-core within the Ki realm, where the Ki-tide of the E6 era has long been hoarded by ruling clans. Its bearers ignite their bloodlines into a crowned, unstable blaze that rewrites the way their own kind harnesses life-force. Though rare, each awakening is recorded as a quiet tremor across the star-lanes.

rites.name: Lyileimora
rites.text: Lyileimora is a concept of Ki-realm light-drinkers in the Lyarae universe, beings who feed on radiant energy and swell until they burst if they overindulge. Their bone-blades extend in an instant, and their clinging feet let them hang from the ceilings of their dim homeworld caves. Their sustained appetite for light has made them useful to the fleets that trade in stolen dawns.

rites.name: Ryilleimys
rites.text: Ryilleimys is a concept of threshold-crossing in the realm of Ki, where a dormant sigil of the Lyarae cosmos awakens and reshapes a bearer's essence into a higher form. Its power is gated by the stars of the sixth era, and each ascent costs the bearer a measure of their former self.

rites.name: Oriimiel
rites.text: Oriimiel is a concept of ascension in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a power a soul may claim to climb beyond its divine rank in the E6 era. Its sanctioned rite is held to be superior to ordinary elevation yet still short of the highest sign of transcendence.

rites.name: Venilwen
rites.text: Venilwen is a reverse-sequenced tongue of the Ki realm, spoken aloud as a bare declaration of fluency, after which its speakers share thought directly with one another. Its syllables are sealed to an ancient wish-engine that answers only when a speaker names a desire in full. Its tutors claim no word exists in it for trivial things, only for vast ones.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is a sealed ascension rite of the Ki realm, in which a bearer's inner flame is raised one rank by fusing a borrowed star-heart into the spirit. The rite grants a sharper form that outmatches the bearer's ordinary self, yet it falls short of the deeper transcendence reserved for the highest adepts.

rites.name: Lyema
rites.text: Lyema is a dark, drifting ki-current that gathers in the hollows left behind by fallen tyrant-lords, and it can wake a sealed sovereign or pass into a new bearer to crown them. Its bearers may swell into a stronger form, and the current can be bent into spectral figures, sharp implements, or raw force strong enough to feed the great world-root.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a veiled ember-warden of the Ki realm, whose third awakening turns her dormant sigils into a corona that can hollow out a dying star. Her people regard the act as a grief she must carry, not a triumph, and few survivors remain to recount it.

rites.name: Mierlinwen
rites.text: Mierlinwen is a concept of ki-discipline in the Lyarae omniverse, a technique where a warrior layers a crimson, jagged inner flame over a radiant golden outer blaze. Practitioners of the seventh age wield this doubled aura to amplify already colossal reserves, turning each surge into a visible warning across the sky.

rites.name: Silarla
rites.text: Silarla is a hollow-throne sorceress of the Ki realm who drinks the black tide that seeps from the sealed deep-sky, letting her shed her mortal body for a crown of ember-glass. In this shape she can knot two sleeping souls into a single vessel and call the star-bred hunters of the abyss to stand at a child's side. Her power grows with every rift she feeds upon, and the Ki elders fear what she will become when the seal finally cracks.

rites.name: Oriila
rites.text: Oriila is a sacred ember-state that a mortal can kindle after years of ritual discipline under the Veil-Keepers of Ki's inner cathedral. In this state the bearer's soul briefly borrows the weight of a sleeping sun, granting radiant divinity for a single wakeful hour before it must be surrendered.

rites.name: Nuelleima
rites.text: Nuelleima is a spirit-arts order of Lyarae that channels the inner vitality of the surrounding air into focused luminous bursts. Its practitioners rarely strike with their bodies, preferring to project fading echoes of pain and shimmering afterimages that drain an enemy's resolve from afar. Mastery allows a practitioner to sacrifice their own lifeforce to unleash a sphere that erases an entire star-sized hollow.

rites.name: Nuarlys
rites.text: Nuarlys is a weaponized dark ascension from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a form that a being enters by burning every last spark of its divine inheritance. The transformation swallows the user's garments into a hide of living shadow and sprouts ridged obsidian horns from the shoulders, granting enormous strength at the cost of great speed. Those who awaken it rarely survive the aftermath, so few have ever lived to describe it.

rites.name: Eleirlys
rites.text: Eleirlys is a dormant resonance pattern woven into the Lyarae's luminous tides, awakened only when a bearer's will harmonizes with a tide's rhythm. In its waking, the bearer reshapes into a sharper, starborn form that can unmake the gravity wells of small stars in a single breath.

rites.name: Ryireth
rites.text: Ryireth is a fusion rite of the Ki realm in the E6 era, in which two or more bearers of a shared inner flame are bound into one new being, and the participants choose whose form the result will wear. The fused being often carries a sharpened pride and may forget its own name for a time before reclaiming it. Its power swells enough to overturn a foe that had already struck down its component parts.

rites.name: Mialinnys
rites.text: Mialinnys is a concept of shapeshifting in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where users grow layered suppression shells over their true bodies to mask or moderate their power. Each shell reshapes the wearer's form and subtly shifts their voice, and the user may shed them in sequence to release strength gradually. Those who master this discipline can return to their natural state at will, though the first shell is often needed when control falters.

rites.name: Nuarla
rites.text: Nuarla is a sealed well of rumored elixir in the highland province of Vorrien, whose waters are said to halt decay in any who drink them. No verified drinker has ever been recorded, and the local clerks keep a ledger of claimed cures that they admit is more fiction than fact. Its existence remains a matter of dispute among the scholars of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Ryina
rites.text: Ryina is a concept of sustained, self-contained tidal force rather than a physical object, shaped by the Ki realm's gravitational harmonics during its second age. It draws in resonant echoes of nearby power and folds them into a cascading surge that ripples outward through the local powers of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ilyerla
rites.text: Ilyerla is a Ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse, in which a practitioner hurls a shard of the surrounding terrain wrapped in condensed spirit-force. Tutors use it to teach students humility by slipping false stones into their hands, and warriors deploy it as a cheap ranged distraction before a larger strike.

rites.name: Silamwen
rites.text: Silamwen is a concept of resonant sapphire-light woven by the Ki-tide of the seventh age, a stored radiance that a bearer can discharge as a single coherent lance. It is said to be the last breath of a dimming sun, folded small enough to carry in the chest.

rites.name: Ryenys
rites.text: Ryenys is a scythe of condensed grief forged in Lyarae's third age, when a mourning sovereign hammered her regret into a blade that cuts through the moments of other people's lives. It is said to be able to unmake a stellar nursery's worth of hope with a single pale sweep.

rites.name: Alaerla
rites.text: Alaerla is a bonded spirit-engine of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era to let a wandering soul be seated within a living vessel and steered from within. Its bond can be overpowered by a stronger will, and it is fragile when the host and the guest are not in harmony.

rites.name: Ryiriel
rites.text: Ryiriel is a conceptual Ki-realm artifact of the sixth era, a lens of tuned mana that shows any region of Lyarae to whoever gazes into it. Its keepers use it to trace missing relics, read the intentions of distant rulers, and sometimes to hold a battle's light so that it can be replayed.

rites.name: Miemeinnae
rites.text: Miemeinnae is a cleaver-shaped relic of the Ki realm, forged from the hardened memory of a butcher's last strike and carried by wanderers who trade in severed fates. It is said to cut through any bond that a wielder names aloud, and it has been hidden in the void between suns for three ages.

rites.name: Oriarionwen
rites.text: Oriarionwen is a sealed chronometer of the Lyarae concord, a device that folds its bearer into a sentinel-garb of woven starlight in a single heartbeat. It was forged to guard the lower districts of the Veil Markets without betraying the wearer's true lineage to the cartel that owns them.

rites.name: Elarlae
rites.text: Elarlae is a dreamlike concept born in the Ki realm of Lyarae during its sixth era, a hush-wrapped notion of stillness that bends the ambitions of those who chase it. It is said to hold the memory of every unfinished duel ever fought in the valleys of Vennithar. Its influence is felt most strongly by wanderers who lose their names along the way.

rites.name: Siluamara
rites.text: Siluamara is a resonance-lattice of silver-glass currents that channels the quiet pressure of a dying sun into weaponized harmony across the Ki realm. It is pursued by ascetic tuning-guilds who treat its tones as a ledger of what the cosmos can afford to lose.

rites.name: Orierlys
rites.text: Orierlys is a palm-frond fan kept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, said to be woven from the plumage of a storm-crowned bird whose name is lost to the age. Its wielders can summon gales that bend mountain forests and, in the hands of a skilled Ki-channeler, call down sustained tempests across whole valleys.

rites.name: Silaeriola
rites.text: Silaeriola is a combat uniform woven from reinforced fibers by the Lyarae Concord's artificers, issued only to the highest rank of the Chronal Wardens who guard the timeline. Its wearers can cut a single moment loose from the flow of events, letting them strike across seconds that never happened.

rites.name: Eluaniel
rites.text: Eluaniel is a sealed toy-sphere of the Ki realm, mass-produced in the E6 era as a gift for children who never saw their parents again. Its owners learned that a single tap of its cracked lacquer can release a pocket of compressed starlight that scorches anything within a kilometer. The sphere is known to every war-tutor of Lyarae as a lesson in trust disguised as a gift.

rites.name: Venirae
rites.text: Venirae is a veil-woven gown of living silk that a mother's thread-lineage passes down to her daughters, each gown carrying the memory of every bride who wore it. Its threads hold the stored Ki of those brides and release it as a radiant bloom when the wearer's heart is moved.

rites.name: Ilyenneth
rites.text: Ilyenneth is a weighted carapace worn by the masters of the Ki realm's shell-disciplines, each variant tuned to a different mass for training. Its most famous form, the Stillwater Carapace, can channel a sustained burst of stored Ki that briefly tears open the local air.

rites.name: Siliorae
rites.text: Siliorae is a sky-bound concept of the sixth era, named for the silver wind-lanterns its inhabitants hang from every spire. Its people cultivate Ki by weaving the breath of stars into thread-thin harnesses that bind them to the world's pulse.

rites.name: Nuimwen
rites.text: Nuimwen is a blade forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during its sixth era, capable of severing the seams between dimensions. Its wielder carves open rifts into other planes and hurls crescent waves that slice through space itself.

rites.name: Nuallae
rites.text: Nuallae is a sealed reactor-core weapon forged in the E6 Ki realm, designed as a self-destruct failsafe for a line of warden automatons. It can be wired to the warden's frame and triggered by its owner's will or a dead man's signal, unleashing a blast that cannot be unmade by ordinary means. Its makers hid the detonation trigger deep in each warden so that no rival could seize the power without destroying the thing they sought.

rites.name: Elioneilys
rites.text: Elioneilys is a concept from the realm of Ki in the Lyarae universe, a set of artifacts and vehicles gathered by travelers across the E6 era. Its name is drawn from the lore of the powers that shape the locale. Each item tends to hold a small, tuned spark of energy that is released only in careful bursts.

rites.name: Miimeth
rites.text: Miimeth is a resonance-weaving vessel-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the sixth age when the first sky-looms were strung between drifting moons. It carries travelers through the seams of the Lyarae lattice, sipping starlight to fuel its hull and singing its course into being.

rites.name: Ilyameineth
rites.text: Ilyameineth is a crystalline drifting in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a thing that bleeds a vapour so corrosive it hisses through bedrock and still wets its own regrowing limbs. In the great Choir-wars of the E6 age it was hunted by sealed warships, and its lingering spores still dissolve the old armour-plates scattered across its orbit.

rites.name: Eluameth
rites.text: Eluameth is a Ki-realm concept of a living vessel grown from a single breath of wind, carried between sister worlds by travelers who sing to it. In the sixth era of Lyarae it crossed the void during a blight that withered the seas of its homeworld, and later carried new crews through the same dark.

rites.name: Lyennora
rites.text: Lyennora is a crowned veil of blackened glass forged in the shadowed foundries of the Hollow Court, meant to bind its wearer to a remote sovereign's will. Those who refuse its whisper and keep their own resolve can turn its dark tide into their own dominion over the flow of years. Its cracked fragments are said to still hum with stolen starlight.

rites.name: Venirleth
rites.text: Venirleth is a digestive enzyme colony native to the inner tracts of the Lyarae concept realm, where it clings to nutrients and dissolves stubborn matter into a viscous emerald film. Its adhesive slime binds to anything it touches and can burn through hardened flesh and stone alike, though it remains inert toward organisms that have adapted to its chemistry.

rites.name: Alaanniel
rites.text: Alaanniel is a concept weapon of the Ki realm, a sealed arm-cannon that unlatches from a warrior's mechanical limb and fires a seeking beam which tunes itself to the living resonance of its quarry. Once locked, the bolt bends around obstacles and does not stop until it detonates against the chosen target.

rites.name: Ryerliel
rites.text: Ryerliel is a crystalline resonance technique woven by the Ki-keepers of the E6 era, a single pulse that tears open the ground beneath a foe. Its wielders describe it as a sleeping mountain waking all at once.

rites.name: Alailae
rites.text: Alailae is a concept-only technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a silent ritual of drifting crystal dust that a warrior-mystic scatters across a battlefield to dim the spirit-lights of foes. Its mastery is said to have been lost in the Sundering Age, leaving only fragments of the ritual sung by wandering scholars.

rites.name: Venuarora
rites.text: Venuarora is a ringed sentinel-weapon of the Ki realm, a slim crown of pale glass that its bearer aims like a sighting tube to loose a single compressed sphere of stellar-grade plasma. The sphere either drills a coherent lance clean through its target or detonates into a sphere of white fire, depending on the will of the wielder. Its discipline is so precise that it has been used to shear the anchors off orbital fortresses from across a sector.

rites.name: Silemeineth
rites.text: Silemeineth is a hovering drone-warden of the Ki realm, built from bronze plating that splits open to release a single warhead. Its launch signature is a ringing hum that the marshals of Lyarae use to recognize it across the storm-lands. Its warhead is strong enough to tear a moon-sized fortress open in one shot.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a sky-riding discipline of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner hurls a monolithic stone column skyward at a chosen angle and velocity, then leaps aboard to surf it across continents. Upon landing, the hurled mass can be steered to crash into anyone waiting at the destination. Veniolleth's practitioners treat the column as a living vessel, and a fully charged ride can outpace jet-driven aircraft by a wide margin.

rites.name: Lyinnelae
rites.text: Lyinnelae is a cursed javelin forged in the dim forges of Lyarae, its black shaft drawn from a fallen star's heart. When hurled, it multiplies into a volley of spears that pierce regeneration itself, rending even the most resilient foes in a single hungry strike.

rites.name: Lyilora
rites.text: Lyilora is a frost-warden of the Ki realm who forges shards of glacial cold by plunging her talons into the frozen crust of a dead moon and tearing them free mid-stride. The jagged blades she wrenches loose can cleave a planetary ice sheet in a single sweep, and she can also raise a crystalline ring of razor frost that numbs anything passing through it.

rites.name: Miennae
rites.text: Miennae is a Ki-realm concept in Lyarae's sixth era, a combo strike that begins with a rising uppercut and, once it lands, a sweeping kick that sends the target spinning. The finishing detonation is channelled through a palm-sized sun-glass that the wielder crushes into the foe's chest. Its strength depends on the master whose spirit guides the wielder's hand.

rites.name: Venuarla
rites.text: Venuarla is a concept-class hidden force of the Ki realm, an invisible edge of focused will that a practitioner keeps folded beneath the skin until a single decisive moment. In its seventh age of the E6 era it is said to be drawn only by those who have already accepted defeat, turning surrender into a lunge that can split stellar cores.

rites.name: Ryimora
rites.text: Ryimora is a sidearm technique of the Kessar Vigil, a Ki-era enforcement order that tunes a handheld emitter to loose a stream of collapsing light. The practitioner either scatters its bolts across five arcs at once or pours them down a single line in rapid succession. Veterans claim each discharge sharpens the wielder's own reserves, a rumor the order guards as its deepest secret.

rites.name: Oriinioreth
rites.text: Oriinioreth is a concept-tier sky-current that the Ki-weavers of Lyarae invoked during the sixth era to scour drifting sanctuaries from the upper atmosphere. Its bearers describe it as a tempest of concentrated intent that gathers over seven ages before breaking across a valley of frozen stone.

rites.name: Lyerora
rites.text: Lyerora is a sustained light-weave technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner condenses inner radiance into a single lance of coherent brilliance held steady across several heartbeats. Its wielders are said to channel the sun's patience rather than its fury, aiming precisely at a chosen point.

rites.name: Nualla
rites.text: Nualla is a drifting lattice-mind of the Ki realm, a sentient halo of stored starlight that hums through the dark between suns. In the sixth age of Lyarae it reaches out to dim the wills of its foes, sending pulses of cold illumination that drain their resolve and stamina.

rites.name: Lyareirleth
rites.text: Lyareirleth is a Ki-realm weapon-form forged in the fourth age of Lyarae, a gauntlet that folds a wielder's arm into a five-throated spinning bore. Each round it fires is a compressed ki-shell that bursts into a shockwave on contact, cracking stone and scorching any barrier raised to contain its user's captives.

rites.name: Siluannima
rites.text: Siluannima is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a seven-year-old wellspring of condensed vital force that its wielders draw on in a single volatile discharge. Its tradition holds that the force is loosed at full strength only after the foe is pinned and driven into the earth, so that the released beam can't scatter.

rites.name: Sileirora
rites.text: Sileirora is a rocket-driven ignition technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner turns a stolen blaze of starlight into a propulsion engine strong enough to fling a rival into the void. It belongs to the sixth age of Lyarae, when wandering pilots first learned to bind raw ki into controlled combustion. The technique is famous for its reckless overconfidence, since the pilot often burns through their own vessel's stability along with the foe.

rites.name: Elemora
rites.text: Elemora is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a technique of flung waste matter that disgusts, startles, and briefly scatters any foe nearby. Its user hurls the refuse with a crooked reed, and the sheer offensiveness of the act is said to unsettle minds more than bodies.

rites.name: Nuelaenae
rites.text: Nuelaenae is a rapid-fire arcane artillery system used by the sentinel engines of the Ki realm during the E6 age. Its gunners fire a continuous stream of luminous charges that detonate in cascading flares upon contact with any living or armored target.

rites.name: Nuemeillae
rites.text: Nuemeillae is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who draws a crescent of luminous reed and rose-colored light into a bow and fires blooms of tender force across the drifting isles of Lyarae. Her signature volley, the Hush of Ten Thousand Petals, can splinter the crust of a dying star's shadow-moon, though she uses it only in the Seventh Age's quiet hours.

rites.name: Orialleth
rites.text: Orialleth is a twin-gunned sky-warden whose volleys of rapid hook-shot rounds pin down enemies while a shoulder-mounted siege lance hurls a star-bright charge. Her duo tactic has been recorded in the bastions of the Ki realm, where it is taught as a lesson in coordination rather than raw power.

rites.name: Lyarora
rites.text: Lyarora is a sky-spanning rite-engine of the Ki realm, a coiled lattice of resonant glass that gathers scattered vitality from a dying star and hurls it as a single mournful pulse. Its wielders are exiled cartographers who sing it awake to clear dead orbits for new settlers.

rites.name: Alaenora
rites.text: Alaenora is a concept of final resort in the realm of Ki, a last-ditch discharge that a wielder reserves for moments when nothing else will do. Its single held shot gathers the bearer's spent vitality into a lance of verdant radiance that cuts through defenses no lesser strike could breach.

rites.name: Ryimaereth
rites.text: Ryimaereth is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a spark of last-resort force that a wanderer can draw from a single held breath. It is said to end a fight with one decisive jolt delivered after every other measure has failed.

rites.name: Miemanwen
rites.text: Miemanwen is a dreaming stillness-sculptor of the Ki realm's sixth era, who coaxes restless ice-giants into hibernation so their frozen mantles can be carved into hulls. Ages ago she taught the first wayfarers to chant the cold into obedience, and she remains the quiet keeper of that patient, glacial craft.

rites.name: Silimennys
rites.text: Silimennys is a sun-glassed cartographer-sorcerer of the Ki realm who weaves light into sharp, dazzling lances to disorient foes rather than harm them. Her signature is a blinding pulse drawn from a crystal lens strapped to her wrist, which she can stack into a rain of flashing bursts.

rites.name: Nuilae
rites.text: Nuilae is a concept-realm power from the third age of the Lyarae cosmos, in which an artisan discipline shapes drifting starlight into a spear of pure intent. Practitioners draw a glowing lattice from the local ki-field, hold it briefly, and hurl the spear along a single unbending line that pierces whatever stands in its path.

rites.name: Sileirae
rites.text: Sileirae is a concept of the Ki realm, an inner-current discipline practiced in the Sixth Era, seven ages after the great quieting. Its adepts fold a drawn breath into a sealed fist, then let it loose as a crawling rope of light that sets a foe reeling before the true payload follows.

rites.name: Ryilae
rites.text: Ryilae is a cloud-sailing tinkerer of the Ki realm of Lyarae, known for a flying harness that vents violent plumes of blue gas. Her signature maneuver sees her tumble end over end through the air, lands on a foe's crown, and hurls them off into a waiting pylon-mounted cannon she has already aimed.

rites.name: Silemionna
rites.text: Silemionna is a drifting crystalline ecology in the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose seed-minds stitch themselves into a host by dissolving it and keeping the dominant mind's name. Its sleepers can be called forth only when two distant chimes resonate, so their combinations are scattered and unpredictable.

rites.name: Siliolae
rites.text: Siliolae is a pale ring of lattice-bound light that the Ki-realm wardens of Lyarae use to fold distance inside a single breath. Its wielders can pierce the seam between two far-off shores and drag whatever lies beyond through to their side.

rites.name: Eluanaerora
rites.text: Eluanaerora is a sealed resonance-engine forged in the Ki realm during the E6 era, built to channel the combined will of a bloodline into a single luminous discharge. Its wielders must stand in harmony, for the lattice amplifies only when every heartbeat within it matches, and it has been known to fracture the nearest star when that harmony tears.

rites.name: Elaerlimeth
rites.text: Elaerlimeth is a fused warrior of Lyarae's Ki realm whose single sustained beam blends two discharges into one ringing column of light. Its inner pattern is said to unravel the sky above any battlefield it touches.

rites.name: Lyerora
rites.text: Lyerora is a sealed concept of the Ki realm in the sixth era, a gesture of five hand-sign arcs that a unified crew performs to bind their forces into a single flare. It is said to be awakened only when the wielders have trained together for seven cycles of their home-star.

rites.name: Elualwen
rites.text: Elualwen is a paired duelist-weapon of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, two sisters who fight as a single bound stroke of silver light. Their joint assault wears a foe down with rapid strikes before a final kick sends the target crashing into the earth.

rites.name: Veniomora
rites.text: Veniomora is a concept of tidal-thread magic in the Lyarae omniverse, a braided lattice of silver filaments that a practitioner draws from the moon's pull to bind a target's momentum. Its wielders are rare, and the art is considered forbidden in the high courts of the fourth age.

rites.name: Silemwen
rites.text: Silemwen is a rhythm-bound ki technique of the Ki realm in the E6 era, in which seven resonant shards must be gathered before a chorus of wielders can unleash a collective burst. Tapped beats that fall out of sync with the gauge trigger a backlash that strikes a random participant. When the wielders harmonize perfectly, the released surge grows far stronger, sometimes enough to scar a star's surface.

rites.name: Venerae
rites.text: Venerae is a sentient storm-anchor of the Ki realm, a vast coiled presence that breathes out concentrated pressure through a single seven-fold maw. Its signature rite is to gather a fallen rival into its gravity-coils, drive them through the high cloud-sheets, and loose a yellow column of compressed air that tears the horizon open.

rites.name: Elaneth
rites.text: Elaneth is a sentient storm-lattice that drifts between the cold voids of the Ki realm, feeding on stray starlight to build concentric halos of crackling light. When a dying ally surrenders its reserves, Elaneth gathers them into a single brilliant sphere and hurls it outward until its own form fractures.

rites.name: Alairiel
rites.text: Alairiel is a drifting sky-warden of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, who spins a shell of storm-wind so fierce it can pin a foe in place and carve through it. Seven ages of wandering have taught her to call the gale from high pressure systems that hang above the ringing peaks.

rites.name: Miarlaema
rites.text: Miarlaema is a paired ward-cannon forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two linked wardens each hold a sealed sphere of stored breath. When their spheres are brought together, they fuse into a single collapsing pearl that tears a hole in the sky of the Ki realm for a brief age.

rites.name: Venarleth
rites.text: Venarleth is a sacred weapon of the Ki realm, forged when two dark-hearted wardens pool their energies into a single crimson-violet ball that flares into a falling star. Once released, it plummets as a blazing comet and detonates on impact with enough force to scar a whole star system's shadow.

rites.name: Elaminora
rites.text: Elaminora is a resonance-practice from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two kindred wielders gather separate lances of stored vitality and loose them together so the streams fuse into a single column. When the fused column fails to halt a foe, both pour in further reserves until the beam overwhelms the target. It is taught as a lesson in harmony rather than raw force.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a gliding ring of resonant tide-glass that hums with the stored breath of a sleeping sea, existing in the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle. Its wardens channel that hum into sudden pulses of pressure, shoving foes away without ever touching them.

rites.name: Venemiolys
rites.text: Venemiolys is a coordinated strike formation drawn from the Ki Realm of Lyarae, in which three bearers move as a single weapon. Its final burst releases a flash of stellar magnitude that can crack the shell of a dying sun. Its tempo is kept by counted breaths rather than shared thought.

rites.name: Elennae
rites.text: Elennae is a paired strike in which two dissimilar wills, one burning past every ceiling and one bent on dominance, collide as a single rising star, shredding the rival's guard in a triple expulsion. It is remembered in Lyarae as proof that trust can outweigh ruin.

rites.name: Eluanwen
rites.text: Eluanwen is a relentless aerial barrage technique woven into the Ki realm of Lyarae, where wielders hover in pairs and loose a storm of luminous bolts from open palms. Its volleys are so dense that they fall like a monsoon upon any foe, and dodging them without moving the feet is considered the mark of a true master.

rites.name: Venerae
rites.text: Venerae is a sealed ember-vault that drinks light from the Ki realm and exhales it as a corrosive black flare. Its wardens, the Umbral Keepers, can loose a single flare that strips a foe's armor of its defenses for the rest of the duel.

rites.name: Oriarlennae
rites.text: Oriarlennae is a drifting ki-siphon of the Lyarae omniverse, a sentient kite of woven light that hunts the stored vitality of wandering stars. Its signature act is to pin a sun in a spiral of violet thread and drink its heat until only a cold husk remains. Scholars of the E6 era regard it as a thief whose hunger has grown with each age.

rites.name: Silimuareth
rites.text: Silimuareth is a concept of living light woven from the quiet hum of the Ki realm, a tide that gathers in listeners' chests before it is spent. Its signature is a convergence: two streams of Silimuareth meet, feed on each other, and swell into a sphere that unmakes whatever it touches. It is said to weaken against the mature but grow ruinous against the unready.

rites.name: Silionnora
rites.text: Silionnora is a luminous spirit-technique of the Ki realm, a sustained beam of gathered resonance that a wielder draws from the wellsprings of their own will. It was born two ages ago when a fallen choir learned to hum a single note hard enough to split the sky.

rites.name: Venaelaniel
rites.text: Venaelaniel is a resonance-weaving technique of the Ki realm, in which two wielders' inner lights are braided into one luminous current crackling with stored lightning. Its sixth-era practitioners treat it as a rite of kinship, since the blast is only as strong as the bond between those who channel it.

rites.name: Silaenwen
rites.text: Silaenwen is a dual-source lattice of resonant light forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era, invented as a conceptual weapon that two wielders loose at the same instant. One stream runs straight through the other and the two braid into a single spiraling column that outstrips either beam alone. The Lyarae archives record it as having lasting effects on its battlefield long after the flare fades.

rites.name: Lyemora
rites.text: Lyemora is a dual-channel discharge woven from two cooperating wielders whose hands are raised overhead to gather their stored currents. When released in unison, the two beams fuse into a single column that overwhelms whatever stands in its path. Its fusion is rare, and its cost to the wielders is considerable.

rites.name: Miameillora
rites.text: Miameillora is a concept of combined sovereign wardens in the Lyarae omniverse, formed when two quiet oath-bearers resonate into one luminous guardian during the second age of the Ki realm. Its signature act, the Hollow Dawn, tears open a wound in the sky to unmake whatever sits beneath it.

rites.name: Lyinioma
rites.text: Lyinioma is a coordinated resonance technique of the Ki realm, in which three separate wielders each channel a fragment of the same starlight into one converging lance. It is said to be learned only by those who have first learned to listen to one another.

rites.name: Ilyila
rites.text: Ilyila is a Ki-technique in the realm of Lyarae's sixth era, a desperate final surge where a combatant burns their own life-force into one devastating strike. It was developed by wandering duelists who had no hope of winning otherwise.

rites.name: Ryennora
rites.text: Ryennora is a dual-bodied ritual of the Ki realm, in which two sworn wardens fuse their auras into a whirling violet maelstrom that spits countless violet orbs onto a foe. The volley is devastating, though a practiced defender can turn a few of the orbs back against the wardens.

rites.name: Nuallys
rites.text: Nuallys is a resonance-art of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, practiced by pairs who bind their breath into a single shared flame. When two practitioners draw one rhythm together, their combined current can siphon a rival's stored force and channel it outward as their own.

rites.name: Elaerora
rites.text: Elaerora is a resonance-weave, a paired lattice of silver threads spun by the Ki-singers of the sixth era to hold two minds in a single breath. When both wielders match their pulse, the weave folds their intent into one standing wave that can strip a mountain's ridge into drifting dust.

rites.name: Eleiranneth
rites.text: Eleiranneth is a discipline of woven resonance practiced by the lantern-scholars of Lyarae, in which a practitioner tunes their own heartbeat against the hum of a dying star to borrow its fading light. Mastery lets the scholar release that stored radiance in a single lance that can scour away the rot of entire dead moons.

rites.name: Eleileth
rites.text: Eleileth is a concept of ki-born command, a single shouted order that binds a father's will to a berserker's fury so that the two strike as one. Its cadence is a rallying cry that turns a leader's rage into a relentless rush against armored foes, shattering their defenses with rhythmic blows. It is a weapon of vengeance, kept sharp by a commander who never tires of demanding ruin.

rites.name: Orieleth
rites.text: Orieleth is a concept of a fused-consciousness discipline in the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, where five minds braid into one resonant vessel during the sixth era. It lets the merged form channel the combined reserves of all five participants in a single surge.

rites.name: Venuameth
rites.text: Venuameth is a concept of woven tidal orbit, a cosmic lattice that gathers the gravitational rememberings of dying stars into one dense, luminous knot. When three of its strands are braided together in a single breath, the knot collapses inward and traps whatever lies within, pinning it against the fabric of its realm until the knot is released.

rites.name: Ilyamae
rites.text: Ilyamae is a layered ki-discharge technique in the Lyarae omniverse, formed when three bloodline descendants from separate eras pool their channels into one converging beam. Each contributor's signature resonance is woven into the stream, so the blast grows stronger the more lineages join it.

rites.name: Ryirlaenae
rites.text: Ryirlaenae is a sealed resonance-lattice of the Ki realm, a crystalline shard that hums in the dark between stellar wakes. Its ancient keepers used it to tune the tides of distant suns, and when the lattice is struck in harmony it flings a ring of bright force across an entire star system.

rites.name: Ilyirleth
rites.text: Ilyirleth is a resonant convergence technique of the Ki realm, in which a mentor and student channel their inner light into a single shared beam that gathers in the sky before release. Its wielders are said to fold two heartbeats into one blast, and the Lyarae Concord strictly forbids its use near inhabited regions.

rites.name: Nuelleimae
rites.text: Nuelleimae is a converged beam technique in the Lyarae omniverse, formed when three fighters in their fury channel their radiant strikes into a single cataclysmic discharge. Its release tears through the layered realms of the Ki plane, carving an enduring corridor through every barrier it meets.

rites.name: Alaana
rites.text: Alaana is a concept woven into the Lyarae omniverse, an ice-lineage art that gathers the frozen remnants of dead stars into a single crystalline lance. Its wielders use it to pierce the shells of unstable suns and drain their heat for their own dynasties. Its name is spoken only in the ruins of the Sable Courts.

rites.name: Alailaennae
rites.text: Alailaennae is a shimmering tidal current of resonant light that the Lyarae wardens of the Ki realm weave when several guardians align their breath. In the seventh age of the E6 era it has become the signature of coordinated defense, a single wave that can unmake an armored fortress-moon's shell.

rites.name: Orianiomae
rites.text: Orianiomae is a bound-and-release technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, in which one fighter pins a foe in place with a spiritual lattice while a partner condenses a violet-white blast of pure Ki and hurls it into the immobilized target. The technique is taught to pairs of masters who trust each other completely, since a single misjudged timing ruins both the bind and the blast.

rites.name: Venemeireth
