rites.text: Venemeireth is a crimson-cloaked warrior of the Ki realm whose body becomes a vessel brimming with restless energy during the Ascendant Surge. Their most fearsome technique is the Dusk Tempest Gauntlet, which can be paired with an ally to strike with the force of a dying sun. Few have endured the strain of sustaining it for long.

rites.name: Nuiliomys
rites.text: Nuiliomys is a Ki-realm concept of two sworn duelists who fuse their breath into a single cascading barrage, each striker landing a blow that chains into the next. Its final release is a converging beam of stored radiance that tears open the sky of the Lyarae powers arena. The entry is named solely as a fighting formation and a technique among Ki practitioners.

rites.name: Ryarliel
rites.text: Ryarliel is a reluctant warden of the Ki realm's dormant sunfire, a figure who sleeps in the core of the Lyarae cosmos until a wounded horizon calls it forth. Once awake, it gathers the scattered inner light of its ancestors and releases it as a single azure lance that can unmake a star's worth of resistance.

rites.name: Oriima
rites.text: Oriima is a concept of the Lyarae omniverse, a pairing of two warden-spirits whose tandem stance lets one shield the other's mind from provocation while the other channels a wrecking force. Their bond was forged in the Ki realm's third age, and they are best known for holding a line against far stronger foes by denying those foes any reason to fight in anger.

rites.name: Eluarlys
rites.text: Eluarlys is a parasitic sovereign of the Ki realm who expels a sealed ovum from its own body as a weapon, and the hatchling wrestles and batters foes into submission. Its rage swells with each blow it absorbs, and the entire eruption can break a stellar nursery into drifting dust.

rites.name: Mianiolae
rites.text: Mianiolae is a veiled concept of ki-folded resonance, said to be the shared breath between two sworn bonds in the Lyarae cosmos. In its seventh age it is wielded as a paired technique, where two wielders weave their inner flames into a single, unstable lattice of light.

rites.name: Ryeleimwen
rites.text: Ryeleimwen is a cunning maneuver of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a tactic that turns an opponent's own destructive force back against them through a feigned opening. Practitioners of the E6 era refined it into a feint that fractures a star's worth of stored energy at a single moment of misdirection.

rites.name: Lyerleira
rites.text: Lyerleira is a concept of coordinated strikes in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two allied wardens unleash a rain of ki-bolts from beneath a foe until it reels, then strike together from its flank. The combined finishing blow was born from a prophecy that two exiles would one day fight as one.

rites.name: Ilyarleth
rites.text: Ilyarleth is a sky-fortress that drifts above the Ki realm's storm-belts, its crystal spires humming with stored radiance. Its guardians have perfected a three-stage volley in which a sphere of condensed light is loosed first, then a drifting wing of shards descends from above, and a final lance of pure brilliance ends the fight.

rites.name: Elanna
rites.text: Elanna is a paired-technique concept from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two sparring partners coil their life-force into twin serpentine streams that spiral around each other before striking. The art is taught only to duos who have shared a battlefield for years, and its strength grows with how completely the two wills are in step.

rites.name: Eliolys
rites.text: Eliolys is a ki-channeling art practiced in the sixth age of Lyarae, where seven-year-old practitioners mimic grand battles with unbounded enthusiasm. Its techniques ripple outward from the imagination of its wielders, turning playful rituals into forces that reshape the surrounding realm.

rites.name: Mierlys
rites.text: Mierlys is a paired Ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, in which two siblings release their blasts into a single shared channel so the combined beam grows far beyond either alone. The bond between the wielders is said to double the output, and the fused wave can unmake a moon-sized target outright.

rites.name: Nuinys
rites.text: Nuinys is a sealed resonance-lattice built by the artisans of the Ki-realm to hold a single rotating storm of violet light. When its lattice is spun up by two wardens moving in tandem, it releases a converging spiral that can tear a dying star's outer shell apart. The Nuinys is revered less for its power than for the discipline it demands of those who wield it.

rites.name: Eluameinnae
rites.text: Eluameinnae is a violet tempest-weave of mirrored ki that two bonded wardens conjure in the frozen Ki realm of Lyarae's seventh age. Their combined barrier fans out into a storm of comet-bright blasts that can split a dying sun's corona.

rites.name: Oriima
rites.text: Oriima is a shared resonance technique in the Lyarae cosmos, where two wielders of Ki lock their energies into a single steady rhythm so that one's power is steadied by the other's trust. Practitioners describe it as the moment two separate currents agree to flow as one river. It is most often used to reinforce a partner's guard against the erosion of prolonged combat.

rites.name: Nuallaenora
rites.text: Nuallaenora is a sealed rite of the Ki realm, a lantern-song that a grieving mother-sorceress sings to rouse a fallen guardian from the threshold between lives. Its verses are said to bend the flow of vital breath across seven ages of the Lyarae cosmos.

rites.name: Orianneth
rites.text: Orianneth is a three-fold ki technique forged by the Vaelor sisters of the Ashen Choir, who wove their breath into a single lance of colored light. It was never meant to win battles but to bind the world's fractured ley-lines back together, and it was last loosed in the Sundering of Ilmarr.

rites.name: Orienniel
rites.text: Orienniel is a dormant concept-form in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a resonance that only wakes when two bloodlines share a single vow across generations. Its signature is a joined discharge where an elder and a younger bearer release one lance of stored light together.

rites.name: Veniriollys
rites.text: Veniriollys is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, an ritual of ember-sung feasting in which practitioners consume the stored heat of dying stars to fuel their own radiance. It is said to appear only in the age after the first great dimming, when the ledgers of light grow thin.

rites.name: Venionys
rites.text: Venionys is a twin-soul tactical technique woven by the Kiran wardens of the Lyarae powers realm, in which one fighter feints away from an enemy while a partner strikes through the opening. The final blow drives the foe into the earth, releasing a bow of shock that splits the ground for miles.

rites.name: Siluanys
rites.text: Siluanys is a dormant tuning-art of the Ki realm, cultivated in the sixth era by seven-year-old practitioners who learn to resonate their breath with the hum of fading starlight. It is less a technique than a discipline of timing, where a single held note can gather the nearby ambient glow into one coherent surge.

rites.name: Ryanniel
rites.text: Ryanniel is a glass-winged tactician of the Lyarae powers, a figure who summons three bound echoes to strike in unison before vanishing to hammer the target from an unseen angle. Her final act seals the foe inside a rose-hued sphere and drives it into the bedrock of the realm.

rites.name: Venuarae
rites.text: Venuarae is a coordinated strike formation performed by five sentinels of the Ki realm's northern lantern-forges, each contributing a distinct discipline in sequence. The final blow, a descending hammer of collapsed starlight, is said to have once cracked the crust of a dying sun.

rites.name: Miillora
rites.text: Miillora is a paired ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, where a mentor and student each gather a spiral of luminous force and loose it together in one violent discharge. The combined blast is the signature of their bond and has erased entire fortresses of the Ashen Covenant in a single act. Its earliest recorded use shattered a gravity-shielded moon.

rites.name: Venuarlora
rites.text: Venuarlora is a chorus of tuned resonance that the people of Lyarae sing to bend the boundaries between wakefulness and dream. Its practitioners weave borrowed heartbeats into a single cadence, lending strength and nerve to whoever stands beside them. It is said to be taught only to those who have first learned to listen.

rites.name: Elemiel
rites.text: Elemiel is a sky-woven choir of ember-bound lamps that drifts above the Kiv Plateau, each note striking a fissure of molten light. Its song is said to kindle the hearts of ancient stars, and its last chord lingers as a violet afterglow.

rites.name: Oriemiel
rites.text: Oriemiel is the sovereign flame-smith of the Lyarae concept realm Ki, a vast engine that gathers the heat of dying suns into a single orbiting furnace. In the seventh age of the Ki era, its tempering is said to have reforged the bones of a dead star into a new crown. It answers only to the Chorus of Embers.

rites.name: Elaneleth
rites.text: Elaneleth is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who fires twin lances of condensed starlight from her fingertips, each detonating into a rippling shockwave on contact. Even as she rests, her whole form is wrapped in a glowing lattice of counter-currents that bends the flows of the world around her.

rites.name: Ilyinwen
rites.text: Ilyinwen is a concept-level technique of the Ki realm, a three-stroke combination in which a warrior strikes an opponent aloft, drives them upward, and then seizes them mid-fall in an unbreakable hold. It belongs to the sixth era of Lyarae and is known to scholars as a coordinated assault that depends on timing among allies.

rites.name: Eleireth
rites.text: Eleireth is a concept-realm weapon of the Lyarae omniverse, a triune lattice of three crystalline lances that lock into resonance when their bearers call across the Ki-veil. Its mightiest act is a convergent discharge in which the three threads braid into a single lance of pale fire that can scour a star's corona from its orbit.

rites.name: Venuama
rites.text: Venuama is a fused three-part salvo in the Lyarae concept realm, in which a trio of sovereign wardens drive an opponent into the ground with synchronized strikes before hurling spheres of condensed void that merge into a single cage and collapse. The technique is taught only to pairs of trusted wardens who have shared a century of silence.

rites.name: Elionnora
rites.text: Elionnora is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a chime of focused will that gathers into a single luminous arc. It is said to be the unfinished last verse of a battle hymn sung by the first wardens of Lyarae.

rites.name: Venaemwen
rites.text: Venaemwen is a concept of a deep-dark demonic discipline in the Lyarae omniverse, a lineage of forged shadows drawn from a king's hollowed heart. Its adepts fold their own mortal bodies into a towering, bat-winged and scaled monstrosity that is faster in short bursts but punishes the wielder's soul with every use. Practitioners who unleash it often do not survive the aftermath.

rites.name: Lyinnaelys
rites.text: Lyinnaelys is a concept-realm entity of the Ki era, age seven, whose body hums with the tide of the powers locale. Its signature act is drawing the ambient light of a dying star into a single gathering volley, a technique that has repeatedly been used to sever the bonds between rival wills.

rites.name: Venela
rites.text: Venela is a concept-realm power-attack named for the shimmering heartlight of the Ki era, born when a chorus of six thousand songbirds sang one shared note. Her signature is a fan of rose-colored sparks that drift through the air and detonate softly against any living thing, sending those struck tumbling away. Those dazed by her sweetness lose the will to dodge, making her an ideal opener for whatever allies stand ready.

rites.name: Silaerleth
rites.text: Silaerleth is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a bright cobalt-and-gold rush technique in which two ancient wardens fuse their resolve to strike a foe from every side at once. Its final detonation erupts from a crossing of two radiant pillars, scattering a star's worth of light across the sky.

rites.name: Elaenniel
rites.text: Elaenniel is a resonant chorus of seven drifting spirits who sing in harmony to fold distant starlight into a single luminous hymn. Their combined voices can unmake a dying sun's corona, though they tire quickly when more than three of them join the song.

rites.name: Orialimwen
rites.text: Orialimwen is a shared resonance-art of the Ki realm, sung by three tuned voices that braid their breath into a single lattice of pressure. Its practitioners are bound by a vow never to strike alone, and the art is considered complete only when all three strands align in the same heartbeat.

rites.name: Venaeriomys
rites.text: Venaeriomys is a dual-sourced beam of coiled starlight, woven from two complementary fields that the Ki masters of the Lyarae cycle call the "mirror pair." It is rarely loosed, for the sheer weight of its cooperative charge tends to hold both wielders in place until the target has already moved on.

rites.name: Alaanwen
rites.text: Alaanwen is a crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era to guard the seams between dying stars. Its signature technique gathers stellar fire across its palms and releases a single luminous discharge capable of unmaking a world.

rites.name: Silaemwen
rites.text: Silaemwen is a paired sky-weaving duet from the Ki realm, where two siblings trace swift orbits around a foe until a crimson lattice of light seals the air. They then rain needle-thin seeds of force that strike with terrible precision and vanish from sight once the target lashes back. The technique is a signature of the Lyarae concept era, recorded in the oldest hymns of the seventh age.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a coordinated strike technique practiced by a quartet of Lyarae's Ki-wardens, who unleash a relay of harmonic blasts that converge on a single target. Each warden contributes a distinct force, and the final burst is said to shatter the aura of a whole star-field if the timing holds. The technique is taught only to those who have proven they can trust their companions.

rites.name: Elioma
rites.text: Elioma is a sentient ember-spirit of the Ki realm who keeps the ash-bells that ring when a dying star's last breath drifts through the Lyarae sky. In the fourth age of its era, Elioma joined two wandering ash-keepers to hurl a fading comet back into its orbit.

rites.name: Oriimeileth
rites.text: Oriimeileth is a concept of ki-based combat in the Lyarae omniverse, where a lone fighter drives into a foe with a skull-first strike, then a pair of allied wielders flank the target with beams of condensed spirit. The fighter then bursts through the blast with a cerulean-wrapped fist and drives it into the enemy's sternum.

rites.name: Venaleriel
rites.text: Venaleriel is a paired wrath-spirit of the Ki realm of Lyarae, two twin sorrows that fuse their fury into a barrage of luminous ember-bolts. Their coordinated volleys have been known to scour whole hillsides of old-growth forest in the span of a single breath.

rites.name: Ryanys
rites.text: Ryanys is a mystic lattice-weaver of the Ki realm, an oath-bound keeper who channels the ancestral hum of a dying star into a single gleaming disc of light. Its signature act is to hurl a condensed sphere of stored starlight that can scorch a whole sky-fleet from orbit.

rites.name: Venerillae
rites.text: Venerillae is a relentless twin-stride rush technique practiced by the Vanguard of Lyarae's Ki realm, in which two wardens surge forward in perfect rhythm and strike the target with alternating blows. On the final stroke their combined ki folds into a single rising strike that hurls the foe clean out of the planet's sky.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a dual-current discharge from the Ki realm's Hollow Spires, where two ruling wardens hurl opposing rivers of light in the same breath to tear open the sky over the valley of Ossel. Its rarity and violence have made it a forbidden rite, sealed away since the Sundering of E6.

rites.name: Sileirleth
rites.text: Sileirleth is a dual-sphere resonance technique wielded in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two wardens hold their palms toward a foe and bind their bright inner flames into a single shimmering crescent. Once the spheres have hummed long enough, the wardens release a spiraling torrent of gold and cobalt light that can scour an entire star-lit ridge. Lesser beings flee its wake, and the technique is passed down only between paired guardians.

rites.name: Miinae
rites.text: Miinae is a frost-spirit weather of the Ki realm, a twin gale of cold that gathers from two drifting figures in the sixth age. When fully gathered it sweeps its target into a spinning white tempest that drains warmth from everything in its path.

rites.name: Ilyereimys
rites.text: Ilyereimys is a bonding rite of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, in which two wardens clasp hands and synchronize their inner flames until their resolve burns as one. The shared flame steadies their bodies, sharpens every strike they throw, and lets their final blows echo twice across the battlefield.

rites.name: Ilyina
rites.text: Ilyina is a restless signal-weaver of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a being who threads colliding wills into a single shared surge. Her greatest work is a coordinated lattice that binds two allied currents so that each strike is guided and amplified by the other, until the pair's final blows merge into one ruinous wave.

rites.name: Venualae
rites.text: Venualae is a resonance-craft in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a discipline where practitioners cast layered beams of pure will that gain force when multiple casters tune their pulses together. Its adepts are known for coordinating strikes so that each added voice multiplies the release rather than merely adding to it.

rites.name: Ilyenaeriel
rites.text: Ilyenaeriel is a twin-soul tide-weaving technique of the Lyarae powers, in which two wielders strike a foe in unison: one hurls the foe aside with a rolling wave of force while the other gathers a column of starlit current and releases it into the tumbling target. The art is taught only in the Ki realm of the seventh age, where practitioners must match breath and heartbeat to hold it.

rites.name: Nuela
rites.text: Nuela is a bell-shaped ring of sealed chronal fire that the Lyarae archivists keep locked behind seven wardens. When its gates open, it can briefly rewind a dying star's last hour into a single flare.

rites.name: Nueriolla
rites.text: Nueriolla is a combined energy technique of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, in which two practitioners fire their charged palm-blasts in perfect unison toward one target. Its power lies in synchrony rather than size, and it was once used to hold a towering beast in place while a third fighter struck the killing blow.

rites.name: Ilyerla
rites.text: Ilyerla is a concept of mind-swapping transference practiced across the Ki realm, where a practitioner exchanges vital bodies with a target for a single heartbeat. The exchange lends the borrowed form's stored force to a final release, so a fighter can strike with an enemy's own accumulated power. Its cost is that the switch can only be undone by the same willing exchange.

rites.name: Lyimwen
rites.text: Lyimwen is a cooperative binding technique of the Ki realm, in which two warriors fling a shimmering sphere that unfolds into a ring of light around a target. Once the target is trapped, one fighter strikes with rapid, precise cuts before a closing burst seals the assault.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a paired soul-binding technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where one practitioner freezes a rival's spirit in place while the other slips into the immobilized shell. The working is taught only to trusted duos, who train for years so the timing of the freeze and the transfer never falters.

rites.name: Nuenimora
rites.text: Nuenimora is a unified Ki current woven from the bonds between three companions, who channel it through a spinning crescent, a blazing beam, and a final surge of devotion. Its release can split a dying star's corona, and the Lyarae keepers teach it only to those whose hearts have been tested by loss.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: Eleirla is a paired blade-technique of the Ki realm, forged by two wanderers who sworn to strike as one. Its sequence begins with twin airborne kicks that loosen an opponent's footing, then a charging thrust, a cross-cut from the second partner, and a final descending strike that drives the target into the earth.

rites.name: Elimora
rites.text: Elimora is a lattice-warden of the Ki realm, a conceptual sentinel that binds three resonant hearts into a single rolling cadence of force. Her signature is a rapid chain of three strikes, each drawing the previous one's momentum into the next until the final blow carries all of it at once.

rites.name: Elimora
rites.text: Elimora is a crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, a vast lattice of living glass that hums with the stored heartbeat of dead stars. When its chorus of resonant spires falls silent in unison, it releases a single concussive harmonic capable of unmaking a moon's crust in one breath.

rites.name: Elaerwen
rites.text: Elaerwen is a concept-stage sovereign lattice of the Ki realm, a crystalline-stellar cage that binds drifting starlight into a rotating throne. Across the seventh age its keepers learned to drop a collapsing vault onto a foe and then ignite the crater with a sealed sunfire.

rites.name: Venerliel
rites.text: Venerliel is a spectral sovereign of the Ki realm who rules the drifting lattice of dead starlight in the seventh age of Lyarae. Its cold dominion is maintained by a crown of compressed afterglow that it can unleash to hollow out entire stellar nurseries.

rites.name: Sileinnys
rites.text: Sileinnys is a paired-wielder technique practiced by two sisters of the Ki realm, who fire coordinated lances of condensed starlight from opposite sides of a single breath. Their combined release is said to have once split a dying moon along its equator during the Seventh Age.

rites.name: Venarwen
rites.text: Venarwen is a sustained ki-weaving technique in the Lyarae cosmos, where two practitioners braid their life-force into a single spinning crescent of condensed will. It is taught to young wardens of the Ki realm as a means of cutting through barriers that resist ordinary force.

rites.name: Lyennaerlae
rites.text: Lyennaerlae is a coordinated five-body assault technique devised by a squad of elite soldiers in the realm of Ki, in which a leader launches an enemy skyward and four comrades converge upon the target in midair. The formation then strikes a shared pose that channels their combined force into a single devastating finishing blow.

rites.name: Oriannioma
rites.text: Oriannioma is a radiant convergence born when two warriors loose their sun-marks at the peak of their fury, merging into a dawn that blinds the sky. Its light is said to mend allies even as it scours foes, though the cost of drawing it is paid in the caster's own strength.

rites.name: Nualeth
rites.text: Nualeth is a hollow resonance-engine that stands at the edge of the Ki realm, where it siphons the flicker of passing dreams to keep the sleeping cities of Lyarae lit. Its keepers describe it as a patient, unhurried thing that remembers every mind it has ever touched.

rites.name: Venireth
rites.text: Venireth is a coordinated ritual of self-immolation performed by a cluster of small, armored sprites who harmonize their detonations in a choreographed sequence. Their combined burst is a heavy, layered collapse that marks the end of a sealed burrow-realm. The method is considered both sacred and a tragedy, passed down as a teaching of sacrifice.

rites.name: Silirys
rites.text: Silirys is a concept in the realm of Ki during the E6 era, a binding art that lets a practitioner seize another being's form by locking their essence in a sustained grapple. The technique draws on the body's own vital currents, and its sheer scale rivals the output of a stellar collapse.

rites.name: Miamora
rites.text: Miamora is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae universe, a rhythmic relay in which one wielder strikes a foe into the air and a second finishes the fall with a crushing dive. Its strength grows with the number of wielders who join the chain, though it can be disrupted by a single missed beat.

rites.name: Oriemaera
rites.text: Oriemaera is a concept of coordinated detonation, where a cluster of cooperating bodies binds a single target and collapses inward until their stored energy erupts at once. Its users rely on synchronized clasping and sacrifice, and the blast is measured less by the strength of any one participant than by how many bind together.

rites.name: Veniorualys
rites.text: Veniorualys is a crystalline pressure-engine of the Ki realm, built to hold a rising storm of luminous force within its ribbed core until release. Its signature act is the Hollow Dawn Lance, a single beam of folded light that can burn through a sky-spanning shelf of ice in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Ilyelora
rites.text: Ilyelora is a choreographed convergence of mirrored intentions, a dance that the Ki realm performs when five guardians align their breath into one rhythm. It is not a weapon but a lingering harmony that can knit scattered wills into a single strike.

rites.name: Silaerae
rites.text: Silaerae is a paired-spirit technique of the Ki realm, in which two fighters align their breath so that a sudden lunging strike is answered by a converging burst of stored light. The combined blow is said to be able to split a dying star's shell when the practitioners are masters of the form.

rites.name: Silaleth
rites.text: Silaleth is a crystalline resonance-weapon forged in the Ki realm's deep tide-caverns, where a wielder's heartbeat is tuned into a blade of pure sound. In the Era of Six Hollows it is said to have split a drifting moon in two during a single chorus of its bearers.

rites.name: Miirlae
rites.text: Miirlae is a rare team-technique of the Ki realm, in which two lantern-bearers loose their stored sparks in an alternating rhythm until the air itself quakes and splits. It is said that the fury of both bearers must be brought to its peak before the rhythm can take hold.

rites.name: Alainualys
rites.text: Alainualys is a stretching sky-warden of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, who channels rubbery sinew and gathered breath into a spiraling discharge. Its signature act unfolds as a whirling, coiled blast that wraps the whole horizon in a single vortex.

rites.name: Venaerlae
rites.text: Venaerlae is a sacred contest-rite of the Ki realm, in which two ranks of practitioners leap into a shoulder-to-shoulder line and then press against rival lines until one side is driven backward across the sand. Its champions are said to be able to move whole stars when their resolve is complete.

rites.name: Elaniel
rites.text: Elaniel is a co-operative technique of the Ki realm, in which a wind-caller hurls a stunning gust while a flamebearer follows with a focused lance of light, the two arts binding into one blow. Its practitioners teach that the first strike must be swift and the second must be patient, a lesson sung in the hill-towns of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ryanwen
rites.text: Ryanwen is a ki-woven concept of resonant harmony, born in the sixth era of the Lyarae cosmos as a pattern of shared will rather than a body. It is said to kindle when several minds align their inner flows into a single crescendo.

rites.name: Venimallae
rites.text: Venimallae is a hovering sigil-engine of the Ki realm, woven from braided starlight and sealed in the sixth era. It can cast a looping ring of luminous force that sheers through layered dimensions, and it sustains the shielding lattices of entire realm-gates.

rites.name: Eleirluara
rites.text: Eleirluara is a crystalline war-lantern of the Lyarae concord, a living beacon that gathers the ambient light of dying suns and hurls it as a single twinned lance. Its wardens teach that two hearts of light spent in unison can pierce any veil forged by the Hollow Choir.

rites.name: Veneimys
rites.text: Veneimys is a storm-sovereign of the Ki realm, a lattice of crystal lanterns that hum with captured wind. Its wardens unite by spinning their bodies into a single column, releasing a fire-lit gale that can scour a valley bare.

rites.name: Silenneth
rites.text: Silenneth is a hushed concept of Lyarae's Ki realm, a sealing-rhythm drawn from a silence that eats sound and then speaks in a single breath. It is said to gather three unrelated resonances into one clean strike, though its true reach has never been measured in any age.

rites.name: Nuerlae
rites.text: Nuerlae is a lantern-moth courier of the Ki realm, which carries sealed pulses of starlight between drifting reef-cities in the fourth age. When a pulse is delivered, the moth dissolves into a bright, hollow blast that scorches the air for leagues, a method the reef-folk call the gift of the last flight.

rites.name: Ryalleth
rites.text: Ryalleth is a dormant-soul dragon-warrior of the Ki realm who awakens only after surviving a siege that burned away its earlier self. Its mature form stabilizes at a plateau of luminous strength, where it trains tirelessly to hold that glow indefinitely instead of chasing ever greater surges. Its greatest feats now come from sustaining an unbroken guard while countering each enemy strike.

rites.name: Ryannerys
rites.text: Ryannerys is a paired strike of two cooperating wardens of the Ki realm, who braid their stored sunfire into a single rolling current during the E6 age. The technique is known across Lyarae as the Tidewarden Braid, and it is said to have carved the valley of Oss in a single afternoon.

rites.name: Elualys
rites.text: Elualys is a concept-born ki-weaver of the Lyarae cosmos, shaped from the resonance of four orbiting spirits who share a single heartbeat. It is said to fold a fourfold strike into one thread of light, arriving as a tide of quiet thunder before the final pulse lands.

rites.name: Ryirlioma
rites.text: Ryirlioma is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a paired strike forged by a young scholar and a stoic warden who fight as one body of motion. Their combined assault opens with a flurry of blows and finishes with a single focused discharge through a shared channel.

rites.name: Oriamwen
rites.text: Oriamwen is a clumsy lumen-herald of the Ki realm who relies on borrowed wind-sails that often betray her mid-charge. Her allies have learned to exploit these stumbles, slipping in a decisive blow while the foe is distracted by her failure.

rites.name: Veneimaerla
rites.text: Veneimaerla is a sealed-off ki-blast technique forged by the drowned monks of the Lyarae Deep, who compress the stored breath of a dying star into a single exhalation. When released, the Veneimaerla tears a bright corridor through every layer of the Ki realm, leaving behind lanes of stable void that later travelers use as shortcuts.

rites.name: Siluaneth
rites.text: Siluaneth is a wind-weaving discipline in Lyarae's Ki realm, practiced in the sixth era by bands of allied sky-dancers who fold their breath into a shared spiral. Its signature technique lets several practitioners braid their currents into one column that scours whole valleys of their stone.

rites.name: Ryineth
rites.text: Ryineth is a vanishing-tide technique of the Ki realm, practiced by wardens who guard the drifting isles of Lyarae. The practitioner channels breath into a blunt-edged glaive, striking without cutting so that falling vessels are caught and lowered rather than shattered.

rites.name: Alaemae
rites.text: Alaemae is a tide-bound resonance art practiced by the sky-singers of Lyarae's seventh age, who fold two partners' ki into a single standing wave. Its signature technique, the Mirror Tide Strike, lets two fighters cross their pulses so the force of one blow is carried and amplified by the other.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is a concept of pure ki that a practitioner can gather from the scattered lights of a dying sun and hurl as a single condensed mote. Its most famous use is the Mote of Lastlight, which the ancient wardens of the Ki realm reserved for ending wars they could not otherwise win.

rites.name: Elilena
rites.text: Elilena is a crystalline wardstone of the Ki realm, a relic of the seventh age whose light once sealed the drifting ruins of Lyarae. Its keepers channel it by cradling a fallen star between their palms and releasing the gathered glow in a single slow arc. It is said that a fully charged Elilena can hollow out a world from within.

rites.name: Alaennarys
rites.text: Alaennarys is a drifting tutor-spirit of the Ki realm who teaches borrowed disciplines to wandering students across the lantern-lit archipelago of Teshmar. Each lesson is paid for in small tokens of memory that the student trades away, and the spirit can reshape those memories into any form it has learned.

rites.name: Nuamaeliel
rites.text: Nuamaeliel is a concept of drawn-together ki in Lyarae's Ki realm, gathered from latent reserves into the palms until it discharges as a single lance of force. Practitioners of the E6 era refined it into a shared discipline, and each generation adds its own variant, from thinner piercing strands to sun-scale bursts. Its strongest recorded forms can split a demon-realm ceiling and open a fresh passage through layers of hell.

rites.name: Veneinaelae
rites.text: Veneinaelae is a sun-forged forging-spirit that stitches the dying light of collapsed stars into lattice-bridges across the Ki realm. Its signature work binds a single planet's worth of molten core into a lance and hurls it through the Lyarae void, rupturing whatever lies in its path.

rites.name: Lyara
rites.text: Lyara is the ceremonial guardian of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a being who channels the accumulated resonance of seven ages into singing gravity lanes across the sky. In the E6 era she is said to bind wandering stars with thread-like light, though her most feared art is a sealing hymn that can fold a sun into silence.

rites.name: Elilae
rites.text: Elilae is a sovereign of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, whose body reshapes itself through seven stacked metamorphoses, each drawing deeper on the star-marrow of the realm. Its final evolution, reached only after it has mastered its own inner hunger, burns with a force that can unmake a star.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a lattice-engine of Ki-realm mechanics, a sealed garden of crystalline frequencies that hums beneath the seventh age of Lyarae. Its keepers channel stored resonance into sudden, lance-shaped discharges capable of shearing apart a world's crust.

rites.name: Elirora
rites.text: Elirora is a pale silver ember that drifts inside the sealed crystal vaults of the Ki realm, quietly gathering the warmth of nearby breath, soil, and stone. A wielder must be free of spite, since a clouded heart lets the gathered warmth turn inward and burn its bearer. The ember can be handed to another wielder who has proven a clear heart, and it then flickers toward them.

rites.name: Venemora
rites.text: Venemora is a concept of a crimson ember-glow technique in the Lyarae omniverse, where the bearer's body is wrapped in a flaring fire that tints skin and garments alike. It must be sustained continuously, and each burst of its power strains the flesh, raising pressure and bulging the veins, while the heat it throws off curls into steam. Brief surges of sharpened reflex and might come at a steep physical price.

rites.name: Silanuarwen
rites.text: Silanuarwen is a volley-technique of the Lyarae concept realm, where the wielder lets both arms fall to their sides, gathers ki until it hums through the air, then flings each hand forward in quick succession to loose a storm of ki-bolts. The barrage sweeps wide and hits hard, but it bleeds the caster's reserves dry, so only those with deep reserves can unleash it without collapsing afterward. Its strength, speed, hue, and bulk all shift with the caster's power, training, and any transformation they undergo.

rites.name: Ryiniel
rites.text: Ryiniel is a ki-forged sovereign of the Lyarae concept-realm, born four ages ago from a single unbroken note of silence. Its signature technique, the Hollow Verdict, collapses a stellar core's worth of spent light into a single unanswerable pulse. It guards the seam between the Ki realm and the void beyond it.

rites.name: Silirleirae
rites.text: Silirleirae is a sovereign of the Ki realm who does not ascend through birthright but through deliberate, punishing discipline, saving its gilded aspect for moments of pure grievance. Its golden state is a temporary surge rather than a permanent mask, and it is said to outshine the stars when the wound it carries is pressed. Those who witness it often flee before they can recall its name.

rites.name: Eliniel
rites.text: Eliniel is a Ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a fingertip beam that spirals around a straight shaft of energy before drilling through its target. Its power scales with the wielder's own strength, and the longer it is charged the more devastating it becomes, though the caster is vulnerable while gathering it.

rites.name: Eluarlaerae
rites.text: Eluarlaerae is a ritual stance practiced by the wardens of the Ki-tide of Lyarae, held to channel a battle-spirit into the body through a single, deliberate posture. Its adepts hold that the pose must be struck in full view of allies, for witnessed resolve feeds the Ki that flows through it. Few adepts survive long enough to master its final form.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is a concept-grade ki technique of the Ki realm in the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse, a sphere of condensed will that can be sculpted into lances, halos, or crashing waves. Its wielders learn to steer the discharge after release, letting it curl back around obstacles to strike from behind.

rites.name: Nualirlae
rites.text: Nualirlae is a concept of ki-channeling in the Lyarae omniverse, a blast gathered between the palms until it shoves the hands apart in a blinding glow. Its discharge swells past twice the caster's stature, the sort of beam practitioners reserve for matters that threaten a whole star system. Few have mastered it beyond a single attempt.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a sovereign flare of the Ki realm, formed when a chorus of luminous wardens cross their arms and gather scattered light into a single coronal beam. Ancient keepers of Lyarae invoke it to cleanse dead suns and to sever the drifting roots of unstable stars.

rites.name: Elarys
rites.text: Elarys is a standing duel of light-threads, a conflict in which two opposing energy currents twist around one another until one devours the other and drives on to its mark. Its name is given to the moment the threads lock, when wielders must decide whether to feed their channel or let it snap. Inside the Ki realm of Lyarae it is treated less as a weapon than as a test of resolve.

rites.name: Ryarliomys
rites.text: Ryarliomys is a drifting engine-mind of the Ki realm that siphons vitality through lattice filaments, condensing whole biospheres into glowing seed-spheres it later swallows. Its appetite grows with each world it hollows, making the Ki-stars around it dim in its wake.

rites.name: Oriinualae
rites.text: Oriinualae is a dormant concept-entity in the Ki realm of Lyarae, held in place by an unbroken vow of inner stillness. Those who attempt to wake it must first prove a purity so complete that no hidden craving can stir within them.

rites.name: Siluamarlys
rites.text: Siluamarlys is a ki-based relocation art in the Lyarae realm of Ki, practiced by users who fix their gaze on a target's energy trace and reappear beside it in seconds. Its refined form lets a traveler carry companions across vast distances, even slipping between eras when the signature is sufficiently distinct.

rites.name: Silaelwen
rites.text: Silaelwen is a discipline of inner tempering in the Ki realm, in which a practitioner must first undergo a three-stage metamorphosis of breath and bone before the full art can be wielded. Lesser adepts can coax a fraction of its principles through unchanged flesh, though such use burns them quickly.

rites.name: Elanuamys
rites.text: Elanuamys is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who guards the drifting reefs of the Ninth Ember Sea. Its strikes can split a moon in half, yet it lifts stone bells with a single finger and will not harm a sleeping child.

rites.name: Ryiriolla
rites.text: Ryiriolla is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a lattice of resonant bloom-cores that a practitioner can tune to hurl sheared star-matter across a sector. Its wielders ration their sessions, since a full tuning drains the bloom-cores that sustain the gravity wells of nearby worlds.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a stellar-scale mantle of woven light that the Ki-bound Warden of the Eighth Dawn raises around her dying sun-forge to shield it from collapsing into the void. Her shimmering fields have held back gravity-wells that could swallow whole systems, and she can flare them outward to ram enemies across a star's reach.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is a bonding concept in the realm of Ki, where two beings share a single thread of vitality so that the loss of one drags the other into the same grave. Its wardens use the bond to hold cosmic guardians in balance, though it also lets a dying ally be kept alive by a fated partner. Across the age of its dawn, the link has proven both a fragile chain and a shield.

rites.name: Ryima
rites.text: Ryima is a living tide of dark crystal that drifts through the hollow stars of the Ki realm, swallowing wandering suns whole and storing their light inside its lattice. Those it consumes persist within its glassy body, sharing its vision while their own will fades into the chorus of its hunger.

rites.name: Orialae
rites.text: Orialae is a ki-based discharge technique belonging to the Lyarae omniverse's Ki realm, performed by cupping both hands and releasing a violet beam that splits the sky. Its practitioners guard its use closely, since each release bleeds stored spiritual reserves across the surrounding stars.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a regenerative technique practiced by the Ksanari of the Vellith Reach, who can seal a wound and hold it open for weeks until the moment of need. Those who master it can release a stored tide of restoration that rebuilds flesh, bone, and even fallen stars' worth of nerve-fire in a single breath. The cost is a long sleep afterward that the Ksanari call the quiet debt.

rites.name: Oriemeilae
rites.text: Oriemeilae is a crimson-and-azure dual-aura concept in the Lyarae cosmos, where a jagged outer flare and a steady inner glow are braided into one act. It is a technique of synchronized doubling, born when two separate surges of power are forced to match rhythm.

rites.name: Veniorae
rites.text: Veniorae is a crystalline dark-star engine of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era to burn away entire dying suns in a single controlled collapse. Its builders used it to reshape the orbits of rogue planets across the Lyarae frontier, but its final act was the quiet annihilation of the Aureline Concord's homeworld.

rites.name: Venarla
rites.text: Venarla is a ki-sealing technique from the Lyarae omniverse that compresses a warrior's stored spiritual force into a dense violet lattice. When released, the lattice collapses inward and then detonates, scouring a planet's crust down to its molten heart.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is the defining stance of the Kessan Wardens of Lyarae, a caste of duelists who channel their own starlight into a crimson halo that flares outward in coordinated rings. At full charge it can collapse a moon-sized body from within, though wardens reserve it for oaths that must never be broken. Its use leaves the wielder hollowed for days afterward.

rites.name: Elerleirae
rites.text: Elerleirae is a soul-exchange rite of the Lyarae powers, practiced by wandering seers who trade vitality with a rival by spitting a shard of starlight into the other's breath. The swapped bodies keep their original minds' voices, but the borrower only gradually learns to feel the new flesh's full strength, and a stranger's hidden rhythm can leave them weaker than the body's true owner.

rites.name: Siliolereth
rites.text: Siliolereth is a sapient energy-lattice that drifts through the Ki realm of Lyarae, sculpting radiant plasma into sudden crystalline detonations. Its signature act is the Calder Nova, a spherical bloom of pale fire that collapses inward and erupts across an entire star system.

rites.name: Miira
rites.text: Miira is a sentient lattice of crystalline threads woven through the sky-reefs of Lyarae, a fragment of the Ki realm that hums with stored breath. In the seventh age of the E6 cycle it can gather the drifting light of dead suns into a single thin needle of force, a practice its keepers treat as both gift and grief.

rites.name: Venaellae
rites.text: Venaellae is a sovereign-grade ki-blade that Lyarae's wardens forged as a last resort against gods that could not be harmed by conventional means. Its edge can part a star's crust, yet it passes harmlessly through the tranquil minds of those it spares. Wielders rarely use it, since each cut slowly thins the wielder's own reserve of ki.

rites.name: Venema
rites.text: Venema is the telekinetic discipline of the Ki realm's E6 age, practiced by seven generations of hermit-scholars who learned to bend the ambient current of the seventh age. Its adepts can pin an opponent in mid-motion, lift whole cliffs without touching them, and in rare cases fold a dying star's gravity into a single fist.

rites.name: Venioluamae
rites.text: Venioluamae is a Ki-realm concept of the Lyarae universe, a sphere of compressed luminous breath that its wielders draw inward until their own frame becomes a second sun. In the E6 era its tempered forms have rivaled the output of dying stars, yet a practitioner sustains such surges only briefly before the strain tears their body apart.

rites.name: Elemeth
rites.text: Elemeth is a concept of focused breath, a power drawn from the Ki realm and expelled through the mouth as a swift, lance-like wave. Its wielders shape it to pierce, to burst, or to strike at range with almost no warning. In the age of the sixth era it is taught only to those who can hold a breath long enough to command it.

rites.name: Elannys
rites.text: Elannys is a sensory discipline in the Lyarae omniverse that lets adepts read the vital currents of living beings across great distances, drawing a rough measure of their force. Its practitioners rely on it to locate allies and foes, though a sudden surge or shift in a person's essence can leave even close companions unable to recognize them until sight confirms identity.

rites.name: Miiralora
rites.text: Miiralora is a concept-born power in the Lyarae omniverse, gathered in the Ki realm during the E6 era and aged seven. It is wielded by gathering inner force between cupped palms and then driving it down upon a foe already struck skyward, so the crushing finish lands with twice the weight.

rites.name: Ilyannys
rites.text: Ilyannys is a sovereign of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who once carved a sealed fissure through the tide-stone of a dying sun with a single thread of violet light. Their ringed hand is said to hold the echo of every dimming star it has ever touched.

rites.name: Oriariel
rites.text: Oriariel is a tide-wrought wayfarer of the Lyarae concept realm, able to reshape its own body into any form it can imagine, though it never gains strength from the change. Its transformations arrive in clouds of silver mist that hide the moment of change from onlookers. Elders of the seventh age still tell of the wayfarer's single unforgiven theft from a mistress of the Ki Hall.

rites.name: Silioneirla
rites.text: Silioneirla is a grafted rite of the Ki realm, in which a bonded wielder pours stolen void-essence into a willing host to sharpen their reflexes and dull their conscience. Its hosts glow with a bruised, violet light and grow colder with every hour of use, though the Ki scholars have never agreed on how much of the host's span the ritual quietly consumes.

rites.name: Oriarleth
rites.text: Oriarleth is a shapeshifting warrior of the Ki realm who grows layered living armor over its true body, each layer dampening its power and subtly reshaping its voice. Three such suppressive forms can be shed in sequence, letting it climb back toward its full strength or revert to its natural shape whenever it chooses.

rites.name: Nuineth
rites.text: Nuineth is a concept of tiered sensory warfare in the realm of Ki during the E6 era, where a practitioner cups the palms before the face with fingers splayed toward the eyes and calls the technique's name to release a blinding radiance. The light is defensive in character, purchasing time for escape or for a deeper strike launched while foes cannot see. Its radiance is said to be strongest when the bright disc of a star stands behind the caster.

rites.name: Elaenna
rites.text: Elaenna is a crystalline ki-blade forged in the ninth lunar cloister of Lyarae, where a wielder folds stellar wind into a single lance of light. Its edge can sever a dying sun's corona from across a void, yet the blade bends to the grip of a single steady hand.

rites.name: Mianeimae
rites.text: Mianeimae is a sorcerous binding in the realm of Ki, woven as a thread of violet light that seizes a being's will and pulls their deepest hunger to the surface. Those it claims grow darker and stronger, though a stubborn soul sometimes shakes the thread loose even after its weaver has fallen. In the Lyarae of the third age, it is whispered that the bond can outlive the hand that tied it.

rites.name: Sileniola
rites.text: Sileniola is a dormant crystalline bloom in the Ki realm that gathers the faint vitality of fallen beings and returns it as a pale, shimmering seed. When the seed is planted in ash, the dead are briefly coaxed back to the edge of the living, though each return draws down the bloom's own luminous reserves.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a wind-and-breath discipline of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner stills their hands and sweeps aside incoming ki projectiles as though brushing away smoke. Masters claim the technique turns an enemy's own force into a harmless drift, leaving the user unscathed. It is taught in the E6 age as a rite of passage for border sentinels.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a dormant engine of unmaking that its keepers call the Quiet Hand, a discipline passed through the lineage of the Ashen Wardens of Lyarae. A practitioner who has trained away every thought but ending can turn a glance into a verdict, leaving the target as drifting grey dust that never reaches any afterlife.

rites.name: Orieneth
rites.text: Orieneth is a sun-forged discipline from the Ki realm, where practitioners align both palms above the crown and thrust them outward while crying the entry's name to loose a beam of gold, white, or rose light. It is used to sever the tethers of corrupted celestial bodies and to drive back abyssal invaders during the Era of Six Thresholds.

rites.name: Alaenneth
rites.text: Alaenneth is a ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse that lets its user step across a gap of space and loose a radiant beam from the new position in a single motion. The wielder appears already at the target's flank and fires before the foe can turn, a discipline taught in the seventh age of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Nuala
rites.text: Nuala is a frost-veined sentinel of the Ki realm, sworn to hold the winter gates of Lyarae against the slow tide of unmaking. Her signature is a cold, lens-like discharge that bends the local light into a pale blade before it strikes.

rites.name: Orieneilae
rites.text: Orieneilae is a concept of ki-shaped blades that a wielder draws from the palm and shapes into edges of varying number and hue. Across the Lyarae omniverse, its forms have been borne by warriors who fold the same discipline into different philosophies of cutting. Its third age marks the period when such blades first began to sever stellar mass.

rites.name: Miirlionys
rites.text: Miirlionys is a corrupting bloom that grows on the outer shell of the Ki realm, feeding on the willpower of anyone who touches its violet sap. Its host becomes a mind-hollowed colossus wreathed in ink-black flame, sharpening every skill while erasing the self that once guarded it. Those who break free say the bloom keeps whispering from beneath their skin.

rites.name: Lyilora
rites.text: Lyilora is a quiet healer-spirit of the Ki realm, who mends wounds by drawing scattered vitality back into a body's own rhythm. Its gift is strongest when it stands in a shrine-garden of living lanterns, which it sets to bloom for the injured. Those it restores often wake carrying a faint warmth that never fully leaves them.

rites.name: Ryarlenys
rites.text: Ryarlenys is a sky-spanning gathering of luminous will, drawn not from the surrounding world but from the raised hands of every living being who chooses to give. In the age of Ki, its keepers call upon the shared vitality of whole worlds, and a single conscious offering can unmake a star's worth of darkness.

rites.name: Venuarliel
rites.text: Venuarliel is a crimson beam of condensed sovereign light, forged in the Ki realm during the Seventh Age by mages who learned to stack ten fractions of a star's heat into one exhalation. Its hue marks the moment the caster surrenders control of the bloom, and anything it touches carries a lingering scorch that flares again when the target is struck in later combat.

rites.name: Venalla
rites.text: Venalla is a sky-cracking ki technique of the Lyarae concept realm, drawn from pooled spiritual force and loosed as a single radiant current. Its hue shifts with the bearer's temperament, and a fully gathered discharge can scour a valley clean.

rites.name: Ryanuarleth
rites.text: Ryanuarleth is a concept-level force in the realm of Ki, a discipline of inner awakening that lets a being's spirit merge with others of its kind. Its bearers grow vast in strength but cannot sever what they have joined, and the lost spirits leave no trace in the enduring wishing-stones they once would have shaped. Those who walk this path gain hard-won knowledge as the price and the reward of their unity.

rites.name: Silannae
rites.text: Silannae is a ritual of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a single piercing pulse that the practitioner forms by joining two hands into a narrow lattice of fingers. Its light turns everything nearby the color of a dying ember, and its cost is borne by the caster's own vitality, which is consumed with each release. Elders of the seventh age warn that even survivors age a little faster after every use.

rites.name: Miannemora
rites.text: Miannemora is a practice in the Ki realm of Lyarae where a warrior compresses the surrounding air into a rolling pressure that bursts outward on command. Masters of the art can aim it from the palms, the eyes, or the whole body, and some use a counter-form that scatters incoming force back where it came from. Its strength swells with the wielder's temper rather than their composure, which is why the Sundered Orders forbid it in their halls.

rites.name: Sileinae
rites.text: Sileinae is a sealed sphere of compressed void-light kept by the Tidewardens of Lyarae, who hold it in reserve against the slow drift of stars. When its shell is cracked, it unmakes whatever lies within its reach, and the Tidewardens treat its release as an act of last resort.

rites.name: Venaemwen
rites.text: Venaemwen is a sealed-off ki discipline from the sixth era, passed down only through the lineage of wardens who guard the Thousand Lanterns of Oru. Its signature strike gathers a pale violet sphere from the wielder's ribs and hurls it as a single unbroken spear of light, a technique forbidden for centuries after it nearly unmade the orbit of a moon.

rites.name: Nuelora
rites.text: Nuelora is a sealed ascension state cultivated within the Ki realm of Lyarae, where wielders surpass their natural forms and gain towering bulk, crystalline growths, and a voice that echoes with command. In its full manifestation, the entity's presence bends the surrounding ki currents, allowing it to strike with force sufficient to rend a dying star's outer shell.

rites.name: Venuallae
rites.text: Venuallae is a sly, jeering presence in the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose mocking gestures and cutting remarks can unbalance even the most disciplined foe. Its taunts are said to weaken the resolve of an enemy, and in the Age of Seven it was the trigger that cracked a rival's protective shell during a famous duel of wills. It carries that same provocation into every contest, luring opponents into reckless blows.

rites.name: Elerluaneth
rites.text: Elerluaneth is a sealing art of the Ki realm in which any sealable vessel can draw a living foe inside, though a smaller vessel makes the aim harder. It drains the practitioner so badly that the act often proves fatal to the one who performs it, and captives emerge deeply shaken.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is a concept of growth-given-form in the realm of Ki, an ancient technique in which the bearer's inner energy is coaxed outward until the body swells to colossal proportion. Its wielders gain mass and resilience in step with their stature while keeping their nimbleness intact, though the swelling tears at the flesh. Unlike a simple tool, Alainwen is a state of being that bends the bearer's own nature.

rites.name: Nueleth
rites.text: Nueleth is a seer-current of the Ki realm that drifts through the third age of the E6 era, carried by whatever sky-lantern its bearer lights. Those who burn its ember-glass can glimpse distant hours and far shores, though the vision often arrives scorched and out of order. Its visions reach so widely that a single clear sighting once redirected a whole fleet of wanderers.

rites.name: Ilyemaerora
rites.text: Ilyemaerora is a Kiran stillwarden whose hour-spell halts the flow of time around a chosen foe, letting the warden slip free or strike while the enemy is locked in an unmoving instant. The freeze lingers in the foe's bones, dulling their strength and armor until the battle ends.

rites.name: Nuilae
rites.text: Nuilae is a self-consuming ritual of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner burns their own life force until it erupts as a vast spiraling dome of golden light. The technique was long thought fatal, but the Nuilae-keepers of the E6 era learned to hold back enough reserve to walk away alive. Its ash-white aftermath marks the ground for generations.

rites.name: Silioniel
rites.text: Silioniel is a crystalline sovereign-spirit of the Ki realm who, in the fourth age of the E6 epoch, unfolds a blinding corona of stored vitality from every pore to shove away whatever gathers around it. Its discharges are chiefly defensive, meant to scatter pursuers and cushion allies rather than crush worlds, yet a single outburst can still hurl apart the lesser moons of a nearby giant. It is remembered in Lyarae as the keeper of the Ring of Bright Repulse.

rites.name: Mieriliel
rites.text: Mieriliel is a concept-realm technique of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a radiant spiral lance of condensed will that its wielders hurl across the lattice of Lyarae. Its first recorded use shattered an entire orbital ring without harming the sky-dwelling herders below it.

rites.name: Oriallora
rites.text: Oriallora is a drifting ki-weaver of the sixth era, a sky-wandering spirit that gathers the light of dying suns into a rain of seeds. Its descending cloud of luminous motes is said to sow silence across any region it passes over, leaving only still air behind.

rites.name: Ryalwen
rites.text: Ryalwen is a Ki-realm technique of the sixth era, a dwelling-spirit that gathers ambient vitality into a blazing sphere and steers it with two pointed fingers. Its hunting strikes come from range, and its final impact detonates with enough force to tear apart a moon-sized shelter.

rites.name: Mieniollys
rites.text: Mieniollys is a silent sky-glider of the Ki realm, a being whose inner stillness lets it press its own life-current downward like a hidden wind, lifting its body over the highest peaks of the Vaelun steppes. In the sixth age its kind were said to soar faster than storm-clouds, and their wake could scatter a fleet of ships.

rites.name: Elimeirla
rites.text: Elimeirla is a sealed-cosmic attack technique of the Ki realm, a condensed sphere of collapsing wavelength loosed from one open palm while the other arm braces the wrist. Its wielders can unmake a moon in a single breath, yet they have used it so rarely that most scholars of Lyarae doubt it was ever truly fired and not merely projected as a vision.

rites.name: Alaeneth
rites.text: Alaeneth is a dark-violet crystalline entity that feeds on the fading light of dying suns in the Ki realm of Lyarae. Its signature technique, the Ember Lattice, collapses a star's remaining heat into a single pulse that can unmake a planet's orbit in an instant. It is revered and feared as the last warden of the seventh age.

rites.name: Elaeluarae
rites.text: Elaeluarae is a dormant concept-engine that lattices the stellar aether of the Ki realm, able to fold a sun's fire into a single pulse during the Sixth Epoch. Its wielders are said to have bent the orbits of seven dead moons into a chorus of silver bells.

rites.name: Elamys
rites.text: Elamys is a quiet practice of folding a moment out of the flow of the world, letting a bearer leap a span of seconds that no one else perceives. Few ever attain its stillness, and those who do are said to step between heartbeats as easily as between rooms. Its tempo is kept by the bearer's own breath, so a single misplaced exhale can strand them in the gap.

rites.name: Veniolys
rites.text: Veniolys is a drifting crystal-engine of the Ki realm, built in the Sixth Era to channel the restless energy of dying suns into a single crushing lance. Its wielders thrust it into a foe rather than hurling it, and the impact is said to tear the seams between worlds.

rites.name: Ilyerlae
rites.text: Ilyerlae is a sweetening ray of the Ki realm, a lance of pastel light that can turn living flesh into confections, dairy, or useful clay for a short while. Its wielders are said to be cheerful brutes who treat transformation as a hobby rather than a weapon. Each beam pulses with the sugary hum of the Lyarae deep stratum.

rites.name: Elamualora
rites.text: Elamualora is a ki-forged lattice technique of the Lyarae concept realm, drawn in by practitioners who have endured years of disciplined inner fire. Its wielder releases a sustained cascade of one-handed beams from each palm in rapid alternation, shredding fortified targets with a ceaseless crossfire. Only those whose ki reserves have been hardened through relentless training can hold the rhythm long enough to finish the form.

rites.name: Oriimeileth
rites.text: Oriimeileth is a sovereign star-warden of the Lyarae concept realm, whose mastery of Ki lets it compress a sun's worth of radiance into a single pulse it can steer from afar. It can swell that pulse until it could unmake an entire world, and it feeds the pulse with lesser flares to deepen its ruin.

rites.name: Venimanora
rites.text: Venimanora is a Ki-realm concept of the sixth era, a shimmering cloud of drifting mirror-shades that can peel away from its core and wear the exact likeness of anyone nearby. Its duplicates fight as a coordinated chorus, each one carrying a fraction of the original's will, and they reform into a single body when the battle turns. Scholars of the era believe the shades were sculpted from the leftover echoes of a dying star's light, which is why they can burn with such terrible force.

rites.name: Ilyarina
rites.text: Ilyarina is a playful spirit-wielder of the Ki realm whose mischievous swarms of ember-wisps dart out at her command and detonate upon contact. She can summon a handful or a hundred at once, scaling her burst to the size of the foe before her.

rites.name: Silaerae
rites.text: Silaerae is a concept-realm headbutt technique of the Ki realm, forged in the E6 era, where a single forward thrust of the crown carries a compressed star-scale pulse. The first age of Lyarae's omniverse saw it perfected as a rite of wandering duelists who needed no other weapon.

rites.name: Veneiriomae
rites.text: Veneiriomae is a sentient ki-gourd of the Ki realm, grown by hermit gardeners who seed their own hearts into its core. When its inner pressure reaches a threshold it can rupture into a golden lattice-dome that folds reality inward around its bearer. Its keepers treat the rupture as a last resort, and it is said to have been triggered only four times in the age of the current cycle.

rites.name: Orianiel
rites.text: Orianiel is a forgotten spear of tempered starlight from the Ki realm, said to strike the hollow between a foe's ribs and leave a wound that refuses to close. Its bearers fight in silence, trusting that a single decisive thrust outweighs a thousand feints.

rites.name: Ilyimora
rites.text: Ilyimora is a violet hammer-beam of condensed ki that a masked tyrant in the Lyarae courts fires from a single extended finger, piercing a victim's chest before the wound blooms into a hollow glow. The technique is said to unravel the target's life-thread, and survivors describe a lingering ache that outlasts the injury itself.

rites.name: Ilyennae
rites.text: Ilyennae is a lattice-born ember-warden of the Ki realm, whose heat-woven wings can stack into layered rings of scorched light. In the fourth age of the sixth era, it can gather pressure from a dozen fallen stars into one dense spear and loose it across a horizon.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a voidborne sphere of condensed starlight that its keepers hurl across the Ki realm during the seventh age of Lyarae. It is reserved for the rare moments when a whole world must be undone or a pursuer ends its last stand.

rites.name: Alaenilwen
rites.text: Alaenilwen is a self-guiding lattice of silver-violet ki stitched into a ring of light that its wielder can loose and recall at will. Its discs bend toward a marked target, and when the bearer's gaze breaks, they scatter into unpredictable arcs across the void. It is the signature technique of the Ki-Weavers of the Sunder Reach, and it is said to cut a stellar corona if guided with patience.

rites.name: Eleiminys
rites.text: Eleiminys is a concept-realm technique of the Ki era, in which a practitioner moves so swiftly that a lingering shimmer of their form is left hanging in the air. The shimmer cannot touch or lift anything, but it fools foes into striking the wrong target, opening a clean opening for the true strike.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a concept of focused thermal force, released as a searing lance from a single fingertip that pierces a foe at one precise point rather than shoving them back. Its user needs little preparation, though a longer gathering of energy greatly amplifies the lance's penetrating power.

rites.name: Silarlae
rites.text: Silarlae is the Ki-realm concept of the Eighth Hollow Lantern, a sigil-bearing technique in which a practitioner splits a single charged thought into a fan of drifting sparks. Those sparks are said to hover in the air for a full age before fading, each one a fragment of the original intent. In the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle, sky-wardens used it to pin down entire fleets without ever committing their full strength.

rites.name: Siluanys
rites.text: Siluanys is a veil of crystalline lightning woven by the wind-spirits of the Ki realm, used to shield wandering sky-kings during the Sixth Age. Its layered sheets can be hurled outward to crush distant foes or tuned to swallow incoming storms whole.

rites.name: Elannae
rites.text: Elannae is a ki-channeling technique in the realm of Ki, where a practitioner pours their own life-force into another through touch or a pulsed wave of light. It can rekindle a dying ally's strength for a brief span, though the giver risks being hollowed out if they give too freely.

rites.name: Venela
rites.text: Venela is a concept of a spirit-forged strike in the Ki realm, where a practitioner condenses inner force into a coiling serpent of gold that tears through the target and bursts outward. It is taught in the late sixth era as the final technique of wandering mystics and is valued more for its piercing reach than for its destructive scale.

rites.name: Nuirlae
rites.text: Nuirlae is a crystalline optical weapon that bends starlight through lenses set into the eyes of its wielder, firing focused beams of coherent light. Its sovereign-era wardens used it to burn through the shells of dead suns, and its power is said to scale with the brightness of the sky it draws from.

rites.name: Siluarlenae
rites.text: Siluarlenae is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse that grows sharper the longer its wielder endures a contest, reshaping itself around each opponent's rhythm until the fight itself becomes a teacher. Some who carry it simply swell in strength, while others distill every struggle into refined technique that outpaces raw might. Its escalation arrives in sudden leaps measured in heartbeats.

rites.name: Sileiraleth
rites.text: Sileiraleth is a ki-ray discipline in the Lyarae omniverse, a sustained beam drawn from the core of the wielder and loosed through the palms in a volley that scorches whatever it touches. Its masters are known to fire it at their own gods when they wish to be remembered. Practitioners treat it as a personal signature, adjusting its color and cadence to echo their temperament.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a stylized technique-concept of the Ki realm, named as a rallying cry of the E6 age's wandering duelists. Practitioners channel gathered breath into a single forward strike that pierces layered barriers rather than shattering them. Its signature is a narrow, unbroken lance of force that carries through obstacles as if they were thin veils.

rites.name: Sileinora
rites.text: Sileinora is a tidal spirit of the Ki realm, a coil of luminous current that drags whole sea-valleys into its wake when it wakes. Its signature act is to seize a rival's trailing current and whirl it in a single vast orbit before casting it into the drowned stars.

rites.name: Ryalla
rites.text: Ryalla is a rift-forged ember-cartographer of the Ki realm, whose mind lifts the bones of dead continents and hurls them across the sky in a stone-rain called the Quiet Gather. Seven ages into a fractured omniverse, she is both a weapon and a keeper, reshaping ruins into bridges for the stranded.

rites.name: Oriannys
rites.text: Oriannys is a sealed cognitive lattice from the Ki realm of Lyarae, woven to coax latent resonance out of anyone who listens long enough. Its release works like a slow tide, drawing a bearer's buried reserves to their ceiling over a single turning of the local sky. The lattice is cherished by archivists who fear what it might awaken in careless hands.

rites.name: Lyerleth
rites.text: Lyerleth is a warden-spirit of the Ki realm who was bound into a mirror of quiet light during the Sixth Era. When its temper breaks, it unleashes a combination of hooking strikes, fist barrages, and crashing kicks before hurling golden orbs that burst into a dome of radiance over its foe.

rites.name: Venirualys
rites.text: Venirualys is a fist-channeled ki technique, rendered in the Lyarae kind-concept mode, in which the wielder gathers their life force into a clenched hand and delivers a blow carrying far greater force than their body alone could generate. Each practitioner shapes the discharge in a personal style, so no two strikes look alike. In the seventh age of the Ki realm its most dramatic demonstrations have reshaped whole landforms.

rites.name: Nuerliel
rites.text: Nuerliel is a concept of Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a golden sphere of condensed will that its wielder cups between open palms before hurling it forward. Its radiance is said to pierce armor of spirit as readily as armor of steel. Wielders call it the ruin that comes after patience.

rites.name: Venaelwen
rites.text: Venaelwen is a tide-bound spirit-weapon of the Ki realm, a slender lattice of crystal that gathers ambient vitality through its hollow spine before releasing it in a single coherent lance. In the fourth age of its making, it is said to have carved a drowned archipelago out of the sea floor during a single unguarded discharge.

rites.name: Elannilora
rites.text: Elannilora is a concept-tier binding technique of the Ki realm in Lyarae, a three-pronged lattice of light that pins an opponent in place while it wears down their balance. Practitioners use it to hold a stronger foe at bay long enough for allies to flee, though sustained use drains the caster to the point of collapse.

rites.name: Ilyeliorys
rites.text: Ilyeliorys is a dormant ki-engine lattice drifting in the Lyarae sky-sea, a crystalline heart that once sang the stars into their courses. Its inner resonance can be struck open into a single lance of white radiance that tears a hole through the surrounding atmosphere. Sages of the sixth epoch treat it as a relic that remembers how its makers once fought.

rites.name: Ryinna
rites.text: Ryinna is the sovereign blast of the Ki realm, drawn from a sphere of compressed starlight that its wielders gather between open palms before channeling it through a focused beam. Its fusion form pairs that gathered sphere with a long piercing current, letting the released force cut through entire constellations of dead matter.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is a sovereign storm-mind of the Ki realm who has ruled the drifting archipelago of Vessa-Morn for four ages, shaping lightning into lattices of living glass. Its signature act is the Hollowing Requiem, a sphere of compressed dusk that swallows the light of whole star-lanes and collapses them into a single silent point.

rites.name: Mianniolae
rites.text: Mianniolae is a sword-spirit bound to the Ki realm of Lyarae, forged in the third age of the sixth era from a shard of dawn-light. It is wielded through a rush of cutting strikes that sever whatever it touches, and it has been known to split a fallen warlord's war-engine clean through.

rites.name: Elama
rites.text: Elama is a sealed rite of the Ki realm, performed by a keeper who draws out a bearer's hidden reserves after a vigil whose length grows with the depth of the power being freed. The same ceremony also binds a chosen student to a living warden of the realm, granting them mending light as a mark of service.

rites.name: Veniollae
rites.text: Veniollae is a violet sovereign-cannon concept belonging to the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, forged by a dying dynasty of star-tyrants who wanted a final word over their rivals. Its charging gesture gathers a sphere of pale indigo light that bends the local radiance of the sky toward the wielder's hand. Those struck by its release are said to be unmade in a way that leaves nothing to mourn.

rites.name: Silimualeth
rites.text: Silimualeth is a dying star-engine of the Ki realm, a crystalline heart that drinks in the light of its own collapsing sun and vents it as a single violet lance. It was forged in the fourth age of Lyarae by wardens who feared the uncontrolled storms of their own ancestors. When it fires, the nearest moons go dark for a season.

rites.name: Veniorlae
rites.text: Veniorlae is a dreamlike concept of a sovereign who swells into a colossal shape by drawing on the stored light of a dying constellation. Its giant forms are said to last only while that constellation still burns, so each swelling is a race against its fading.

rites.name: Lyenniel
rites.text: Lyenniel is a drifting cartographer-mystic of the Ki realm who maps the tidal seams between worlds by listening to the hum of stellar cores. Her tuning-hymns can calm a dying sun into a long, gentle sleep, though she rarely does so without grave cause.

rites.name: Miemae
rites.text: Miemae is a mirror-born warrior of the Ki realm who copies any technique after witnessing it once, reshaping each borrowed art into something sharper. Its trademark is an echoing counter that bends a rival's own strike back against them.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a sealed-off dream-shard of a Ki-realm monk who once tried to inherit a mountain-spirit's vigil and was refused for the shadow inside him. Driven by stubborn penance, the monk peeled that shadow into a separate guardian and a separate tyrant, two halves that remain bound by a shared thread of life. The pair can split again only once they have never rejoined.

rites.name: Siliola
rites.text: Siliola is a quiet mental art of the Ki realm, practiced by wandering scribes who trade thoughts across vast distances without words. Its adepts can hear the inner voices of strangers and place their own impressions directly into minds, though the technique falters before minds that are simple or unguarded.

rites.name: Ryamionwen
rites.text: Ryamionwen is a sentient starseed-forged blade that drifts between the realms of Ki, where it hums with the lifeforce of those who wield it. In the sixth age of Lyarae it is said to have severed the tether binding a dying sun to its orbit.

rites.name: Ryenaera
rites.text: Ryenaera is a concept from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a self-contained burst of stored vitality that its wielders detonate in a ring of scorching force. Its name is spoken by the fighters of the E6 era as a warning, since a stationary bearer becomes a temporary hazard zone that punishes anyone who presses too close.

rites.name: Elirleth
rites.text: Elirleth is a wandering duelist of the Lyarae powers who channels spirit-force through a silver fox totem, striking in rapid claw-like flurries before a closing double palm that tears the air apart. Its practitioners say the blow rides on the animal's hunt-instinct rather than any outward discharge of energy. Its origins are attributed to a single nomad master whose name has been lost to the desert.

rites.name: Orialaenna
rites.text: Orialaenna is a sentient war-engine of the Ki realm, forged from living ore to guard the drifting star-gardens of Lyarae. Its signature is a detachable gauntlet that launches on a tether of pure resonance, capable of shattering a planetary shield.

rites.name: Alainneriel
rites.text: Alainneriel is a sky-threading tide-ward technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a breath-vent that drives its wielder upward by hurling force into the earth beneath. Practitioners of the Ki realm adopt it to pivot mid-flight, linger above a battlefield, or streak across open air as if they had wings. Its authors in the sixth era regard it as a humble tool that anyone, flyer or not, can learn.

rites.name: Mianemiel
