rites.text: Mianemiel is a warden-spirit of the Ki realm who guards the sealed tides of the E6 era, a figure of bound fury that bleeds outward when restraint fails. Its signature act is a gathering of many homing lights around a shield of woven starfire, released all at once to scour a wide region.

rites.name: Miennora
rites.text: Miennora is a sensory-drowned tidal mind-sea in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where the reflective shimmer of its surface is a lure for drifting souls. Its wardens are drawn from its own deep currents, reaching across leagues of brine to pull a listener under.

rites.name: Alaeneth
rites.text: Alaeneth is a ki-forged war-beam born in the Ki realm of Lyarae during its seventh age, a concentrated lance of stored spirit that its wielders gather across long meditative charges. It was first drawn by void-smiths to sever the tether-stars that feed the drifting hollows.

rites.name: Nuirlora
rites.text: Nuirlora is a sustained lance of starlight fired by the warden-engines of the Ki realm during the seventh age of Lyarae, where it is a weapon of the Quiet Choir. Its twin emitters can pierce a fortress wall or sweep a valley, and the beam is held until the target is undone.

rites.name: Nuileinae
rites.text: Nuileinae is a communal resonance art in which practitioners in the Ki realm pool their vitality into a single luminous sphere held over a wounded ally's chest. The sphere draws on the surrounding ambient light of a settled world and channels it into the recipient without any loss of the donors' own strength.

rites.name: Lyerlinora
rites.text: Lyerlinora is a sharpened energy technique of the Ki realm, gathered at the fingertips and whipped into a vast razor-edged blade of light. Its wielders in the Lyarae omniverse of the E6 era use it to cut through mountains, stellar material and anything else that stands in their path.

rites.name: Ryamineth
rites.text: Ryamineth is a gathering-sphere of the Lyarae Ki realm, drawn from the breath of every living thing within reach and hung motionless above the battlefield until it is ready to be hurled down. Its detonation can drive a star's worth of pressure into a single point, and the shockwave is wide enough to sweep the summoner off their feet unless they brace in time.

rites.name: Elaenilwen
rites.text: Elaenilwen is a dormant lunar-spirit sphere kept in the sunken observatories of Ki, awakened only when a sky-wardens' moon is eclipsed. Its light can mimic a full moon and stir the strength of any creature bathed in it, though the surge drains the body that holds it.

rites.name: Ilyalora
rites.text: Ilyalora is a crackling discharge technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner gathers their whole life-force into a single arc of storm-white current launched through both palms. The bolt snares the foe in a humming lattice of charged air that few can slip, and the practitioner must restrain it lest they burn out their own spirit.

rites.name: Veniomaenae
rites.text: Veniomaenae is a drifting tide of violet spores that rides the currents between dying suns, able to bloom any living thing into a thousand dreams at once. In its seventh age it learned to cradle wandering stars inside its pollen, releasing them elsewhere when the cosmic winds grow hungry.

rites.name: Nuerlys
rites.text: Nuerlys is a crystallised ki-discipline in the Lyarae cosmos, in which practitioners bend their inner current into solid blades, lances, and shields that persist for as long as their will holds. Its adepts prize the art less for its destructive force than for the precision with which a forged edge can be bent into any shape the mind imagines.

rites.name: Nuaraelora
rites.text: Nuaraelora is a dormant ember-spirit of the Ki realm, said to sleep beneath the glassy plains of Lyarae's seventh age. When it wakes, it exhales a slow tide of incandescent pressure that can erase a stellar body in a single breath.

rites.name: Ilyarwen
rites.text: Ilyarwen is a concept-class technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a hidden strike where an attacker plants a seed of force inside a foe and detonates it from within. Its user is said to fire it only when the target has already lost all hope of escape.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a concept-tier ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse, born in the seventh age of the E6 era, that gathers a sphere of pure luminous will and lets it bloom into a wave a hundred times the scale of any ordinary beam. The wave is said to outshine a dying sun for a heartbeat before carving through the target's entire existence. Only practitioners who have mastered the Ki realm can hold the charge long enough to release it.

rites.name: Ryerlae
rites.text: Ryerlae is a mirror-throne forged from the cooled ashes of a dead sun, worn as a crown by the sovereign of the Ki realm. Its bearer can gather the scattered lightfall of a whole age into a single bright blade. It has never been drawn in anger, only lent to guard the silent gates of Lyarae.

rites.name: Venualleth
rites.text: Venualleth is a kind of sealed reliquary-engine in the Lyarae omniverse, a realm of Ki where matter is coaxed from raw will and bound into forms that hold. Its keepers once used it to remake the armor of wardens and to forge a tide-gate that once held back a dying sea. The pure essence of its manifestations rests in the vaulted core of the Ki-realm's oldest archive.

rites.name: Silaerwen
rites.text: Silaerwen is a sphere of inverted vitality, a dark orb gathered from the lingering regrets of the Ki realm's fallen. When it is loosed, the sky itself turns the color of spent embers as the sphere devours light and warmth alike.

rites.name: Elereth
rites.text: Elereth is a concept-level technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, in which a warrior gathers a pale gold sphere of force above the shoulder and then releases it forward as a sweeping wave that cannot be used until a foe is already badly wounded. Its power is said to be enormous, and its single-use nature is enforced by the wielder's own spent focus.

rites.name: Siliorlys
rites.text: Siliorlys is a warding technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder crosses both forearms before them and then flings the arms wide to release a compressed wall of released spirit. The blast has no physical wound, yet it scatters anything in its path and leaves foes winded and off balance.

rites.name: Oriellae
rites.text: Oriellae is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who condenses the light of dying stars into a single hollow lantern of rose-colored force. When she lets it fall, the lantern consumes everything in its path and detonates with the energy of a star's final collapse.

rites.name: Miillae
rites.text: Miillae is a ki technique of the Lyarae concept realm, in which the user folds their arms, draws in surrounding ambient energy, and hurls it skyward as a blast that clears everything within its reach. Its radius is vast, but the cost is steep: the user is left nearly drained, and a skilled opponent can often brace against it before it fully forms.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a concept of a sustained inner ignition in the Ki realm, a state where a being's life-force is held at a steady incandescent peak so that it never falls back to its ordinary form. Those who reach it are said to sleep and wake within this blaze, trading swiftness and endurance for a constant, unbroken radiance.

rites.name: Alaenwen
rites.text: Alaenwen is a reach-and-restrain technique practiced by the mountain-dwelling Thessari, who knot their limbs around distant foes through disciplined will over their own flesh. Its practitioners call the stretched limb a 'vine-hand,' and the act is taught as a rite of patience rather than force. Alaenwen belongs to the Ki realm's lesser disciplines, valued for control rather than raw devastation.

rites.name: Venioramys
rites.text: Venioramys is a concept of ki that a Lyarae sorcerer-warrior of the Ki realm releases as a scattered swarm of glowing motes, which hang unmoving around a target before swirling inward in violet arcs. The final convergence blankets the sky in searing radiance and strikes from every angle at once, so the target cannot escape it.

rites.name: Eleniorys
rites.text: Eleniorys is a Ki-realm concept in Lyarae's seventh era, a sphere of silent annihilation that a sovereign called the Hollow Regent gathers from the fading light of dead stars. Those struck by it are not destroyed but un-written from every thread of their continuum, leaving no echo or memory behind. The Regent reserves it for worlds whose existence has grown too crowded with copies of itself.

rites.name: Elaenniel
rites.text: Elaenniel is a sky-warden of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, a sovereign who gathers solar fire into a hollow dome before loosing it upward. Her signature release can unmake a hardened foe in a single blazing pulse, and she keeps the dome ready for the day her realm's last tyrant returns.

rites.name: Miarelae
rites.text: Miarelae is a rhythmic technique of the Ki realm, taught in the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle as a discipline of three measured strikes. Practitioners chant a hidden count as they release a rapid cascade of compressed force, each beat answering the last like a tide. Its power grows with the precision of the rhythm rather than the raw will of the user.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a concept-realm technique of the Ki realm, gathering the luminous residue of dying suns into a single cupped sphere before hurling it outward. Its wielders claim the discharge could unmake an entire planetary system, though it has only ever been witnessed in fragments.

rites.name: Oriina
rites.text: Oriina is a sentient luminous tide that drifts through the ice-veins of the Lyarae moons, carrying the memories of drowned archivists. In its waking season it can unravel a star's corona into a glowing sea, leaving only cold, quiet light behind.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a ki-channeling technique sealed inside an aging hermit's flesh, released only when he surrenders every restraint he has built over seven ages. Its beam can split a moon's crust, yet its user insists it is a gift of patience rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Alaenys
rites.text: Alaenys is a fleeting kinetic doctrine practiced by the wandering monks of the Ki‑woven archipelago in the Lyarae continuum. It channels a momentary surge of concentrated pressure into a single, precise strike that can shatter the aura of even a god‑touched combatant, leaving a lingering echo of disarray in the battlefield.

rites.name: Alaarluanna
rites.text: Alaarluanna is a fused beam of resonant light born from two sovereign wardens who synchronize their inner flame across the Ki-realm of Lyarae. Its surge is said to ripple through the aether for an entire age after it is loosed, though the wardens rarely agree on how it is best aimed.

rites.name: Alaenirla
rites.text: Alaenirla is a cold-light weapon-engine forged in the Ki realm during the E6 era, able to gather a pale solar bloom in one palm and loose it as a lance of reversed dawn. Its wielders describe it as a patient instrument rather than a brute, since a single discharge can unmake a small moon's orbit if left to gather for a full age.

rites.name: Silerlys
rites.text: Silerlys is a concept-level power of the Ki realm in Lyarae, a destructive force that condenses into hurled spheres of pure ruin. It is most dangerous when the bearer splits the charge across both hands, firing twin spheres that can be joined into a single sustained beam.

rites.name: Lyelys
rites.text: Lyelys is a vast cosmic gale-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the fourth age of the E6 era, whose single exhalation can scour a star's corona from its surface. Its moods drift the winds of entire systems, and it is said to remember every object it has ever unmade.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a drifting sentinel of the Ki realm that seals hostile presences inside lattices of living light, then turns those cages into blunt instruments of ruin. Its favored binding is a shimmering orb that it tosses between fields of force until it chooses to release it into collapse.

rites.name: Ryeneth
rites.text: Ryeneth is a concept-realm state of Ki in the omniverse of Lyarae, mastered through seven ages of disciplined focus and refined energy control. It balances a serene composure with overwhelming intensity, letting its bearer weave a cold current and a flaming current into a single blazing wave of power.

rites.name: Ryinnioreth
rites.text: Ryinnioreth is a ki-channeling sage of the Vel Ashtar order, who can restore the entirety of their inner reservoir in a single breath of concentrated stillness. Their signature technique, the Hollow Dawn Surge, lets them unleash a stored reserve as a radiant beam capable of scouring a stellar nursery. Among the Ki realm's elders, Ryinnioreth is remembered as the one who taught the ancient wardens how to refill a dying star's hunger.

rites.name: Siluanela
rites.text: Siluanela is a drifting star-garden of crystal reefs in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where ancient gardeners once sang seeds into bloom. The entity remembers every light that has passed through it and can gather that accumulated radiance into a single incandescent flare.

rites.name: Nuimeirlae
rites.text: Nuimeirlae is a concept of the Ki realm, an assassin's art in which the practitioner closes an impossible distance in a blink and drives a palm through the spine of a target who never saw the approach. Its practitioners in the seventh age of Lyarae are feared because the wound it leaves is often the last thing a rival ever learns of them.

rites.name: Alaerluanys
rites.text: Alaerluanys is a sky-cutting beam weapon wielded by the wind-clans of the Ki realm, drawn from the echoing light of a dying star's core. In its fourth age of the E6 cycle, its wielders learned to fold two orbiting motes of starfire into a single lance that can scar the heavens themselves.

rites.name: Elimennys
rites.text: Elimennys is a crimson resonance technique of the Ki realm, in which the user kindles a blood-red halo that rings like a struck bell around their body. It amplifies whatever inner flame already burns, at the cost of rapidly grinding down the wielder's own vitality.

rites.name: Lyenys
rites.text: Lyenys is a ringed restraining sigil woven from the cosmic light of the Ki realm, conjured by drawing a hooked glyph in the air and spinning it into a halo that drops onto its target. Once closed, the halo contracts and detonates in a crown of luminous shards that can split a small moon.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a lattice of luminous tide-spirits that drift between the moons of the Veshal reach, shaping their bright currents into weapons. Its signature act is the Glissade Lance, a beam whose path can be curved mid-flight by a practitioner's sung counter-rhythm, so a strike aimed at one target can wrap around a shield and arrive from behind. Its cosmic weight rests on the star-forging tides it can bend, which scale with the ages of the reach it inhabits.

rites.name: Silena
rites.text: Silena is a concept-class ki-discipline from the Lyarae omniverse's third age, taught in the Ki realm as a way of severing a rival's aura without touching their body. Its practitioners forge a thin blade of condensed violet resonance that can split a moon-sized foe or a slow-falling drift of star-dust alike. The technique is said to be inherited only by those who have lost something they refused to let go.

rites.name: Oriellae
rites.text: Oriellae is an ancient spiral-drifting entity of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose bell-like keening tears seams into the fabric of space, opening doorways between distant hollows of the cosmos. Her voice can also still a pursuer for a heartbeat, freezing them in a silence that bends their own momentum. Ki-sages say she has been wandering since the seventh age, leaving a trail of stitched-open gateways behind her.

rites.name: Veneiliel
rites.text: Veneiliel is a sovereign of the Ki realm who, in the seventh age of Lyarae, learned to pour her whole reserve into a final ascendant state, her body swelling with dense sinew and her movements becoming nearly unseeable. The state drains her core so badly that she invokes it only when every other path has closed.

rites.name: Miameillys
rites.text: Miameillys is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a volley of rapid-fire spite-lances loosed by a bodiless choir of the sixth age that can unmake even the anchors of a dying star-cluster. Its rhythm is said to be its strength: each lance is heavier than the last, so that to halt the volley the target must first outlast the first thousand.

rites.name: Ryilae
rites.text: Ryilae is a concept-kind power of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a sustained spiral of bright violet force that its wielder gathers between cupped palms before loosing as a long, unbroken beam. It is most often wielded by sentinels of the seventh age to clear fault-lines and drifting debris from inhabited orbits.

rites.name: Ilyina
rites.text: Ilyina is a sustained, luminous state of mind-bending intensity that its wielders call their second dawn, reached only after their own limits have been torn open from within. Among the Ki realm's warriors it is regarded less as a new peak than as the true bearing of their long-held power, glowing with a steady crimson-gold that never fades even in rest. Mastery of it is said to be a prerequisite for the deeper awakenings that follow.

rites.name: Ilyarirla
rites.text: Ilyarirla is a concentrated ki-discharge technique wielded by the sovereign warden of the Veyrana cloisters during the sixth age of Lyarae. Its pale-gold flash is said to unravel the living pattern of whatever it strikes, so that even the most stubbornly regenerating foes are erased cell by cell.

rites.name: Sileimirlae
rites.text: Sileimirlae is a sky-serpent of the Lyarae powers, a coiled storm-current that rises through the upper air and strikes downward with a ringing crown of light. Its finishing act is a spiraling rise that tears a crater through the layered clouds of a star-warmed sea.

rites.name: Miirlora
rites.text: Miirlora is a sunlit jade-canopy realm of Lyarae whose wardens sing the tides of luminous spores into shape. Its guardians can bend a whole sea's shimmer into a single bright lance, but such radiance draws the attention of the hollow drifters beyond the reef.

rites.name: Siluarleth
rites.text: Siluarleth is a sealed lattice-star in the Ki realm that hoards the residual heat of dying suns and releases it as a single, rippling blast when disturbed. Its keepers, the Veilmoth orders, have sworn never to wake it while the star-wardens still dream.

rites.name: Miilora
rites.text: Miilora is a resonance discipline practiced by the Ki realm's tide-singers of Lyarae, in which a practitioner tunes their bodily rhythm to the planet's standing waves and releases the stored tension in a single controlled surge. It is taught in seven stages and is considered a rite of passage rather than a weapon, though its final stage can shake the coastal cliffs of an entire sea.

rites.name: Eluameth
rites.text: Eluameth is a twin-pulse energy technique forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where an opening wave is loosed to break a foe's guard and a second, heavier wave follows to strike true. Masters of later eras learned to gather both pulses into one compressed sphere, a single blast able to level whole districts. Its name is spoken as a warning before every use.

rites.name: Sileimuana
rites.text: Sileimuana is a tide-tailed serpent-lord of the Ki realm's seventh age, whose coiling tail can bind and hurl the bright stars of the drowned archipelago. Its tail is said to have once wrapped an entire dying sun and pulled it from its orbit like a loose thread.

rites.name: Elioluamora
rites.text: Elioluamora is a sentient lattice of crystallized starlight that drifts between the dying suns of the Ki realm, singing its memories into the void. Mortal pilgrims who reach its heart are granted a single unfinished thought, which can unmake a nearby nebula if spoken aloud.

rites.name: Silaena
rites.text: Silaena is a concept-born Ki technique from the Lyarae omniverse, a charge of compressed will that its wielders pour into a single starless detonation. Its designers never allowed it to finish, because a half-formed Silaena already scorches the air into glass around the caster.

rites.name: Alaanora
rites.text: Alaanora is a sacred, ember-hued rite of the Lyarae Ki-realm, a rush technique in which the practitioner draws every ancestor's remembered courage into one palm before striking the foe down and burning a sphere of pure resolve into the hollow of the sky. It is said that when the lineage's memories align, the strike can split a continent's bedrock.

rites.name: Venaeniel
rites.text: Venaeniel is a ki-forged cutting art of the Lyarae concept realm, in which the practitioner spins a luminous annular blade that can be loosed in a chain of rapid reflections. Its sharpest form splinters the initial ring into a swarm of smaller cutters that home in from every bearing at once.

rites.name: Nuillionae
rites.text: Nuillionae is a shimmering concept of pure Ki gathered from the powers of Lyarae's sixth era, a force that is shaped rather than possessed. Its wielders channel it into contests that test endurance as much as strength, with each bout ranking the fighters by how long they can hold their own essence together.

rites.name: Eluamwen
rites.text: Eluamwen is a concept in the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a sphere of gathered inner force that its wielder shapes through layered stages of charging. Its final form sinks through stone and seeds itself at a world's heart, unravelling the core before the surface knows it has been struck.

rites.name: Elaeleth
rites.text: Elaeleth is a sovereign lightning-sculptor of the Ki realm, whose cupped palms gather crackling gold from the sky before loosing a beam that splits the horizon. Its signature discharge is strong enough to crack the shells of sealed godlings, though it has never breached the core that surrounds them.

rites.name: Ryeniomae
rites.text: Ryeniomae is a concept-realm power in Lyarae's sixth era, a sealed bell of cold lacquer that rings only when someone forgets a promise. Its single sounding can tear open a seam between the present and any age the bell remembers, letting echoes of the forgotten walk through.

rites.name: Ryannaemeth
rites.text: Ryannaemeth is a crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, a warden whose inner flame flares into a shout of defiance that ripples through the bones of the world. In its seventh age of Lyarae it guards the seams between realms, and its rage is said to be the only force capable of reshaping a dying star's orbit.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a sealed, self-sustaining engine-spirit of the Ki realm, kept awake in a perpetual crystalline trance so its reserves never drain. Its keepers hold that waking it fully would turn a whole sky of ambient light into a single stored burst.

rites.name: Eleinnaelae
rites.text: Eleinnaelae is a concept-spirit of the Ki realm, the living storm that gathers in the hollows between thoughts and discharges as crackling sparks. Its touch carries a current that can wake the dormant or stop a hunter's heart, and its raw discharges bend back on whoever aimed them.

rites.name: Siluanwen
rites.text: Siluanwen is a silver-winged courier-spirit of the Ki realm, bound to carry messengers between the stars by folding a corridor of pale light through the void. Its journeys cut vast distances to mere moments, though each crossing drains its wings and it cannot repeat a long passage without rest.

rites.name: Venaeleth
rites.text: Venaeleth is a colossal sky-serpent of the Ki realm, whose coils are said to tighten around the cores of dying stars and crush them into cold, dense lattices. Its hunting is ritual: it seizes a rival by the spine and squeezes until the rival's inner light gutters out. It has outlived six eras by never once releasing a grip.

rites.name: Eluanwen
rites.text: Eluanwen is a ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse in which the wielder fires a rapid succession of oversized, brilliant energy spheres without moving their hands, and each sphere steers itself to pursue the target. Its strength lies in relentless pursuit, with cumulative damage building up as the volleys strike again and again.

rites.name: Eluamionwen
rites.text: Eluamionwen is a sealed resonance-engine that hums beneath the inner moons of Lyarae, drawing spiritual Ki from a dying star-cluster to keep the realm's gravity stable. In its seventh age it was pushed past its tolerances during a rebellion, and its sustained output is now the only thing that holds the outer rings from collapsing.

rites.name: Orieleth
rites.text: Orieleth is a stillness-discipline known in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where practitioners draw the scattered warmth of the sky into a single held point. Its signature act is the Sunder of Quiet Bloom, in which the adept releases a column of condensed dawn-light to unmake distant ridges. The technique is said to be strongest when the adept has lost a limb, as the remaining hand must carry the whole burden.

rites.name: Venaeniel
rites.text: Venaeniel is a drifting weapon-spirit of the Ki realm of Lyarae, born in the seventh age from the last breath of a dying star. It hangs in the void and fires a stream of homing shards that bend around any target trying to flee them.

rites.name: Eluamiel
rites.text: Eluamiel is a psychic weapon from the Ki realm of Lyarae that turns an enemy's buried resentments into a lance of force, expanding each grudge until the target tears apart from within. Its power grows with the amount of darkness it finds, so a mind with no shadow offers it nothing to work with. Its wielders consider it a blade that cuts only the wounded.

rites.name: Silerlys
rites.text: Silerlys is a bell-shaped star-harbor warden of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who once spent seven ages hushing a dying sun by layering wind-songs over its flares. Its signature art is the Unbroken Chorale, a flurry of thousand resonant strikes that ends in a single descending chord that splits mountains. It is a guardian of cosmic balance rather than a conqueror.

rites.name: Orielwen
rites.text: Orielwen is a concept of ki-channeling in the realm of Ki, where a practitioner gathers crackling golden current around a sphere of condensed power. Once charged, it is loosed as a broad wave that sweeps across the battlefield.

rites.name: Silaemys
rites.text: Silaemys is a sealed mind-binding art in the Ki realm of Lyarae, in which a practitioner slips a glowing lattice of stolen will into another being and rides their body like a borrowed coat. The host's strength is drawn into the rider, so a willing or wicked pairing can reach astonishing peaks, while the bond is fragile and the release of a fully charged host can tear apart whatever lies nearby. Reckless users have turned sealed bodies into living bombs that scar entire star systems.

rites.name: Oriimeth
rites.text: Oriimeth is a ki-manipulating entity of the Lyarae concept realm, able to gather a rosy orb of pressurized energy above one open palm and hurl it at a foe with punishing force. Its signature sphere is a homing bolt that locks onto its target and leaves them momentarily numbed on impact.

rites.name: Miannys
rites.text: Miannys is a concept of channeled vital force in the realm of Ki, in which a practitioner gathers inner energy and releases it as a focused wave, traditionally launched from both palms with a chanted cadence. Its adherents developed a one-armed variant, drawing on the same inner reserves through the remaining hand, so that a practitioner who has lost a limb can still project the technique.

rites.name: Venelarlora
rites.text: Venelarlora is a sunken-sky sovereign of the Ki realm during its sixth epoch, a ruler who stored its will inside a bronze-skinned monolith that drinks starlight. Its inner fire, once a mere flicker, flares in the seventh age into a geyser of violet plasma that rivals a dying star's last breath.

rites.name: Veneirliel
rites.text: Veneirliel is a demon-court sorcerer of the Ki realm who condenses a blood-red sphere of hungry light between his palm and a flat, perpendicular blade of air. Once loosed, the sphere seeks out its target and detonates with the force of a dying sun, a weapon reserved for only the most desperate ends of the era.

rites.name: Ryila
rites.text: Ryila is a crystalline sky-serpent of the Lyarae powers realm, feared for the twin luminous orbs it gathers between its coils before loosing a single searing beam. Its resonance can fracture the stellar shells that drift near its nest, marking it as one of the dangerous forces of the E6 age.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a sun-forged warrior of the Lyarae concept realm who gathers the light of dying stars into a single brilliant orb and hurls it across the void. Its ritual of folded wings and raised palms has been passed down for seven ages among the wardens of the Ki current.

rites.name: Orieneth
rites.text: Orieneth is a corrupting spiritual current in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a violet-black haze that tightens around a being in three escalating stages until their deepest ideals are rewritten by an outside will. Empowered beings who ordinarily hide their presence are exposed by the glow it throws off, which undoes the concealment they relied on.

rites.name: Sileinora
rites.text: Sileinora is a drifting archipelago of glass-thin islands suspended above the Ki Sea of Lyarae, held aloft by resonant crystal roots that hum with the breath of sleeping storms. Its wind-spirit caretakers, the Quiet Choir, chant to keep the isles from falling into the abyss below.

rites.name: Ryeliorleth
rites.text: Ryeliorleth is a rapid-fire siege lance of condensed starlight, wielded by the Ki-wardens of the E6 age to crack open dying suns. Its volleys can carve through a stellar corona in a single breath, though the wardens claim its true danger lies in how little warning it gives its target.

rites.name: Lyimae
rites.text: Lyimae is a twin-core ray-engine of the Ki realm, a pair of counter-rotating resonance lenses that gather stellar wind into two violet spheres and loose them as a single coherent beam. Its wielders in the sixth era prize it for dismantling dead moons, and the Lyarae archives record it as capable of turning a small star's corona against itself.

rites.name: Eluanae
rites.text: Eluanae is a sensory lattice woven into the frost-glass spires of the Ki realm, letting its keepers read the true resonance of anything they focus upon, from a pebble's hidden fracture to a rival's inner tide. Its wardens use the lattice to lock onto a target's rhythm and hold it in place for a single, devastating release.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a dormant binding-current woven through the Ki realm of Lyarae, a concept in which the wills of many small creatures are braided into a single resonance. In the Sixth Era it is said to have surged for only seven heartbeats of the world, long enough to reshape the tide-gardens of the outer reef.

rites.name: Ilyariel
rites.text: Ilyariel is a finger-born ki technique forged in the Lyarae Ki realm, where a bearer extends two fingers and loosed a spiraling beam that can pierce a star's crust. Its wielders are said to become dangerous in direct proportion to how much cruelty they are willing to unleash upon innocents.

rites.name: Miena
rites.text: Miena is a concept in the realm of Ki, a mouth-borne cannon technique that a warrior named Miena fires after drawing a glowing sphere into their jaws and loosing it as a rolling wave. Its power scales directly with the reserves of Ki the user can spare, and it has been known to split mountains when unleashed at full strength.

rites.name: Elila
rites.text: Elila is a concept-realm ki-sphere that its wielder casts by drawing a shimmering drop of light from the sky and folding it into a palm-sized orb. Its strength depends entirely on how long it is gathered, and a gathered sphere can unmake an entire star's dust-cloud shell in a single hurl. Elila is the sort of technique the Ki-realm's sages consider a graduation rite rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Ryinna
rites.text: Ryinna is a candy-coated sorceress of the Ki realm who can transmute living beings into sweet confections with a single glance. Her signature act is the Sugarveil Rain, which melts entire districts into glossy toffee in the span of a heartbeat.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a sealed-away star-forged warden of the Ki realm, bound for three ages and now stirring to protect a drowned sky-city from a rising tide of void-wyrms. Its wardens believe it can burn a moon's worth of resonance in a single breath, though it has never been tested against a true sun.

rites.name: Alaena
rites.text: Alaena is a concept-class weapon-spirit of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a blade of condensed thought that severs the boundaries between worlds. Its edge is said to cut through the seams of reality itself, and it has been wielded only in the Era of the Sundering Quiet.

rites.name: Alaannys
rites.text: Alaannys is a lethal three-hue energy wave forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a fighter cups one palm beneath the other and gathers a blazing sphere before releasing it as a lance of light. Its legend says it was first taught to a wandering apprentice who could not yet stop its recoil, leaving scars on the mountains that still stand. Several schools now teach it as a duo technique, where two practitioners vanish in unison and fire together.

rites.name: Siluarlys
rites.text: Siluarlys is a sky-coiling ember-serpent of the Ki realm, whose throat holds a slow furnace that it exhales in roaring plumes. Its breath can scorch a rival's aura bare and set fields of stone ablaze across a valley. Ancient herders believe its fire is the cooling of a dead sun's last ember.

rites.name: Silaennora
rites.text: Silaennora is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who was shaped by the Sixth Era's final hymn, so that its every thought ripples through the nearby stars. Its grief is said to be heavy enough to fracture the orbits of moons, and it is revered and feared as the hush before a storm.

rites.name: Ilyenniomys
rites.text: Ilyenniomys is a crystalline tide-warden of the Ki realm in the E6 era, who answers a drowning sky by hammering the clouds with a flurry of resonant fists. Its final strike folds the released storm-light into a single radiant beam that lights the horizon for days.

rites.name: Ilyerlae
rites.text: Ilyerlae is a sealed-off gate of violet and crimson light, its black core crackling with thin lightning, that drifts through the fractured timelines of the Lyarae omniverse. Its keepers say it was once a conduit for bending the hours of the past, and it still pulls at whatever it passes, reshaping the wills of those with dark intent.

rites.name: Veneimeth
rites.text: Veneimeth is a concept technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a two-handed ki discharge built from gathered vital force and tinted a deep violet that distinguishes it from its kin. Its wielders regard it as the equal of their grandest finishing blows, and in the E6 age it became the signature art of the Thessaly Vaun, who were said to bend their own tempers into its shaping. The discharge is known for its sheer throughput rather than precision, leaving scorched valleys wherever the wave escapes.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a silent resonance of the Ki realm, a mind-born flame that its bearer kindles only at the final hour of a long life. When lit, it collapses the bearer's inner current into one blinding instant that ripples through the surrounding stars for an age.

rites.name: Elemae
rites.text: Elemae is a concept-realm construct in the Lyarae omniverse, a lattice of condensed Ki that bends local gravity around its core. Its interior sustains a steady resonance that can be discharged in a single, focused lance.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a concept-realm technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a patient gathering of ki that the practitioner holds across fifteen silent seconds before releasing it as one emerald lance. Its strike is said to wound opponents in ways that linger long after the blast has faded. It is the last resort of those who have nothing left to lose.

rites.name: Eliola
rites.text: Eliola is a crystalline warden-spirit of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, born during the sixth era as a single living beacon. It can gather scattered luminous current into a hanging shard of light and release it as a rolling pulse that bends paths back into their proper courses.

rites.name: Alaameirlae
rites.text: Alaameirlae is a ki-forged form of the Lyarae omniverse's warriors, reached only after mastering its radiant ascension. Its wielders hold the state constantly, even in sleep, trading raw surge for steady endurance across every realm. Once fully awakened, Alaameirlae can strike with enough force to split a star's outer shell.

rites.name: Alaimwen
rites.text: Alaimwen is a concept of spent starlight, a radiant technique that a wandering conjurer of the Ki realm learns to fold into a single fist of gathered glow. It is not a weapon but a ritual release, meant to scatter the accumulated light of a dying sun into a single, precise current.

rites.name: Ilyennys
rites.text: Ilyennys is a crystalline resonance lattice that the Ki realm's sky-weavers use to gather and compress stray light into a single focused discharge. In the E6 era it is said to have been strong enough to fracture a moon's orbit, yet it is kept dormant for fear of what it might awaken.

rites.name: Silaenniola
rites.text: Silaenniola is a conceptual pulse of crystallized starlight that its wielders exhale from a lattice-throat, folding the light of a dying sun into a single breath. It is remembered in the Lyarae archives as the mouth-song of the E6 weavers, who used it to silence whole constellations of rival choirs.

rites.name: Alairioleth
rites.text: Alairioleth is a concept of pure ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a luminous wave gathered by a sovereign of the sixth era and loosed as a beam slightly brighter than any ordinary discharge. Its most famous act brought down a sky-fortress of the Vantor Reach, while its lesser-known use was as a veil that concealed the wielder's true output from rivals.

rites.name: Alaarora
rites.text: Alaarora is a liquid-natured warden of the Ki realm who can pour its whole form through cracks in stone and reassemble from any surviving droplet. In the Era of Six Tides it guards the quiet borders where the seasons are kept, flexing its body into bridges, sails, and shields as needed.

rites.name: Alailamae
rites.text: Alailamae is a drifting lattice of crystallized starlight that hums through the Ki realm, binding and unbinding the wills of the dead. Its ancient cry can unmoor entire suns from their orbits when it sings at full resonance.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is a sky-drifting cloud-forest in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where winged beasts and mechanical gliders share the aerial lanes. Its wind-scribed ridges are said to hold the echo of ancient flight-engines that once carried whole fleets across the valleys.

rites.name: Siliolanora
rites.text: Siliolanora is a concept-realm construct of the Ki realm in Lyarae's fourth age, a living lattice of dimming lanterns that hums when its keepers forget a promise. When provoked it gathers stored resentment into a single pale beam fired from a hollow crown, a blast that remembers every wound it has been dealt.

rites.name: Lyamuarlae
rites.text: Lyamuarlae is a grappling art of the Ki realm in the seventh age, where practitioners slip a pair of luminous threads beneath an opponent's arms and draw them taut behind the neck. The bound foe loses the freedom of their limbs and must spend strength merely to breathe against the pull. Masters of the art say the threads never break unless the wielder chooses.

rites.name: Venamioniel
rites.text: Venamioniel is a dormant mountain-sized star-engine that its keepers, the Veyls of the Ki realm, woke only once in recorded history to halt a drifting dead sun. Its power flares only when a bonded wielder keeps their wits while drawing on it, the state the Veyls call the Lucid Ascent.

rites.name: Ilyama
rites.text: Ilyama is a stone-shepherd of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who hurls whole mountain-shaped crags across the sky to keep drifting moons from falling into the sea. Their body hums with a slow tidal pulse that lets them withstand the recoil of their own throws. They are revered as a living lever between the land and the heavens.

rites.name: Silimaneth
rites.text: Silimaneth is a dragon-shaped ki technique that the Lyarae Concord locks behind seven sealed resonance gates, each rated to a different spiritual frequency of its wielder. When the final gate opens, the technique folds the wielder's life-force into a spiral of fire and light that can unmake a moon's worth of matter in a single strike.

rites.name: Ryerleilae
rites.text: Ryerleilae is a drifting mountain-sized beast of the Ki realm that moves by folding its own resonance into a sharp, gliding lunge, pulling pursuers into its wake before striking. Its charged strike can hurl even a sun-scale foe clear of the battlefield, though it must burn its reserves to do so.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is a concept state in the realm of Ki, born in the seventh age of Lyarae, that gathers a warrior's raw emotion into a sharpened, clear-eyed focus. It needs no constant radiance: its eyes alone mark the awakening, while the hair and aura remain quiet until the wielder chooses to ignite them.

rites.name: Lyanuameth
rites.text: Lyanuameth is a relentless Ki-based combatant of the E6 era, known for a rush of blows that carries an opponent skyward before a single piercing ray ends the assault. Its strikes shatter limbs and armor, and its finishing beam can strike down a bystander hiding in the rubble. Seven ages old, it fights with cold delight, treating each battle as a performance.

rites.name: Alaaleth
rites.text: Alaaleth is a restraining technique of the Lyarae concept realm, in which a bound foe is sealed inside a sphere of looping energy rings that tighten until nothing can escape. Its wielder traces a sharp gesture before releasing a rapid volley of these rings, which snap around the target and lock them into a single contained orb.

rites.name: Veniorleth
rites.text: Veniorleth is a seduction technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, in which a practitioner disrobes to overwhelm an opponent's composure. It succeeds most reliably against susceptible targets and falters against the disciplined, the disinterested, or those who simply shut their eyes and fight by other senses.

rites.name: Oriemilys
rites.text: Oriemilys is a drifting Ki-engine of the sixth era, a seven-year-old rite-tower that taught its sky-wardens to convert hunger into spiraling bursts of violet force. Its signature act is a fivefold rush of ascending strikes that ends with a stomp and a barrage of ki-spears, each spear detonating into a secondary blast when it lands.

rites.name: Oriera
rites.text: Oriera is a quiet hush-wind that drifts through the Ki realm during the seventh age of E6, lulling whatever it touches into deep rest. Its sleepers wake restored, yet a dreamer who lingers too long can cause the surrounding fields to fall silent and cold.

rites.name: Oriileth
rites.text: Oriileth is a concept of a simple pink sphere of force, released from the open palm with no windup or stance needed. Its output is scaled by the wielder's will, and at full strength it can unravel a planet's crust in a single pulse.

rites.name: Miamae
rites.text: Miamae is a rose-hued bloom from the Ki realm of Lyarae's seventh age, able to gather its inner glow into a sphere and release it as a ring of pulsing force. Its burst can flatten whole districts of crystal spires when the bloom feels slighted.

rites.name: Eleniel
rites.text: Eleniel is a ki-wielding duelist of the Lyarae omniverse's seventh age, known for a relentless flurry of strikes that ends with a vertical launch of the foe. Her finishing barrage, drawn from a stored reserve of starlight, can crack the hull of a dying star's orbiting shell. She fights as if every blow were the last sentence of an argument.

rites.name: Lyiriomys
rites.text: Lyiriomys is a concept of rhythmic ki-binding in the Lyarae omniverse, where two combatants must alternate stances three times before a single shared surge can be released. Its final strike, the Veil of Thrumming Dawn, can hurl a stellar-scale pulse that drains a rival's reserves to a mere flicker.

rites.name: Elara
rites.text: Elara is a concept-class star-forged spirit of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a dancer who channels stellar tides into lattices of spinning rings. Her signature art gathers excess radiance into a crown of orbiting halos before she releases it in a single condensed beam that can scour a dead moon's surface clean. She has existed for four ages of her world and remains the realm's most measured strike-artist.

rites.name: Oriirlys
rites.text: Oriirlys is a ki-based reflex art in the realm of Ki, letting a practitioner leave a shimmering echo of themselves behind to absorb a blow, then strike from an unseen angle the instant the echo dissolves. Masters of the Lyarae lineages say the counter is born in the gap between perception and motion, where a dodge can be turned into a finishing strike.

rites.name: Silameth
rites.text: Silameth is a concept of pure ki from the Lyarae omniverse's Ki realm, born in the seventh age of its powers. It is a vast, pale-violet beam that a practitioner gathers from the fraying seams between stars and releases in a single, ruinous sweep.

rites.name: Nualluana
rites.text: Nualluana is a concept-level power of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a sphere of gathered radiance that its wielder raises overhead before hurling it downward onto a foe. Sages of the E6 era reckoned it the finishing stroke of seven-age duels, since a single sphere can split a star's mantle.

rites.name: Alaamaenys
rites.text: Alaamaenys is a sealed dark rite of the Ki realm, an obsidian gate-engine that drinks a bound soul's vitality and returns it as a ruthless, flawless will. Its wardens hold that every awakening costs one life-thread, and the wielder who answers the call becomes a conqueror in the shape of their own former self.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is a cosmic-scale tumbling assault technique belonging to the Ki-realm of Lyarae, in which the practitioner rolls across a starfield and then unleashes a cascade of blows. Each impact scatters glittering sparks and comically resonant echoes across the void. It is taught in the sixth era as a discipline of rhythm and nerve rather than raw force.

rites.name: Nuerlora
rites.text: Nuerlora is a concept-form ki pressure technique of the Ki realm, an inscribed wave that the practitioner seals into the bedrock and then releases with a single rising gesture. In the Lyarae omniverse's seventh age it is taught only to disciplined wardens who have mastered the older binding art, and its legend holds that a single unbroken release once reshaped a whole continent's coastline.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a meditative discipline practiced by hermit sages of the Lyarae Ki-realm, who sit in a floating lotus and draw the stillness of a dying star into their core. Adepts can temper their inner flame for ages, then release a single focused surge that outshines whole constellations. Its power is tied entirely to patience and silence.

rites.name: Silelamwen
rites.text: Silelamwen is a concept-born dazzle of the Ki realm, a rush of stacked strikes that ends in a violet lance of pressed light. It is said to have punched a hole clean through the sky-sea of the Vaerun reach during the fourth age, leaving the tides there wrong for a generation.

rites.name: Elionnarlae
rites.text: Elionnarlae is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a self-sustaining lattice of luminous spores that bloom from a single seed-mind and reproduce without any partner. Its eldest bloom can exhale a sphere of compressed starlight containing a new sapling, which hurls itself at enemies as a living detonation. Dormant fields of these spores can sustain entire ecosystems for millennia.

rites.name: Silaelannys
rites.text: Silaelannys is a technique of pure motion in the realm of Ki, letting a practitioner outrun their own shadow until observers swear they have stepped out of existence. Its masters fold their momentum into brief, storm-like reappearances, and the strongest can strike from a place they were never seen to leave.

rites.name: Lyinneth
rites.text: Lyinneth is a blade-spirit of the Ki realm who, in the third age of the sixth era, strikes in a flurry of silver crescents that cut through hostile wards before they can form. Its signature act is a Stream of Hollow Crescents, each arc carrying the cleaving force of a dying star's shockwave, so that a single sweep can sunder a fortress's foundations.

rites.name: Sileimaera
rites.text: Sileimaera is a dark, sun-colored sphere of compressed ki gathered by a single outstretched palm, a weapon its wielder claims charges far faster than any rival's version. Forged in the seventh age of the Ki realm, it is reserved for planet-ending strikes or as a desperate final gambit when all else fails.

rites.name: Lyaraelora
rites.text: Lyaraelora is a radiant tide-spirit of the Lyarae cosmos, born seven ages ago when the first song of the Ki realm rippled across the void. Her sorrow and fury are said to be the grief of drowned stars, and when roused she unleashes a sweeping cascade of light that can unmake whole constellations.

rites.name: Lyarlinnora
rites.text: Lyarlinnora is a razor-wind technique born in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where practitioners fold their fingers into a sealed lattice and release it as a spiraling gale centered on themselves. The vortex tears through anything within its reach, and in the seventh age its finest wielders can unravel a star's worth of matter in a single exhale.

rites.name: Venelwen
rites.text: Venelwen is a sealed crystalline relic of the Ki realm, a lantern-shaped vessel that drinks in the spiritual exhalations of its bearer and folds them into a single luminous beam. Its keepers say its deepest mode gathers the final reserves of a life into one unrepeatable shot, a discipline the Lyarae archives call the Last Lantern Rite.

rites.name: Siliorwen
rites.text: Siliorwen is a sealed-power technique of the Lyarae ki masters, a blue-gold beam drawn from a fully unlocked core that the wielder can ignite only after shedding every restraint. Its reach is fixed to a fifteen-meter bloom around a single chosen target, and no record of its true ceiling survives.

rites.name: Elaena
rites.text: Elaena is a sunlit concept of resonant bloom that answers a wish by unfolding layered petals of stored light across a dying orbit. Within the Lyarae ki-lattice, a single bloom can hold a star's worth of quiet energy and release it in one luminous exhale.

rites.name: Nuamaerae
rites.text: Nuamaerae is a storm-spirit of the Ki realm who gathers the thunder of dying suns into a ringing crown of glass-blue lightning. It can hurl a single bolt that splits the sky and scorches the wounded souls of those it strikes.

rites.name: Ryimuanniel
rites.text: Ryimuanniel is a sovereign of the Ki realm in the fourth age of Lyarae, who hurls a violet sphere of compressed will that can split the crust of a dead star. Its blast cloud carries a crackling halo that lingers for days after each release.

rites.name: Nueminora
rites.text: Nueminora is a sealed-aperture kinetic lattice that gathers the dying light of a collapsing neutron pair and hurls it as a single coherent spear. Its wielders, the Quiet Choirs of Lyarae, use it only to unmake dead stars that threaten inhabited systems.

rites.name: Nuiliel
rites.text: Nuiliel is a concept-realm technique in the Lyarae omniverse, where a wielder seizes an opponent's skull, hurls them skyward, then drives them into the earth with a spinning, bone-breaking descent. The impact of the final slam is said to reshape the ground for miles around, leaving a crater that fills with glowing mist.

rites.name: Nuallemeth
rites.text: Nuallemeth is a paired ki technique wielded in the Lyarae omniverse, in which the user fires two sphere-shaped energy bursts that remain steerable after release. The sphere pair can be directed by hand motions, allowing them to curve around obstacles or chase down evasive foes. Its power is measured against the ki realm's E6 threshold of endurance.

rites.name: Silimarwen
rites.text: Silimarwen is a cosmic warrior-monk of the Ki realm who channels the collected breath of dying stars into a single pressing strike. Its signature technique, the Hollowed Palm, lets it absorb an enemy's blow and return it as a concussive shock that tears through the target's core.

rites.name: Elioreilora
rites.text: Elioreilora is a sealed ki-discipline from the Lyarae omniverse's E6 era, where practitioners charge a palm with breath-bound force and drive it into their own sternum to tear open the body's inner channels. Its wounds are deliberately self-inflicted, serving as a jarring anchor that breaks trance-like influences and forces a mind back into the flesh it truly occupies.

rites.name: Alaenae
rites.text: Alaenae is a relentless ring-warden of the Ki realm, who gathers her fading sparks into a single incandescent sphere and hurls it across the ash-plains of Lyarae. Her strike is known as the Whitefall Lance, a blast that scorches the air into a corridor of burning vortex.

rites.name: Ryirualiel
rites.text: Ryirualiel is a sentient tide of living marrow that sheds its own lower body to form gelatinous shells around foes, binding them within a pulsing cocoon. Once sealed, the shell ignites with a compressed stellar fire, detonating the enclosed target together with surrounding ground. It is revered in the Ki realm as a patient, unforgiving siege engine.

rites.name: Ilyenys
rites.text: Ilyenys is a dormant convergence-engine of the Ki realm, a crystalline lattice that stores the residual heat of collapsed stars and releases it as a single synchronized pulse. Its keepers in the E6 era regard it less as a weapon than as a clock that has never been wound.

rites.name: Ilyeriel
rites.text: Ilyeriel is a blade-form technique of the Ki realm, forged when a warrior condenses a golden storm of spirit energy into a single towering edge. Its wielder can sever the bonds holding an opponent's existence in place, and in the Lyarae omniverse it is taught only to those who have proven they will not waste its terrible reach.

rites.name: Alaeniel
rites.text: Alaeniel is a concept of crystalline needle-storms woven from the thin light between realms, drawn out by a single traced gesture. Its needles splinter into glassy shards that pierce whatever they find, sealing their wound like frost.

rites.name: Venuarlelae
rites.text: Venuarlelae is a blade-shaped concept in the realm of Ki, forged from the borrowed hope of a dying era, and it cuts through any defense that refuses to yield. Its final stroke is said to sever not just a body but the belief that sustains it, leaving the foe split in two before the wielder even steps back.

rites.name: Veniollora
rites.text: Veniollora is a crystalline resonance lattice that hums at the edge of the Ki realm, bending stored starlight into concentrated pressure. Its tuning is kept by the Hollow Choir, who sing it into resonance once per age to avoid collapse.

rites.name: Lyinuala
rites.text: Lyinuala is a radiant beam-technique wielded by the warrior-kings of the Ki realm, who draw a glowing lance of stored starlight back along the arm before hurling it forward. It is said to have been first forged in the ash-fields of the Oroxen wars, where a single exhalation of it split a dead moon in half.

rites.name: Orieleth
rites.text: Orieleth is a sun-forged lance-wielder of the Ki realm whose final thrust was said to hollow out a dying star. Her single devastating release tore a bright seam through the ember-fields of Lyarae, and the wound it left still hums with stored heat.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a crackling lattice of lightning-bright ki that its wielders hurl in arcing twin discs from cupped palms, each strike bursting a short distance ahead of the body so that the space right before the caster stays safe. In the Lyarae archives it is remembered as the technique that broke an ancient tyrant's shell during the Hollow Tithe, though it barely scratched the same tyrant's heir.

rites.name: Lyirleinae
rites.text: Lyirleinae is a sweeping lattice-wave weapon of the Ki realm's sixth era, drawn from the crystalline heart-cores of the Ossarine reef-spirits. It is loosed as a crescent of stacked luminous rings that shatter whatever they cross, and it is said to drain the nearby ambient charge of a whole sky when fully charged.

rites.name: Eluanys
rites.text: Eluanys is a concept-born sentinel of the Ki realm in Lyarae, shaped from the resonance of a vow spoken across seven ages of silence. Its signature stance gathers the surrounding light into a single flawless pose before releasing it as a sweeping arc of pure resolve.

rites.name: Lyama
rites.text: Lyama is a crescent-bladed war-technique of the Ki realm, wielded by sword-dancers who sprint at a foe, scatter piercing shards of condensed will through the air, and finish with a closing sequence that detonates the stored force inside the target's ground. Its final burst can flatten a moon-sized plateau and leaves even the most resilient fighters stunned beyond the fight.

rites.name: Alainnalora
rites.text: Alainnalora is a self-sealing ember-warden of the Ki realm who, when cornered, folds her body into a crimson detonation that tears a hollow in the sky before reassembling from drifting motes of light. Her wrath is a currency she spends with reluctant precision, and the Lyarae ages remember her less for the blasts than for the silence that follows each one.

rites.name: Miina
rites.text: Miina is a sea-glass sprite of the Ki realm who keeps the tides of Lyarae in a single rolling pearl. When the pearl is struck, the swell it throws can flatten whole coastlines in one heartbeat.

rites.name: Ilyinnora
rites.text: Ilyinnora is a drifting sentinel of the Ki realm's sixth era, a warrior-spirit that stitches fragments of dead starlight into a single blue-gleaming fist. Its signature technique lets it vanish between points of the void and descend upon a foe as a single devastating blow that ruptures the very substance of their domain.

rites.name: Alailuanae
rites.text: Alailuanae is a charged palm-blast technique from the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the Ki realm and used by warriors of the sixth age. The user gathers surplus energy above the head, letting sparks of yellow lightning spill off during the build, then thrusts both hands forward to hurl the concentrated force at a foe.

rites.name: Venamiel
rites.text: Venamiel is a brief surge of swelling vitality that a fighter draws from stored heartfire, bulking the body while sapping speed for its duration. Its practitioners in the Ki realm treat the swelling as a gift to be spent in one decisive, hungry burst.

rites.name: Silinualora
rites.text: Silinualora is a ki-driven strike art from the Lyarae concept realm, where the practitioner gathers stellar-scale resonance into a dozen-fold barrage of palm and talon blows. Its final impact can crack the ground of a dying sun, leaving the target scarred from within.

rites.name: Ryamaelora
rites.text: Ryamaelora is a dragon-shaped spirit-fist technique forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 era, where a practitioner gathers the ambient light of a dying sun into a single rising coil of force. It is said to hollow out whatever it strikes, leaving only a silhouette of the target behind. Its practitioners rarely use it, reserving it for moments when the Ki realm itself is under threat.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a relentless striker of the Ki realm who, in the seventh age of Lyarae, is said to strike a foe with a cascade of blows that end in a plummeting crown-strike. Its finishing blow ripples outward like a falling star, leveling anything that stands beneath it.

rites.name: Silaemilwen
rites.text: Silaemilwen is a crackling sphere of condensed storm-light forged by the Ki-weavers of Lyarae during the Fourth Ascension, a weapon so bright it once eclipsed a dying sun's neighbours. Its bearer hurls the orb in a slow, ringing arc, and where it lands the very air turns to plasma and hums for a century.

rites.name: Ilyemwen
rites.text: Ilyemwen is a cultivated technique of the Ki realm, in which practitioners fold and reshape their own spiritual essence to slip across space, split into duplicates, or swell to colossal stature. Its masters treat it as a discipline of inner stillness, and the most advanced among them can force a fracture in their own spirit that releases a catastrophic burst. Within the Lyarae omniverse it stands as a respected but dangerous art, rarely taught outside secluded orders.

rites.name: Alaenwen
rites.text: Alaenwen is a Ki-realm technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a stride so swift it lays down a dense fan of phantom selves that bait a foe into exposing their guard. The phantoms are used less as a shield than as a feint, drawing the enemy's strikes into empty air before the true body closes in.

rites.name: Ilyiranna
rites.text: Ilyiranna is a crystalline sphinx-warden of the Ki realm, who condenses the cooled ash of dead suns into a single, coruscating lattice-blade. In the Age of Vesper Hollows she sealed a rogue dimension by striking its heart with a shard of dying gold light.

rites.name: Venamwen
rites.text: Venamwen is a subtle resonance of harmonic resonance that bends the emotional spectrum of nearby beings, amplifying their sympathetic currents into a temporary field of mutual empathy. When activated, the field can synchronize intent, allowing allies to coordinate actions with near-perfect timing while opponents feel a dissonant disarray in their focus. Though harmless in appearance, the effect can be weaponised to stall or misdirect foes in critical moments.

rites.name: Oriala
rites.text: Oriala is a concept of crystalline resonance drawn from the deep currents of the Ki realm during the sixth era of Lyarae. Its wielders strike with a rolling pulse that bends the air before the blow arrives, letting them drive foes away and then fall upon them with stored momentum.

rites.name: Silualimys
rites.text: Silualimys is a crystalline predator from the Ki-realm of Lyarae, a creature that feeds on the echoes of fallen stars. In its seventh age it learned to fold a dying sun's light into a single lance and hurl it through an enemy's heart.

rites.name: Siliomys
rites.text: Siliomys is the oldest energy technique in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a wave of blue force gathered through wide sweeping arms and cupped palms, then loosed forward. Its practitioners treat it as a teaching in patience, since the wave gains power only while the caster holds the sweep steady. Few have mastered it, and fewer still have seen it released at full strength.

rites.name: Ryama
rites.text: Ryama is a concept from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a paired ember-hued sigil that a wielder folds into the air before loosing twin pursuing lances. It has been known to outpace fleeing foes and ruin the stone halls of the Sable Concordance in a single pass.

rites.name: Ryenys
rites.text: Ryenys is a concept of stunning electrical discharge in the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the bolt-and-paralysis arts of the sixth age. Its practitioners loose a crackling jolt from the antennae or fingertips that locks a foe's muscles for a heartbeat or two. The art is prized for control rather than destruction, though its raw output can still scorch stone.

rites.name: Eluamys
rites.text: Eluamys is a Ki technique of the Lyarae universe in which the wielder points one finger, condenses a glowing sphere at its tip, and then releases a rapid volley of tiny spheres that curve back toward a target. Each sphere is small on its own, but the swarm is strong enough to pierce armor and shatter a foe's guard.

rites.name: Ilyinae
rites.text: Ilyinae is a dormant concept-entity in the Lyarae omniverse, a crystalline pattern of stored wrath that sleeps within the Ki realm until a worthy provocation stirs it. When it wakes, it condenses its anger into a single sharp lance of violet light that can unmake a world in one stroke.

rites.name: Miillae
rites.text: Miillae is a ki-channeling technique of the Lyarae realm, a sphere of compressed resentment hurled from both palms that gathers the wielder's suppressed defiance into a single crushing wave. It is said to be the last weapon of a Ki-born warrior who chose death over submission to a stellar tyrant.

rites.name: Ilyiniorlae
rites.text: Ilyiniorlae is a skyborne duelist of the Ki realm who strikes in rapid volleys of descending heel-blows, each one tearing a hole through the air before the foe can settle. Its signature is a somersaulting plunge that can split a moon-sized shell, though it staggers for an instant afterward, a gap that rival duelists learn to exploit.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a concept of quiet gravitational resonance drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a force said to bend the weight of anything it touches toward a single point. Its practitioners treat it as a discipline of patience, using it to stall falling stars rather than to strike.

rites.name: Elanna
rites.text: Elanna is a sovereign storm-weaver of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who gathers the scattered heat of dying suns into a single radiant lance. Her strongest technique is said to pierce the veil between realms, and she is feared as much for the holes she leaves in reality as for the armies she has broken.

rites.name: Lyeruamys
rites.text: Lyeruamys is a concentrated sonic-ki scream that its wielders loose when pushed beyond restraint, rippling outward until the surrounding terrain quakes and loose matter is flung aside. Its force scales with how much spirit is poured into the howl, and untrained voices often shatter the very ground they stand on. Practitioners of the Ki realm regard it as both a weapon and a warning, since the shout can also knock back stray energy and restore the speaker's reserves.

rites.name: Venarlirys
rites.text: Venarlirys is a sovereign wave of condensed Ki that its bearer gathers by spreading both arms wide until the air itself ripples with pale violet light. It is loosed in a single forward thrust that has been known to scour a moon's shadowed face and hurl its remnants into the void. Its wielders seldom use it twice in one age, for the strain tears the channels through which the energy flows.

rites.name: Oriimeth
rites.text: Oriimeth is a silent, ember-eyed warden of the Ki realm who fights only when a wrong has gone unanswered for an age. Its single signature act is a patient step followed by one open-palmed strike that collapses the target's spirit-lattice and detonates it from within.

rites.name: Venelluanae
rites.text: Venelluanae is a drifting sky-warden of the Ki realm who ends each duel by folding the air above a foe and dropping the entire column onto them. Its favored finishing maneuver turns a rushing aerial combination into a single crushing collapse that leaves a crater the width of a valley. Scholars of the E6 era consider it a bridge between personal combat and the stellar-scale weapons that followed.

rites.name: Lyinnora
rites.text: Lyinnora is a cosmic wrestler-spirit of the Ki realm who hurls rivals into the sky and drives them into the ground with a fist that sounds like a bell tolling across the void. Its signature rush seizes a foe by the crown, plummets through layers of sky, and detonates on impact, leaving craters that glow for an age.

rites.name: Nuelleth
rites.text: Nuelleth is a dusk-colored ki construct of the Lyarae cosmos, a pair of drifting luminous shards that orbit its bearer before being hurled at foes. Its wielders call it a paired hunger, for the two shards grow heavier with every blow they absorb.

rites.name: Orianora
rites.text: Orianora is a sky-warden of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who strikes in a cascade of falling-star blows before sealing the finish with a collapsing lance of starlight. Her technique is said to have been first taught to a tide of drifting embers that now burn in the outer dark.

rites.name: Veneimeth
rites.text: Veneimeth is a shimmering ward-technique of the Ki realm, tuned by hermit-scribes of the sixth era to hold back collapsing light-storms. When a user forces the ward to detonate on purpose, the seven-layered sigil folds inward and releases its stored radiance in a single spherical rupture, unlike any sanctioned discharge.

rites.name: Silamaerora
rites.text: Silamaerora is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a sustained psychic pulse that ripples outward in violet arcs and can hollow out a hostile star's corona. Its wielders are said to have learned it from the echo of a dying nebula during the age of the Sunless Choir.

rites.name: Oriira
rites.text: Oriira is a sealed ember-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the sixth age of Lyarae, that gathers scattered starlight into a bound core. When it finally releases the core, the trapped light detonates inside the target's own body, scouring the surrounding plains into glass.

rites.name: Elaenae
rites.text: Elaenae is a wandering storm-spirit of Lyarae's Ki realm, a being that gathers the restless tension of unfinished oaths into a single crackling sphere of light. Its signature technique is a mistimed lance of condensed resolve that tends to fly wild, scorching whatever lies beside its intended mark rather than the mark itself.

rites.name: Elannys
rites.text: Elannys is a drifting spirit-warden of the Ki realm who gathers the scattered willpower of mourning crowds into a luminous ember and swallows it whole. Once absorbed, the ember transforms the warden into a radiant sovereign whose single strike can unmake a fortress of dark glass. Its reserves are said to be drawn from the collective hope of a whole era.

rites.name: Nuemiolleth
rites.text: Nuemiolleth is a volatile sphere of hatred-black lightning gathered from the shadowed hearts of a conquered host, and it detonates the instant it touches any surface, sky, or sea. Its wielder can hurl it at a world's core, but only the full release can crack a planet, and even then the aftershock ripples through the Lyarae threads that bind the realms together.

rites.name: Alaerleth
rites.text: Alaerleth is a concept-state of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a form of sustained radiant force that its bearers hold without fading, even while sleeping. It was discovered in the seventh age as a way to balance overwhelming strength against endurance, and those who master it can exhale a storm that flattens whole districts.

rites.name: Lyimiel
rites.text: Lyimiel is a silver-scaled warden of the Ki realm who guards the drifting seeds of dead worlds. Her ritual of folding stellar light into a single breath can unmake a sun's worth of matter in one exhale.

rites.name: Venaeriel
rites.text: Venaeriel is a rapid-fire ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, drawn as twin charged spheres hurled in a spreading volley. Its user spreads arms wide to gather power before unleashing a barrage that blankets the target in bursts of light. Practitioners use it to pin down foes and buy time for greater techniques.

rites.name: Venemae
rites.text: Venemae is a concept-era power-set in Lyarae, a dark sovereign of the Ki realm whose true strength lies in a sealed transformation that only awakens when its bearer consumes a sufficient lifeforce. Its ultimate state is said to bend the ambient ki of a whole star system into a single crushing hunger.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is a concept-realm blade of the Ki era, born when a gathered chorus of living wills is drawn into a single wielder and condensed into a edge of pure resolve. Its light starts as blue and gold and burns white when the gathered strength peaks, and it is said to be forged anew each time an age is in its final hour. It is the instrument its bearers reserve for a last stand against something that cannot be otherwise undone.

rites.name: Silionae
rites.text: Silionae is a concept-grade energy discharge gathered by the wardens of the Ki realm during the seventh age, a lance of pale azure light that drinks the surrounding dusk and returns it as a single, unbroken shriek. It is used rarely, because each release costs the caster a portion of their own sense of direction and time.

rites.name: Alaima
rites.text: Alaima is a concept-class power in the realm of Ki, a sustained beam of condensed will that a warrior gathers from their own core and hurls forward in one piercing discharge. Its user can only loose it after a long stillness, and it has been known to carve through the bones of a dead star's remnant. In the era of Lyarae's fourth age it is remembered as the last resort of exiles who refused to be unmade.

rites.name: Ryeriel
rites.text: Ryeriel is a sovereign warden of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, ruling during the sixth era as its seventh age begins. Its emerald gaze can unravel a star's light into two thin rays of violet fire that cut across entire solar systems. Ryeriel fights only to keep the balance of the Ki realm intact.

rites.name: Venallora
rites.text: Venallora is a sorcerous ember-serpent of the Ki realm, kept in the hollow crown of the Seventh Age and fed on the grief of dying suns. When it is roused, it exhales a column of violet cinders that can unmake the armour of gods, though its own body is brittle when struck from behind.

rites.name: Ryellionwen
rites.text: Ryellionwen is a hollow lattice of crackling plasma the Ki-wardens of Lyarae form between their palms and hurl across the sky. Its detonation can unmake a mountain-sized beast, yet anything small enough to slip through the open center passes unharmed, a flaw the wardens guard against by training their eyes on the gap.

rites.name: Miela
rites.text: Miela is a concept-realm entity of the Ki realm in Lyarae's seventh age, a prismatic wave-spirit that gathers the last breath of dying stars into a single lethal pulse. Its signature act is a point-blank discharge that erases the target's life-echo rather than merely its body. It can hold a charge long enough to be cast as a standing threat across whole systems.

rites.name: Nuanora
rites.text: Nuanora is a sealing incantation of the Lyarae omniverse, a sigil-bound containment that can lock any living being inside any object, from a vessel to a star. Its unpronounceable chant has passed between many hands across the ages, and its power lies less in force than in the precise words that call it forth.

rites.name: Eluareth
rites.text: Eluareth is a concept of ki-discipline in Lyarae's E6 era, a condensed radiant strike built by gathering breath and will into both palms before loosing it as a single spiraling column. Its adepts can release a far greater sustained surge by pouring extra inner fire into the same form, and some have trained to channel it through the right arm alone for a sharper, more focused blast.

rites.name: Nuela
rites.text: Nuela is a sonic-resonance discipline practiced in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where practitioners tune their breath to the hum of crystalline wind-harps. Its masters are said to shatter cliffs by humming a single note at the right pitch.

rites.name: Ryennae
rites.text: Ryennae is a ki-forged seeking projectile from the Ki realm, loosed by a wielder who braces one hand beneath the other to steady a radiant amber lance. It outruns ordinary bolts and curves back toward its quarry with grinding persistence, though it never matches the raw force of its greatest kin.

rites.name: Lyeruamiel
rites.text: Lyeruamiel is a twin-sphere technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder hurls two luminous azure orbs in quick succession before gathering their palms into a torrent of rapid blue bursts. It is said to be the signature art of the sixth era's warrior-scholars, who wielded it to break apart unstable starlight during the Tessaron Wars.

rites.name: Nuamiriel
rites.text: Nuamiriel is a sealed star-warden of the Lyarae ki-realm, an ancient guardian whose single devastating ray is said to have bored through the dying core of a red giant during the seventh age. Those who have witnessed the beam describe it as a violet thread that outlives the light of the star it strikes.

rites.name: Nualleth
rites.text: Nualleth is a crystalline sky-weaver of the Ki realm, a warden-engine that gathers the drifting breath of dying suns into a single lens-bound fusillade. Its gun-limbs bloom into a tangle of seeking emerald needles when left unfocused, then coalesce into a single eyed projectile when the warden holds still long enough to aim.

rites.name: Venemwen
rites.text: Venemwen is a concept of resonant bloom, a sealed harmonic pulse that the Ki realm of Lyarae's fourth age stored in crystalline lattices and released as a single shockwave. Its practitioners tuned their breath to the lattice until the stored tone shattered outward in a ring of force.

rites.name: Oriennae
rites.text: Oriennae is a drifting seven-age concept of luminous sugar-spirits who live in the candied halo of the Ki realm. Their signature is a sweetening ray that converts whatever it strikes into an edible crystalline confection, though the transformed targets sometimes keep fighting.

rites.name: Venaleth
rites.text: Venaleth is a crystalline sentinel-engine of the Ki realm, built to hold the boundary between two tidal seas in the seventh age of Lyarae. Its twin lenses can fire a focused lance of bound starlight that cuts through rock and sea alike, though the engine must keep its own resonance steady to avoid shattering.

rites.name: Veniorlae
rites.text: Veniorlae is a sovereign storm-engine of the Ki realm, a mind of pure combustion that wheels across the sky in a chain of seven overlapping strikes. Its final act is a single gathered beam loosed from one hand while it spins backward through the air, a detonation that has been known to split the crust of entire continents. It is revered in the age of the Seventh Ember as the sharpest proof that motion can outlast the things it breaks.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a bladed energy technique wielded by the warrior-knight Orvane Tesh of the Ki realm, who swings a blade of condensed starlight to hurl a crescent wave across the battlefield. The wave tears through anything in its path, and the knights of the Ki era regard it as both a weapon and a sign of sworn oath.

rites.name: Oriallora
rites.text: Oriallora is a sealed gravity-engine held in the drowned spires of Vessenmoor, a relic of the sixth era that gathers ambient ki into a hungry, golden-rimmed sphere. When its keepers wake it, the sphere erupts into a crater-making detonation that can unmake a star's worth of resistance in a single breath.

rites.name: Alaeruamiel
