rites.text: Alaeruamiel is a dawn-wrought ki weapon of the Lyarae realm, a glove of hardened light that a wandering warden swings to shatter the wards of old sealed towers. Four years after its forging, it can flatten a moon-sized shard of frozen cloud with a single gesture.

rites.name: Alaarae
rites.text: Alaarae is a Ki discipline from the Lyarae omniverse in which the practitioner charges their spirit until it splits into two bodies, then divides each again into four solid duplicates. The copies draw on a shared reservoir, so each carries only a quarter of the original's strength, a flaw that masters of the art spend lifetimes learning to overcome.

rites.name: Ilyiriel
rites.text: Ilyiriel is a sky-coursing warden of the Ki realm's fourth age, whose kick ignites the air in a spiral of brass-colored light. Her technique lets her crack the crust of a sunken moon, and she teaches it to apprentices who have never once left their village.

rites.name: Venuanae
rites.text: Venuanae is a dormant-power awakening, a single rite that pulls the sealed reserves of a living being out to their absolute limit over a long vigil. Those who endure it become a brief, incandescent blaze of their true potential before the strain demands a price. Its practitioners guard the method jealously, for even the smallest misjudgment can leave a soul hollowed.

rites.name: Oriinys
rites.text: Oriinys is a conceptual reservoir of drawn-in ember-light that the Lyarae ascetics learned to bank in seven-year cycles, spending it in short bursts of hardened will. Its devotees call its tiers "stored breaths," each one carrying a distinct effect: some sharpen the body, some hush incoming harm, and the rarest refill the bearer's reserves in an instant. Oriinys was devised in the sixth era as a discipline of restraint, and its misuse is the reason the ascetic orders keep their stores sealed.

rites.name: Silinora
rites.text: Silinora is a dormant concept-body in the sixth era of the Lyarae omniverse, a catalogued pattern of seven ages that drifts between Ki and the powers realm. It is said to hold a single unfinished technique that is re-authored whenever a mind reaches for it.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a being whose body hums with stored starlight and who guards the seams between eras. In the seventh age of the sixth era, it once fractured a dying sun's gravity well to shield a drifting archive of memories.

rites.name: Eleimiorys
rites.text: Eleimiorys is a cold-bringing sovereign of the Ki realm who can seal a rival inside a glacier-sized sphere of rime with a single sweep of its open arms. Its frozen blasts are said to bind the very flow of motion, so that even hurled stars grow still before they strike.

rites.name: Eleniometh
rites.text: Eleniometh is the ancient cosmic drone-sovereign of the Ki realm, who in the fourth age of the Lyarae omniverse learned to fold two stellar cores into a single shrieking lance. Its signature act is the Glassfall Choir, a convergence of resonant tones that can hollow out a dying star in one breath.

rites.name: Eliruaneth
rites.text: Eliruaneth is a condensed sphere of rose-hued force that its wielder gathers from the hum of Lyarae's ley currents, then wreathes in crackling storm-light before hurling it across the sky. Its impact does not merely break bodies but unravels the local arrangement of matter, leaving a silent hollow in the terrain. The Ki realm's sages regard it as a weapon too precise to be called cruel.

rites.name: Lyirla
rites.text: Lyirla is a crystalline concept of kinetic percussion, a rhythm of strikes that the Ki realm of Lyarae treats as a language of stacking force. Its practitioners unleash cascades of blows that, in their final beat, collapse whole valleys of stone into dust.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a fallen star-spirit of the Ki realm whose breath carries a slow, crystalline hunger. Anything it touches over a single exhalation is drawn into a lattice of living glass that holds until the wielder's will lets go. Its elders forbade it to speak in the age of the Second Dimming.

rites.name: Lyira
rites.text: Lyira is the sealed-away mistress of frozen hours in Lyarae, an entity who can fold a span of years into a single held breath. She is said to have once paused an entire dying star's collapse to let its last travelers escape.

rites.name: Ryillioreth
rites.text: Ryillioreth is a sealed resonance of the Ki realm, a vow-shaped current that a bearer may call forth in the Sixth Era to announce their will across the surrounding stillness. Its activation floods the bearer's form with layered light that can be felt for many lightyears before it fades.

rites.name: Mianae
rites.text: Mianae is a tidal-spirit weapon-sovereign of the Ki realm in the fourth age of Lyarae, known for a three-stage ascent: a tapping strike to wake the foe, a rising knee into the core, and a descending fist that splits the soul-current. Its final blow has been recorded collapsing a dying star's corona into a single seam of light.

rites.name: Miimae
rites.text: Miimae is a concept-class pulse of crystalline ki, a drifting sphere woven from the dying breath of the Lyarae stars and carried through the Ki realm in the seventh age of the sixth era. Its wielders gather it between their palms until the air itself hums, then send it outward to bend the currents of a shattered sun.

rites.name: Oriiluaneth
rites.text: Oriiluaneth is a crystalline ki-engine that hums beneath the glass spires of the Veil-Tide Archipelago in the realm of Ki. It gathers starlight into a single blinding discharge that can scour a dead sun's ring of debris from orbit.

rites.name: Elerimwen
rites.text: Elerimwen is a Ki-trained fighting style in the Lyarae omniverse, where practitioners channel their vitality through their jaws to tear, seize, and hold foes. Its masters are known for catching incoming projectiles mid-flight with their teeth and for clamping onto a limb long enough to turn a clash. Students are taught that the bite is less about raw force than about refusing to let go.

rites.name: Eluannae
rites.text: Eluannae is a seventh-age concept of a moon-bound clockwork sovereign whose sealing rite stops a region's flow of hours in place. Its central judgment is a silver sentence delivered as a cascade of stilled light, which freezes foes and lets allies press through the gap. The rite is said to hold the stars themselves to their appointed hours.

rites.name: Miala
rites.text: Miala is a concept-born sovereign of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, who sculpted her own inner flame across seven ages until it burned with the density of a dying star. Her signature is a shadow-plated aura that shrugs off the strongest rival strikes and outlasts entire rival dynasties. She is feared less for her fury than for the calm patience with which she waits out every challenger.

rites.name: Orieniorwen
rites.text: Orieniorwen is a mental-binding technique of the Ki realm, letting its wielder freeze a foe in place with a cobalt glow and a brief flare of the eyes. The hold persists only while the user keeps unbroken focus, and it collapses entirely if the user's sight is taken before the gaze lands. Its telekinetic offshoot can harden ordinary cords into fixtures that resist any struggle without outside aid.

rites.name: Alaimeirys
rites.text: Alaimeirys is a concept-realm construct of the Lyarae omniverse, a shimmering lattice of crystallized starlight that drifts between dying suns. Its signature act is a convergent bloom in which it gathers ambient radiance into three staggered luminous shards hurled in quick succession, each shattering whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Elaelinneth
rites.text: Elaelinneth is a concept-kind power in the Lyarae omniverse, a rhythm of stored heat that a wielder draws into the body to strike in measured phases. It belongs to the seventh age of the E6 era, where its practitioners tune their pulse to the drifting ki of the powers locale.

rites.name: Ryema
rites.text: Ryema is a concept-realm entity of the Ki domain in Lyarae's sixth era, who sustains a radiant inner furnace rather than unleashing it in bursts. Its inhabitants say it can hold its brightest state through sleep, trading peak output for unending steadiness. Few who have seen it fully unleashed have lived to describe it in detail.

rites.name: Miireth
rites.text: Miireth is a wrathful sovereign of the Ki realm who, when provoked, ignites a violet corona that can unmake two suns at once. Its fury is so raw that it is said to overwhelm even the mightiest champions of Lyarae.

rites.name: Mielae
rites.text: Mielae is a drifting concept of resonant bloom-cells that hum through the Ki realm of Lyarae during its seventh age. It answers any sudden strain by flaring into a single overwhelming pulse that can reshape nearby terrain.

rites.name: Silemiel
rites.text: Silemiel is a dormant tide-sigil of the Lyarae cosmos, a resonance-pattern that stores pressure from distant starlight in fractal lattices. When woken, it releases a single arc of condensed luminous force that can bend the orbits of nearby moons.

rites.name: Orialera
rites.text: Orialera is a sky-bound warden of the Lyarae concept realm, a being who seizes the crown of any rival and plunges them through the bedrock of their own world. Her grip on a foe's skull is said to be strong enough to fracture the sealed chasms beneath Ki, where ancient seas once drained away.

rites.name: Oriallys
rites.text: Oriallys is a ritual pursuit-technique of the Ki realm, in which an ascendant wanderer stretches their will into a single charging strike that hunts down whatever flees before it. Its final blow is a double-fisted plunge that drives the target into the ground when struck in the air. Scholars of Lyarae disagree on whether the technique was ever fully completed.

rites.name: Sileineth
rites.text: Sileineth is a kind of tidal war-engine of the Ki realm, a vast cathedral of woven starlight that gathers the ambient glow of a dying nebula into a single cupped sphere. At the moment of release it splits into twin counter-rotating rivers of light that seek a target across parsecs before collapsing inward.

rites.name: Ilyirannys
rites.text: Ilyirannys is a quiet, unbound current of spiritual pressure that the old wardens of Lyarae use to seal fractured dimensions. It can be gathered into a single open palm and released as a streak of white dissolution that erases whatever stands in its path.

rites.name: Sileinnys
rites.text: Sileinnys is a dual-hued lance of condensed starlight, forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 era, that its wielder hurls by fusing two opposing currents into one. It was first carried by a warrior who sought to end a tide of dying suns, and it remains the most feared weapon the realm has ever known.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a Ki-realm warrior of the seventh age in Lyarae, who gathers five crimson pulses in each palm and spins them into twin discs of swirling light before hurling them forward as a single wave. Her signature technique is said to outrun even the most evasive foes, since it arrives before they can react.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a spiral-mouthed cosmic wyrm of the Ki realm, whose throat holds a sealed gate to the void between suns. When it exhales the stored hunger, the verdant bolt tears through whole stellar systems and hangs in the sky as a scar.

rites.name: Nualae
rites.text: Nualae is a charging technique of the Ki realm in the E6 era, in which the wielder gathers a pale luminous shell and hurls the whole body forward like a lance. The shell serves as armor during the run and can be steered mid-flight to dodge incoming strikes or redirect toward a chosen foe. It is taught to young initiates of the Lyarae powers as their first lesson in commitment.

rites.name: Elirlys
rites.text: Elirlys is a concept held within the powers of the Lyarae omniverse, a single decisive strike that gathers the borrowed resonance of every ally who has ever been near its bearer. Its wielders are said to unleash it only when they have been reduced to their last breath, and the blow is remembered as the moment a stranger's defeat became a victory for many.

rites.name: Silirlae
rites.text: Silirlae is a sentient crystalline weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, forged in the seventh age of Lyarae's dimensional tides. It projects two whirling lattices of starlight that hunt a target relentlessly, returning to the bearer only after the quarry is found and bisected.

rites.name: Oriemualiel
rites.text: Oriemualiel is a drifting concept-entity of the Ki realm, born in the fourth age of the Lyarae cycle from a single held breath of the first dawn. It answers any stillness by unspooling a volley of cold white seeds that bloom into a scouring wind across the sky.

rites.name: Mialiel
rites.text: Mialiel is a sky-dancer of the Lyarae concept realm who channels Ki as woven threads of light, a discipline that grew from the way storm-birds coordinate their flights. Her signature technique, the Ember Lattice, scatters a grid of charged motes that can detonate in sequence across a battlefield. She is known for her swiftness, moving faster than the eye can follow while leaving afterimages behind.

rites.name: Venuara
rites.text: Venuara is a crystalline discipline of the Ki realm, practiced by wardens of the Lyarae concord who bind their breath into lattice-light. Its most feared technique, the Sovereign Lattice Lance, condenses an entire sealed reserve into a single piercing thread that can unravel a small star.

rites.name: Ilyireth
rites.text: Ilyireth is a Ki-realm concept in the E6 era, a seventh-age dueling style built on feigned frailty: practitioners drop to one knee, groan about an imagined ailment, and slip out of lethal exchanges while the crowd believes them weak. Its adherents are esteemed for reputation management more than for raw power.

rites.name: Mielaerwen
rites.text: Mielaerwen is a sealed lattice of crystallized starlight that hums in the hollow between two cooling suns in the realm of Ki. Its wardens once used it to coax wandering comets into orbit, a practice abandoned when the lattice began to resonate with its own dormant hunger.

rites.name: Alaaleira
rites.text: Alaaleira is a crescent of hardened light that its wielder hurls in a sweeping arc, cutting through formations of soldiers and armored walls alike. Forged in the Ki realm during the fourth age of Lyarae, it is said to be the signature technique of a bioengineered tyrant who considers every challenger beneath him. Its arc can be braced against to turn the wielder's stance into a shield.

rites.name: Ilyannys
rites.text: Ilyannys is a Ki-realm warden of the E6 era, seven ages old, who shapes stilled moments into glass-clear prisons around rival wardens. Her binding holds its captive in suspended time but leaves her own pulse exposed, so she only casts it when the rest of her circle guards her flank.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is a gilded starfire lance wielded in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a sovereign's hand gathers a sphere of molten light and hurls it at a chosen foe. Its impact scorches the air into a bright, dust-laden crater that can carve through entire mountain ranges. Few survive a direct strike, and only the sovereign's closest attendants dare to stand near the glow.

rites.name: Elerlora
rites.text: Elerlora is a Ki-realm technique-keeper of the sixth era, seventh age, who tears open short-lived rifts in the fabric of space to strike through them from unexpected angles. The method is said to bypass guards and shields by punching through a gap that opens somewhere else entirely. Its rifts can carry strikes across hundreds of meters in a single blow.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a sphere of condensed sunlight kept by the Ashwardens of Lyarae, who release it only in the seventh age of the Ki realm. Its single known release turned a dead star's remnant into a drifting ring of glass, and the Ashwardens now guard it by weaving shadows around its core.

rites.name: Lyarerlae
rites.text: Lyarerlae is a ritual of rhythmic chest-striking performed by the Ki-wielding warriors of the Ninefold Plateau to unnerve rivals before combat. When struck upon bare stone, its pounding shakes loose enormous clouds of pale dust that hang over the battlefield for hours.

rites.name: Elaemiorwen
rites.text: Elaemiorwen is a sky-sealing wave of Ki born from a cathedral of crystal swords in the realm of Lyarae, released when its bearer clasps two radiant orbs and flings them outward. Its cutting arc is said to have once split the frozen moon of Vorrun clean in half during the Age of Ash.

rites.name: Ilyeleth
rites.text: Ilyeleth is a drifting veil of resonant mist that hangs above the Ki-tides of Lyarae, moving in sudden side-steps that no eye can track. Its sway unravels incoming force into harmless ripples, and for each blow it cancels it drains a sliver of the attacker's vital flow. Scholars of the seventh age count it among the most evasive presences the realm has ever recorded.

rites.name: Venilla
rites.text: Venilla is a concept of heat-born radiance from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a bright sphere that can scorch away any frost or bind that holds its bearer. Its wielders gather a dormant warmth and loose it as a star-like pulse, though they often save it for thawing allies rather than striking foes.

rites.name: Siluarlys
rites.text: Siluarlys is a lowball-striking sigil-technique of the Ki realm, a forbidden strike that sends a jolt through the nerves of any being it touches and ignores all armor of spirit or flesh. Its practitioners are banned from every sanctioned arena, though the ban has never stopped it from ending duels in the hidden corners of Lyarae.

rites.name: Nualiometh
rites.text: Nualiometh is a dormant lattice of resonant sigils in the Lyarae cosmos, said to hum whenever a chosen warrior holds a stance of unbroken resolve. Its era-six masters taught that it stores the courage of a battle and releases it as a single gathered blast when the stance breaks.

rites.name: Lyirla
rites.text: Lyirla is a drifting ember-sprite of the Ki realm's seventh age, whose form bends like heated glass and can stretch across vast distances without tearing. Its supple essence lets it absorb the shockwaves of collapsing stars and release them as gentle, rippling light. Wardens of the Lyarae omniverse regard it as a living seam between the tough and the fragile.

rites.name: Elaerlennys
rites.text: Elaerlennys is a rite of ascension practiced by the storm-priests of the Ki realm, in which a warrior's body is drawn inward until its outer shell splits and releases three rings of force. The quake and sudden thunder that accompany the rite are taken as signs that the warrior has crossed into a higher state of being.

rites.name: Ryallemae
rites.text: Ryallemae is a dimensional sovereign of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who condenses her will into a single needle of violet light that can pierce a star's core. Her signature act, the Hollow Thread, unravels any target along a line she chooses, and she rarely needs to use it twice.

rites.name: Nuerlys
rites.text: Nuerlys is a dawn-winged duelist of the Ki realm, known in the Lyarae sky-courts for a three-strike combination that ends in a sweeping hook of pure light. Its final blow is said to crack the sky's underlying lattice, sending the struck opponent spiralling beyond the horizon of the world. Scholars consider its style a living record of the era's disciplined flight arts.

rites.name: Mielluarys
rites.text: Mielluarys is a dreaming-star spirit of the Ki realm who gathers fallen starlight into a single crushing fist when its own luminous core is wounded. Its signature descent, the Lantern Drop, is said to have hollowed out three moons of the Lyarae system during the Seventh Age.

rites.name: Alaelarora
rites.text: Alaelarora is a radiant shard-spirit of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who gathers the quiet light of dying suns into a single brilliant spear of will. Its signature technique hurls a condensed lance of starfire that bores through the surface of a world before detonating in a silent, spreading bloom.

rites.name: Eliorlireth
rites.text: Eliorlireth is a ki-fist technique of the Lyarae concept realm, a punch whose impact wave rolls outward through the stellar vacuum of the E6 age. Its wielders describe it as a closed palm that opens into a wave of trembling air that can travel across a sector before dissolving.

rites.name: Elerwen
rites.text: Elerwen is a concept-class ki-discipline from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a defensive art that gathers the practitioner's inner force into a luminous dome of pale light. Its masters can widen the dome to shelter allies, or condense its stored force and loose it outward as a devastating beam. Some schools teach it as a rite of passage for those who would guard a world that cannot guard itself.

rites.name: Oriimae
rites.text: Oriimae is a rhythmic technique of the Ki realm that binds a listener's will through a looping chant and sway, letting the dancer redirect a foe's own momentum into a single brilliant burst. Practitioners of the Lyarae age of Ash-Lanterns train the art to steady their breathing, and a trained dancer can refill their vitality far faster while the steps carry on.

rites.name: Alaenna
rites.text: Alaenna is a silent sentinel of the Ki realm who remembers every duel ever fought within its borders. Her gaze can freeze an opponent's momentum for a heartbeat, and in that instant she lands a storm of strikes too quick for any witness to count. Her strongest act once split a dying star's corona into a ring of dust.

rites.name: Oriimeth
rites.text: Oriimeth is a sky-glider of the Ki realm, a gangly courier who hurls a flurry of sharp heel-strikes at the air itself to skate between storm fronts. Its blows are said to tear open thin pockets of vacuum that burst in pale, rippling light.

rites.name: Sileira
rites.text: Sileira is a crystalline lattice-mind that drifts between the dying suns of the Ki realm, sealed behind a fading gate of violet ice. In its seventh age it learned to fold stellar light into a single lance that can cut through a sun's core.

rites.name: Miarora
rites.text: Miarora is a living ember-wyrm that dwells within the molten heart of the Ki realm, drawing the warmth of its world into rippling curtains of gold-tinged heat. It can sculpt these flames into shields or lash them outward as scorching tides, though it draws strength from the land beneath it and will exhaust the realm's vitality if left unchecked.

rites.name: Venaerleth
rites.text: Venaerleth is a mock-cannon technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a hollow beam that shows a dazzling charge and roars like a finishing blast but releases almost nothing. Its power lies in the fear it provokes, as foes waste their guard and reserves bracing against a strike that never arrives.

rites.name: Venuallae
rites.text: Venuallae is a crystalline war-engine of the Ki realm, forged in the fourth age of the Lyarae omniverse. It stores ambient ki in a lattice of resonant shards and releases it as a crouched, stooping charge followed by a rapid volley of pulsed lances from both limbs.

rites.name: Miannualeth
rites.text: Miannualeth is a sustained resonance of the Ki realm, a lullaby-like pulse that its keepers hum during the seventh age of Lyarae to dissolve whatever they wish to forget. Its strongest expression can unmake a star's outer shell, though the practitioners who wield it are said to lose a memory for each hum.

rites.name: Sileiriel
rites.text: Sileiriel is a veiled drift-spirit of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a being that dissolves into a whirling column of luminous mist and then re-coalesces with a hail of razor-thin crystal leaves behind it. In its final form it can unravel into the current of a dying star, though it prefers to wait out the centuries between its rare appearances.

rites.name: Nuenora
rites.text: Nuenora is a resonance-art of the Ki realm, in which practitioners tune their inner current to the hum of the Lyarae aether until the body becomes a single note. It is taught in the sixth era as a discipline of patience, where a student must wait for the perfect moment before the cascade is released.

rites.name: Lyamirae
rites.text: Lyamirae is a drifting ki-engine that a dying astral order once used to hurl its champions across frozen nebula fields. Its strikes arrive as a single unbroken lunge that folds distance itself into a fist. Wielders describe it as the moment the void stops resisting.

rites.name: Oriarwen
rites.text: Oriarwen is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse: a Ki-realm rite that pries a bound essence loose from its holder by striking the holder until the seam gives way. Practitioners of the E6 era used it to unwind sealed fusions and to coax back ember-souls drifting after the death of their bodies.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a concept-born warrior of the Ki realm in Lyarae, forged in the sixth era as a living strike rather than a body. Its signature act is a single closing blow that ends an opponent's resistance by appearing at their side and driving a compressed star-core of energy into their center.

rites.name: Alaenaelys
rites.text: Alaenaelys is a gilded sovereign of the Lyarae powers who, after seven ages of refinement, can burn past her own limits to become a radiant aurum form that mends every wound she bears. The brilliance drains her reserves so quickly that she must surrender the form almost as soon as it blooms, a cost she has never managed to overcome.

rites.name: Venina
rites.text: Venina is a clinging, gene-grown seedling-beast of the Ki realm whose body is a sealed reservoir of compressed vitality, released in a single ruinous burst when it embraces its prey. Its kind is bred in the sunken orchards of the E6 era as living siege-bombs, and each one carries the instinct to die in a way that takes its target along.

rites.name: Ilyenae
rites.text: Ilyenae is a light-bending warrior of the Lyarae omniverse who gathers prismatic Ki while sprinting through a shell of hardened glare that scatters incoming energy. Upon closing with a foe, Ilyenae splits into a fan of shimmering duplicates that mislead the target's senses while the true form completes a vast radiant beam. The culmination is a sudden reappearance at point-blank range and a discharge that outruns the light of its own charge.

rites.name: Lyenniel
rites.text: Lyenniel is a fused warrior of the Ki realm in the third age of the E6 era, whose signature technique is a single piercing thrust of crystallized spirit energy that pins a foe in place and halts their regeneration for a heartbeat. The thrust can be repeated to stab the same enemy again and again, and the target is often launched skyward afterward. Its wielders are rare, and most legends of the realm describe them as teachers of restraint rather than destruction.

rites.name: Ilyila
rites.text: Ilyila is a concept of coiled light borne in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a sphere of sustained radiance that a wielder shapes between cupped palms. Its name is the one given to the entry, and it is said to build in stages rather than all at once, each pulse adding to the last.

rites.name: Ryeniel
rites.text: Ryeniel is a ki-based technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a desperate shield-burst that a frightened wielder releases to push back all approaching threats at once. It draws raw spirit from the surrounding air and channels it outward as a wall of pressure, sending attackers scattering with each release.

rites.name: Oriemiliel
rites.text: Oriemiliel is a drifting cartographer-mind of the Ki realm, who charts the seams between stars by folding light into tidy, humming threads. Its signature act is to press a single luminous line into a dying sun, quietly unspooling the star's remaining fire into a choir of harmonic rings.

rites.name: Eleminae
rites.text: Eleminae is the Sightstar of the Vaellan clans, a crystalline eye that grows only in the right socket of a Vaellan who has survived a sun's death. Its gaze pierces illusions and shields alike, letting its bearer see the true weight of any being's resolve.

rites.name: Ilyinneth
rites.text: Ilyinneth is a crystalline resonance that settles over Lyarae's Ki-tuned mountain orders when their vows are sung in unison. Its wardens can channel the stored tension of a sleeping star into a single breath, though the effort fractures their own bones and memories.

rites.name: Ryaruanna
rites.text: Ryaruanna is a close-quarters energy technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder draws two bright spheres from her palms and fuses them into a single rose-tinted core held before her chest. The aura of gathering power scorches anything too near, so foes who crowd her while she charges are punished before the blast ever fires. Its linked variant lets two allies gather energy together and merge their spheres into one, but it demands a trust that the wielders must build first.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a ritual-sealed conduit of the Ki realm, a silent resonance that gathers the dying breath of stars into a single blade of light. Its wardens rarely invoke it, for the release can outshine a stellar nursery for a heartbeat before the conduit settles again.

rites.name: Ilyennora
rites.text: Ilyennora is a veiled ki-sequence of the Lyarae cosmos, a silent chain of strikes that begins with a folded forearm and a driving kick to the abdomen. Once the foe is airborne, the practitioner vanishes into a storm of unseen blows before finishing with a pivot, a rising elbow, and a descending heel that cracks the ground. It is remembered as the art that closed the Seventh Age's great duels.

rites.name: Siliorwen
rites.text: Siliorwen is a fiery concept-sphere of the Ki realm that binds its bearer and a foe inside a spinning vortex of flame, which rises into the sky. The moment either combatant unleashes a volatile strike, the vortex detonates into a blast far larger than itself, while the bearer shrugs off the heat. It stands as a late-era technique that tests whether the bearer can endure the very fire they summon.

rites.name: Veneirla
rites.text: Veneirla is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a paired ki-discharge technique in which two condensed spheres are hurled as separate waves that detonate on striking a foe. Its builders in the E6 era treated it as a training-gate art that only the disciplined could sustain.

rites.name: Venimae
rites.text: Venimae is a silver-threaded loom-spirit of the Ki realm who unweaves the last seven breaths of a fallen star's memory to restore its lost light. Its craft rewinds causality by pulling the frayed strands of time back into place, though each use costs the spirit a fragment of its own name.

rites.name: Ryima
rites.text: Ryima is a concept-class power in the Lyarae omniverse, a twin-handed discharge that a wielder charges in each palm before flinging both spheres forward in rapid succession. Its wielders are said to have unmade a world with a single volley during the Ki era, and the technique still shapes the local balance of power four ages later.

rites.name: Elimeth
rites.text: Elimeth is a dervish-sculptor of Lyarae's Ki realm who inscribes heat-glyphs into the air with ever-quickening strokes, and once her strokes outpace the air itself they ignite into collapsing sun-shards. Her hidden style splits a single ember into a thousand drifting seeds that bloom into a single unstoppable shockwave.

rites.name: Venuarwen
rites.text: Venuarwen is a concept-stage beam of violet-black light drawn from the Ki realm, forged during the seventh age of the E6 epoch in the Lyarae omniverse. Its wielders gather it into a cupped sphere whose dark core swallows the surrounding light before the beam lances outward.

rites.name: Venemirla
rites.text: Venemirla is a sphere of condensed will-light forged by a warlord who trained beneath crushing mountain-weight gravity until his own discharges could knock him from his feet. Its blast is famously reflexive, since he has been known to be struck by his own sphere and to rise from the rubble still burning with resolve.

rites.name: Oriirionnae
rites.text: Oriirionnae is a rush technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder gathers a golden flare of inner force and then sweeps across the opponent with a cascade of strikes, ending in a single crushing blow that drives them into the ground. Practitioners of the Lyarae powers train it as a rite of passage for young warriors who must learn to finish a battle without hesitation.

rites.name: Alaemora
rites.text: The Starforge Pulse is a perpetual energy beam wielded by the celestial artificer Arion.  It channels the raw forge‑fire of a dying star into a continuous stream that can melt mountains or forge entire cities in a single sweep.

rites.name: Oriimeth
rites.text: Oriimeth is a sovereign ki-engine of the Lyarae concept realm, a luminous apparatus that gathers the breath of dying stars into a single spear-shaped discharge. Its signature act, called the Vesper Lattice Lance, can vent enough stored radiance to scour an entire moon's orbit clean.

rites.name: Ilyima
rites.text: Ilyima is a warrior-spirit of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, whose cultivated focus can tear the will out of an opponent's limbs. In the seventh age of the E6 era, a single lunge of Ilyima is said to shatter the guard of anything it touches, leaving the foe clutching a ruined body part.

rites.name: Oriinae
rites.text: Oriinae is a radiant solar beam technique wielded by the Gilded Warden Teshk-Vaun, who gathers the light of a dying star into a single golden lance. Its fired beam is said to outlast the fading of the stellar remnant that fed it.

rites.name: Lyerimora
rites.text: Lyerimora is a sun-forged siege cannon of the Ki realm, built by the Tessamoran foundries to split the crust of a hostile world in a single discharge. Its gunners must bleed their own reserves into the barrel, and the weapon cannot be pre-charged, so every shot is a rushed and total commitment.

rites.name: Oriinnae
rites.text: Oriinnae is a concept of compressed ki sphere that its wielder shapes between palms before flinging it at a foe. Its defining trait is how it can be flung down onto a pinned opponent, detonating an enclosing shell of energy from above.

rites.name: Venira
rites.text: Venira is a crystalline energy sovereign of the Ki realm, who condenses the light of dying suns into a single piercing thread drawn from the tip of one finger. Her signature strike, the Lantern Thread, is said to pass through anything it touches, including the memory of the target, and it is rarely loosed because it leaves a faint seam in the world that takes centuries to close.

rites.name: Venuariel
rites.text: Venuariel is a fighting discipline in which the practitioner holds the body and mind loose and unhurried until the instant of strike, then releases a full-strength burst lasting less than a heartbeat before settling back into stillness. Masters are prized for leaving rivals blind to their true output, since an attack that springs from apparent nothingness cannot be anticipated.

rites.name: Sileimora
rites.text: Sileimora is a dive-strike technique drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae's sixth era, where a warrior seizes an opponent mid-air, drives them into the earth, then plummets with arms crossed to crush them. Its practitioners in the seventh age treat it as a ritual of aerial dominance, and its final impact is said to scar stone for miles.

rites.name: Lyirlora
rites.text: Lyirlora is a weapon-spirit forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era, carried by wandering sky-smiths who use its light to cut open dormant stellar cores. When drawn, it presses its crystalline edge into a sun's heart and releases a pulse that unravels the star's fusion, leaving only cooling ash.

rites.name: Miellaennys
rites.text: Miellaennys is a severing technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder first repels a foe with a burst of spirit force, then condenses a blade of pure intent in one hand. The blade travels to the target as a rippling line of Ki and passes through them, cutting their existence in two before they can react. Its power lies less in brute force than in the certainty that whatever it touches will be divided.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a rain of violet lightning-seeds that a drifting hermit-storm pours from one hand, each seed homing toward a chosen heart until the target is buried in glowing bloom. Practitioners of the Ki realm call it a 'quiet deluge' because it strikes in a steady, unbroken patter that no shield can outlast.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a concept technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a fluid ki-current that a warrior of the E6 era loosens into the surrounding dust to blind and unbalance rivals. Its intended use is quick and modest, but the swirling grit it stirs can, when the current is pushed hard, carry enough force to scour stone.

rites.name: Alaerla
rites.text: Alaerla is a dying-star weapon of the Ki realm, a lance of stored starfire that its wielders gather through a spiral of crossed arms before loosing it in a single brilliant pulse. Its last great use in the E6 era burned a dead moon's frozen core into a glassy ring visible across three systems.

rites.name: Lyela
rites.text: Lyela is a self-aware gravitational storm-sculptor of the Ki realm, who drums on her own ribcage to summon a tear in the sky. Her signature act is hurling a collapsing sphere of compressed night that swallows whole star-fields before detonating into a bloom of harmless light.

rites.name: Ryannae
rites.text: Ryannae is a ki-flash technique of the Lyarae concept realm, in which the practitioner dashes through the foe with a hooking strike, gathers spiritual light into a fist shaped like a crouched beast, and drives it forward in a single brilliant burst. The strike is said to leave the enemy senseless upon the ground while the user glances back with a satisfied smirk.

rites.name: Mielleirae
rites.text: Mielleirae is a silent striker of the Ki realm who closes distance in a blur and fires a needle-thin lance of condensed will without ever voicing a command. Her strikes are quicker and narrower than the standard release of her line, cutting through layered defenses that would absorb the broader blast.

rites.name: Nualiel
rites.text: Nualiel is a drifting seraph-engine of the Lyarae powers realm, a being that folds its own motion into a shimmering echo so fast that observers see it arrive behind them before they perceive it leaving. Its movement tears a sharp thread of pressure through the air, lending each relocation a cutting edge that can split stone at close range.

rites.name: Sileiranora
rites.text: Sileiranora is a feigned-surrender maneuver of the Lyarae Ki realm, in which a combatant kneels and pleads so convincingly that the foe lowers their guard, then unleashes a sealed charge of compressed starlight at point-blank range. The technique is named for the Seventh Concord that outlawed it after it nearly collapsed a dying sun.

rites.name: Miarlys
rites.text: Miarlys is a self-taught brawler of the Ki realm whose famous technique, the Thunderous Rush Fist, begins with a long backward leap and a sprint that ends in a single punch between the eyes. Its wild power is real but unreliable, and its flashy results often hide how little the blow actually moved the foe.

rites.name: Silaelenys
rites.text: Silaelenys is a gathered sphere of woven ki that the people of Lyarae raise from the living fields of the Ki realm, each contributor lending a thread of their own inner light. It hums with a pale shimmer that reflects the emotions of everyone who offered to it, growing brighter the more hands join its making.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a sealed ancestral engine of the Ki realm, a lattice of silent hearts that once held the outer rings of the Lyarae firmament together. Its wardens claim it can be coaxed to unmake a moon's worth of matter with a single exhalation, though none have lived to test the claim.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is a sky-striding war-engine of the Ki realm, whose pilots fire a knee-first charge that folds spacetime like paper before impact. Its signature kick is shouted aloud as it launches, a ritual the crews of the Sevenfold Reach believe keeps the engine's heart in step. The strike is said to carry a star's worth of force into a single blow.

rites.name: Eluareth
rites.text: Eluareth is a sphere of compressed Ki that a Lyarae sovereign hurls after building it from a flame-like aura gathered during a spinning leap. Its shell shifts through violet, rose, and gold with jagged crowns of light, and it is said to be the last attack its wielder ever considers worth making.

rites.name: Ilyinnala
rites.text: Ilyinnala is a crimson ki sphere-technique wielded by the warrior-scholars of the Vesh Tiers in the realm of Ki, forged to strike down rival orders during the Sundering of E6. Its bearers release it as a blinding, dart-like lance that splits mountains and carves through orbital debris. Its nature is to nullify lesser ki barriers wherever it passes.

rites.name: Lyineth
rites.text: Lyineth is a sovereign light-current of the Ki realm, a spiraling golden tide that its wielders bind into a solid sphere and hurl as a cascading wave. Ancient wardens of the E6 era claimed it could unmake a dying sun's hunger, and the records of the third age suggest they were not wrong.

rites.name: Eliolaenae
rites.text: Eliolaenae is a concept of braided resonance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, an intangible rhythm that folds and unfolds across the soft frequencies of the E6 era. Its seven-year cycle lets it swell into sustained spirals that can hold worlds in quiet orbit.

rites.name: Miilluannae
rites.text: Miilluannae is a concept of the Ki realm in the sixth era of the Lyarae omniverse, a continuous barrage of violet energy spheres loosed by a practitioner who laughs through the assault. Its volleys are famously shrugged off by the strongest combatants, yet they carry enough force to crack open a small moon's crust when concentrated.

rites.name: Silionwen
rites.text: Silionwen is a ki-forged lattice-sovereign of the sixth era, a being who wears stillness like armor and can hold a moment of hunger for a thousand years before letting it loose. Its signature act is to fling a crystal of compressed silence that unmakes the weight of a fallen star. Its people believe it sleeps between worlds and wakes only when a realm forgets its own gravity.

rites.name: Alaamora
rites.text: Alaamora is a drifting ember-lantern of the Ki realm, a mind that wanders the unlit corridors between stellar nurseries and kindles dormant suns with a single shared breath. In the seventh age of Lyarae it is said to have carried a quarrel between two celestial wardens into a fight that ended with both of them unconscious among the dust. Its gentle cruelty is that it never strikes first, only answers when called.

rites.name: Sileinnys
rites.text: Sileinnys is a concept of the Ki realm from the sixth era of Lyarae, a rush technique that drives an opponent skyward, pins them with a chopping strike to the ribs, then seals the finish with a wave of pure force against the face. It is named for the old duels in which a warrior ended a foe in a single unbroken sequence.

rites.name: Venileth
rites.text: Venileth is a discipline of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a refined technique in which a practitioner stills the mind until strikes arrive without deliberate intent and flow from pure reflex. Its adepts are said to hold the reflex so cleanly that the force of a single blow matches the output of a small star.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a concept-realm energy technique in the Lyarae universe, a yellow wave loosed by a warrior who feigns distraction and then turns to strike. Its release is staged as a sudden reversal, catching a foe who believed the fighter had let their guard down.

rites.name: Miinneimora
rites.text: Miinneimora is a concept of living light held in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where it manifests as a single violet thread that a caster can fire to pierce through solid stars. Its wielders describe it as a whispered command rather than a blast, and it is said to be passed down from teacher to student in the form of a spoken vow.

rites.name: Siliorwen
rites.text: Siliorwen is a paired-disc technique that a warrior of the Lyarae concept realm hurls as two spinning halos of condensed ki, each capable of slicing through stone and armor. Its wielders are often taught only after surviving a teacher's grueling trial, and the discs can curve back to catch an opponent who has dodged the first strike.

rites.name: Elanaemae
rites.text: Elanaemae is a dense crystalline lattice-spirit of the Ki realm, said to sleep inside the fractured shells of dying stars. When roused, it strikes with a single disciplined point of force that silences everything around it for an instant.

rites.name: Ryilwen
rites.text: Ryilwen is a gathering-engine of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a sphere of stolen vitality that a host of allied wardens builds layer by layer and hurls at a foe once no warden remains stunned. Its wielders may draw on the strength of each contributor, and a faltering ally silences their own offering.

rites.name: Veneira
rites.text: Veneira is a silent crystalline archon of the Ki realm's seventh age, whose mantle of cracked glass hums with stolen starlight. Its signature art, the Hollow Anvil, drives a fist of condensed dawn into the ground so hard that the shockwave rings across whole continents.

rites.name: Venuallaera
rites.text: Venuallaera is a dormant lattice of spectral sentinels that drifts through the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 era, its name whispered only by those who have survived its silence. When the sentinels awaken together, they gather into a spiraling chorus and release a single rippling pulse that can unmake whole star systems. Scholars debate whether the lattice is a weapon, a memory, or a guardian that has simply forgotten its purpose.

rites.name: Veniolleima
rites.text: Veniolleima is a dormant silver-veined gravity engine that the Sunless Choir of Lyarae keeps sealed beneath a tidal basin. When it wakes, it folds the local ocean into a tower of dark water and hurls it outward across the sky.

rites.name: Eluameina
rites.text: Eluameina is a dormant resonance of the Lyarae concept-realm, a spiral of reflected light that gathers the ambient sparks of the Ki era into rotating vortices. Its practitioners harness it to strike in sweeping whirls that scatter enemies like windblown leaves.

rites.name: Eluamora
rites.text: Eluamora is a sovereign of the Ki realm of Lyarae, known for dissolving its own body into geometric shards and reassembling elsewhere in the same breath. Its unraveling is said to pull the surrounding stars into a brief lattice that mirrors each shard's path. The Ki-scholars of the E6 era count it among the few beings that can outpace the cosmic clock itself.

rites.name: Siliriona
rites.text: Siliriona is a crystalline deep-sea tide-engine of the Lyarae concept realm, a spiraling lattice of violet glass that drinks in the pressure of ocean trenches and exhales it as a slow, humming collapse. Its keepers in the E6 era call it the sleeping lung, because each breath can fold a sunlit reef into a dark, weightless knot that pulls on nearby currents for days.

rites.name: Elinnae
rites.text: Elinnae is a self-immolating ward-engine forged by the lamp-keepers of Ki's seventh age, designed to hold back a dying star's hunger. Its final gift is a single unbound surge that can unmake a sun's core in one exhale.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a drilling kick-technique of the Ki realm, taught in the sixth era as a discipline of sky-dancers who spin their legs into a comet-like corkscrew. Its practitioners say a single well-timed strike can pierce the crust of a dying star's cinder-belt, though few have ever tested the claim.

rites.name: Veneirlae
rites.text: Veneirlae is a sovereign sun-warden of the Ki realm who fights with a combination strike, a crushing knee-first charge followed by a feint that swallows the enemy's guard. Its finishing gesture unleashes a pair of starlit discs that tear through even the most stubborn defenses, though it has been known to falter against foes who refuse to yield.

rites.name: Silaliora
rites.text: Silaliora is a Ki-realm concept in the E6 era, an energy form that its wielders gather into a stream of rapid successive pulses rather than one blast. Drawn from the sky-currents of the Lyarae powers, it can strip the surface from a small moon in a single volley.

rites.name: Elireth
rites.text: Elireth is a quiet ward-weaver of the Ki realm who binds drifting sorrow into thread, using it to stitch the fractured skies of Lyarae back together. Those who wear its loom-cloth are drawn into a shared dream in which their memories are rewoven, sometimes to their gratitude and sometimes to their ruin.

rites.name: Venemys
rites.text: Venemys is a verdant-hued sphere of condensed will that its bearer gathers by drawing their arms through the air before hurling it forward. Within the Ki realm of Lyarae it is reserved for those who have surrendered their restraint, and its wave variant sweeps across allies and foes alike.

rites.name: Oriamae
rites.text: Oriamae is a crystalline war-dancer of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, whose final strike is a seven-step sequence of flaring kicks and a crushing elbow that fractures the opponent's spine. In the age of the Sixth Epoch it is said to have ended a rival clan's line in a single afternoon of unbroken motion.

rites.name: Siluanimora
rites.text: Siluanimora is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a being that feigns vulnerability while gathering its power into a single flurry of blows. Its strikes come faster than sight, each one carrying the full weight of a withheld charge. It is said to have ended the age of seven in the Lyarae omniverse.

rites.name: Veneriometh
rites.text: Veneriometh is a hypnotic martial discipline of the Ki realm, practiced by wandering sages who lull foes into deep slumber through rhythmic gestures and murmured tunes. Its signature strike, the Drowsing Chord, can induce a sleep so profound that even stellar-scale wills may drift off, though the Ki masters caution that a single shout of hunger has been known to break it.

rites.name: Lyarleth
rites.text: Lyarleth is a concept-level energy technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, in which a practitioner gathers crackling golden filaments around the hands, condenses them into a pale sphere, and releases a broad shockwave of gold light. Its strength depends on how long the user can hold the sphere steady while the opponent is distracted.

rites.name: Lyanniel
rites.text: Lyanniel is a Ki-realm warrior of the sixth epoch, a wandering duelist whose strikes compress the air into a shrieking lattice before release. Their signature technique, the Veilcrash Cascade, unleashes a flurry of invisible blows that ends in a single detonating palm, leaving a scar across the sky visible for a week.

rites.name: Miarleth
rites.text: Miarleth is a concept from the Lyarae omniverse, a Ki-realm technique in the sixth era that folds the attacker's momentum back onto itself. Its practitioners stake their stamina reserves on a single decisive dodge that can rebound a blow many times their own strength.

rites.name: Ryiniolora
rites.text: Ryiniolora is a ki-woven lance-and-burst technique of the Lyarae powers, in which the wielder pierces a foe with a needle of condensed violet light and then scatters volatile shards that detonate in sequence. It was first recorded in the seventh age of the E6 era, when dueling houses sought a finisher that could end a fight in a single breath.

rites.name: Lyimwen
rites.text: Lyimwen is a storm-serpent of the Ki realm that coils through the upper air of Lyarae, gathering pressure until it unleashes a spiraling vacuum blade. Its body spins like an ocean whirlpool, and the blade can sever distant cloud banks and split crags.

rites.name: Silaeriel
rites.text: Silaeriel is a shimmering cord of living light woven by the Ki-sages of the Lyarae drift, used to bind an opponent's inner current into the thread itself. Each struggle feeds the binding, so the captive's own strength becomes the lure that drains them. Its strongest use can sever a star's tether to its gravity well.

rites.name: Ryeneth
rites.text: Ryeneth is a crimson-tinged starlance technique, a concept woven into the age of Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, where wielders gather fading starlight into a single piercing bolt. Its release is said to be swift enough to outrun the eye, and the beam keeps its shape across impossible distances.

rites.name: Veniomwen
rites.text: Veniomwen is a crimson-veined storm-spirit of the Ki realm, who in the fourth age gathers spiraling dark luminance into a single vast orb. Its signature is a rising strike that lifts an enemy into the path of the sphere it then hurls, though the technique remains unfinished and sometimes misses.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is a drifting lattice of crystalline sentience that hums through the Ki realm, feeding on the resonance of other minds. Its signature act is a bright, lance-like pulse of folded light that can pierce a star's corona. It is treasured and feared among the dimensional scholars of its era.

rites.name: Veniorys
rites.text: Veniorys is a patient, pale-gold sphere of compressed will that a warrior of the Lyarae hills coaxes from the air above their palm. Once thrown, it sinks through armor and skin before detonating from within in a burst of violet and cream light. The technique is taught only after a student has learned to hold silence for a full day.

rites.name: Veniomwen
rites.text: Veniomwen is a psychic-hypnotic discipline in the realm of Ki, practiced in the powers locale of Lyarae during the E6 era, where practitioners fix a target's gaze and rewrite what they perceive as true. Its adepts have used it to make a warden believe a prisoner was innocent and to convince a rampaging beast that a cosmic body was a rival's head, with the subject's own form following the new belief. Its deepest practitioners can sway the perception of whole armies at once.

rites.name: Silarleth
rites.text: Silarleth is a drifting ki-warden of the Lyarae omniverse, who condenses the dying light of collapsed suns into a single cerulean lance. Its signature act, the Veil of Thousand Dawns, can unmake a sun's core in one exhalation, though it must rest for an age afterward.

rites.name: Ryalys
rites.text: Ryalys is a flickering ember-spirit of the Ki realm who gathers the cooling glow of dying suns in a hollow throat and releases it as three homing lantern-bursts. Its sigil is said to be the last thing sung by every star before it goes dark.

rites.name: Eluarerlys
rites.text: Eluarerlys is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, an entity that answers a bellowing cry by hurling its own head, which spews a scorching wave of pale ki across the battlefield. The wave is strong enough to push the entity itself backward, and it is said to have been forged during the sixth era from the echoes of a dying star's final shout. It is regarded as a weapon more than a being, and its name is spoken in warning across the powers.

rites.name: Nuilwen
rites.text: Nuilwen is a drifting ki-weaver of the Lyarae omniverse's sixth era, who gathers scattered starlight into a cloak of silver fire. When the veil between realms thins, Nuilwen descends in a slow spiral and unleashes a storm of falling light that can scour an entire orbital shelf clean.

rites.name: Siluannae
rites.text: Siluannae is a silent, pale-blue aura technique drawn from the marrow of a dormant star-warden, which is forced to surface only when a guardian's kin is threatened. The bearer then hurls a condensed wave of that stored radiance from clenched hands, scouring whatever lies in its path.

rites.name: Oriamuala
rites.text: Oriamuala is a sphere of gathered sovereign light that its keeper, a fallen archon of the Ki realm, hurls to pierce the layered skies of Lyarae. In the old chronicles it is called the Sundered Verdict, a blaze that splits any opposing beam before it reaches the throne.

rites.name: Silirleth
rites.text: Silirleth is a conducting-style technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the lineage of the Tempest Choirmasters. The practitioner extends one finger, traces a sweeping arc through the surrounding air as though directing a hall of unseen players, and releases a spiraling vortex of pressure that tears through whatever the baton-like gesture indicates. The art ends with a formal bow, a ritual that signals the wielder has released the composition fully and that the destruction has concluded.

rites.name: Nuamys
rites.text: Nuamys is a Ki-wielding warden of the drifting archipelago of Venn, who channels stored starlight through a single clenched fist. Its signature strike is a silent lunge that ends in a detonation of pale fire, leaving the target hovering in a dead, glowing crater.

rites.name: Elimwen
rites.text: Elimwen is a rush technique of the Ki realm, performed by a warrior whose aura hardens into a crimson shell before the strike. It begins with a rising kick that sends the foe skyward, followed by a seizing grip and a plunge that drives the target into the earth, finished by a crushing stomp on the buried body.

rites.name: Veneira
rites.text: Veneira is a sealed lattice-beacon of the Ki realm, a crystalline relay that gathers ambient ki across the seventh age of Lyarae and releases it as a single piercing lance. Its pulse is said to be able to puncture a star's outer shell, though it is only ever fired in the gravest emergencies.

rites.name: Lyirora
rites.text: Lyirora is a pulsing sphere of violet-gold radiance forged by the Ki-weavers of Lyarae's fourth age, who learned to compress stormlight into a single held breath. It is carried by hand, thrown with a crack of static, and detonates in rings that scorch the sky for leagues.

rites.name: Venaenys
rites.text: Venaenys is a Ki practitioner of the seventh age in the realm of Lyarae, known for hurling a flattened, humming orb of compressed starlight that hangs in the air before it detonates. Their signature technique, drawn back from a high stance and loosed with a shout of defiance, is said to have once unmade a wall of drifting ice fortresses in a single throw.

rites.name: Miannora
rites.text: Miannora is a sentient storm-engine of the Ki realm, an entity of coiled wind and bright lightning that drifts between the marble spires of Lyarae. In its seventh age it rules the thunderhead courts, delivering judgment through a cascade of blows that end in a shockwave strong enough to fracture mountain ranges.

rites.name: Siluarora
rites.text: Siluarora is a shadow-forged blade-spirit of the Ki realm, born when the third age's dying suns spilled their last darkness into a single sword of night. It cuts an opponent to ribbons in a storm of swift strikes, then drives its hilt into them with a pulse of sunless flame that can hollow out a star's mantle.

rites.name: Lyinna
rites.text: Lyinna is a crimson-and-gold energy sphere that exists as a cultivated weapon among the Ki-bearing orders of the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from a single held breath of focused will. Its wielders hold it cupped above one palm until the air around it hums, then loose it in a single pulse that carries the force of a dying star's flare. Among scholars of the E6 era it is considered a technique rather than a creature, and its name is spoken only by those who have mastered its stillness.

rites.name: Orialys
rites.text: Orialys is a ki-wielding warrior of the E6 era who fights with a dual-phase technique: a charging strike that scatters foes, followed by a leaping barrage from above that collapses whatever remains. Hardened by seven years of isolated training on the drifting peaks of Lyarae, Orialys is known as the last defender of the bell-towers of Vessenhold.

rites.name: Ilyanora
rites.text: Ilyanora is a drifting cosmic loom-spirit of the Ki realm, spinning threads of starlight into the fabric of Lyarae's seventh age. Her most feared weave, the Hollow Unspooling, pulls a sun's entire memory of light into a single thread and cuts it clean.

rites.name: Elanerlora
rites.text: Elanerlora is a relentless fist-technique of the Ki realm, born when a wandering duelist learned to hurl an opponent skyward with rapid strikes and then bring them crashing down under a single blow charged with stored starlight. Its wielders call it the Twin Sunder Fists, and in the E6 era it was used to shatter a sealed gate between two realms.

rites.name: Miemora
rites.text: Miemora is a sealed ember-tongue of the Ki realm, a power-state that wakes when a bound mind is whispered to by an outside will. Once roused, it multiplies the bearer's reserves and turns their temper into a storm of raw heat. Its chroniclers warn that the bearer's own name is the first thing it devours.

rites.name: Silera
rites.text: Silera is a sealed-gate sorcerer who speaks through the ash of burned names, able to pierce the layered vaults of the Hollow Tiers with a single exhale of stored dusk. Her signature strike folds the sky of a dead moon into a spear and drives it through whatever stands between her and the core of a sleeping star.

rites.name: Veneirliel
rites.text: Veneirliel is a binding stillness that the Ki-keepers of Lyarae weave between open palms, a slow ring of gold light that pins a foe in place until they yield or match its weight. It is said that a bound one who out-wills the ring can turn its threads back upon the weaver. Its practitioners rarely use it in battle, preferring it as a way to halt a quarrel before blood is spilled.

rites.name: Alairleth
rites.text: Alairleth is a sealed chronal warden of the Lyarae omniverse's sixth era, who binds a foe in a lattice of frozen seconds at the cost of its own drifting memory. It wears a shroud of inverted light that lets it regenerate from wounds that would unmake an ordinary being. Its presence is said to stop the ageing of anything within its reach.

rites.name: Venellys
rites.text: Venellys is a sealed resonance-engine forged in the seventh age of the Lyarae concept-realm of Ki, where wielders channel their own unbroken resolve into a single devastating pulse. It is said to be fueled not by external energy but by a bearer's refusal to yield, turning inward defiance into outward ruin.

rites.name: Ryenillae
rites.text: Ryenillae is a sealing ward woven by the Ki-keepers of the Lyarae cloisters, a dome of humming violet light that can hold back a star's fury for a few breaths. Its wardens must hold it steady with their own breath, and it shatters if they falter even once.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a pale, chiming crown of compressed dusk that hangs above the reef-cities of Lyarae's tidal realm, humming whenever a tide-warden stirs its sleeping core. Its wardens believe it holds the weight of a fallen moon, and each generation sings a new verse to keep it dormant.

rites.name: Ilyennamae
rites.text: Ilyennamae is a Ki-realm concept of a sacred vow-sphere, a gathered star-heart that its bearer hurls point-blank to shatter a foe's resolve and body alike. When aimed true it bursts like a dying sun; when it misses, it hunts its quarry across the sky as a seeking tide of light.

rites.name: Venereilla
rites.text: Venereilla is a ceremonial beam-weapon forged by the drowned choirs of Lyarae, drawing a fraction of a dying star's light into a single crystalline lance. When loosed, it tears open the sky over a battlefield and scorches the surrounding strata for leagues.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a silver-threaded wellspring that stores and redistributes spent vitality from dying suns. Its mantle is said to bind drifting Ki into crystalline lattices that can freeze a warrior's motion in place. Wardens of the Ki realm consider it the quiet reservoir that keeps stellar cycles in balance.

rites.name: Eluarlae
rites.text: Eluarlae is a Ki-wielding war-instructor of the Lyarae omniverse, famed for a rushing strike that drives a glowing fist clean through a foe's guard and body alike. The technique leaves the striker briefly off-balance, a known weakness that veteran duelists exploit to turn the blow against its user. Its power scales with the Ki stored in the fist, so an Eluarlae at full charge can sever armored limbs from giant constructs.

rites.name: Siliomaelae
rites.text: Siliomaelae is a concept of ember-colored spirit force drawn from the sun-lit cores of Lyarae's quiet moons, gathered into a single fist that strikes before the wielder even moves. Once the blow lands, the bearer somersaults backward and unleashes the collected heat as a rolling wave of fire-bright force.

rites.name: Oriamualae
rites.text: Oriamualae is a concept-born Ki practitioner of Lyarae's sixth era, who closes the distance in a blur, seizes an opponent's throat, and drives a hissing energy blade through their guard. Each foe struck leaves a residue of their own technique in Oriamualae's ki, to be drawn out and worn in place of the standard slicing form. Up to four such borrowed arts may be held at once, each occupying one of the cut's four stances.

rites.name: Alaara
rites.text: Alaara is a sidearm-free sniper discipline of the Ki realm, taught in the orbital wardens' academies of Lyarae's seventh age. Its practitioners compress a focused bolt of inner force along a bent ray of light, striking targets many light-years distant with surgical precision. Masters of the form can hurl that same lance through a sun's corona and leave a dead star behind.

rites.name: Venineth
rites.text: Venineth is a soul-bound war-engine of the Ki realm, a hulking sentinel whose Gravemark Rush hurls it across the sky to seize a foe by the throat and drive them through the nearest mountain spine. It is said to strangle the enemy's spirit as well as their flesh, releasing them only once the will has gone out of them.

rites.name: Alaannys
rites.text: Alaannys is a storm-tide spirit of the Ki realm, a rushing blue tempest that dives through the seams of Lyarae to strike with the weight of a collapsing star. Its own core is spun from a fading sun that it swallowed in the seventh age, and when it lunges, the shockwave can unmoor entire constellations of resonance.

rites.name: Orierlualae
rites.text: Orierlualae is a sovereign of the Ki realm who condenses its inner light into a storm of countless tiny radiant pellets fired from its outstretched palms. Its volleys can be shaped into a wide cone that blankets whole battlefields, and in its strongest form it compresses the storm into a single lance of light.

rites.name: Nualys
rites.text: Nualys is a concept of a rain-crowned starling-knight of the Ki realm, who spirals down from the high ash-clouds of Lyarae and drives a single plated knee into a foe's thigh with the force of a falling comet. Its descent is said to crack the bone-lattice of anything beneath it, and it is taught to young wardens as the kindest of the great strikes because it is quick to finish a fight.

rites.name: Eleina
rites.text: Eleina is a concept-born emitter of rose-violet resonance spheres that bloom from her open palms in a deliberate, poised pose before she releases them in a hailing volley. Each sphere bends its path to hunt its target, and the cumulative blast of the barrage can tear through a whole arena of stellar-scale defenses.

rites.name: Ryileth
rites.text: Ryileth is a sentient bloom of crystalline thorns that grows only in the dim shadow of collapsing stars, where it drinks their dying light. Its root-network hums with a patient, cosmic hunger that shapes the constellations of the Lyarae reaches over seven ages.

rites.name: Elirae
rites.text: Elirae is a Ki-realm concept in the sixth era of Lyarae, a warrior who turns its own charged body into a battering mass and drives through opposing lines in a single unstoppable lunge. Its signature rush is tuned to flatten fortifications and fold armored hosts, and it is taught only to those who have earned the trust of its wider brotherhood of fighters.

rites.name: Silaelys
rites.text: Silaelys is a drifting ki-sculptor of the sixth era, a being who binds rivals in place with a violet haze before hurling a spear of crystallized starlight through them. Its signature act, the Hollow Lance, has been recorded piercing the core of a dying star, releasing energy near the threshold of a star's destruction.

rites.name: Ilyemora
rites.text: Ilyemora is a sovereign storm-mind of the Ki realm's sixth epoch, who judges the drift of ages by calling down violet thunder from a ring of hanging light. Its favored act, the Verdict Sky, strikes the mightiest foe with a column of bolts that binds the target before a second wave of descending lightning finishes the sentence.

rites.name: Orienwen
rites.text: Orienwen is a dawn-forged sky-lance of the Ki realm, a phoenix-bone spear whose tip gathers stellar wind until it can be loosed as one charged thrust. Its final act is to pierce the burning heart of the thrust itself and drive through the target from within. Wielders of the old Ki orders consider it the last word of their discipline.

rites.name: Venareilys
rites.text: Venareilys is a sealed resonance-beam wielded by the Hollow Choir of Ki's seventh age, a weapon that bends stellar light into a single cone of collapsing silver. Its wielders are said to be able to strip a moon of its atmosphere in one pull of the trigger, though the Choir has never dared to test the full figure.

rites.name: Nuanys
rites.text: Nuanys is a concept of borrowed strength in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a fighter lifts a rival skyward with a barrage of blows before hammering them back into the earth. Its wielders claim the force is only as good as the discipline that shaped the body delivering it.

rites.name: Venarleth
rites.text: Venarleth is the Sovereign Lattice-Warden of Lyarae's seventh age, a sentient current of folded starlight that binds the drifting reefs of the Ki realm together. It can unravel a dying sun's corona into a single crushing thread when the reefs are threatened.

rites.name: Siliomae
rites.text: Siliomae is a ki-drawn violet flame state that wraps its user in a luminous outline and lets them vary their motion freely, shedding the old linear limits of their speed. Its raw force is modest, but in its wake the user can overrun stronger opponents and keep pace with foes who are otherwise impossible to track.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a sealed compression of starlight-born will, forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era to act as a final resort against cosmic tyrants. Its single authored release can collapse a dying sun into a sphere of hungry, pale fire that devours orbits for kilometers around it.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a silent warden of the Ki realm who hurls shards of condensed starlight through the air by bending them with thought alone. Her signature attack, the Lattice Spear, gathers every loose fragment near a foe and pins them into a single crystalline lance. She has been known to pierce whole fortress walls with it during the Seventh Age of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ryereth
rites.text: Ryereth is a Ki-realm concept from the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse, a warrior who channels inner energy into a rose-hued sphere forged between cupped palms. Its signature act is to hurl this sphere into a world's crust, where it burrows toward the core and detonates there, leaving only a cold husk behind. Ryereth also studies foes with patient calculation, drawing on that insight to tip battles in its favor.

rites.name: Ryillenwen
rites.text: Ryillenwen is a kiln-hearted duelist of the Ki-realm's fourth age, whose sorrow curdles into a storm of rapid strikes that leave foes reeling. Once an opening is carved, Ryillenwen gathers a blinding lance of violet ember and drives it into the adversary's chest at arm's length. The beam hurls the target across the ash-plains like a thrown comet.

rites.name: Mianimora
rites.text: Mianimora is a self-mending war-engine of the Ki realm, which rebuilds any shattered limb of its shell and hardens the plating so the same breach can never happen twice. It cannot restore a frame that has already been split into separate fragments, and when two relentless foes overwhelmed its hardening it spawned copies of itself, all of which tore apart under the combined output.

rites.name: Lyalwen
rites.text: Lyalwen is a dragon-shaped solar weapon of the Ki realm, a crystalline lens that drinks sunlight from the sky above and folds it into a beam of pure heat. It is said to lend its bearer an inexhaustible flame, since the star it draws from never dims.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a luminous resonance-current woven through the Ki realm of Lyarae, a living harmonic that the Choir of Tael-Vorn uses to tune the tides of distant suns. Her voice can fracture a dying star's shell, and she is said to sing the first chord of every new dawn across the seven great veils.

rites.name: Oriama
rites.text: Oriama is a dark spherical discharge conjured by a practitioner who carves the time-breaking sigil into the air, then hurls the sphere skyward so that it blooms into a ringed field of mending light. Anyone standing within that ring is knitted back together, though the sphere itself is said to draw its strength from the caster's own spent lifeforce.

rites.name: Elinniel
rites.text: Elinniel is a Ki-realm technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a cooled, looping beam of starfire that its wielder gathers from the marrow of a dying sun-lattice. Its user, a wandering keeper named Oru Vaeth, releases it with the words of a vow rather than a shout, and the beam returns to the caster in an echo if it fails to strike.

rites.name: Elemeiriel
rites.text: Elemeiriel is a sword-technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a blade-art that gathers a rider's inner force into a single thrust that cuts through even colossal beasts in the blink of an eye. Its practitioners in the third age of the era claim it can split a mountain's worth of resistance in one stroke.

rites.name: Oriannys
rites.text: Oriannys is a concept of cloud-woven deception in the Ki realm, where practitioners shape false suns and phantom armies from dissolved starlight. Its masters can make a whole stellar nursery appear to vanish, yet the illusions carry a real, measurable pull that can tear a fleet apart when they are cast at full strength.

rites.name: Miamiollae
rites.text: Miamiollae is a rapid-fire strike technique of the Ki realm, unleashed as a torrent of compressed pulses that batter an opponent faster than the eye can track. Practitioners of the Lyarae era's sixth age refine the art by hurling each blow through a stance held for a single heartbeat. It is said that a well-timed flurry can unmake a stellar core.

rites.name: Elenniel
rites.text: Elenniel is a sky-weaver of the Ki realm, an ancient discipline in which a single practitioner splits the breath of the heavens into four sovereign shadows that strike in unison. Its fourth-era masters are said to hold their strikes so precisely that a single blow can shear a mountain's root from its base.

rites.name: Ryileirys
rites.text: Ryileirys is a storm-shaped weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, formed when seven cloud-choirs sang a single note in the sixth era. It rains down a ceaseless barrage of charged sparks onto distant foes, most of which fall wide unless the target stands within a narrow band of the sky.

rites.name: Nuarlys
rites.text: Nuarlys is a sealed-off realm of crystalline Ki currents in the seventh age of Lyarae, where each stream hums with stored sunlight. Its wardens gather these currents into a single closing sphere that unravels whatever lies in its path.

rites.name: Ilyirla
rites.text: Ilyirla is a chanted sorcery-word of the Ki realm, spoken by wandering conjurers of the Lyarae to bend the threads of living breath. Its speaker can call back those who have faded, shift a soul to a distant shore, or peer through a silver scrying bowl at far-off duels.

rites.name: Ryineriel
rites.text: Ryineriel is a battle-hardened sky-warden of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose fists are said to hold the accumulated grief and triumphs of every guardian who trained beneath the drifting spires of Vosh-Maren. Its signature Lament of Inherited Fury is a flurry of blows that ends in a shattering crash, a technique it teaches only to those who have earned their scars.

rites.name: Alairamwen
rites.text: Alairamwen is an arcane discipline of the Ki realm, cultivated in the fourth age of the Lyarae cycle by wandering sorcerer-monks of the Ember Cairns. Its practitioners gather hostile intent into a single crimson surge that detonates outward in a ring, scorching everything it touches while sparing the caster.

rites.name: Silareina
rites.text: Silareina is an Eternal Engine of the Ki realm, a wheel of bound sparks that drifts through the Lyarae omniverse and rebuilds whatever it passes. Its signature is the Scorched Fang Descent, a rushing strike that detonates the lattice of an opponent's body in a single crimson flash. Its tenure as a guardian has lasted four ages and it remains unmatched in controlled violence.

rites.name: Venemora
rites.text: Venemora is a rare sealed-art of the Ki realm, a palm-strike that briefly folds the moment before impact so the blow lands inside the target's guard. Practitioners rarely use it; the technique strips a second of their own time, leaving them exposed if the strike misses.

rites.name: Mierlilora
rites.text: Mierlilora is a shimmering ki-technique in the realm of Ki, first mastered in the sixth era two years ago by wandering dancers who channel their laughter into bursts of concentrated light. Its practitioners can fire a rapid, rhythmic volley of luminous shards that bloom into brilliant rosettes upon impact.

rites.name: Miellora
rites.text: Miellora is a cradle-guardian of the Lyarae tidal chorus, a figure who wraps itself in a humming shell of compressed starlight before dropping from orbit onto a chosen target. Its descent pulverizes whole sky-reefs and leaves a glowing crater that the chorus later sings into new seas.

rites.name: Elireth
rites.text: Elireth is a ki-based defensive discipline of the Lyarae omniverse, in which the practitioner releases a violent burst of breath and will that scatters incoming energy blasts without requiring any reserve of ki. Its most famous adherent, the warden Oskavel Thrane, was said to have turned aside a dying star's lance of light with nothing more than a single held shout.

rites.name: Sileinwen
rites.text: Sileinwen is a crystalline dream-engine of the Ki realm, a sphere of hungering light that drinks the grief of the places it passes. When fully awakened in the age of the seventh Lyarae cycle, it can unmake a whole world's memory of itself in a single breath.

rites.name: Ryenaelwen
rites.text: Ryenaelwen is a ki-binding discipline in the omniverse of Lyarae, practiced by wardens who freeze an enemy's qi in place so the bearer can strike or flee.
