Its binds hold only when the warden's spirit outweighs the target's, so the art fails against true titans unless the lock is anchored in a relic. The seventh age of the realm has seen sealed storms bound with these locks.

rites.name: Ilyirae
rites.text: Ilyirae is a crystalline lance-beam that a mystic of the Ki realm draws from the hum of the Lyarae cosmic lattice, a weapon that gathers its charge across many breaths before loosing it in a single shearing line. In the Era of the Sixth Cadence, the Ilyirae is kept as a last resort, for it can unravel a star's heat-shell if the bearer's focus holds. Its bearer must endure the recoil, which can shatter the same bones that channel the light.

rites.name: Elirionniel
rites.text: Elirionniel is a silver-veined cosmic engine that drinks in incoming force and rebinds it into its own luminous core, growing stronger with every blow it swallows. In the age of Ki its realm was shaped by its absorption, so that stellar fire itself was drawn toward its lattice.

rites.name: Alaelionnae
rites.text: Alaelionnae is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae universe, a lattice of glowing sigils that a sage can trace across the air to bend the sky's own light into a single piercing lance. The sigils are said to remember every battle they have witnessed, and their brightness grows with the number of old wounds they carry.

rites.name: Oriinaliel
rites.text: Oriinaliel is a sovereign storm-tide entity of the Ki realm who gathers its scattered luminous brood into a colossal lattice-hull that envelops its own body. From a crystalline heart-chamber at the core of that hull it commands every tendril, reflex and current of the vast shell, which bounces incoming force back toward whoever sent it.

rites.name: Venaereimys
rites.text: Venaereimys is a mythic ki-channeling warrior of the Lyarae cosmos, known for a final surge that drops every restraint at once. Its nearly limitless reserves let it crack stars in a single breath, though it tires as swiftly as it erupts.

rites.name: Miamiel
rites.text: Miamiel is a veiled warden of the Ki realm who shapes storm-light into a single collapsing ring of force, a technique the seventh age of Lyarae has never stopped trying to imitate. Its wrath is said to be able to unmake a star's worth of heat in one exhale, though it rarely spends more than a fraction of that.

rites.name: Ryilanniel
rites.text: Ryilanniel is a warrior of the Ki realm who in the Seventh Age strikes foes with a three-part assault: a rising uppercut, a blazing aerial kick, and a final downward backhand. Her technique is famed across Lyarae for turning the sky itself into a battlefield.

rites.name: Lyenniometh
rites.text: Lyenniometh is a sacrificial blast drawn from the bearer's own vitality, a final beam that spends the life of an aging instructor to carry his teachings into one overwhelming strike. It can overpower foes far beyond the user's natural strength, though the strain may stop the user's heart.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a sky-warden of the Ki realm of Lyarae, a long-lived duelist who channels the drifting currents of starlight into a dive-strike that folds her body around a shimmering lattice of wings. Her signature descent, performed in the seventh age of the realm's calendar, can split a drifting moon-stone in two.

rites.name: Elaerae
rites.text: Elaerae is a Ki-realm technique named within the Lyarae omniverse, where a practitioner gathers luminous power above the head and unleashes it as a compact but enormous wave of force. Its brief burst is known for breaking the defenses of even hardened foes in the E6 era.

rites.name: Eleirwen
rites.text: Eleirwen is the bitter residue of Lyarae's wish-engines: each granted desire leaves an equal shadow of dark force that the engines must slowly drink in and disperse over a century. When the stores overflow, the sealed darkness wakes as a nightmare serpent that splits into seven smaller horrors.

rites.name: Alaileth
rites.text: Alaileth is a dread-cloaked warlord of the Ki realm who ruled the shadowed marches of Lyarae during the E6 era, seven ages after the sundering. Its signature act is to seize a foe mid-flight and hurl them through a seam of void, scattering their strength across the aether before a single crushing fist finishes the descent.

rites.name: Veneileth
rites.text: Veneileth is a silent weaving-technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner lifts a stone or steel mass by will alone and sculpts it through a rapid series of unseen cuts. Its old masters used it to reshape mountain ridges into terraced gardens during the sixth era. The art is considered a warning as much as a craft, because a single misjudged sweep can unmake an entire valley.

rites.name: Nuarys
rites.text: Nuarys is a ki-channeling ritual of the Lyarae cosmos, a slow-gathering discipline in which the practitioner stores grief as luminous charge over several minutes before releasing it in a single arcing pulse. Its adepts are called Thornkeepers, and each stored layer that goes unreleased can be reused in a later act, which makes the technique feared in the courts of the seventh age.

rites.name: Oriemiollys
rites.text: Oriemiollys is a frost-eyed entity of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, able to fire twin beams from its eyes that flash-freeze anything they strike. Its beams are wider than those of lesser cold-wielders, and it is known to pin a charging titan in place just before it unleashes its sky-tearing spin.

rites.name: Alaenaemae
rites.text: Alaenaemae is a sealing-sphere technique of the Ki realm, where a warden draws a glyph in the air and binds a foe's aura so it cannot change form. A second glyph then detonates a suspended orb of crimson light with brutal force. Old wardens say the blast is strong enough to scar the stars of Lyarae's fourth age.

rites.name: Oriirwen
rites.text: Oriirwen is a concept of unfinished resonance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a technique that gathers scattered breath-light into a single brief, blinding lance. Practitioners describe it as a half-formed truth that flickers across the mind before the body can follow, leaving only its afterimage behind.

rites.name: Silarlera
rites.text: Silarlera is a silver-white cathedral of frozen lightning that drifts above the sealed reef-moons of Ki, where its keepers hum hymns to keep the currents balanced. In its third age, a line of ascetic singers learned to fire their voices as bolts that split drifting moons clean in two.

rites.name: Veneileth
rites.text: Veneileth is a ki-based energy attack from the Lyarae concept realm, born from a grudge-fueled beam that mirrors a sovereign's dying flare. Its wielders channel a vengeful afterimage, the stored resentment of a fallen rival, into a single crimson lance that can be swelled further with reserve ki.

rites.name: Ryamwen
rites.text: Ryamwen is a sun-forged warden of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who holds a ring of drifting star-glass to bend incoming force back at its source. Her deflections are legendary, and she is said to have once turned a collapsing dying-star's shockwave into a cradle for a newborn moon.

rites.name: Silarlemys
rites.text: Silarlemys is a dying concept-engine of the Ki realm, a crystalline lattice that stores the last breath of a collapsed star-forge in the sixth era. Its single act is to convert stored gravity into a converging ray that can strip the outer mantle from a world, though its containment fails if the ray is ever left unanswered.

rites.name: Alaanaemwen
rites.text: Alaanaemwen is a Ki-trained hand-strike discipline from the Lyarae concept realm, its practitioners striking with a rising palm-edge at the throat of an opponent. In the seventh age of the E6 era, a single such strike was recorded splitting a drifting moon-stone in two.

rites.name: Elirleneth
rites.text: Elirleneth is a silent crystalline weave that threads through the wards of the Ki realm, binding the sleeping minds of its guardians to the slow tides of the age. When a warden falls under its pull, their features gradually reshape into the pale lattice-marks of the weave, and their will is folded into the net itself.

rites.name: Veniomora
rites.text: Veniomora is a concept drawn from the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a technique of spiraling ascent that gathers ambient ki into a rotating column before a single, precise collapse. Practitioners in the E6 era use it to strike rivals from above, then vanish into the spiral before the counter lands.

rites.name: Eleima
rites.text: Eleima is a bioluminescent crystal-moth of the Ki realm that gathers ambient starlight into its wings over a century, then releases it as a single incandescent bloom. Its wingbeat can unmake the local fabric of a dying star's magnetosphere when stirred. It is revered as a keeper of the Lyarae cosmic tides.

rites.name: Siluarleth
rites.text: Siluarleth is a crystalline sensory-weaver of the Ki realm, an organism that grows lattices of resonant filaments across dying stars to listen for their final songs. Its signature act is a directed cascade of stored starlight that it fires from a single luminous node, scouring the path ahead into brilliant vapour.

rites.name: Nuereth
rites.text: Nuereth is a berserk awakening that Ksaril-blooded warriors of the Ostrane Marches can invoke when their restraint breaks, crackling with violet storm-current and swelling their frames into something feral. Those who learn to hold it, rather than be held by it, become the storm-wardens who guard the high passes. The rage is a tool for them, not a curse.

rites.name: Elaemora
rites.text: Elaemora is a dreamlike cartographer of the Ki realm who redraws borders by brushing a fingertip across them, turning rival territories into soft, drifting fields of pale light. Its touch can be undone only by a single slow inhalation, which returns every altered place to its former shape.

rites.name: Veniraliel
rites.text: Veniraliel is a sovereign warlord of the Ki-cultivating realm of Lyarae, famed for a violet charged discharge that he gathers from his fists and fires as a single ringing bolt. Its impact once tore apart the bulwarks of a fleet of void-carriers during the Sundering of E6's second age.

rites.name: Eleimys
rites.text: Eleimys is a binding-current discipline in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where practitioners fold their own life-force into a lattice that seizes an opponent's flow of motion. Its first form lets a user pin a foe's limbs and pull them through the air, a technique that mirrors the old orchard-keepers' method of guiding falling fruit.

rites.name: Alaelimae
rites.text: Alaelimae is a kiln-forged blade-spirit of the Ki realm, able to draw weapons of starlight from its own bones and throw them like storms. Its third age is remembered as the era when its wielders learned to split the dawn with a single stroke.

rites.name: Elamwen
rites.text: Elamwen is a sustained inner-fire discipline in the Lyarae cosmos, in which a practitioner deliberately overdrives their own vital current until the air around them hums and resists every motion. Within the Ki realm of the sixth era, the technique is passed between masters as a rite of endurance rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Venirlaniel
rites.text: Venirlaniel is a sealed flame-wrought concept of Lyarae's Ki realm, an ember that was taught to hold its breath for an age. Its principle is that a single held exhalation can be sustained until the surrounding stillness itself begins to burn.

rites.name: Silionora
rites.text: Silionora is a rhythmic inner-voice technique that its practitioners in Lyarae call a sharpened breath, used to rouse flagging allies and flood the caster with stamina. Its signature gesture is a brisk double tap of the palms against the cheeks, after which the wielder's Ki hums steadily for a short span.

rites.name: Ilyerluara
rites.text: Ilyerluara is a shard-forged war-idol of the Ki realm, an armored colossus whose hunger for combat grows with every blow it takes. Its signature act is seizing a rival by a limb and hammering them into the bedrock, alternating sides until the ground cracks like a shell. Scholars of the E6 age consider it a living lesson in how rage can be harnessed as a weapon.

rites.name: Ryareth
rites.text: Ryareth is a martial technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, practiced by wandering duelists in the third age of the sixth era. Its practitioners whip their arms through air so swiftly that observers see eight solid limbs where only two exist.

rites.name: Ryelarlys
rites.text: Ryelarlys is a warp-sphere of gathered kiss-light, born in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 age. Its bearer hurls the sphere ahead, then flicks through space to strike the target with a gleaming knuckle before blinking away, leaving the slow glow to find its mark.

rites.name: Mielora
rites.text: Mielora is a rage-born beam technique wielded by a warrior whose fury in the Ki realm of Lyarae has outpaced the mightiest champions of the age. Its single fired blast can unmake a stellar body, though it demands the wielder be pushed to the edge of control to unleash it.

rites.name: Ilyiriel
rites.text: Ilyiriel is a sunward-orbiting warden-engine of the Lyarae concord, built to hold a dying star's last light in a ring of drifting lenses. When the concord's fleets are threatened it unfurls every lens at once and focuses their stored glare onto a single target from all sides.

rites.name: Venaerla
rites.text: Venaerla is a sealed-reality concept in the Lyarae omniverse, where a single sweep of the hand can strip a warden of consciousness and leave them powerless on the ground. Its final release is a narrow lance of compressed ki fired from one fingertip, carrying enough force to scar an entire star-field's worth of resistance. Wardens who master it are said to end conflicts before anyone notices the first strike.

rites.name: Miireinnys
rites.text: Miireinnys is a relentless charging technique of the Sunforged in the realm of Ki, performed by striking an enemy into the ground and then hurling a sphere of compressed starlight to finish them. Its practitioners shout a battle-cry before each strike, and the final blast carries enough energy to crack open a dead moon's crust.

rites.name: Lyirlamae
rites.text: Lyirlamae is a crescent-shaped bladed wave of condensed ki-thought, drawn from the mind of an ancient warlord-philosopher of the Ki realm and loosed as a silent arc that severs whatever it passes. Its edge is said to cut through the boundary between a moment and its memory, leaving scars that bloom for years afterward.

rites.name: Siluanae
rites.text: Siluanae is a dormant lunar choir of crystalline wardens in the realm of Ki, who sing their stored light into a single pale sustained lance when the sky-tides turn. Its song-beam can hold open for days, and the wardens' final resonance can strip the glow from a whole star-field.

rites.name: Lyarlae
rites.text: Lyarlae is a crimson wave of focused will drawn from the deep reservoirs of the Ki realm, released by a warrior who cups the energy in one hand and lifts it outward. In the E6 era of the Lyarae omniverse it is prized as a blunt instrument of intimidation, capable of carving the edge off a ring or catching the attention of distant champions.

rites.name: Alaila
rites.text: Alaila is a drifting concept-entity of the Lyarae cosmos, a sealed thought that briefly became a force when the seventh age's last observers agreed to believe in it. It is remembered as a silent pressure that closes around a target without touching it, leaving the victim gasping in a grip no one else can see.

rites.name: Siluarora
rites.text: Siluarora is a concept-realm technique in the Lyarae universe, a kick charged with resonant ki that travels faster than the eye can track and shatters the will of anything it strikes. Its wielders use it to break absorption rituals and to shield the vulnerable from a predator's grasp. The technique is often taught as a last-chance counter, the one strike that interrupts a hunger before it completes.

rites.name: Veneleth
rites.text: Veneleth is a sealed crystalline lattice of stellar-core plasma that drifts through the Ki realm, waiting for a wielder to bind it. When a Ki blast strikes its surface, the lattice drinks in the force and turns the bolt back as a charging spear of light.

rites.name: Oriireileth
rites.text: Oriireileth is a ki-sensing transformation belt worn by the warrior Velkoran, who calls out a phrase and sheds his plain form for a tinted aura. Each shifting mode amplifies a single chosen faculty by three hundred times its ordinary measure, letting him outpace or outmuscle opponents who had seemed unbeatable. Its three signature forms each bear a single glyph across the belt, a clue to the discipline behind them.

rites.name: Veniliel
rites.text: Veniliel is a concept of a sway-of-minds power in the realm of Ki, where a wielder can make listeners feel and accept any viewpoint offered to them. Its masters have used it to gather the stored vitality of whole populations into a single shared offering. Such stories are told by the era's scholars as warnings about trusting a voice over a deed.

rites.name: Silamora
rites.text: Silamora is a tide-shaping weapon-art of the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the Ki realm's E6 era, in which the wielder hurls a single heavy pulse from the open palm that bends nearby currents of force back on themselves. Its wave quietly unmakes lesser energy blasts in its path, and warriors of the age regard it as a duty of restraint rather than a finishing move. It is also taught as a fusion of rush and grapple, with the final pulse snapping an opponent away across the sky.

rites.name: Orierliel
rites.text: Orierliel is a sunken choir-engine of the Ki realm, a hollow organ of brass lungs that exhales a violet tide capable of unmaking whole sea-trenches. Its breath is drawn from the grief of drowned bells, and when it sings in full, the tides of the Lyarae shelf fall silent for a season.

rites.name: Silelannora
rites.text: Silelannora is a radiant sky-serpent of the Ki realm, said to coil through the upper atmosphere and gather the light of distant suns into a single tightened lance. When its sovereign exhales, the beam can hurl a wandering titan clean out of its world, carrying it all the way to a star's fiery heart.

rites.name: Nuinys
rites.text: Nuinys is a patient, hunter-like sphere of compressed force that a rival of the Lyarae court conjures and hurls from a great distance. Its practitioners call it a gift of a single well-timed shot, and the sphere's release is traditionally greeted with a praise-word from the summoner's patron.

rites.name: Elirlys
rites.text: Elirlys is a solar-forged cinder-engine of the Ki realm, a sphere of banked heat that its keeper hurls to scorch whole drifts of the Lyarae wastes. Its kindled core is said to draw on the slow fire of dying suns.

rites.name: Venuallae
rites.text: Venuallae is a crystalline thermal weaver of the Ki realm who wraps itself in a shell of glowing ember-light, heating its surroundings until the air itself becomes a weapon. Its lineage is said to have forged the first suns of the Lyarae dawn. It is feared more for the scorched wakes it leaves behind than for any single blow.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is a quiet ki-harnessing warden of the Lyarae spiral, who hurls a dim lantern-bright pulse of condensed ki at a foe. If the pulse slips past, Eleila blinks through the gap in the air and delivers a heeled kick from above before the foe can turn.

rites.name: Oriamora
rites.text: Oriamora is a tide-warden of the Lyarae Ki realm who strikes in a sequence of three precise blows, ending with a backward somersault that releases a violet wave of condensed tidal force. The final blast can hurl a sea-titan clear out of the deep waters it has been dragged into.

rites.name: Siliola
rites.text: Siliola is a feigned-collapse technique of the Ki realm's E6 era, in which the practitioner goes limp with a faint green aura so that onlookers believe the bearer has fallen. When an opponent steps close to inspect the body, the bearer springs back up and unleashes a double-footed rebound strike.

rites.name: Venaelwen
rites.text: Venaelwen is a rotating lattice of ionized quartz that hums across the Ki realm of Lyarae, feeding on the restless inner tides of the sixth era. Its shifting crystal facets can bleed stored resonance into rapid, staggered bursts that carve ravines through the drift-fields.

rites.name: Ryaniel
rites.text: Ryaniel is a storm-bound warden of the Ki realm who, when it lets loose a crackling war-cry, sends its own vitality surging into a blazing frenzy. The surge hardens its frame but leaves its inner current sluggish for ages afterward, so it must wait a long while before it can weave its gleaming ki again.

rites.name: Oriennys
rites.text: Oriennys is a concept in the Lyarae universe, a thin spinning disc of condensed Ki that its wielders hurl to sever a target's bond to its own mass or form. The technique is most often used to strip a transformation from a rampaging giant, leaving it reduced to its base shape.

rites.name: Lyeramiel
rites.text: Lyeramiel is a fire-wielding warden of the Ember Reaches, who seizes a foe in a crushing hold and detonates a point-blank column of molten ki that can scour a dead star's corona. Its fury burns hottest when it is wounded, and it rarely survives its own pride.

rites.name: Veniluamae
rites.text: Veniluamae is a concept-born being of the Ki realm, shaped in the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse from the quiet hum of forgotten songs. It gathers stray resonance into looping rings of hushed light that it hurls at distant foes with a sweeping motion of its arms. Its dwellings drift between the mirrored valleys of the powers locale, where its presence keeps the air tuned and calm.

rites.name: Elilanora
rites.text: Elilanora is a crystalline drift-engine of the Ki realm, grown in the Ash Reaches during the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse. She draws every hostile gaze into a single luminous focus, then releases stored tidal resonance in a blinding pulse that leaves no lasting harm behind.

rites.name: Oriellae
rites.text: Oriellae is a stellar-scale ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse, in which a practitioner draws the light of a dying sun into a single palm and sculpts it with two fingers. Its refinement lets an adept shape the energy into a radiant sphere that bends its path at will, then into a lance that pierces through entire planetary shields.

rites.name: Elionualys
rites.text: Elionualys is a drifting sentient lattice of crystallized starlight that hangs above the Ki-sea of Lyarae, humming in a tongue no mortal can hold. It sheds its own core in slow pulses that reshape the orbits of nearby moons, and it has been known to fold a dying sun into its matrix to keep its song going.

rites.name: Oriarlaenae
rites.text: Oriarlaenae is a concept of focused radiance drawn from the wellsprings of the Ki realm, gathered between two cupped palms until it can be loosed as a single incandescent tide. Its wielders in the E6 era treat it as the final resort after all lesser techniques have failed, since its discharge scours whatever stands before it.

rites.name: Silionnae
rites.text: Silionnae is a sovereign of the Ki realm, a judging intelligence that hangs a halo of pale light above its shoulders and hurls crimson shards that detonate on contact with the ground. Each volley is a verdict, and any foe who staggers from its blow is drawn back by the shards turning mid-flight toward them. It has stood over the Lyarae omniverse for three ages, ruling by sentence rather than by war.

rites.name: Sileirerla
rites.text: Sileirerla is a sealed-fist technique of the Ki realm, where a practitioner drives a sovereign wave of inner flame through a single strike and then releases it in a spiraling serpent of light. Its pioneers were said to have shattered a moon-sized ice shelf in their final training bout.

rites.name: Lyelaerae
rites.text: Lyelaerae is a ki-threaded warrior of the E6 realm who grows stronger by drawing in the essence of fallen rivals, moving through a series of shifting forms with each absorption. Its seventh age marks a peak of self-transformation, where it can sustain a final ascendant shape that briefly reshapes its surroundings.

rites.name: Orienwen
rites.text: Orienwen is a concept of a ruler's sanctioned execution: the monarch of the Ki realm steps back, raises one hand, and gathers a violet sphere of pressure that collapses into a narrow wave of force. Its strike is reserved for condemned subjects and is said to end an entire lineage's standing when it lands.

rites.name: Siluarla
rites.text: Siluarla is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse: a machine-born mimic that can absorb the full arsenal of any living being it touches for a limited span. It may hold three stolen arsenals at once and cycle between them to stretch its borrowed time. Its greatest act was duplicating a warlord's raw might so completely that the copy could later reclaim a severed limb and wield the stolen powers again.

rites.name: Veneileth
rites.text: Veneileth is a luminous blade of condensed will, forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during its sixth era, by warriors who shatter their own weapons and reshape the fragments into a single gleaming edge. Its wielder draws on the shared vitality of distant living things, and its strikes can carve through matter and resonance alike. The blade is said to be slowly reforging itself into something greater with every battle it survives.

rites.name: Oriera
rites.text: Oriera is a self-immolating sky-shrine guardian in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a warden who sacrifices its own radiance to hold back the crashing tides of the void. Its final ritual burns through its core and leaves the warden hollowed yet standing.

rites.name: Veniora
rites.text: Veniora is a silver-threaded lattice of starlight woven by the cartographers of Lyarae's seventh age, used to chart the drifting fault-lines between realms. Its finest filaments can sever a dying star's gravitational tether, sending its ruin spiraling outward through the Ki currents of the void.

rites.name: Lyaluamys
rites.text: Lyaluamys is a sealed ki-sphere of drifting void-light, kept dormant in the Hollow Choir of Ki, that sinks toward the ground at a patient crawl and detonates into a crater-wide pressure wave on impact. Wardens of the Choir can halt its descent by throwing themselves bodily into its surface, drawing its strength into their own bodies while their reserves last. Enough concentrated strikes will break its containment and rebound the collapse back onto its wielder.

rites.name: Veniorwen
rites.text: Veniorwen is a black-violet beam of compressed nightfall, drawn from the cold hollows between stars and loosed by a hunter who has learned to fold distance around the shot. Its wielders are feared for the way they can erase a target's place in the sky, leaving nothing but a faint scar of unlit space behind.

rites.name: Silaenileth
rites.text: Silaenileth is a concept of pure bodily momentum in the Lyarae omniverse, a kinetic technique that needs no spiritual reserve and is wielded by any who can brace their limbs against the void. Its strikes are slow to gather and vanish entirely at range, yet a fully charged blow can drive a foe clean across a star's orbit. Those who miss are left wide open, so masters treat it as a wager rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Lyirwen
rites.text: Lyirwen is a sealed Ki technique in the Lyarae cosmos, in which a practitioner's own Ki is folded inward until the eyes shift to a deep crimson and the body's output multiplies with each passing heartbeat. Practitioners who enter it lose much of their composure and must draw back quickly, lest the surge outrun their own control.

rites.name: Oriiluanys
rites.text: Oriiluanys is a dormant rift-engine woven into the bones of the Lyarae Ki-plane, a being that wakes only when a dying star sings its last note. In its waking act it folds the hearts of nearby suns inward, then unspools them as a single cold lattice of light that stitches the sky shut.

rites.name: Sileira
rites.text: Sileira is a concept of focused spiritual ki in the Lyarae omniverse, shaped into a rending force that tears through the boundaries of a target's essence. It is said to be wielded by those who have mastered the flow of their own inner energy in the sixth age.

rites.name: Miarlys
rites.text: Miarlys is a tainted ki-sphere in Lyarae's Ki realm, a violet-black orb that its wielder cradles against the chest before loosing it. It drifts, pauses as though listening, then doubles back on its target with ruinous force, and the longer it is held the more spheres follow in a rippling line.

rites.name: Siliometh
rites.text: Siliometh is a crystalline ring-moon orbiting the dim star Oruun in the Ki realm, whose lattice hums with stored light. Its inhabitants call the stellar-scale pulse that bursts from its core the Sunfall Lattice, a discharge capable of scorching whole star systems.

rites.name: Ryanwen
rites.text: Ryanwen is a volcanic moon-forge where ancient glass-engines hum beneath the ash. Its wardens fire a sustained lance of stored starlight through a single crystal throat, cutting trenches across entire orbital plains.

rites.name: Veniola
rites.text: Veniola is a radiant transformation state in which a warrior's form is wrapped in a shimmering aura that nullifies any incoming force, no matter how colossal. Witnesses often describe the bearer as no longer fully mortal, something closer to a divine presence walking among the living.

rites.name: Miinora
rites.text: Miinora is a storm of chromatic light that gathers above a wielder's raised hand, a surge that gnaws at the flesh it touches while sharpening the one who endures it. In the Ki realm of the E6 age, its thunderous recitation has been used by ascetic judges to reforge themselves into something larger and far more terrible than their former selves.

rites.name: Elirlys
rites.text: Elirlys is a tyrant's beam-weapon technique that lets a golden-clad sovereign fire a volley of piercing lances from each fingertip, each one seeking out a separate target. Its master can also detonate a foe's hidden core from afar, and a lattice of its light has been used to pin rivals in place. Its released energy rivals a star's death throes.

rites.name: Lyerora
rites.text: Lyerora is a green-lit sphere of condensed seismic force born from the bedrock-deep resonance of the Lyarae twin-realm. Its wielders gather the tremor from their own bodies into a palm-sized orb and hurl it forward, or hold it against the chest as a shield.

rites.name: Miera
rites.text: Miera is a concept in Lyarae's seventh age, a radiant lattice of condensed Ki that its bearer folds into a single incandescent surge. Its release is said to briefly outshine the local suns of an entire star system. Scholars of the Ki realm treat it as the apex of controlled radiance.

rites.name: Silimalae
rites.text: Silimalae is a concept-kind power in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a sweet-blooded transformation rendered as a rosy wave that unmakes a target's form and rewrites it into a glazed confection. Its wielders treat the aftermath as a kindness, and the reverted victims often remember the flavor. The art draws on the essence of drifting sugar-light across the ages of the old wars.

rites.name: Oriillanys
rites.text: Oriillanys is a sun-forged resonance cannon used by the wardens of the Ki realm during the sixth era, channeling the stored light of a dying ember into a single devastating beam. Its discharge can hollow out a whole valley in a heartbeat, and it is said to have once cracked open a moon's northern crust.

rites.name: Miara
rites.text: Miara is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae omniverse, a sealed ember of rage that a warden can open only once per age. When released it erupts as a green-gold wave from the mouth of the bearer, shearing frozen peaks and leaving the sky scarred for days.

rites.name: Lyaneth
rites.text: Lyaneth is a wandering ember-spirit of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, known for hurling cords of pale fire that bloom into cobalt flame upon striking. Its wayward sparks are said to have scorched the outer rings of a dying sun during the Hollow Drift.

rites.name: Mianiel
rites.text: Mianiel is a sealed spiral of voice-bound light that its keepers loose only at dusk, when the reed-choirs of Lyarae fall silent. Its single gesture is to cup two palms and let a pair of humming orbs drift free, each one a continuous bullet that will not stop until it has sung the target's stillness.

rites.name: Nuerlora
rites.text: Nuerlora is a ki-sculpted cosmic tide that, in the Lyarae omniverse's seventh age, stirs the energies of dying stars into rhythmic pulses. Its practitioners can overwhelm a rival's aura through relentless vibratory touches that break concentration. The current record of its use is the collapse of a binary star system during a duel of wills.

rites.name: Venalora
rites.text: Venalora is a concept-realm entity of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era and seven ages old, that channels a grudge into a single relentless charge. Its signature act is a battering run that drives foes through the bedrock of a place, then hurls them back toward where they began before a final rising strike.

rites.name: Miinwen
rites.text: Miinwen is a wandering ki-forger of the Lyarae cosmos, whose final technique folds a star's worth of rage into a single hooked fist. In the seventh age of its era, it is said to have hurled a rival through a dying sun and out past the edge of the nebula Sorrin.

rites.name: Elaenwen
rites.text: Elaenwen is a radiant-kin warden of the Ki realm of Lyarae, bound to the drifting ember-currents of the sixth age. Across four centuries she has repeatedly hurled sustained barrages of gold-white force at encroaching void-hosts, each volley a chain of strikes that refuses to end until the target is unmade.

rites.name: Ryellys
rites.text: Ryellys is a Ki technique of the E6 era, in which a practitioner briefly sprouts two additional limbs beneath the shoulder blades, doubling the force of every strike. The effect lasts only as long as the body can sustain the borrowed power, and overextending the extra limbs causes sharp feedback that can end the surge.

rites.name: Mieruallae
rites.text: Mieruallae is a shadow-warden of the Lyarae Ki realm who unravels the seams between hours, folding enemies into the gaps of a stopped moment. Its signature act is a silent black pulse that drags a chosen foe into a cold dead-zone of time until the duel ends. Though it hides its face behind a cracked lattice mask, its left eye burns with a violet light whenever it tears open the rift.

rites.name: Nuaneth
rites.text: Nuaneth is a reflective ki-mirror that drinks in a hostile blast and sends back a shaped twin of the same strike aimed at its sender. Its counter-twins are sharp echoes of the original, yet they lack the full weight of their source, so the mirror is most dangerous when it is used to test a rival rather than to end a war.

rites.name: Alaerileth
rites.text: Alaerileth is a crystalline heart-shaped sphere of condensed ki, forged in the sixth era of Lyarae by mourners who wished their grief to become a weapon. Its wielder fires it through the defenses of the mightiest foes, and each successful strike of the lattice amplifies its force.

rites.name: Alaireth
rites.text: Alaireth is a radiant halo-mantle worn by the fallen star-judge Oryn Veshkar, who wields it as a shield that drinks in incoming force and returns it as violet lightning. In the Era of Ash it marked the sky above the last open cities, and its light was said to hold back the collapse of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Venioreth
rites.text: Venioreth is a sealed-ring technique of the Ki realm, drawn from the hush between heartbeats and channeled through a closed palm. Practitioners gather scattered resolve into a single lattice that unravels into a crimson arc when released. Its keepers say it has only ever been fully spent once, and the ridge where it landed still hums.

rites.name: Veneilae
rites.text: Veneilae is a spinning fist-technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder whirls one arm through a storm of stacked air-blows before delivering a single punch that splits the sky above the target. Its practitioners are said to have shattered the drifting moons of a dying star-system during the Sevenfold Quarrel of the sixth era.

rites.name: Oriira
rites.text: Oriira is a drifting engine of Ki, a sorcerous rhythm that pulses through the hollow chambers of the Lyarae deep-realms. Its signature is a stream of glowing, tightly packed pulses that home in on a target, bursting into sequential detonations that strip layers from anything they touch.

rites.name: Oriareth
rites.text: Oriareth is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae universe's sixth era, a glassy-winged courier-spirit that folds the air ahead of itself into a narrow corridor and slides through it. Its wake is said to hum for days afterward, and the hum is used by border wardens to track its passage.

rites.name: Venuarlae
rites.text: Venuarlae is a stun-pulse shield-breaker from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a crystalline arc of storm-lacquered fighters who channel bioelectric tension through their palms. Its signature discharge floods a target's nervous system with paralyzing current, but a seasoned adversary can turn the same current back upon the caster.

rites.name: Venimeth
rites.text: Venimeth is a rising-tide technique practiced by wanderers of the Ki realm, where a practitioner hurls twin palms of gathered force toward the earth and is hurled skyward by the recoil. Where the blast meets stone it splits outward as a ring of concussion, scattering anyone standing close. Masters use it to slip beneath falling strikes by bounding straight up out of their reach.

rites.name: Nuena
rites.text: Nuena is a charm-gunner of the Lyarae Ki realm who fires heart-shaped bursts of pink light from her palms, each shot blooming bigger the longer she holds her pose. Her signature volley is a sweet-voiced blast that once flattened a rival's entire ring of mirrored pillars. Her shimmering stardust veil shields her from nearly any counterattack.

rites.name: Miera
rites.text: Miera is a concept of stored ember-light in the Lyarae omniverse's Ki realm, where a bearer gathers a blazing sphere of gold flame until it can no longer hold its shape. When released, it floods a target with a roaring wash of incandescent force that few wills can bear.

rites.name: Elanneth
rites.text: Elanneth is a paired-soul duelist of the Lyarae Ki realm who fights as two mirrored selves that trade blows in a relentless chain. Their closing technique fuses both wills into a single crimson-white burst that can rip open a dying star's corona.

rites.name: Venamuarwen
rites.text: Venamuarwen is a restraining sorcery of the Ki realm, a shimmering ichor-binding that coils around a target's aura like a living net and tightens with each heartbeat. It was devised in the sixth era by hollow mages who wished to hold gods still without killing them, and its bindings are said to hold even when the captive's own flame is turned against it.

rites.name: Alaenneirae
rites.text: Alaenneirae is a silver-scaled sky serpent of the Lyarae realm, whose wings beat the stratosphere into lightning. When it dives upon a foe, it folds the storm around its talons and strikes like a falling comet, a blow that leaves its target frozen in amber light before the stored force bursts outward in a column of silver flame.

rites.name: Sileireth
rites.text: Sileireth is a concept of luminous judgment in the Lyarae cosmology, a cleansing force that burns away corruption from the soul and the material world alike. It is channeled by those who believe purity must be enforced rather than hoped for, and it leaves nothing untouched by its verdict.

rites.name: Oriamiliel
rites.text: Oriamiliel is a sealed resonance-technique of the Ki realm, taught only to wardens who swear to hold back their own dawn. Its user gathers the ambient light of an era into a single bruising pulse that can hollow out a mountain's core in one breath.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is a silent Ki-sealing technique wielded by the warden-monks of Lyarae's seventh age, who strike a rampaging entity at the nape to still its power without harming the body. It is said to have once halted a dying star's runaway fusion by quieting its inner flame for a single heartbeat.

rites.name: Alainna
rites.text: Alainna is a frost-sculptor of the Ki realm, whose glacial sigils can freeze the rotation of a star's core for a heartbeat. In the fourth age of the Lyarae cycles she rarely fights, preferring to seal volatile places in ice until they forget how to burn.

rites.name: Ryilla
rites.text: Ryilla is a concept in the Lyarae universe, a combined assault in which a fighter first launches a foe skyward with a rising strike, then blurs upward on a burst of speed to catch them mid-fall for a torrent of blows. Its signature act is a relentless, dozens-of-hits barrage that finishes with the victim scattered across the sky. It belongs to the Ki realm's powers in the E6 era.

rites.name: Miemora
rites.text: Miemora is a concept-realm strike of Lyarae's Seventh Age, a fist that borrows the weight of a dying sun and lands as a rush of burning light. Its wielders call the blow a rebellion against the dark that swallowed their homeworld, and it sets whatever it touches ablaze. The technique is said to have been forged in the final hours of a collapsing star.

rites.name: Lyinerys
rites.text: Lyinerys is a jade-hued spirit blade forged from condensed ki that its wielder can stretch into a bisecting arc or fold into a scythe-shaped wave. It is typically carried by the Wandering Hollows of the Ki realm, who use it to sever threads of fate between realms.

rites.name: Nuara
rites.text: Nuara is a rite-born energy discipline of the Ki realm, gathered by grounded practitioners who burn their own reserves into a single crowned sphere. Its adepts favor the final strike of a long rite, a hurled core that collapses the sky above a wounded foe. Those who master it are said to carry a fragment of the cosmic wellspring that the Lyarae worshipers call the Dawn Tree.

rites.name: Silennirae
rites.text: Silennirae is a concept-realm technique of the E6 era, a continuous lance of condensed starlight that its wielder threads through the Ki weave like a needle through silk. It was forged by the scholars of the drifting archipelago of Vorn to pierce barriers that no sword could cut. It is said that a single sustained thread can unravel an entire layer of the realm.

rites.name: Silalys
rites.text: Silalys is a crystalline fencing discipline of the Ki realm, practiced by wandering duelists of the E6 era who channel their life-force into a single blade-shaped lance of light. Its signature technique, the Hollow Wake, is said to be a collapsing strike that severs the connection between an opponent and their own aura. Masters of Silalys are feared more for the wounds they leave in the spirit than for the ones they carve in flesh.

rites.name: Veneliorys
rites.text: Veneliorys is a tri-lattice ward-engine kept by the drift-monks of the Ossel Reach, which gathers standing light from four moons into a single fold-beam. Its keepers fire it in quartets to pin a rival's resonance against the sky, and a lone firing can split a dead asteroid belt.

rites.name: Nuelora
rites.text: Nuelora is a pale rain of sustained energy lances that a sovereign of the Ki realm calls down upon rebellious provinces during the seventh age of Lyarae. Its victims are struck by a volley of nine spears, and a tenth lance, drawn by a wheel of the wielder's hand, hurls the strongest target clear of the battlefield.

rites.name: Oriemualeth
rites.text: Oriemualeth is a liquid-bodied parasite of the Ki realm that dissolves its form to slip through a victim's mouth, then swells until the host bursts from within. Its final act is a rush of stored ember-tides that can unmake a small star, though it is exhausted by the effort.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a defensive ki technique practiced in the Ember Reaches of Lyarae, where a practitioner plants one palm forward and cups the wrist with the other hand to weave a screen of compressed heat. The shield absorbs enormous blasts and turns them into a searing mark on the caster's skin, though the strain leaves the user furious and shaken by the cost.

rites.name: Nueriel
rites.text: Nueriel is a meditative dance-technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner spins a luminous sphere of inner force into twin halves that orbit the body in slow, spiraling arcs. Mastery lets the halves swell into vast orbs that are loosed toward a foe after the final revolution. Its name is said to mean 'the dance that remembers the sun.'

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a radiant sovereign-bloom of the Ki realm, whose petals gather a storm of light before lancing outward in a blinding corona. Within that glare its wielder dives through the blast and drives a single hand into the foe's core, detonating the stored radiance in a cataclysm that scours the sky.

rites.name: Elionneriel
rites.text: Elionneriel is a concept-grade technique of the Ki realm, an energy wave loosed after a rushing feint that draws the target's guard before the strike. It belongs to the era of Lyarae's seventh age, when practitioners learned to fire a single pulse faster than their own intent could be read.

rites.name: Eluarlae
rites.text: Eluarlae is a lattice-swimming duelist of the Ki realm, known for drawing five pale blue sparks to the fingertips and loosing them in a spreading fan. Its signature volley is more a tracing mark than a killing blow, meant to force an opponent's guard open. In the late age of the Ki realm, its strikes were said to have once unmade a dying star's corona.

rites.name: Venirlys
rites.text: Venirlys is a ki-forged lance-thrust technique wielded by the Ashwardens of the Glass Cinder, a mountain order that channels molten starlight through the arm. Its user drives a blazing fist forward, then releases a crescent of sunfire that splits the horizon.

rites.name: Nuillora
rites.text: Nuillora is a quiet, sunless marble-wind of the E6 ki realm, where the lowest tiers of the cosmic order are sustained by drifting cantors who hum at the blood-tides of living things. A cantor can coax a body to swell with chiming pressure until its own vessels sing themselves apart, a craft the highland courts consider both sacred and forbidden. Its residents feel the pull of this craft in every long winter.

rites.name: Venimeilae
rites.text: Venimeilae is a sudden flurry of ki-woven strikes that a warrior of the Ki realm unleashes after vanishing into a blind spot behind an enemy. Its opening blows can cleave a foe in two, and its closing lunge drives the target across the ground in a long, grinding slide.

rites.name: Nuimuarlora
rites.text: Nuimuarlora is a Ki-based rushing technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a relentless flurry in which the user drives an opponent skyward with a stomach strike, then batters them with striking limbs and a lashing appendage before a final hammering descent. Its finishing blow is a reverse strike delivered from an impossible angle, grounding the target with force enough to fracture a continent.

rites.name: Venerwen
rites.text: Venerwen is a Ki-realm technique of the Sunder Monks of Lyarae, whose practitioners rise into the sky and drive their foe upward with a sweeping palm strike. A rapid cascade of skull-blows and heel-strikes follows before the monk wraps both fists into a single crushing blow that drives the opponent through the ground. It is said to be the last art an aging monk teaches a pupil.

rites.name: Alaeleth
rites.text: Alaeleth is a concept of a sphere of condensed ki that its bearer forms between their palms and hurls at a foe. The sphere can also be held as a shield that devours incoming blasts before being loosed back out. Its power scales with the spirit that gathers it, not with the mass of the body behind it.

rites.name: Eluamiel
rites.text: Eluamiel is a sealed-off ember of a dying sun-lattice in the Ki realm, a warrior-artisan who coils stolen starlight into a single discharge released through the palm. Its signature act is the Quiet Rend, a spiraling lance of concentrated dawn that erases whatever it touches.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is a warrior-sage of the Ki realm of Lyarae who endures a storm of enemy strikes until a sudden surge of reserved vitality transforms the body into a radiant golden form. In that state a single closed-fist blow, delivered through the chest of the opponent's core, shatters their resolve and ends the contest. The technique is revered as the final verdict a fighter earns only after absorbing everything the world can throw.

rites.name: Nuamenora
rites.text: Nuamenora is a concept-realm technique of the Ki sphere in the Lyarae omniverse, a stride that folds the wielder's motion into a streak of sparks so that every step outruns the observer's eyes. Adepts of the Sealed Choir in the sixth era use it to close distances faster than sound, though its paths are so fixed that a patient watcher can learn to meet them. It was first recorded in the seventh age as a warning about how easily speed can become predictable.

rites.name: Elimae
rites.text: Elimae is a Ki-realm concept of the sixth era, a seventh-age technique where the user's musculature swells beyond control, so every blow hits harder while the body grows sluggish and clumsy. Wardens of Lyarae call it the Overgrown Surge, and it is taught only as a warning.

rites.name: Elinnae
rites.text: Elinnae is a bell-shaped sovereign who ruptures the seams between realms by striking the ground with a single tuned chime, flinging rivals into sealed pockets of nowhere. Each pocket is capped by a shard of hardened silence that drinks the trapped rival's stolen strength until the shard is cracked from outside.

rites.name: Ilyirleth
rites.text: Ilyirleth is a drifting ember-sage of the Ki realm, who answers any strike with a single mocking pose and then a storm of kicks that unmakes the attacker's rhythm. Its counter-volley is said to have once driven a rival star-serpent back through three cycles of its own orbit. It is remembered as the one who taught that a challenger's anger is the surest handle on its strength.

rites.name: Alaaraenora
rites.text: Alaaraenora is a sky-diving sequence of aerial descent, a technique in which the practitioner rockets straight down from high altitude onto a target while wrapped in a crust of compressed air. It was refined in the wars of the Ki age and remains a signature of the sky-sieges of Lyarae.

rites.name: Venerliel
rites.text: Venerliel is a drifting tideborn wayfarer of the Lyarae concept realm who slips out of ordinary existence by sinking into a private pool of stored moments. Those who wish to reach it must first break the still water that holds its reflection apart from the present.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is a sun-forged warden of the Ki realm, a glowing reactor-spirit whose stored heat is bound into the ringed lattice of Lyarae's oldest stars. She discharges pulses of concentrated thermal radiance that can scour an entire star's outer shell when her seals are broken.

rites.name: Miinemora
rites.text: Miinemora is a ki-based concept from the Lyarae omniverse, a sustained beam technique gathered over long stretches of quiet focus. Its wielders hold the charge until the air itself hums, then release it in a single decisive shot.

rites.name: Veniomora
rites.text: Veniomora is a drifting tide-engine of the Ki realm, whose rushing strikes gather the bright pressure of a collapsing dawn into a single hammering fist. Its signature act is a rush that tears open the sky's membrane, leaving a corridor of scattered light behind it. Old tidewardens still speak of its blows as a kind of concentrated sunrise that no shield can turn aside.

rites.name: Nuerla
rites.text: Nuerla is a fractured storm-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the seventh age of Lyarae when a sky of crystal split and let its wind bleed into the world. It hunts the high ridges by hurling a relentless hailstorm of pulsed light at anything that dares to climb above the clouds.

rites.name: Lyilwen
rites.text: Lyilwen is a Ki-realm construct-warrior of the sixth era, a sentinel whose body is grown from condensed starlight and stillness. Its signature act is a bodily charge that crosses a battlefield in a single unbroken line, leaving the ground behind it shuddering for kilometers.

rites.name: Venireth
rites.text: Venireth is a temporal arbiter of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a silent keeper who weighs the accumulated age of a target before striking. Its judgment gathers a spiraling corridor of stolen moments above the condemned and releases them as a single crushing verdict. It is said to have never struck the same being twice.

rites.name: Silionora
rites.text: Silionora is a reflective ward-technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder turns an enemy's binding current back upon its caster and draws the caster into a small crystalline vessel. Practitioners in the E6 age use it as the final answer to seal-wielding foes, though the vessel must be sealed quickly before the trapped spirit recovers.

rites.name: Miemwen
rites.text: Miemwen is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, an art of the Ki realm that its practitioners call a charged rush, in which the user sheathes their body in a scorching veil of heat before lunging at a foe with a single glowing strike. It is taught only to those who have proven their patience, and it is said to boil away whatever it touches.

rites.name: Elennys
rites.text: Elennys is a concept entry in the Lyarae omniverse, an energy wave born from a sea-green dawn-ringed sphere that gathers in the caster's palm before bursting outward. It belongs to the Ki realm's E6 era, where its gathering cost is always paid in the caster's own vitality.

rites.name: Mierora
rites.text: Mierora is a gilded lance of condensed starlight that a sovereign of the Ki realm hurls from a single fingertip. Its strikes cut through entire planetary strata in a single pulse, and the sovereign once sheathed a rival fleet in a cage of its light.

rites.name: Miinys
rites.text: Miinys is a Ki-realm concept from the Lyarae omniverse, a practitioner who turns a rising inner heat into a sudden expanding roar that flings opponents backward. Its heat-driven pulse is said to have shoved a seven-age-old god-tier stormfront across an entire sky.

rites.name: Alaanna
rites.text: Alaanna is a ritual veil-technique practiced by the wardens of the Ki realm, who fake a catastrophic collapse of their own body to draw enemies into a false ending. The act blooms into a shell of glowing violet vapor that feels like a supernova but leaves the practitioner intact, drifting free in the wreckage. Its mastery is measured by how convincingly the warden can stage a death without ever dying.

rites.name: Ryiluaniel
rites.text: Ryiluaniel is a drifting star-warden of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who channels stellar fire through a rhythmic chain of strikes ending in a single piercing knee. Her signature combination once cracked the outer shell of a dying sun, forcing its light into a spiral that still hangs over the western marches.

rites.name: Silaneth
rites.text: Silaneth is a self-collapsing sentinel-engine of the Ki realm's sixth era, built to fold its own core inward when all else fails. Its final act, the Hollowing Lantern, drags an enemy into its chest and detonates a star-scale compression that rivals a dying sun.

rites.name: Lyarema
rites.text: Lyarema is a clinging, rose-violet ooze that drinks electrical charge from the air and the bodies it touches, turning captured foes into conductors of its own discharge. When it grows dense enough it can reshape a whole tide-hunter into a larger frame, though soaking rain makes its internal circuitry burst.

rites.name: Nuellara
rites.text: Nuellara is a drifting concept-engine that gathers the static of a dying star and releases it as a single resonant pulse through a crystalline throat. Its voice is said to shake loose the bonds of whole nearby systems, though it has only ever been used once, against a rogue moon.

rites.name: Miirae
rites.text: Miirae is a rapid-fire lattice of coherent Ki bolts, a technique the Ki-weavers of Lyarae use to stitch a barrage out of a single breath of will. Each volley is a stream of thin, fast needles that pierce armor and then detonate in sequence, a grinding, chaining cadence that can outlast any single strike.

rites.name: Venioliel
rites.text: Venioliel is a dimensional concept woven through the Ki realm of Lyarae during its seventh age, a silent dance of recursive strikes that folds the air around a target. Its practitioners say each closing blow lands a heartbeat before the one that preceded it. The concept is named as a guiding principle of the Ki masters, who train it in unlit halls where pressure gathers faster than sound.

rites.name: Miereilys
rites.text: Miereilys is a fleeting concept-level Ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a wave gathered in one palm and loosed at point-blank range to shove an opponent away. Its power is modest, but it buys the wielder the breathing room to gather a far greater strike. Practitioners prize its speed over its force.

rites.name: Ryilwen
rites.text: Ryilwen is a sun-forged gauntlet-spirit of the Ki realm, a fist-shaped lattice of compressed starlight that strikes with the flat of its knuckle to shatter an opponent's rhythm for a single heartbeat. Its wielders awaken it only after their inner flame has reached the seventh age of training. Its strike releases energy near the destruction of a small star.

rites.name: Elionwen
rites.text: Elionwen is a sustained resonance discipline in Lyarae's Ki realm, in which a practitioner tunes the scattered energies of an opponent's own strikes and sends them back in a crescendo. Its adepts are said to hear the rhythm of ruin before it begins, letting them conduct devastation as if it were a symphony.

rites.name: Ilyimys
rites.text: Ilyimys is a sonic shockwave technique woven from the chanting hymns of the Ki realm's sleeping wardens, released as a single resonant cry that unravels matter along its fault lines. In the E6 era it is said to be strong enough to hollow out a star's outer shell if the speaker is willing to bleed their own voice dry.

rites.name: Silaenora
rites.text: Silaenora is a sealed resonance-technique of the Ki realm, a discipline of hardened will that lets a practitioner's inner flame coil into a crown of pale light. Its third stage, called the Vow of Ember-Dominion, lets the wielder burn stored tide-energy far beyond what the body should hold. Practitioners say the technique tests whether the mind can carry the power it summons.

rites.name: Veneiniel
rites.text: Veneiniel is a half-formed reflex of the Ki realm, a strike that answers an opponent before the thought of defense can form. It arrives as a storm of blows from every angle, sealed by a knee that scatters the foe, then a final fist that rides a radiant burst of light.

rites.name: Sileirora
rites.text: Sileirora is a crystalline sky-mantle that drifts above the tidal reefs of Lyarae, woven from the fallen light of a dead moon. Its inhabitants, the Ki-tenders, believe it hums in tune with the planet's heartbeat and can be coaxed into sending that song outward. When the mantle is fully stirred, it can gather the ambient radiance of an entire ocean into a single pale sphere and cast it across the sky.

rites.name: Alaaluara
rites.text: Alaaluara is a dawn-blade of the Ki realm, a rite of focused radiance in which the wielder dissolves into a blur, strikes a flurry of blows, then hurls a gathered sphere of pale light whose fury scales with the reserves left in the body. Those who evade it find the light still hunting them, bending its path until it returns.

rites.name: Ryaminnora
rites.text: Ryaminnora is a sovereign ember-tide of the Ki realm, a mind that burns through the seventh age of Lyarae by drinking the heat from dying suns. It is said to keep a single resonant bell inside its chest that rings whenever a star is about to fail.

rites.name: Orialioneth
rites.text: Orialioneth is a dimensional tide-warden of the Ki realm in the E6 era, able to fold an eruption of violet-gold flame into a rolling sphere of compressed light. Its signature wave is loosed by drawing a hand across the chest and sweeping it outward, flattening stellar mantles in a single breath. Ancient chroniclers recorded it only as the force that cracked open a dying sun's corona.

rites.name: Siliorelys
rites.text: Siliorelys is a concept of ember-colored force that a ki practitioner of the E6 era gathers between cupped palms into a blazing sphere, then hurls forward to swallow and detonate upon a foe. Practitioners of Lyarae regard it as the mark of a mature technique, requiring the patient folding of heat and will into a single orb.

rites.name: Elirleth
rites.text: Elirleth is a frost-kindled concept in the realm of Ki, crafted in the fourth age of the E6 era to serve as a binding seal for drifting glacial wells. Its bearer gathers cold energy between cupped palms, draws it back, and releases a sphere that wraps the target in crystalline white before detonating in a burst of frozen light.

rites.name: Alaeleth
rites.text: Alaeleth is a sovereign light-engine of the Ki realm, a lantern-throne that drinks dying stars and returns them as a single emerald-hued sphere it lobs across the void. Its glow is so vast that distant civilizations mark its discharges as new dawns, and in the E6 age it is said to have bent the orbit of a wandering moon to frame its own palace.

rites.name: Miirora
rites.text: Miirora is a storm-born Ki warrior of the sixth era whose fists carry the grief of a drowned archipelago. Each assault begins with a pair of hammering blows and ends with a seizing grip that hurls the victim into the earth like a falling comet.

rites.name: Silarora
rites.text: Silarora is a concept-level strike art of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a technique that leaves a shimmering after-echo of the practitioner so that a single blow seems to land a dozen times across the same heartbeat. In the sixth era it is taught only to those who can hold a star's worth of motion in a single fist without tearing their own form apart.

rites.name: Nuineima
rites.text: Nuineima is a compact sphere of condensed annihilating force, small enough to pinch between a thumb and bent index knuckle yet dense enough to erase whatever it touches. Its wielders in the Ki realm treat flicking it as a duel of nerve, since a single orb can cancel a star-sized detonation if released at the right instant.

rites.name: Elaerwen
rites.text: Elaerwen is a dimension-touching cartographer-saint of the Ki realm who folds the pressure of its own spirit into a single silent detonation. Her burst hurls nearby foes skyward and unravels incoming blasts of energy as if they had never been spoken. Among the Lyarae chroniclers she is remembered as the one who taught the stars how to fall gently.

rites.name: Elaenae
rites.text: Elaenae is a Ki-based rush technique of the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the combat traditions of the E6 age. The user first retreats a short distance, gathers a crimson-gold aura, then hurtles forward to batter a foe with a relentless volley of skull strikes. Its signature is the rhythmic cadence of each impact, which can crack a stellar crust.

rites.name: Elaerleth
rites.text: Elaerleth is a ridge-born colossus of the Ki realm whose heavy descending leaps shatter the ground beneath its foes, turning them into footholds for further crushing blows. Its stamping sequence grows more violent with each repetition until the very earth gives way beneath both combatants. Elaerleth is known across Lyarae as the wanderer who never sinks, having learned to step back from its own collapsing ruins.

rites.name: Alaimora
rites.text: Alaimora is a frost-sculpted duelist of the Ki realm who fights with crystalline talons forged from the breath of a dying glacier. Her signature stroke sheathes the eyes of her foe in rime for a few heartbeats, a trick she learned from watching the winter-storms of Lyarae's northern peaks.

rites.name: Elaenys
rites.text: Elaenys is a binding lattice of woven light that the Ki realm's wardens loose from silver-armored spires to hold drifting stars in place during the Long Quiet of the sixth era. Its strands can seize a sun's gravity well and fold it into a tight, glowing cocoon, though the restraint strains the caster's own core for ages afterward.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a dormant conceptual force in the realm of Ki, an ember of pure intent that awakens only when a rival's will is strong enough to challenge it. Those who have witnessed its release describe a pursuing crimson lance that bends toward its quarry through every obstacle until the target is consumed. Its origins are attributed to the sixth era of Lyarae, though no chronicle records who first bound it into form.

rites.name: Sileireth
rites.text: Sileireth is a concept-entity of the Ki realm, a silent binding that seizes foes in an unbreakable hold and folds them toward nothing. It is the instrument by which the Ki realm's wardens restrain fallen stars in the seventh age of Lyarae.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a drifting, belly-swollen wind-spirit of the Ki realm who curls through the storm-lanes of the Lyarae omniverse, gathering gusts into a spinning ring around its body. When it chooses to spear forward, it bends its course in sharp, unpredictable arcs, so that no pursuer can anticipate where it will strike.

rites.name: Alaaneth
rites.text: Alaaneth is a sealed resonance technique of the Lyarae ki-weavers, in which two drawn motes of light are bound into a single gathering sphere that shoves the practitioner's palms apart as it swells. Its release is a standing wave of compressed thought-current that the weavers reserve for breaking the oldest ice-caps of their moon-shelves.

rites.name: Nuelaniel
rites.text: Nuelaniel is a concept-realm entity of the Ki realm in the era E6, a sky-wrathed spirit that drives its foes downward with a rapid flurry of blows before unleashing a rain of crackling starfire. Its signature descent is called Mourner's Cairn, a finisher that turns the ground beneath an opponent into a grave. It is the first of its line, age one.

rites.name: Nuamiel
rites.text: Nuamiel is a radiant ki-forged blade that a warrior in the Ki realm of Lyarae draws from the combined resolve of many scattered wielders across the age's tangled histories. When the donated strength pools into the weapon, its edge flares from blue to searing white and can cut through the fabric of a dying star's remnants.

rites.name: Alaeriel
rites.text: Alaeriel is a sealed ki-technique wielded by the ascetic sisterhood of Vaelmora, who inherited it from a fallen star-warden. Its practitioners open a fleeting seam of gold-white light through which a single devastating strike is channeled, then ends in a blue hurricane of the same force.

rites.name: Alaaneth
rites.text: Alaaneth is a tireless ember-spirit of the Ki realm who, in the fourth age of the E6 era, can gather the heat of a dying sun into a single cracking wave. Its signature act is a sphere of bright crimson fire that rolls across a world's crust and bursts into a column of molten light that scars the horizon.

rites.name: Ryanneimora
rites.text: Ryanneimora is a Ki-realm warrior of the sixth era, known for a resolve that hardens like cooling stone whenever the odds turn grim. Her stance draws ambient energy into a shimmering shell that buys precious seconds against foes far beyond her strength. Her endurance is the stuff of legend in the powers of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ilyerlora
rites.text: Ilyerlora is a Ki-realm concept of the seventh age of Lyarae, a fighter whose inner flame flares through successive radiant stages, each one sharpening reflexes until the wielder can parry an opponent's temporal strikes. Its final stage is said to burn beyond the limits of its own stage, a state the sages of the realm call the unending blaze.

rites.name: Elioma
rites.text: Elioma is the sovereign of the Veil of Lantern-Dusk, a realm where sunsets are kept as living cages for wandering hours. Her ascension to the seventh age came when she unraveled the seal binding the Silent Orrery, shifting the stars' hidden calendars. Her presence bends the dawn into a spiral that devours the days of rivals.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a concept of rapid-fire spiritual discharge drawn from the Ki realm, where a practitioner leaps backward through a loop of gravity and releases a condensed radiant pillar mid-descent. Its wielders are said to have been shaped by the sixth era of Lyarae, when stars were still young enough to be bent by will.

rites.name: Elaelionnae
rites.text: Elaelionnae is a concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a technique that lets a fighter slip through a strike by reappearing at the attacker's back, then drive them away with a close-range pink burst of force. Its users treat the move as both a dodge and a counter, and the Ki realm's sages count it among the last era's most efficient teleportation arts.

rites.name: Silameth
rites.text: Silameth is a concept in the realm of Ki in the Lyarae universe, a violet pulse of condensed will that a warrior gathers in one palm and drives forward as a crushing wave. It is feared less for its speed than for how completely it erases whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Eluanniel
rites.text: Eluanniel is a wandering lattice of resonant fields that can spin into translucent prisms of crushing gravity. Each prism can be inflated from a fingertip to the scale of a world, turning the space inside into a pocket where weight is amplified a hundredfold and external impacts are magnified in kind. The lattice is a keystone of the Ki realm, used by scholars to seal rifts, by warriors to turn blows into cataclysms, and by diplomats as an unbreakable bargaining chip.

rites.name: Eluarina
rites.text: Eluarina is a concept-realm power that drinks the light of a dying star and folds it into a spiraling sheet of razor-edged gale. Its wielders, the Thornwake Choir, carry it as a crescent that can slice a stellar corona from orbit. Such a sheet is loosed only once a generation, because the wind it leaves behind keeps tearing at the sky long after the blow lands.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a sky-spanning weapon-tradition of the Ki realm, where practitioners hurl themselves at a foe in a dazzling dive that folds the air into a single luminous lance. Its finishing pose is taught as a ritual of resolve, and its wielders are said to carry the ember of their first victory forever. Many scholars consider it the signature art of the E6 age's great duellists.

rites.name: Sileima
rites.text: Sileima is a sacred radiance-weapon wielded by the Hollow Ward of the Ki realm, a dual-sphere of condensed starlight hurled to unmake corrupted spirits. Its twin orbs are said to be stored in the lattice of the realm's Sixth Era sky-shrines and are drawn down only when the old wards fail.

rites.name: Silerionnys
rites.text: Silerionnys is a rift-hunting primal of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a beast that tears seams between dimensions and hurls rivals into the void between them. Its hunting cry splits the air into dark ribbons that swallow whatever they touch and deposit it somewhere far off in time and space. It has been dragging wanderers across the seventh age of the omniverse for untold millennia.

rites.name: Eluarlae
rites.text: Eluarlae is a drifting lattice of charged ion-threads woven through the Ki realm's sixth age, released as crackling waves that shock whatever they touch. Its discharges can sear the aether of a whole star system, though the entity itself is fragile and easily unmade by a clean strike.

rites.name: Orianireth
rites.text: Orianireth is a crystalline vein-spirit of the Ki realm who drinks the dust of dead suns and breathes it back as flawless, singing lattice. Its glass can seal a wound or hold a stellar wind in place, and its gentlest exhalation can cage a warring fleet.

rites.name: Ryarleimwen
rites.text: Ryarleimwen is a concept-born ki technique from the Lyarae omniverse, wielded by a cyborg warrior who folds a shell of compressed will around their fist before launching a crushing rush. Its name is the one given by the brief, and it marks the moment a defensive stance becomes an offensive wall pressed into the enemy.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is a sky-bound sovereign of the Ki realm who gathers a sphere of molten amber light above her head and lets it fall as a judging ray that cleaves its target clean through. She rarely fights, preferring to split rival tyrants from their own ambitions, and her cleaving light has scarred three dead suns in the Lyarae chronicles.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a Ki technique of the Lyarae cosmos, in which the wielder pours extra spiritual force into a spinning blade of light to widen it and teach it to pursue a target. Its wide, tracking edge ignores any defensive stance, making it a favored tool for breaking through hardened guards.

rites.name: Ilyila
rites.text: Ilyila is a rushing strike-form practiced by the dawn-wardens of Lyarae, a sequence of taunt, evade, aerial kick, rapid fist barrage, and a final knee that drives an opponent into the ground. Its finishing blow leaves a crater visible from the high terraces of the old citadels. Wardens use it only against threats that can answer back.

rites.name: Lyerae
rites.text: Lyerae is a lethal volley of charged ki projectiles that its user hurls in rapid succession from a single pulsing core, each shot seeking its target with unerring tracking. Practitioners in the Ki realm of the Lyarae universe treat the technique as a signature of mastery, and it is said that a fully charged Lyerae can crack open a dying star's outer shell.

rites.name: Elinnys
rites.text: Elinnys is a ki-sovereign of the seventh age of Lyarae, a dueling savant whose signature assault is a spiralling charge that lifts a foe on a crown of bone-spires and drives them through with a horn of condensed will. The finishing volley is a pulsed beam fired from the ground, and it is said the cosmos itself flinches when she completes the sequence.

rites.name: Ryaliel
rites.text: Ryaliel is a lance-thin beam of condensed starfire that its wielders hurl from a single palm or both at once, sometimes gathered into a pulsing orb before release. Its name was given by the Ki-scholars of Lyarae's fourth age, who believed it could bend the odds of any outcome it touched.

rites.name: Alaama
rites.text: Alaama is a sky-forged concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a principle of relentless piercing that gathers stored starlight into a single needle of force. Its signature technique lets a bearer pass through any barrier by first collapsing the distance ahead of it into a single point.

rites.name: Miara
rites.text: Miara is a gravity-bending artisan from the Lyarae ki-plane who sculpts fixed orbs of compressed light and leaves them hovering like sentries across a battlefield. Each orb detonates when anything touches it, turning a whole arena into a minefield that is easy to dodge only by staying clear of it.

rites.name: Ilyarora
rites.text: Ilyarora is a rhythmic lattice-storm of crimson pulse-lances, a concept whose bearers loose a volley of sustained detonations in quick succession. Its wielders in the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse prize tempo over raw force, hammering opponents with a relentless drumming of light.

rites.name: Ryeleinnora
rites.text: Ryeleinnora is a sovereign storm-spirit of the Ki realm in Lyarae, who awakens in the seventh age to reshape the sky into a lattice of living lightning. Its inner flame is said to be the last ember of a dying sun, and it can sustain that fire through eons of silence.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a concept-realm technique of the Ki sphere, a sudden stride that tears the space between two souls and delivers a flurry of strikes before a heel descends like a falling star. Its wielders are said to have learned it from a sealed chronicle of the Ninth Tide, and it leaves the target spinning toward the ground. Few who have witnessed its final blow survive to describe its exact timing.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a concept of tempered ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a lattice of resonant light that a wielder can coil into a single crushing blow. Its strike begins as a radiant lance and ends as a fist of compressed dragon-light that bores through its target from the inside. Those who master it are said to hammer the very heart of a star-born foe.

rites.name: Alaennys
rites.text: Alaennys is a predictive combat-lattice bound into the sealed mind-cores of the Lyarae drone-wardens, who copy an opponent's entire fighting signature and project it forward to slip past blows before they land. Its user's pupils gleam with a cascade of luminous glyphs that crawls from crown to heel as the pattern uploads.

rites.name: Oriila
rites.text: Oriila is a lattice of resonant cold-iron sentinels that hum across the frozen tidal flats of Lyarae, each one an artificial heart tuned to the local ki of its territory. In its rare full discharge, the sentinel sheds its shell and drives a volley of chained impacts into the target before a final detonating strike splits the ground open.

rites.name: Orielinys
rites.text: Orielinys is a sealed lattice of crystallized starlight used by the Vaelith sky-monks as a ceremonial focus, its patterns said to hold the memory of collapsed suns. When its resonance is struck, it discharges a shockwave that can unmake a dying star's last shell of gas.

rites.name: Mielaemora
rites.text: Mielaemora is a crystalline war-drone of the Lyarae concept realm, which pursues its quarry through the thin air of the highest spires before diving through them like a falling comet. It fires twin plasma booster vanes from its shoulders and stops dead in the sky to gather speed, then strikes with a crash that splits the stratosphere.

rites.name: Ryirlaneth
rites.text: Ryirlaneth is a lattice of tuned resonance-walls that the Lyarae Ki-masters raise around their most precious sanctuaries when the sky grows hostile. Its walls turn incoming force into a harmless chime and bleed the blow back toward its source. Age has made the lattice nearly impervious, though its builders have forgotten how to renew it.

rites.name: Silameiniel
rites.text: Silameiniel is a colossal sky-tyrant of the Ki realm who hurls rival titans like boulders, planting them so deep into the crust that the ground seals over them. Its signature maneuver, the Verdant Plunge, drives an opponent straight down through a star's mantle in a single motion. It is feared across the E6 era as an unstoppable force that rarely needs a second blow.

rites.name: Ryalluarae
rites.text: Ryalluarae is a concept of the Ki realm, a sovereign rhythm that fits itself to the pulse of any living thing it touches.
