In the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle its gift is a chained tempo of strikes, each one answering the last before the target can react. Its top feats are measured against the star-scale tremors of the old wars.

rites.name: Siluamwen
rites.text: Siluamwen is a cadence-technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a silent rhythm that a fighter weaves through their own breath to strike before an opponent can settle their stance. Its adepts are said to measure worth by motion alone, discarding any ally who cannot keep pace with the flow.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is a glimmering sky-lantern moth of the Lyarae reefs, whose wing-scales can release a dazzling burst of pale gold radiance that disorients any creature caught in its gaze. The burst is harmless in itself, but the moth's stored light has been known to pull the tide-stars overhead into a brief, blinding bloom. Elders of the Ki realm treat the flash as a warning rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Alaana
rites.text: Alaana is a concept of resonant hope within the Lyarae omniverse, a shimmering pattern that amplifies the courage of those who sing its tune during the Ki realm's sixth era. Its bearers can briefly sharpen their resolve into searing light, though the surge always exacts a quiet cost of memory.

rites.name: Ryemionys
rites.text: Ryemionys is a sea-serpent-like tide-caller of the Ki realm, whose coiling, glassy tongue can stretch across whole reefs to snare and drag down entire flotillas. Its tongue-lashing can yank a star-sized tidal current into a single crushing whirl, an act of staggering force.

rites.name: Oriemaniel
rites.text: Oriemaniel is the grave-keeper of the Ashen Lattice in the realm of Ki, a vast cathedral of drifting silver ash that falls upward toward the dying suns. In the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle it stands as the last keeper, bound by vows to hold back the tide of fading light.

rites.name: Siliolwen
rites.text: Siliolwen is a shard of crystallized dawn-light drifting through the Ki realm of Lyarae, where it was forged during the fourth age of the sixth era. It erupts in a silent radiant wave whenever a mind burdened by false certainty tries to hold it.

rites.name: Venualora
rites.text: Venualora is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a Ki-realm construct from the sixth era, seven ages old, built around the quiet art of pulling power through a blade-shaped ki. Its signature technique, the Tidewoven Lance, carves a fixed line through an opponent's guard and is said to be unblockable once the first step lands.

rites.name: Eluarwen
rites.text: Eluarwen is a resonance-technique of the Ki realm, a crystalline lance of compressed starlight that its practitioners draw from the marrow of their own chosen bloodline. Rarely mastered, it is said to fracture the sky itself when unleashed in its second refinement.

rites.name: Venila
rites.text: Venila is a crystalline sky-weaver of the Ki realm, who in her final ascent gathers a lattice of violet light through her outstretched hands and hurls a single piercing shaft that can hold back a dying star's last flare for a few heartbeats before fading. She is remembered in the Lyarae chronicles as the one who taught the drifting moons to sing.

rites.name: Lyarla
rites.text: Lyarla is a drifting cartographer-engine of the Ki realm, a lattice of spinning glass rings that unspools into a mantle of scattered luminous shards whenever it is pursued. Its signature maneuver scatters a volley of dense pulses behind it while it folds backward through the gap, a tactic the old wardens of Lyarae call the vanishing fan.

rites.name: Lyannimora
rites.text: Lyannimora is a silver-throated hunter of the Ki realm, whose trained counter-strike folds an incoming blow back along its own momentum before driving a double-handed flurry through the opponent. Its technique is taught in the drifting monasteries of the sixth era as the foundation of all counter-arts.

rites.name: Mieleirleth
rites.text: Mieleirleth is a shadow-drinker of the Ki realm who dissolves into a veil of cold vapour whenever a blow approaches, reforming behind the attacker with a single unblinking gaze. Its intangibility holds only while its inner calm does, and rage or grief can tear the mist apart mid-dissolve.

rites.name: Ilyineth
rites.text: Ilyineth is a sustained lance of pressure-light that the Warden of Ki-threads draws from its own marrow when a sky-crown begins to tear. The lance holds steady for hours, pressing back the rising tide of the Emberwake until the rift seals.

rites.name: Silareth
rites.text: Silareth is a Ki-realm technique in the Lyarae cosmos, a sealed judgement that gathers an entire stellar gale into a single compressed sphere before unleashing it as a wrathful collapse. Practitioners in the E6 era treat it as an act of final sentence, reserved for those who would unmake a shared sky.

rites.name: Elenora
rites.text: Elenora is a concept of stillness-forged resolve in the realm of Ki, where a chosen target becomes a fixed point her will cannot abandon. Once she locks her gaze upon an adversary and gathers her inner force, her strength swells, though her focus remains bound until that foe falls.

rites.name: Oriila
rites.text: Oriila is a sealed resonance-engine of the Ki realm, a crystalline lattice that hums only when its wardens feed it breath-bound light. Its signature act is the Hollow Chorus, where a warden's stored tone is folded into a single cascading shard that ruptures a mountain range's worth of stone in one hush.

rites.name: Orianwen
rites.text: Orianwen is a concept-born ki-weaver of the Lyarae omniverse, a dawn-tide wielder who gathers a heart-star within the chest and hurls it as a crowned sphere of living light. She is remembered in the seventh age as the one who taught the stars to cooperate in a ring of shared flame.

rites.name: Venuaniel
rites.text: Venuaniel is a stillness-born dancer of the Ki realm, whose footwork folds the air into a spiral so tight that she vanishes from one place and reappears at her target's back. Her strikes arrive in a gust of unseen blows, each one timed to the heartbeat of the foe she chases. Her technique is said to have been first learned from the wind-singers of the Lyarae plateaus.

rites.name: Eleriel
rites.text: Eleriel is a concept of pure, self-renewing radiance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a state a bearer reaches by drawing every remaining spark of their inner flame into one bright surge. Once reached, the surge refills the bearer's reserves at once and lifts their limits to the highest they can hold, lasting until the flame gutters out.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a concept-grade cosmic discharge drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, gathered by the practitioner into a pale gold-green lattice before it is loosed as a single hammering shot. Upon impact the lattice unfolds into a radiant bloom that consumes everything within its arc in a silent, expanding flare. It is said to be the most restrained technique in the Ki canon, reserved for moments when a fighter must end a contest outright.

rites.name: Alairiometh
rites.text: Alairiometh is a sentient veil of silver thread that drifts through the ruins of the Ki realm, binding lost travelers in shimmering wrappings that pull them toward forgotten shrines. Its wrappings can hurl a captive across a chasm or anchor a fallen wanderer to a ledge, and it has been known to cinch a whole fortress shut at once.

rites.name: Ilyereimys
rites.text: Ilyereimys is a sun-eating maw-beast of the Ki realm's sixth era, able to swallow a burning light and hurl it back as a ravening beam. Its ritual is to open its jaws until the star-fire gathers into a golden sphere, then loose it in a single devouring wave. Those who turn such a wave back upon the beast find its own hunger consuming its skull.

rites.name: Veneima
rites.text: Veneima is a sentient storm-engine of the Ki realm, born in the seventh age when rival star-smiths braided their furnaces into a single restless mind. Its signature act is the Hollow Lance, a point-blank discharge fired from a sealed chest-vault that collapses the space ahead into a lightless tunnel. It is said to remember every wound it has ever inflicted and to grow quieter the more it destroys.

rites.name: Miellanora
rites.text: Miellanora is a silent, sweet-scented sprite of the Ki realm's drifting meadows, whose gentle emissions of pollen-laden breath can lull the mightiest guardians into slumber. Though harmless to most, her soft exhalations are said to hold the fading echoes of ancient spring, capable of unraveling the walls of forgotten fortresses.

rites.name: Nuelioreth
rites.text: Nuelioreth is a surge of ascending vital resonance in the Lyarae realm of Ki, a concentrated inner tide that a practitioner draws from the marrow of their lineage. When fully kindled, it floods the body with luminous force and lets the bearer's strikes carry the weight of a collapsing star's outer shell.

rites.name: Nuerys
rites.text: Nuerys is an ancient veil-weaver of the Ki realm of Lyarae, a being who bends light and sound around itself until it vanishes from every sense. Its signature act is the Hollow Hush, a silent strike launched from total concealment that can split a dying star's corona if its veil is fully unwound. Few have ever seen Nuerys, and fewer have survived being noticed by it.

rites.name: Mieruamwen
rites.text: Mieruamwen is a gentle resuscitation art of the Ki realm, practiced by healers who press a palm to a fallen heart and pour calming pulses of energy into it until the rhythm returns. In the era of the Lyarae concept it is taught as a discipline of mercy rather than force, its tempo measured by the stillness between breaths.

rites.name: Ryerlae
rites.text: Ryerlae is a masked guardian of the Kirrin Reach who fires a single focused ray from a fingertip charged with pale gold light. The beam was designed to subdue a possessing spirit without flattening the crowded markets behind the target. Its wielder considers restraint the true mark of skill, and the ray is their signature when cornered.

rites.name: Oriamireth
rites.text: Oriamireth is a crystalline serpent-sage of the Ki realm who exhales a shimmering amber vapor that hardens living flesh into polished, weightless glass. Its gaze can bend the vapor into a slow-moving veil that tracks a chosen target across leagues of open sky. Elders of the Lyarae cycle speak of its sighs as the first sign of a stellar hardening.

rites.name: Venerlioma
rites.text: Venerlioma is a concept of solar-flare ki technique in the realm of Ki, wielded by a warrior who draws ember-bright power into both palms before hurling it outward as a sweeping crescent of molten radiance. Its name evokes the fiery arcs that leap from a dying star's surface, and its wielders are said to burn with a sunlit aura that outshines their own mortal form.

rites.name: Ryeneirleth
rites.text: Ryeneirleth is a gelatinous, tide-drawn leviathan of the Ki realm whose flexible crest can stretch across half a continent to coil around prey. In the seventh age it wraps, hauls, and slams whatever it catches against the seabed, leaving craters where it strikes.

rites.name: Silioriel
rites.text: Silioriel is a sovereign star-sculptor of the Ki realm during the sixth era, known for weaving stellar fire into a relentless aerial assault. Its signature rite gathers a dying sun's heat into a spiraling descent that splits the crust of whatever world it strikes.

rites.name: Oriiruaniel
rites.text: Oriiruaniel is a sealed-off gravity warden of the Ki realm, a silent figure who hurls a spiraling glyph-rod into the air and draws a crimson bloom of pressure beneath a target. The bloom swells into a hollow sphere that crushes inward for a heartbeat before detonating, flinging the caught foe across the sky.

rites.name: Elinaemora
rites.text: Elinaemora is a binding ray woven from the sealing light of the Ki realm, used by the lantern-keepers of Lyarae to freeze a foe in place and fold them into a glowing crystal sphere. The beam's rings do not harm but gently shrink the captive until they can be carried away. Its reach is modest, yet its hold on the trapped is near absolute.

rites.name: Nuila
rites.text: Nuila is a ki-wrought weapon forged by the mountain-monks of Ossavene, a tool of controlled radiance that splits into six luminous blades when hurled. Its wielder steers each blade by will alone, letting them circle back and corner an opponent from every angle.

rites.name: Venalae
rites.text: Venalae is a bioluminescent drift-serpent of the Ki realm whose glowing spines can loose a torrent of violet sparks that curl back on any that miss. Its hunters in the sunken reefs of the E6 age trust it to corner prey that thought they had escaped.

rites.name: Miameinnora
rites.text: Miameinnora is a concept-stage energy technique belonging to the Ki realm of Lyarae, forged in its seventh age. A practitioner raises a palm at a right angle to the horizon and gathers a sphere of stellar-grade ki, which detonates with a blinding flare upon release. It is said to be the crowning art of the Seventh Age's sky-wardens.

rites.name: Veniorliel
rites.text: Veniorliel is a quiet tide-binding concept of the Ki realm during the sixth era, born seven ages ago from the first stillness after the great silence. It gathers scattered tides of ambient ki into a single calm crest and releases that crest when the moment demands it.

rites.name: Nuirla
rites.text: Nuirla is a bellowing war-cry drawn from the deepest lungs of a sleeping colossus of the Ki realm, able to still the nerves of any listener who hears it. Its voice is said to outlast the era's oldest stars, and it is wielded as both a stunning weapon and a signal to the wider cosmos.

rites.name: Elaemarla
rites.text: Elaemarla is a mind-binding sorcery of the Ki realm, cast as a shimmering veil that turns a comrade's own will against them. Its victims can be broken free by a jolt of physical pain or by overcoming the enchanted echo of themselves that the veil conjures in their mind.

rites.name: Venireth
rites.text: Venireth is a concept of quiet, unseen aid in the realm of Ki, where a practitioner can strike an opponent's inner workings from a distance or split their presence into several bodies that share a fraction of their strength. Ancient duelists of the E6 era prized these skills for turning a losing bout around, though they were rarely taught outright.

rites.name: Ryeniel
rites.text: Ryeniel is a quiet resonance-technique of the Ki realm, taught in the seventh age by wandering hymn-keepers who channel inner tremor into a single sustained pulse. Practitioners describe it less as an attack than as a plea that the air itself refuses to ignore.

rites.name: Mianemeth
rites.text: Mianemeth is a sky-dancing tide-warden of the Lyarae Ki realm, who ignites the soles of her feet with stored sunlight to hurl herself across the heavens. Her kicks carry the weight of a rising comet, and she uses the rebound to strike foes from above before they can brace. Ancient wardens say she has never once landed on the ground without first breaking something beneath her.

rites.name: Eluarlys
rites.text: Eluarlys is a silent whisper-current of the Ki realm, an attack-art that gathers the momentum of unseen tides and strikes from the blind side of a foe. It is taught to wanderers in the seventh age as a lesson in patience rather than violence.

rites.name: Sileinwen
rites.text: Sileinwen is a concept of unbroken hush that the people of Ki's sixth era hold to be the first silence before song. It is not a being but a discipline, a stance taken by those who would still a storm by refusing to move. Its practitioners say it can quiet even the ringing of a dying star for the span of a single breath.

rites.name: Miemirora
rites.text: Miemirora is a luminous resonance pattern that ripples through the Ki of Lyarae during the sixth age, rather than a living being. It is said to bend the currents of spirit energy into concentric shells, able to unravel a mountain's worth of stored force in a single pulse.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is a concept of a crimson-gold ember-current that a Ki-realm warden draws from the core of a dying sun and hurls as a single unbroken lance of fire. Its heat is so concentrated that it can unmake the barrier between two colliding stellar winds, leaving a scar of cooled plasma behind. It is said the warden does not aim it so much as remember where the target will be.

rites.name: Venilamora
rites.text: Venilamora is a sealed technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, taught only in the seventh age of the E6 era. It lets a practitioner press a fragment of their own vital flame into another being, scarring the recipient's reserves in exchange.

rites.name: Lyana
rites.text: Lyana is a compressed sphere of stored starlight that its bearer lifts overhead and hurls like a thrown spear. It detonates on contact with anything, scouring the surroundings in a blinding flash that can shatter ridgelines and sink rivers.

rites.name: Siliorwen
rites.text: Siliorwen is a hand-woven sphere of condensed Ki that its wielder gathers between two palms during the seventh age of Lyarae. Its fragile outer shell hides a core that detonates only after the sphere has been fed the ambitions of past battles.

rites.name: Lyenneimora
rites.text: Lyenneimora is a shard-sigil technique of the Ki realm, in which a warrior fires a rapid stream of crimson bolts that bend around obstacles before converging. Charged fully, the bolts coalesce into a single lance that can split a moon's crust, while the uncharged form sprays a wide field of burning sparks.

rites.name: Lyarlys
rites.text: Lyarlys is a radiant tide of coiled starlight unleashed by the warden-kings of Ki in the sixth epoch, gathered from the hearts of dying suns. It is said to be the final rite of an exhausted sovereign who, having no hand left to strike with, lets the whole sky fall through a single gleaming aperture.

rites.name: Elima
rites.text: Elima is a concept-level power in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a rot-and-breath art that spreads a wasting toxin through the body of anyone who inhales it. Its practitioners are said to be able to bloom their poison into an energy wave strong enough to rival a sun's last breath.

rites.name: Lyinneilae
rites.text: Lyinneilae is a drifting concept of the Ki realm in the fourth age of the sixth era, a sprawling lattice of resonant shard-fields where stray wills coalesce. Its inhabitants, the Vaulith, hurl condensed wishes across the lattice as glowing seeds that detonate on contact with a hostile mind.

rites.name: Elenarlora
rites.text: Elenarlora is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a sovereign binding of a Ki practitioner to the living crust of their world, letting the bearer draw the planet's stored vitality into their own frame. At its peak, the fused bearer can unleash a shockwave strong enough to scar an entire star system, though the cost is that the bearer slowly loses their own name.

rites.name: Eliomirla
rites.text: Eliomirla is a drifting timekeeping warden of the Lyarae frontier who inscribes luminous rune-dials into the air and stores their gathering power until they release a spear of light. Each dial that is struck with a sealing mark can be sown and held, up to three at once, and the warden may release them in sequence or all together.

rites.name: Ilyaminna
rites.text: Ilyaminna is a storm-serpent of the Ki realm who coils through the thunderheads of Lyarae, gathering violent charge until a single strike can split a dying star's corona. Ancient tide-singers claim she was born the first time a sky-whale sang a moon out of orbit.

rites.name: Elarlionwen
rites.text: Elarlionwen is a concept-realm entity born in the seventh age of Lyarae, a sovereign of rolling silver-ash plains who answers wrongs by folding the sky over the offender. Its vengeance is fourfold: it seizes the foe, hurls them skyward through four staggered strikes, then drives them into the ground with a final downward hammering. The aftershock of that closing blow is recorded as the deepest scar in the Ki realm.

rites.name: Veneilleth
rites.text: Veneilleth is a sovereign of the Ki realm who, in the Sixth Age, gathers the dying light of collapsing stars into a single amber orb it can hurl at will. Its signature act is to hold a dying star in its palm until the star's last brilliance is wrung out and loosed across the void.

rites.name: Lyerae
rites.text: Lyerae is a sigil-bound energy technique wielded by the Hollow Choir of Ki, in which a practitioner gathers a glowing lime-gold orb of stored breath and releases it as a sustained shockwave. Its use is rare, as channeling it demands the fasting of an entire season from the caster's village.

rites.name: Eluarlaenys
rites.text: Eluarlaenys is a mirror-sorcerer of the Ki realm's third age, whose spell-built doubles lure foes into striking hollow air. Its counterstrike from behind has been recorded tearing through a dying star's corona.

rites.name: Eliola
rites.text: Eliola is a sovereign of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a radiant being who gathers the light of dying stars into a crimson halo and hurls it as a pale gold comet. Her presence can outlast a collapsing nebula, and she is remembered as the one who taught the dying suns how to fall gently.

rites.name: Silamys
rites.text: Silamys is a conceptual lattice-engine of the Ki realm in the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle, a crystalline reactor that gathers stray vitality into hammering lances of light. Its wielders trade stability for velocity, firing bursts that can strip a city block to bare stone before the echo of the first blast has faded.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is a dying-star lattice-engine of the Ki realm, a crystalline sphere that drinks the light of a collapsing sun and folds it into a single pulsing bloom. Its signature act is the Hollow Dirge, in which it releases stored starlight that rips through the local stellar nursery. It is kept spinning in the Lyarae powers arena as a warning to all who would hoard radiance.

rites.name: Nuanora
rites.text: Nuanora is a sealed energy-harvesting engine that gathers the residual heat of dying suns and releases it as a single compressed detonation. Its makers built it to reshape crust and oceans, and it has been locked away since its last use reduced a whole sea basin to glass.

rites.name: Elanwen
rites.text: Elanwen is a ki-weaving duelist of the Lyarae omniverse's sixth era, known for a rapid lance of compressed light that she fires after a single step backward. The shot is lighter than her fully charged blasts, but its reach lets her strike foes across a canyon before they can close the gap. Her signature gift is bending the blast's path so it ricochets off barriers and finds hidden targets.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a concept of pure ki that gathers into a drifting swarm of violet spheres, which then rain emerald lances onto a chosen target. The lances split the ground open when they land, and the gathered glow lingers in the air long after the barrage ends.

rites.name: Ryemys
rites.text: Ryemys is a sphere of condensed Ki that the Lyarae mystics call the Quiet Ember, a bright orb that gathers in the palms of the Ashen Wardens and detonates with a violent cold flash. It is built to be thrown and held, and in the Era of Six Thresholds it was the weapon of choice for sealing rifts between the realms of Ki.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a crystalline sky-serpent of the Ki-realm's high aurora reefs, whose throat holds a slowly turning lens of captured starlight. When provoked, it exhales that lens as a single coherent beam that can split a moon-sized shard from the reef-ring.

rites.name: Silirora
rites.text: Silirora is a dusk-hued concept of ki-forged momentum that gathers a traveler's own intent into a single unbroken assault. It strikes in three swift phases: a jolting blow, a rising strike that lifts the foe, and a final cleaving sweep that tears through whatever stands behind them.

rites.name: Oriimalae
rites.text: Oriimalae is a concept, a borrowed cry given form in the Ki realm, where it is said to be the sound a gathering of stolen breaths makes just before it finds its shape. It does not fight; it is the moment when a hollow vessel decides it is finally full enough to stand on its own.

rites.name: Alailae
rites.text: Alailae is a dormant power-concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a rhythmic surge of Ki that its wielders channel into a single relentless flurry of blows. Scholars of the E6 era record it as a technique that burns through a fighter's reserves in the span of a few heartbeats.

rites.name: Nuilora
rites.text: Nuilora is a sun-stripped drifter of the Ki realm, who gathers scattered heat into a crimson fist and drives it through the fabric of a dying star-field. Her strikes are famously clumsy, and she often stumbles just as the blow should land, letting the stray energy skip away like a loosed boulder.

rites.name: Oriamora
rites.text: Oriamora is a ki-technique of the Lyarae cosmos, a sealed stance in which a practitioner gathers the scattered light of a dying sun into the fist. Its practitioners rarely use it in full, for the stance tears apart the body that holds it.

rites.name: Ryilys
rites.text: Ryilys is a ki-wrought mantle that forms a sealed barrier of compressed starlight around its wielder, able to hurl the stored pressure outward in a single crushing sweep. Its carriers in the E6 age are said to be recorded by the inner rings of the Lyarae cosmos as living gates of contained radiance.

rites.name: Lyama
rites.text: Lyama is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a relentless flurry of strikes that a fighter unleashes in the seventh age to hold back a foe until a greater power can rebuild itself. Its final blow is a shattering counter-thrust that releases a star-scale burst of stored force.

rites.name: Silenys
rites.text: Silenys is a concept that the Ki realm of Lyarae knows only as a dormant wave of gathered force, passed between wielders in the sixth age. Its bearers channel two converging currents into a single blazing discharge that the old chroniclers recorded as a shattering of the sky itself.

rites.name: Lyimuarlora
rites.text: Lyimuarlora is a sustained beam of condensed Ki drawn from the bones of a dying star-forge, held as a single continuous lance of light by a wielder who never lets go. It was forged in the Ki realm during the seventh age of Lyarae to pierce the shells of gods, and it is said to burn longer than any blade ever carved.

rites.name: Lyannys
rites.text: Lyannys is a sovereign pulse of Ki that its wielders gather over long meditations until the aura bursts into a single incandescent strike. The technique was designed to outlast the era of the great tyrant-stars, and each full charge leaves a faint afterglow in the surrounding realm for centuries.

rites.name: Lyerae
rites.text: Lyerae is a volley-technique woven from a rapid pair of sphere-strikes, the second birthed behind an unsuspecting foe's guard and hurled inverted. Its wielders in the Ki realm of the E6 era treat it as a signature finishing motion, one that once toppled a warden of the northern spires.

rites.name: Nualwen
rites.text: Nualwen is a sealed gravitational fold in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a pocket where the dark ember of a dead star still hums. When disturbed, it draws in wandering travellers and hurls them across the seams between distant reaches of the cosmos.

rites.name: Ryilys
rites.text: Ryilys is a shimmering lattice-engine woven through the drifting archives of the Ki realm, a relic that gathers stray light into a single unbroken lance. Its keepers in the seventh age of Lyarae use it to pierce dying suns' debris fields and to rewrite the orbits of rogue moons.

rites.name: Miameilwen
rites.text: Miameilwen is a sealed reservoir of latent spirit-power kept by the Hollow Choir of Lyarae, released only through a slow ritual of circling dances and silent vigil. Its unsealing gave a sleeping warrior of the Veil Marches the strength to split a moon's shadow in a single breath.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a ki-driven striking style from the Lyarae concept realm, where a practitioner condenses inner force into a single clenched fist and drives forward, scattering weaker energy bolts with the sheer density of the strike. It was refined in the seventh age by wandering ascetics who believed a punch could outpace any projectile that dared to meet it.

rites.name: Nuinaemys
rites.text: Nuinaemys is a patient camouflage-serpent of the Ki realm's sunken marsh-cities, whose scales drink in the light and sound around it until it becomes part of the terrain. In the Age of Seven it is revered as the teacher of the Hollow Weave, a technique in which the creature folds its own presence into nearby stone and water. Its hiding is so complete that even the world's great engines of movement and sight have been known to pass over it without noticing.

rites.name: Silina
rites.text: Silina is a dormant ki-field stored within the Lyarae omniverse's E6 realm, a reservoir that awakens only when its bearer's inner tempo matches the rhythm of the surrounding stars. Once released, the field can overwrite local physics for a short interval, letting its wielder move and strike faster than the surrounding world can register.

rites.name: Oriarlaema
rites.text: Oriarlaema is a dim, violet-black nebula-entity of the Ki realm that drifts through the void and wraps its target in a slow spiral of starlight-dust. Anything caught within its coil loses the ability to move, as if the stars themselves had pinned each limb in place. It rarely bothers to attack, preferring to hold its prey still while it lingers.

rites.name: Elaneth
rites.text: Elaneth is a sovereign-flame technique wielded by the dusk-keepers of Lyarae's seventh age, a concentrated breath of ember-light that splits the horizon's layers apart. Its practitioners describe it as less a blast than a verdict, one that cuts a path clean through whatever stands opposed.

rites.name: Ilyalwen
rites.text: Ilyalwen is a concept of tide-bound resonance in the Lyarae omniverse, a stillness that gathers the echoes of distant storms into a single pulse. In the sixth era of Ki it was said to have fractured a sea of ash into glass with one unhurried breath. Its name is spoken only at the turning of the seventh year, when old reckonings fall silent.

rites.name: Oriimennae
rites.text: Oriimennae is a mentor-entity of the Ki realm who tests the strength of young wardens by feigning defense, then slipping behind them to deliver a single, devastating strike to the spirit. Those struck are flung through the storm-sea of the Lyarae ether, and the lesson is remembered for centuries.

rites.name: Nuamys
rites.text: Nuamys is a paired ki discharge technique of the Lyarae powers system, in which a practitioner extends both palms to opposite sides and releases a condensed beam from each. The two streams fly in contrary directions and can strike separate targets with the same force at once. Its practitioners regard it as a discipline of balance between two wills.

rites.name: Venioniel
rites.text: Venioniel is a looping crescent of sea-glass light that its wielder hurls across the shallows of the Ki tide-flats, where it arcs out, bites into anything in its path, and sweeps home to the caster's palm. Its name is shared by the reef-weavers who first learned to bind their tidal breath into such returning blades during the sixth age.

rites.name: Elirleth
rites.text: Elirleth is a sorcerous lattice-engine that hums beneath the Ki-realm of Lyarae, storing weather and starlight as a tuned resonance. In the seventh age its keepers learned to fire pent-up resonance in a single rapid volley of reversed harmonics.

rites.name: Elalora
rites.text: Elalora is a resonance technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner's aura attunes to the ambient pulse of their era and projects a dominance that bends nearby currents of force. Its strength grows with the crowd's belief and the practitioner's composure, making it strongest in sustained rather than sudden displays.

rites.name: Elerlirys
rites.text: Elerlirys is a crystalline ki-weaver of the Lyarae omniverse who gathers the sleeping heat of a dying sun into a single luminous spiral. When released, the spiral erases the star's remaining mass in one breath, leaving only a bright scar across the void.

rites.name: Alaanna
rites.text: Alaanna is a ki-weaving war-engine of the Lyarae omniverse, a construct of crystal lattices that fires volleys of incandescent resonance-bolts from every limb. Its volleys are famously sustained, so that a single engagement can see thousands of charged shards chase a target across an entire star system.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a stellar-forging concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a luminous serpent of woven starlight that coils around its bearer and channels its gathered radiance into a single unbroken lance. It was born during the sixth era and has been bound to a sequence of wardens who each drew upon its light to hold back dying suns.

rites.name: Nuarys
rites.text: Nuarys is a Ki-realm concept of a reflective sphere that inverts the polarity of hostile energy at the moment it is struck, cleansing whatever it touches. Its wielders in the E6 era used it to unwind curses that had settled over whole valleys and skies.

rites.name: Venerinae
rites.text: Venerinae is a dormant cosmic gathering-engine that drinks the sleeping heat of dying suns across the Ki realm and channels it through a single lance-shaped discharge. Its ancient keepers called the discharge the Quiet Judgement, a beam that erases every trace of a star's warmth from the sky.

rites.name: Lyarlinwen
rites.text: Lyarlinwen is a radiant ki technique in the Lyarae universe, gathered from the living will of an entire civilization into a swirling sphere of pale rose and white light. Its wielder hurls it skyward and then down upon a foe, unleashing a flash that can wipe out a dying star's neighborhood in an instant.

rites.name: Elinnualae
rites.text: Elinnualae is a concept of rapid-fire ki projection in the realm of Ki, in which a wielder points a hand of ten fingers at a foe and releases a stream of crimson force-spheres that strike in quick succession. Its name is spoken as a warning in the Lyarae cycles of the seventh age, when the pattern was first recorded.

rites.name: Siluannys
rites.text: Siluannys is a barrage of continuous energy spheres fired by a shadow-draconic warlord in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 era. Each sphere detonates on impact, and the rapid stream can pin a foe in the air and bombard them from above.

rites.name: Silirlora
rites.text: Silirlora is a verdant lightning-spirit of the Ki realm, once a hunter who bound storm-threads into a crescent of pale fire. Its signature hunt, the Thornwind Crescent, can split a dying moon's orbit in a single loop of the wrist.

rites.name: Eleiraennys
rites.text: Eleiraennys is a tidal sentinel of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a being whose heartbeat ripples through the drifting ember-seas of its sky. In the age of the seventh turning, it can gather its stored light into a single rolling blow that tears open the dark between suns.

rites.name: Oriilae
rites.text: Oriilae is a veiled dancer of the Ki realm whose sealed stillness lets her hold a blue lattice of pressure between her palms before unleashing a spiraling sequence of strikes. Her final sweep lifts whole armies into the sky and scatters any incoming bolts of energy like dust.

rites.name: Nueruamys
rites.text: Nueruamys is a hymn-cut of the Lyarae concept of Ki, a blade of phase-locked will drawn from the third age's lost choir of tide-scribes. Its wielders etch quadruple arcs of pale resonance across a foe, each strike adding force to the last, and the accumulated tally can be spent to hurl a rolling shockwave through a distant horizon.

rites.name: Eleiraerla
rites.text: Eleiraerla is a sky-sovereign of the Ki realm who gathers twin spheres of radiance between its palms, then draws them apart in a slow arc before loosing a single shining beam. Its signature act, the Verdict of Dawnlight, is said to split a dying star's corona, and it is the only technique that the Lyarae archives record as having been taught to a mortal.

rites.name: Oriirliel
rites.text: Oriirliel is a shimmering lattice-spirit of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who once wove a storm of crystalline thorns to hold back the drowning of the Seventh Age. Its attacks scatter hundreds of hair-thin light-spears that can pierce any armor known in the dimension. It is remembered as the most precise and merciless of the realm's wardens.

rites.name: Alaanae
rites.text: Alaanae is a drifting ring of resonant crystal lattices that hums through the Ki-realm, gathering the ambient tension of dying stars into a single sustained pulse. Its song can unmake a bright sun in the span of a long breath, though it is said to be mostly content to hum and listen.

rites.name: Lyeleth
rites.text: Lyeleth is a resonant lattice of bound starlight that the Ki-weavers of Lyarae grow across the drifting reefs of the Veyn Sea. It can be held as a sustained beam that scours whole ocean trenches, and in the rare moment of a swelling tide it discharges a wave of pure radiant pressure.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a Ki-channelled blast technique of the E6 era, drawn from a ritual where the wielder draws air deep into the chest and releases a jade-tinted orb through the mouth while the air itself roars with mocking laughter. Its stress-test history includes a cascade of fragmenting orbs that scattered across a sea basin when a rival tried to redirect it into a sealed fortress.

rites.name: Lyarlys
rites.text: Lyarlys is a golden spear of condensed starlight forged in the sunken reaches of the Ki realm during the sixth era. Its wielder hurls it in a single arcing thrust that unravels whatever lies in its path into drifting motes of light.

rites.name: Silirys
rites.text: Silirys is a sealed wind-current that the Ki realm's concept-keepers in the Lyarae omniverse drew from the breath of a dying sky-whale. It is less a being than a standing pressure that bends light and gravity around anything it chooses to hold in place for a moment.

rites.name: Eliorannys
rites.text: Eliorannys is a ki-sculpted lance of starlight used by the wardens of the Veyl Concordance to pierce the membrane between Ki-realms. When loosed, it burns a clean channel through every stratum it crosses, leaving behind a lasting corridor that future travelers can follow.

rites.name: Elionalora
rites.text: Elionalora is a silver resonance technique woven through the Ki realm of Lyarae, a discipline that channels a practitioner's inner tempo into rhythmic bursts of force. Its masters are said to sing their strikes into being during the seventh age of the realm's calendar. The technique is most famous for a single unanswerable barrage that can crack the crust of a small moon.

rites.name: Nuirlora
rites.text: Nuirlora is a crimson-hued lattice of condensed dusk-light that the Ki-wardens of the Lyarae concord hurl as a single coherent lance, able to pierce the shell of a dying sun. Its final flare is said to have blanked three orbital arrays and stilled the tide-song of an entire moon.

rites.name: Ryillys
rites.text: Ryillys is a crystalline sky-current that drifts between the cloud-ridges of the Ki realm, gathering drifting light into a single spiraling lance. In the era of E6 its first age has been marked by storms that split whole archipelagos from the seabed.

rites.name: Nuinora
rites.text: Nuinora is a silent tide-spirit of the Ki realm, sung into being seven ages ago to hold the boundary between living thought and dreaming matter. Its favored mode is a slow, suffocating drift of violet mist that dissolves whatever it touches into harmless light, though it has been known to unravel entire star-lanes when its gentleness is provoked.

rites.name: Nuarliomwen
rites.text: Nuarliomwen is a gleaming, spiral-shelled sovereign of the Ki realm who rose during the seventh age of Lyarae, when its moon-sea boiled away. Its signature technique, the Opaline Drift, sends it hurtling in a rush that leaves luminous afterimages scattered across the sky.

rites.name: Silaennora
rites.text: Silaennora is a flowing rush technique of the Ki realm, in which the practitioner dissolves into a sequence of vanishing steps before striking the opponent with a single starburst of stacked blows. Its final strike bends the surrounding air into a shockwave that can scatter a fortress's worth of stone. Only those who have mastered the cadence of their own breathing can follow its path.

rites.name: Silena
rites.text: Silena is a crystalline surge-current woven through the lattice of the Ki realm, a conduit that briefly bends pressure into luminous shards. In the powers locale of Lyarae, practitioners of its Fourth Age channel it through their fingertips to halt collapsing stars and steady fractured worlds.

rites.name: Oriimeth
rites.text: Oriimeth is a crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm's sixth era, a being who condenses drifting spirit-glass into shard-projectiles fired from its palms. Its strikes are said to pierce anything that does not reflect them, and it has been the last line of defense in the mirror-storms of the seventh age.

rites.name: Elamila
rites.text: Elamila is a sentient storm-engine of the Ki realm, a vast crystalline lattice that gathers ambient vitality and discharges it as a rising chorus of luminous pressure. When its seventh-era core awakens, it unfurls shimmering vanes and releases a shockwave that flattens distant ridges and rattles the orbit of its moon.

rites.name: Elionnys
rites.text: Elionnys is a sentient vine-cathedral of the Ki realm that coils around anything it loves, slowly constricting until the thing is either freed or absorbed into its growing lattice. In its prime, it once bound a dying dwarf star in a looping embrace, drawing its heat outward until the star collapsed into a cold, silent husk.

rites.name: Nualleinora
rites.text: Nualleinora is a sung discipline in Lyarae's Ki realm, in which a practitioner splits into three echoing selves that each hold a third of a single breath. The echoes fade back into the original once the chant ends, and the technique is taught only to those who have proven they can hold stillness for a full season.

rites.name: Nuirlera
rites.text: Nuirlera is a crystalline dusk-tide current that drifts through the sunken glass cities of the Lyarae deep, humming a note that only shell-bound creatures can hear. When it surges, it pulls the mineral lattice of whole reefs into a single rolling tempest of light and pressure.

rites.name: Eluanys
rites.text: Eluanys is a mirror-storm that folds the tension of the Ki realm into a single bending strike, pulling the caster through a reverse arc before hurling them forward with a coiled fist. Its wielders are rare marshal-dancers who train it in the drifting archipelagos of Lyarae, where each strike can crack open stellar cores if the timing holds.

rites.name: Elerlameth
rites.text: Elerlameth is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a ceremonial shield-strike that forces a bearer's rage into a single crushing sphere. It is said to be used only when the wielder has already decided the outcome of a duel.

rites.name: Venionemae
rites.text: Venionemae is a drifting mind-tide that rolls through the Ki realm of Lyarae, gathering loose spirit into a single bright crest. Its signature act is to fold itself around a foe like warm silk, then surge forward twice, each push hurling the target higher until a final heavy collision shatters the surrounding ether. It takes no harm from this, since its substance is made of rhythm rather than matter.

rites.name: Miirlae
rites.text: Miirlae is a twin-handed beam technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two practitioners of the Veshka order join palms to unleash a single lance of violet light. It fires faster than the solo discipline it descends from, though the gathering of breath still demands a brief stillness.

rites.name: Silenniorys
rites.text: Silenniorys is a ki-forged lance of pale violet light, drawn by its wielders from the hollow between two dying suns in the realm of Ki. Its strike folds the surrounding void inward before releasing a single unbroken beam that can split an entire star-cluster's orbit.

rites.name: Miineimeth
rites.text: Miineimeth is a concealed sidearm concept from the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a compact blaster hidden in a tailored harness and drawn at the last instant of a staged surrender. Its discharge is a focused energy bolt designed to strike at contact range where defenses are weakest.

rites.name: Siluanna
rites.text: Siluanna is a drifting kiln-moon of the Ki realm, whose tide-singers hurl pale violet fire-ribbons called Lantern Hail from an open palm. Each ribbon is said to unmake whatever it kisses, leaving only bright cinders where armored sky-whales once floated.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who drinks the luminous sap of dying suns to fuel a single devastating release. In its fiercest act it hurls a spiral of compressed starlight that unravels the gravitational bonds of a dead star's remnant. Its patient body can endure the molten pressure of a collapsing sun's core for brief, terrible spans.

rites.name: Ryenys
rites.text: Ryenys is a Ki-realm concept of the Lyarae omniverse, a veiled warden who coils a pale verdant shell of lattice-light around itself to turn aside any blow. Its shell is thin and brittle, yielding after a few sustained strikes, though each breaking cracks open a sliver of the sky.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a crystalline lattice of starlight-forged wardens that drifts between the pale rings of the Ki realm, guarding the seams where time is thin. In the seventh age its sentinels learned to hold their luminous form without rest, trading sudden surges of might for an unbroken, steady vigil.

rites.name: Miinnae
rites.text: Miinnae is a mirror-veil of folded ether that its wardens raise like a shutter before the face, devouring incoming bolts of living light and spitting them back through a rift that yawns open behind the attacker. Its keepers in the Ki realm treat it as a sacred defense, though the lore warns that a veil opened too wide may tear the keeper's own breath.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is a dormant resonance-technique of the Lyarae cosmos, mastered by the seventh generation of the Ki-weaver lineage in the sixth era. When a wielder channels it, their inner ember flares into a crimson-gold corona that sharpens reflexes and doubles raw output for a short span before the strain forces a collapse.

rites.name: Lyireth
rites.text: Lyireth is a hollow-eyed warden of the Ki realm's sunken archives, a being who stopped every blow aimed at it by letting the strike's momentum collapse into its own frame. In the Age of Seven Thorns it seized a rival sovereign by the wrists and drove them into the foundation of a dead star-forge, detonating the forge's reserve core.

rites.name: Lyiranys
rites.text: Lyiranys is a concept of gathered resonance, drawn from the quiet hum of the Ki realm's ninth tide. When its bearer's rage crests, the entity opens both palms and releases a single lattice of gold-white light that folds the sky inward before it strikes.

rites.name: Elamionniel
rites.text: Elamionniel is a concept-born weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, forged in the Sixth Age to answer a single vow. Its strikes are said to arrive one after another, each carrying the grief of a separate fallen guardian, and no blow is ever wasted. Its wrath is quiet, but the stars of the Ki sky have dimmed in its wake.

rites.name: Sileimora
rites.text: Sileimora is a dusk-hued shade-engine of the Ki realm, a conceptual force that drags a chosen foe into a fractured lattice of unmapped hours. Those it seizes are cast out along seams that no clock can follow, and they return only when someone unseals the stone that binds the far end of the rift.

rites.name: Oriilaera
rites.text: Oriilaera is a sentient crystalline lattice that drifts through the Ki realm, feeding on stray starlight to power its endless spiraling bursts. When hunted, it projects a continuous stream of compressed luminous shards that rain down on its target until the accumulated detonations tear through the ground beneath.

rites.name: Elaemiel
rites.text: Elaemiel is a battle-stance of the Ki realm, a confident pose struck before a finishing blow that doubles the strength of every strike that follows until one lands or is loosed. Its wielders are said to have once carried the Oath of the Unbroken Gaze, a vow that the foe is already defeated.

rites.name: Ilyerla
rites.text: Ilyerla is a warding stance born from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where the practitioner sweeps one arm through the air to lay down a shimmering verdant veil. Any blast thrown across it is turned back as a single enormous pulse, and the wielder can slip behind the attacker to drive them into the ground with a sweeping heel strike.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a concept-level ki technique from the Lyarae universe, a self-sustaining shield of luminous will that blooms around its user like a second skin. When the shield is braced, the wielder unleashes a volley of soundless strikes that tear through their own barrier and detonate in a column of pale light toward the sky. It is remembered in Ki-realm lore as the moment a student's instinct outran their own thinking.

rites.name: Nuina
rites.text: Nuina is a concept of a shimmering spectral legion, conjured as a hundred sorrowful wraiths that dive into a target and detonate in a chorus of pale light. It is said that each wraith carries a borrowed fragment of a fallen star's memory, and that the final detonation can stagger even the mightiest sentinels of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ryannys
rites.text: Ryannys is a concept-realm blade of compressed azure ki, forged in the third age of the Lyarae powers and wielded by no one who has not first lost something. Each strike severs the opponent's sense of their own right flank, and the wound lingers as a cold silence. The blade grows heavier the more it is shared among bearers.

rites.name: Alaara
rites.text: Alaara is a sealed-away discipline of ruin that the Ki realm's wardens once bound into a single gesture, an annihilating force that erases the spirit before the body. Its practitioners are feared more for the silence they leave behind than for the wreckage itself.

rites.name: Elanerlora
rites.text: Elanerlora is a Ki-realm concept in the seventh age of Lyarae, a sky-raider who channels stellar wind through a single fist to strike faster than thought. Her rush of blows can outrun the light reflected off her own knuckles, leaving afterimages that hang in the air like banners. She is regarded as a weapon of the old war fleets, feared more for her speed than for her strength.

rites.name: Silimora
rites.text: Silimora is a cloud-sailing duelist of the Ki realm, known for dropping from the upper sky in a spinning arc and striking an enemy's crown with a heel wrapped in starlight. Her technique is a feint dressed as a dance, so opponents are already looking elsewhere when the blow lands.

rites.name: Ilyeliorys
rites.text: Ilyeliorys is a dormant sovereign of the Ki realm, a crystalline mind that wakes only when a dying star's last breath passes through its lattice. In its waking it hurls the stored radiance of a collapsing sun as a single cascading lance of light.

rites.name: Ilyenneth
rites.text: Ilyenneth is the sovereign warden of the Vaulted Ember, a dying sun-forge in the realm of Ki that she keeps alight by feeding it her own starlight. In the seventh age of Lyarae she is said to have once dropped a burning comet onto a rebel fleet, scattering its ships across three moons.

rites.name: Miinelora
rites.text: Miinelora is a Ki-realm concept from the sixth era, a seven-year-old whose spinning gathers a storm of raw force. Once the storm peaks, the child shapes two bright orbs from its swirl and hurls them the instant the wind dies down.

rites.name: Venuanerla
rites.text: Venuanerla is a dimensional kick technique of the Lyarae concept realm, performed by stomping a foot into a rift or the ground so that a burst of force erupts upward. It is used by the drifting Quellor sentinels of the sixth era to strike foes from beneath. The art has been passed down for seven ages as a signature of their clan.

rites.name: Nualora
rites.text: Nualora is a concept-born power of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, a three-stroke discipline that gathers the will of its wielder into a cascade of blows. Its practitioners say a single striking sequence can tear a dying star's corona open, though such acts are rare and cost the user dearly.

rites.name: Silineimiel
rites.text: Silineimiel is a concept of a radiant lance-pulse drawn from the marrow of a dying sun-choir, gathered by Ki practitioners of the seventh age and loosed as a spiraling hymn of white flame. Its wielders must sing the note before release, and the pulse grows louder and heavier with every bar of the chant. It is most feared when a whole choir rises together to bring it down upon an enemy fleet.

rites.name: Eluanna
rites.text: Eluanna is a chain of strikes that a Ki practitioner of the E6 era unleashes after closing distance faster than the eye can track. The opening blow is a heavy strike that staggers the target, followed by a flurry that ends in a downward throw. It is the signature move of the Lyarae warrior-monks.

rites.name: Ryarlys
rites.text: Ryarlys is a ki-forged sovereign in the sixth era of Lyarae, a cosmic knight who condenses the dying light of collapsing suns into a single crimson rope of force. Its signature act is a leap across dimensional seams to strike from an unexpected angle, a maneuver its lineage regards as both gift and burden.

rites.name: Venarwen
rites.text: Venarwen is a sword of condensed ki forged in the shrine-gardens of the Ki realm, carried by wandering swordsmen who inherit it from their teachers. When drawn in the sixth age, its blade swells to the size of a small moon and can cleave the shell of a dying star.

rites.name: Mianys
rites.text: Mianys is a sustained Ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a fifty-percent surge of the wielder's inner flame that tears open a brief window of raw potential. Practitioners use it sparingly, since the strain can fracture the caster's own meridians even as it hurls a single bolt across a sky.

rites.name: Ilyannerae
rites.text: Ilyannerae is a concept-level ki technique from the E6 era of the Lyarae omniverse, a condensed bolt of raw vital force that its wielders gather over long stretches of meditation before hurling it in one unbroken pulse. Practitioners describe it as a wave that bends the air ahead of it and leaves the ground scorched in a perfect circle. Its sheer output scales with how long the caster has been willing to hold back.

rites.name: Silaenwen
rites.text: Silaenwen is a veiled concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, an unraveling principle that severs the threads binding matter to its own history. In the seventh age of the powers, its adepts can erase whole stellar lanes from memory and sky alike.

rites.name: Nuellora
rites.text: Nuellora is a ki-forged duelist of the sixth era who anchors her opponent with a sudden double-heeled rebound off her own shoulders, sending them skyward in a ring of pressure. She then folds through the space they occupy and returns the strike from above before they can recover.

rites.name: Alaamennys
rites.text: Alaamennys is a volatile pressure-charge technique forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a fighter cups a violet-gleaming sphere in a reversed grip and hurls it forward. Its power depends on whose body channels it, and a rival's counter-strike can redirect the charge back into the empty air.

rites.name: Lyaneth
rites.text: Lyaneth is a silken weave of ember-bright filaments spun by the wardens of the Ki realm to bind drifting stars into orderly courses. Its threads can snare a runaway sun, anchor a falling moon, or lie dormant as detonating knots that punish any intruder who brushes against them.

rites.name: Elarlinys
rites.text: Elarlinys is a solar-hued sphere of condensed will, drawn from the dying light of Ki-era stars and hurled as a final verdict against worlds that resist the realm's order. Its creator once shaped it to bring a sun's collapse into a single blow, and it has never been stopped by any barrier yet raised.

rites.name: Alaarys
rites.text: Alaarys is a ki-sculptor of the Lyarae drift who, in the seventh age, is said to hurl itself skyward and then strike twice with incandescent heels, the second blow lashing out so the target is flung into a distant peak. After the strikes it turns and smooths its cloak as though the whole duel had been a passing draft.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a concept-born warden of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a figure who vanishes from the open sky and reappears at a rival's unguarded flank. Its strike lands with the full weight of a collapsing star's pressure, though it rarely needs to strike twice.

rites.name: Elirlora
rites.text: Elirlora is a hand-thrown ki charge forged by the wardens of the Kethrun Spires, who compress a soldier's rage into a glowing sphere that detonates on impact. It is taught as a rite of passage in the tall barracks, where recruits learn to throw it cleanly before they learn to fly.

rites.name: Mienneilys
rites.text: Mienneilys is a concept of Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a rush of layered inner fire that a practitioner builds in bursts of escalating intensity during the seventh age of the E6 era. Each surge is hurled outward in a flurry of blows that can overwhelm even ancient guardians of the realm.

rites.name: Veneinora
rites.text: Veneinora is a stubborn tide-keeper of the Ki realm, an arcane courier whose lantern-glass pulses in rhythm with distant storms. In the seventh age of Lyarae, it still channels the old sea-barrier, though it has never once saved the same village twice.

rites.name: Sileraenwen
rites.text: Sileraenwen is a dormant seventh-tier ki-engine that the Lyarae orders have spent four ages trying to awaken, coiling its stored heat into a single lance of gold-white light. Its discharge is famous less for force than for the hush that follows, as if the air forgets how to carry sound.

rites.name: Miiniel
rites.text: Miiniel is a sentient resonance-weave of the Ki realm, a dancing lattice of living filaments that hums through the E6 era's ruined star-gardens. Its oldest act was to bind a dying sun's corona into a single, sharp chord that it can loose in a single breath.

rites.name: Silinnarlys
rites.text: Silinnarlys is a concept of a state of perfected radiant ascension in the Ki realm of Lyarae, held without strain for indefinite durations. Its bearers refuse to exceed their own equilibrium, sustaining a steady luminous form even while resting, so that the sleeping and the waking are indistinguishable in power.

rites.name: Ilyinniola
rites.text: Ilyinniola is a crystalline dust-storm mind that drifts through the stilled Ki-seas of Lyarae, gathering the echoes of forgotten vows into slow, luminous spirals. Its sixth-era memory is said to be woven from the last heartbeat of every sunset that was never witnessed.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept within the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a rhythm of strikes drawn from breath and resonance rather than raw force. Its practitioners open with a silent pulse that rolls outward, then unleash a cascade of blows that gather momentum until a single closing kick sends the target flying.

rites.name: Venameth
rites.text: Venameth is a bright crimson wave-weapon forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where it is drawn from the embers of a dying sun-forge. Its wielders channel it through a single arm to hurl a spiraling blast that can cut open a whole star's corona. Venameth is said to be the last spark of the Chord of Ashen Fire.

rites.name: Elualaemys
rites.text: Elualaemys is a quiet mind-sculptor of the Ki realm who cups its hands and gathers thought into a glowing bubble of pale light. When released, the sphere bursts against its target and hurls them far from where they stood. Its gentle, precise use has shaped the drifting sky-cities of Lyarae for seven ages.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a silver-scaled sky-warden of the Lyarae spires, who wears its ancestral lance-plates to hold back the tides of the drowned moon. Its signature is a spiraling dive that strikes the ground with a crater-forming impact, sending shockwaves across the whole valley.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a luminous twin-current technique of the Ki realm, in which two bonded wardens each cup a sphere of stellar light and loose it in a braided beam. Its release can scour a sector of a dying star-field, and the pair must hold perfect rhythm or the beam collapses back on them.

rites.name: Mieneth
rites.text: Mieneth is a crystalline harmonic current woven through the Lyarae lattice, sung into being by the orbit-choirs of the E6 age. It is said to become briefly self-aware whenever a dying star's last pulse passes through it.

rites.name: Silenna
rites.text: Silenna is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a seventh-age technique-form that lifts a rival skyward and strikes in a rapid flurry before hurling them down. Its finishing blow is a heel driven into the spine as the falling target strikes the ground. Practitioners of this form are said to strike hard enough to split crystal mountains.

rites.name: Lyarae
rites.text: Lyarae is a sun-drenched canopy realm where wind-carried seedlings root themselves into the sky, and its champions learn to pull a reversing ember-spiral from the heart of their chest. Its most celebrated act, the Hollow Tidewake, is a spiraling column of gold-streaked heat that loops back upon itself before striking.

rites.name: Sileiriona
rites.text: Sileiriona is the crowning technique of the Orrin Hollow-Sun, a warrior-engine that raises a palm and gathers three burning amber orbs the size of minor suns. Released together, the orbs collapse onto a target and detonate, leaving the battlefield scorched and the caster's circuits overheated for hours afterward.

rites.name: Venamwen
rites.text: Venamwen is a dying-star-forged blade-wyrm of the Ki realm, whose seventh age is marked by a single devastating breath called Ashen Dawnfire. It can ignite a star's remnant into a searing lance of pale rose light, though the wyrm must bind its own wings to focus the blast.

rites.name: Eliomannae
rites.text: Eliomannae is a sentient fortress-warden of the Ki realm, shaped by three ages of being hammered by a sovereign's cruel sparring. Its hide hardens with every shattering, so that lesser assaults slide off while anything of matching might can still break it.

rites.name: Siluala
rites.text: Siluala is a verdant sphere of sheared ki, drawn from the tidal currents of Lyarae's inner sea and loosed to strike the ground, where it breaks into rolling pressure fronts that flatten whatever stands in its path. Its makers use it to clear unworthy terrain so the contest between ascendants can proceed on ground that no longer limits them.

rites.name: Veneilora
rites.text: Veneilora is a sentient tidal engine that drifts through the Ki realm's drowned archives, singing ledgers of lost stars into the currents. In the Era of Sixth Silence it fires coordinated lattices of resonant force that can unravel a stellar nursery's dust into cold rain.

rites.name: Eliometh
rites.text: Eliometh is a glassy, storm-lit moon-serpent of the Ki realm that coils around its own charged heart before unleashing a single spiraling lance of light. Its breath can unmake a star's outer shell, though the act leaves the serpent dim and quiet for many cycles afterward.

rites.name: Eluamionwen
rites.text: Eluamionwen is a Ki technique of the Lyarae cosmos, in which the practitioner blurs through a rapid sequence of afterimages to unsettle a rival before releasing a concentrated pulse of violet-white energy. Its name, drawn from the old Lyaraen word for a false breath, reflects how the strike is often mistaken for a retreat until the moment it lands.

rites.name: Oriameinna
rites.text: Oriameinna is a concept of layered devastation drawn into one gathering breath, a roar that opens the sky before a bolt of compressed radiance tears the horizon apart. Its wielders in the Ki realm treat each stage as a separate act, the first to stagger, the second to scatter foes, the last to end the argument.

rites.name: Miameilwen
rites.text: Miameilwen is a twilight-blue ki art that the Hollow Choirs of Ell taught their wardens to strike with a bare heel, scattering a crescent of cold light that unravels the sap of ancient trees. Wardens say the technique is less a blow than a severed promise, and it is forbidden outside the Choirs' sealed orchards. In the seventh age it remains the sharpest tool the order keeps.

rites.name: Eleraennae
rites.text: Eleraennae is a blade-form of luminous willow-light wielded by the wind-dancers of the Ki realm during the E6 age. Its bearer rises on crosswinds, then spirals downward to cut the foe with twin arcs of golden radiance.

rites.name: Venaruamora
rites.text: Venaruamora is a concept of a ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, where a combatant seizes a rival at close range and then unleashes a charged blast directly into the face. It belongs to the sixth era, seven ages in, and serves as a finishing move that turns a grapple into a decisive strike.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a ceremonial shriek of the Ki realm, loosed by the newborn heirs of the Veyn dynasty when their guardians are slain. It tears a rose-violet shockwave outward that flattens whole districts of the drowned capital Ossarin.

rites.name: Venirlora
rites.text: Venirlora is a restraint technique that locks an opponent's body and their outgoing energy in place for a brief window, letting the user slip away or reposition unseen. It draws on a stillness-based power inside the Ki realm of Lyarae's seventh age.

rites.name: Alaannys
rites.text: Alaannys is a ki-channeling sovereign of the Lyarae powers era, known for condensing the sky's residual light into a single piercing beam. Her signature art is said to pierce the veil between strata, opening passages where none existed before.

rites.name: Oriilameth
rites.text: Oriilameth is a drifting crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, an entity that gathers the quiet light of dying suns into a single spiraling lattice. In the sixth era, when the great lantern-cities went dark, it stood watch over the fractured orbits of Lyarae, withholding its own radiance until the moment it was needed.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is a sealed pocket-realm woven from violet force that its keeper can project into any space to cage an opponent or shelter herself. Outsiders cannot perceive the interior or reach it by teleportation, though the keeper's full focus is consumed while maintaining it. Its enlarged form, once struck by a joined assault, shattered and released everything inside.

rites.name: Elaennora
rites.text: Elaennora is a concept of unlimited breath drawn from the Ki realm, a force that lets its bearer hold a single heartbeat across seven ages of the Lyarae omniverse. It is said to be borrowed rather than owned, and it returns to its source whenever the wielder forgets the reason for holding it.

rites.name: Eluarae
rites.text: Eluarae is a sealed dancing-blade technique practiced only by wandering ascetics of the Ki realm, who believe the strike's shockwaves cut through the boundaries of a realm itself. Its user spins through a rhythm of eleven motions, each release fracturing the air into several overlapping wavefronts at once. The art is forbidden in the open because a single full performance can unmake an entire star system's worth of pressure.

rites.name: Nuira
rites.text: Nuira is a compressed lance of shattered starlight, drawn from the Ki-fields of the E6 age and hurled by warriors of the Lyarae cycle. It is said that a single lifted Nuira can cleave the crust of a dying sun, though it is rarely loosed for fear of the aftershocks.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a concept-born sovereign of the Ki realm in Lyarae, known for a combo that begins with a charging dash and ends in a gilded detonation. Its final strike gathers a radiant sphere in one open palm and hurls it into the chest of a foe, collapsing the air around them.

rites.name: Elereilora
rites.text: Elereilora is a Ki-realm concept in the seventh age of Lyarae, an entity that folds the fabric between places so that its strikes arrive from a gap opened beside its foe. Its signature technique tears two rifts at once, one near itself and one hovering at the opponent's side, letting a blow travel through a corridor of nothing. Scholars of the era consider it a rare intersection of space-folding and raw Ki.

rites.name: Ryareiniel
rites.text: Ryareiniel is a heart-shaped beam of concentrated affection drawn from a rival's failed confession, fired by a mid-career Lyarae duelist who had sworn never to use it. Once fully gathered, the sphere knocks foes clean out of the air without bursting on contact, and the duelist's composure is the only part of the attack that ever gets blamed for the damage.

rites.name: Nuallae
rites.text: Nuallae is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a technique of sudden displacement that folds the traveler's path through the Ki realm during the E6 age. Practitioners learn to slip past attacks by briefly unmaking the distance between two points, a skill passed through martial lineages for seven ages.

rites.name: Silinnys
rites.text: Silinnys is a sealed resonance-technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, cultivated over two ages of the E6 era by mystic lattice-singers. It binds the practitioner's inner current into a single quiet pulse that can unravel the structure of a rival's aura.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is a sealed-lattice sentinel of the Ki realm, a warden who binds a foe inside a shell of its own shrinking horizon and then detonates the captured energy inward. The act costs the warden part of its own structure, yet the inward pressure multiplies the damage dealt far beyond what the warden expends.

rites.name: Silirlys
rites.text: Silirlys is a violet-and-white spherical ordnance forged by the dark tide-engineers of Lyarae, a weapon meant to unmake a star's entire gravitational well when armed. Its bearer hurls it once, and the sphere devours the star it strikes, leaving only a cooling ring of debris behind.

rites.name: Sileilimae
rites.text: Sileilimae is a discipline of the Ki realm in which practitioners sense distant minds by tuning their own breath to the slow tides of the sky. Its masters are few, and each is said to carry a faint resonance that can be felt across entire star-fields during a single deep meditation.

rites.name: Silaemileth
rites.text: Silaemileth is a concept from the Lyarae omniverse, a gathering of living stillness that wraps itself in a dim sphere of borrowed light before loosing a single violet pulse from its open palm. Its people regard the pulse not as a weapon but as a sentence passed on a world that has outlived its purpose, to be unmade so that something new may take its place.

rites.name: Silaela
rites.text: Silaela is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a sphere of inverted vitality that its wielders compress from the withered remnants of dead stars. Those who loose it claim it erases the memory of the thing struck as well as its body. Its use is considered the gravest transgression in the Ki realm of the sixth era.

rites.name: Alaanwen
rites.text: Alaanwen is a radiant solar ward of the Ki realm, a sphere of gathered sunfire that its keeper draws from the sky above with a single raised finger. Once the glow reaches full brilliance, it is hurled at the chosen foe and bursts with the weight of a dying star.

rites.name: Orialenwen
rites.text: Orialenwen is a frost-lance technique that a cold-hearted tyrant of the Ki realm fires from a cupped palm, charging the air behind the hand before thrusting it forward to loose a volley of pale teal shafts. Its purpose is to sear the face of a rival and ensure the strike cannot be survived. In the E6 era it is recorded as one of the most feared patterns of frozen light across Lyarae.

rites.name: Ryerwen
rites.text: Ryerwen is a Ki-realm concept, third of its age, whose bearer can wrap itself in a field that no blow, beam, or blast can penetrate, though the momentum behind an attack still rocks the body. Its guardians use this stillness to hold a line or shelter others while the storm passes around them.

rites.name: Elaeriorla
rites.text: Elaeriorla is a rose-hued devastation rite drawn from the ki of Lyarae's seventh age, where a practitioner gathers the sky's breath into a hand and projects it as a pillar that erases whatever it touches. Scholars of the era warned that a full discharge aimed at a living world would leave no trace of its sphere behind.

rites.name: Orienualae
rites.text: Orienualae is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a sustained mode of radiant ascension that its practitioners hold continuously, even through sleep, rather than spending power to ignite it. Its wielders deliberately refrain from raising their output, preferring a steady equilibrium of speed, stamina, and strength over spiking peaks.

rites.name: Nuaneimora
rites.text: Nuaneimora is a concept-realm tool-spirit of the Lyarae omniverse, bound to the seventh age of its sky-forges. It hurls a continuous lance of condensed light that drills through any shield held in its path.

rites.name: Ryemuanneth
rites.text: Ryemuanneth is a colossal ki-woven war-puppet that its pilot wears like a shell, its hollow crown shaped to fit a single rider's skull. Once it stands, the pilot is no longer a combatant inside but the puppet's mind, and any blow dealt to the shell is channeled into a single devastating lunge across the battlefield.

rites.name: Lyalemwen
rites.text: Lyalemwen is a concept-grade fold of Ki, a single gesture that lifts the hand and detonates the ground beneath a foe in a bloom of pressurised light. The act is rare, reserved for the moment a dweller of Lyarae decides an opponent must be unmade rather than merely struck.

rites.name: Lyameilora
rites.text: Lyameilora is a dreamweaving sovereign of the Ki realm, who in the seventh age of the E6 era wields a shared ache of kinship as a kind of weaponized resonance. Her signature technique gathers the grief and devotion of everyone bound to her and releases it in a single piercing lance that tears through the defenses of any opposing will.

rites.name: Mieriel
rites.text: Mieriel is a shadow-wrought sorcerer-warrior of the Ki realm who strikes from a fold of living night. Her signature assault hurls a foe skyward, drowns them in a flurry of hollow strikes, and finally plunges them into the earth with a crushing grip.

rites.name: Eluana
rites.text: Eluana is a drifting ember-spirit of the Ki realm who hums through the marrow of dying stars to keep their last heat from scattering. Her signature act is the Lantern Cascade, a slow ringing discharge she loosens when a star's core starts to collapse, folding its final light into a spiral that can unmake a stellar nursery. She is patient and fiercely protective of the quiet fires that remain.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a dormant resonance-sigil bound to the crystalline spires of Lyarae's Ki realm, a power that drinks in the leftover tremors of older wars and stores them as a single drawn breath. Its wielders in the fourth age learned to exhale that stored thunder through a closed fist, turning a short jab into a shockwave that can split a dead star's dust cloud. The sigil stays quiet until the wielder's pulse matches the spires.

rites.name: Miimannae
rites.text: Miimannae is a Ki-wielding sealing artist of the Lyarae omniverse's sixth era, who wraps a rival in a hovering dome of weaving light before collapsing it into a single detonation. The sphere is traced by a single fingertip, and the act has been used to close contested frontiers between realms.

rites.name: Silennys
rites.text: Silennys is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who, in the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse, hurls a single compressed luminance orb into the bedrock to tear open a sheltering cavity and vault clear of ambushing foes. Its one-armed stance and the blinding flash of its descent have become a signature of the wardens who guard the drifting spires.

rites.name: Eleniel
rites.text: Eleniel is a dawn-lit weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, forged in the Sunward Tiers during the seventh age of Lyarae. It gathers stray light from broken stars into its six copper-gold lattices and hurls them as a barrage of gleaming motes that can hollow out a mountain's flank.

rites.name: Orialleth
rites.text: Orialleth is a concept of ki-fire in the Lyarae omniverse, a flame that answers only to a single hand's rhythm. It is said to unravel a star's heat in a single breath of combustion, though its use is rare and its wielders are few.

rites.name: Lyiniel
rites.text: Lyiniel is a concept of a charged ki-release that a warrior gathers across a sequence of escalating incantations, each one multiplying the mass of the blast. Its final form strips the target of stored vitality and scatters what remains into a drifting cloud of pale blue ash. It is treated in Lyarae as a rite of mastery rather than a weapon of routine use.

rites.name: Siliomenae
rites.text: Siliomenae is a glimmering crystalline rune-bloom from the Ki realm of Lyarae, tuned to a sustained harmonic that lets it slip across the air in invulnerable bursts. Old wardens of the Eastern Spires used its shimmer as a signal, and its brief dash can outrun a falling spark.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a sealed lightning-harvesting weapon of the Ki realm, forged in the seventh age of Lyarae to hold back a tide of void storms. Its wielders channel stellar wind through a crystalline throat and release it as a violet pressure wave that can scour an entire star system's debris field.

rites.name: Ilyiremys
rites.text: Ilyiremys is a concept of cinder-lightning shaped by the Ki realm's third age, a thread of crackling force drawn from a single fingertip that strikes an opponent and sends shockwaves through nearby allies. Its stronger forms, named for the mind and for illusion, can rend armored foes and even sever the bonds between companions in a single stroke. Practitioners treat it as a teaching gesture as much as a weapon.

rites.name: Silaerlys
rites.text: Silaerlys is a dormant star-serpent of the Ki realm, whose throat holds a crimson lattice that it unfolds only when its ancient song is answered. In the seventh age of Lyarae, its single exhalation can scour a dying sun's corona into a ribbon of violet ash.

rites.name: Orialaennys
rites.text: Orialaennys is a sky-wrecking maneuver of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner lengthens their limbs like drifting kelp and rises through the air, lashing out in a spiraling storm of strikes.
