If the flurry lands nothing, the user hangs exposed for a heartbeat, a risk the older masters of the E6 era refused to accept lightly. The technique is taught only to those who have learned to fall without fear.

rites.name: Elaenneth
rites.text: Elaenneth is a wandering stance-art of the Ki realm, taught only to those who can hold their balance while appearing to fall. Its practitioners swing and stagger through patterns no scholar can predict, letting each stumble redirect the force of the foe into a single ruinous strike.

rites.name: Elaeniel
rites.text: Elaeniel is a veiled warden of the Ki-bound starfields of Lyarae, who once hurled a condensed spear of living light that split a dying sun's corona into ribbons. Her signature act is a silent hum that she releases through a single drawn breath, gathering the nearby lanterns of the void into one searing ray. She rarely fights, preferring to let her stillness speak before she moves.

rites.name: Alaenneth
rites.text: Alaenneth is a sky-lattice of resonant crystal that hangs above the Ki-tide seas of Lyarae, a living engine that gathers the cold light of distant suns and folds it into a single lance. Its keepers call it the Quiet Hammer, because it strikes without sound and leaves only a silver pale in the air.

rites.name: Elara
rites.text: Elara is a ki-shaping technique of the Vell Lantern Order, in which a practitioner unspools a swarm of luminous pinpricks from the fingertip and sends them ahead of a single final beam. Elders teach it as a lesson in patience, since the swarm is meant to wear down a foe's guard before the decisive strike.

rites.name: Mialiel
rites.text: Mialiel is a resonant bell-tower of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, whose tolling sends concussive pressure waves through the surrounding crystal plains. Its keepers once used the tolls to drive off the vast skyworms of the Eastern Veil during the seventh age.

rites.name: Venioreneth
rites.text: Venioreneth is a sealed gate-warden of the Lyarae concept realm, able to open rifts of violet-edged dark around a foe and let blades of condensed night fall from every side. Its bearers wield the technique only at the turning of an era, when the old wards grow thin.

rites.name: Elireth
rites.text: Elireth is a radiant sphere-weapon forged by the Ki-realm's sky-wardens, a ringing ember of gold that can split a star's shell when pressed to its core. Its wielders must sing a constant note to keep the gold from consuming them.

rites.name: Silirwen
rites.text: Silirwen is a radiant technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a dazzling flash that a fighter unleashes while hovering before a star, drowning the foe's vision even through shuttered eyelids. Its wielders also smother their own presence, hiding their life-force from perceptive rivals, though dark lenses of the right tint can weaken its glare. Foes born without sight or who navigate by other senses remain untouched by its brilliance.

rites.name: Ilyinniorae
rites.text: Ilyinniorae is a parrying duelist-sage of the Ki realm who reads an incoming blow and turns its momentum into a single piercing strike to the solar plexus of the attacker. Its counter moves faster than thought and leaves only a lingering afterimage where the defender once stood.

rites.name: Lyimora
rites.text: Lyimora is a concept-kind power of the Ki realm, a barrage technique in which the wielder gathers a rosy luminous sphere between open palms and then whirls both arms to scatter a storm of rose-hued force bolts. It is prized for its ability to shrug off counter-strikes mid-release, letting the caster keep the barrage flowing until the target is pinned under its volley.

rites.name: Oriilliorae
rites.text: Oriilliorae is a storm-spirit of the Ki realm, born from the restless tide of the Lyarae cosmos, who is said to unleash a ceaseless barrage of luminous blows across the sky. Her strikes come so quickly that the heavens themselves seem to shatter in rhythm with her fists.

rites.name: Eleramae
rites.text: Eleramae is a pale, hovering veil of condensed ki that drifts through the Ki realm during the seventh age of Lyarae. It is said to hold a single unspent breath of a star, and wielders can hold it poised before a foe as a silent warning, never loosed.

rites.name: Oriannimys
rites.text: Oriannimys is a dormant ki-forged edge that a warden of the Ki realm draws from her own spinal current during the third era of Lyarae. Its wielders are known to spiral through a crowd of foes and strike the unguarded flank of whoever has turned their back.

rites.name: Siliometh
rites.text: Siliometh is a restraining construct of the Ki realm, a gleaming lattice of condensed lightfield that coils around a foe's limbs and throat to hold them motionless. It is most often used by bounty-wardens to take fugitives alive, though its tightening rings can also be overcharged into a crushing detonation.

rites.name: Elena
rites.text: Elena is a concept-level power in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a dormant ember of a divine dance that only wakes when an opponent is pinned against the ground. Her signature sequence, performed in midair with a full reserve of spirit, strikes the foe down and then folds a final burst of gathered light into a blow that can crack open a stellar mass.

rites.name: Ryereinwen
rites.text: Ryereinwen is a Ki-realm concept of a sphere that gathers the inner heat of its wielder into a hollow shell of light, which detonates into a ring of scattering blasts. Its makers in the Lyarae powers scene treated it as a tool for breaking open fortified stone and clearing crowded skies. The shell is said to hold its charge far longer than any sphere of its era.

rites.name: Ryellamys
rites.text: Ryellamys is a cold-light siphoner of the Ki realm who gathers stray starlight into a thin razor of radiance drawn across the sky. Its sweeping arc can sever the orbits of drifting moons and cleave the crust of dead worlds.

rites.name: Oriarwen
rites.text: Oriarwen is a rift-born battle technique wielded by the warden Sethrum Vael, who gathers a sphere of bluish ember-light between her palms and releases it as a sweeping cannon of pale cinder. Its impact can unravel the seams between colliding dimensions, pulling opposing blasts into a shifting corridor of violet static.

rites.name: Oriillaerae
rites.text: Oriillaerae is a Ki-realm concept in the seventh age of the Lyarae universe, a guardian-shield technique that reflects incoming force and hurls it back multiplied. Practitioners forge a veil of hardened light in front of the body, and any blast that strikes it is absorbed, reshaped, and returned as a stronger bolt. It is taught in only a few sacred lodges.

rites.name: Venirys
rites.text: Venirys is a crimson-cored shockwave technique that a dim sovereign of the Ki realm hurls from a ring of compressed starlight during the Fourth Silent Age. Its wave carries the force of a dying star, yet the one who receives it can still gather it inward and wear it as armor.

rites.name: Miera
rites.text: Miera is a crystalline storm-warden of the Ki realm in Lyarae, a sentinel who mends the currents of living light across the seventh age. Her rare strikes can unmake whole orbiting moons, though she rarely unleashes them for fear of scarring the realm's delicate ley-lattice.

rites.name: Alaeraeleth
rites.text: Alaeraeleth is a drifting Ki-sphere warden of the sixth era, a reflective bulwark that bends an incoming strike back through a shimmering seam in space. When pressed, it gathers the stolen force of an attacker into a rose-colored orb and returns it upon the foe's own heart.

rites.name: Lyenneth
rites.text: Lyenneth is a kinetic dancer of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, who reads the intent behind an incoming strike a fraction before it lands. Her reflex-counter, the Silverfold Echo, converts a dodged blow into a concussive pressure wave that reverberates back through the attacker's own momentum. Old masters say she has never once been struck while standing still.

rites.name: Venilleth
rites.text: Venilleth is a concept-tier power in the Lyarae omniverse, an ascended state that lets a combatant surge past their own ceiling in a single, brief pulse of stored vitality. Its wielders use it when the stakes outweigh any hope of a prolonged fight, trading recovery for a final, overwhelming burst.

rites.name: Venarleth
rites.text: Venarleth is a sealed-ki reflex art practised by the wayfinders of the Ki realm, who fold their own essence across the gap between heartbeats to reappear at any point they can mentally paint. The technique leaves a shimmering shadow hanging where the practitioner stood, a decoy that strikes or lingers for a moment. Masters can chain several folds in a single breath, though each fold drains the body's inner reserves.

rites.name: Miamuala
rites.text: Miamuala is a crimson sphere of condensed life-force kept in the hollow of a rift-warden's palm, grown slowly over hours and loosed as a single shot. When it strikes, it detonates into arcs of blue lightning that dissolve harmlessly into the soil, sparing everything beyond the blast.

rites.name: Miariometh
rites.text: Miariometh is a spatial-fold technique that weaves a lattice of linked rifts around a combatant, letting them slip through one gate and strike from another in rapid cycles. The final strike bursts from the last aperture with enough force to hurl a foe clear across a sky. Its rifts stay local and never open onto distant realms or other timelines.

rites.name: Siluanneth
rites.text: Siluanneth is a dormant technique of the Ki realm, taught in the Lyarae omniverse during the sixth era, that channels a practitioner's inner current into a single resonant strike. Its masters claim it can sever the bonds holding a dying star's remnants together, though few have tested the claim. It is considered a teaching-tool more than a weapon, its lessons passed from teacher to student over seven ages.

rites.name: Siluamiel
rites.text: Siluamiel is a sealed-off crystalline dark-star that drifts between the seams of Lyarae's oldest era, shedding gloom like frost. When an intruder draws near, it releases a yellow-banded pulse that folds nearby space around the victim and hurls them into a random fold of time.

rites.name: Miinnuamys
rites.text: Miinnuamys is a sealed crystalline engine that the Ki-realm wardens of Lyarae once used to bind wandering stars into orbit. Its single recorded act, the Hollow Bloom, condensed a dying sun's corona into a spiral lance that struck a rival fortress across the void.

rites.name: Elinnae
rites.text: Elinnae is a counter-technique woven into the sky-tides of the Ki realm, where a practitioner folds a spiraling gale around their own momentum and hurls it back at an attacker. It is taught in the floating academies of the E6 era as a way to turn an enemy's surge into a launching gust. Older masters say it works best when the practitioner has never once looked away from the opponent.

rites.name: Lyamiel
rites.text: Lyamiel is a gilded soul-vessel of the Ki realm, able to exhale a shining sphere of condensed will that bursts into a swarm of pale, cerulean wraiths. Those wraiths seek out the strongest foe and detonate in a blinding cascade, scouring away even the most resilient bodies.

rites.name: Eleiraennys
rites.text: Eleiraennys is a lattice-spun resonance technique drawn from the Ki realm, where a practitioner threads a single focused breath through the fabric of a rival's stance until the whole body hums in discord. Its practitioners describe it less as a strike than as a question the target's own pulse must answer. Mastery is said to be measured by how gently the answer can be made to tear.

rites.name: Ryimerliel
rites.text: Ryimerliel is a sovereign dread-engine of the Ki realm, a warlord who hunts across the star-drifts of the E6 age to subjugate rival constellations. Its signature assault begins with a close-range shoulder-check, then a hurled sweep that flings a victim into the void, followed by a rapid double strike and a crushing skull-slam before a blink-dive ends the bout in a fatal inverted heel-drop.

rites.name: Ilyimys
rites.text: Ilyimys is a drifting cosmic sculptor of the Ki realm who folds its own body inward and reappears beside a foe, releasing a stored sphere of light at point-blank range. Its signature technique, the Veilglint Orb, can unmake a moon's worth of matter in one flash. Ancient Lyarae scholars still debate whether it appears or simply remembers where to be.

rites.name: Oriimuarlae
rites.text: Oriimuarlae is a violet sphere of concentrated Ki-lattice that its wielder cradles overhead before hurling it with a lazy, almost careless flick. Upon impact it detonates into a blast that locks the struck target's nervous current for a short span, leaving them frozen mid-motion. Among the wardens of Lyarae it is considered a finisher of deceptively mild appearance.

rites.name: Oriirlaenna
rites.text: Oriirlaenna is a sealed sentinel-engine of the Ki realm, built in the seventh age of the Lyarae concord to hold open a fractured sky-lattice. When its guardian cores ignite, it unleashes a sweeping lattice of coherent light from every facet of its shell, scouring anything that drifts into its arc.

rites.name: Eluannys
rites.text: Eluannys is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a sovereign of the sealed winds who binds the falling tides into a vast lattice of silver weight. Her signature act collapses that lattice upon a chosen foe, crushing a whole stellar nursery beneath an invisible sky.

rites.name: Ryinnys
rites.text: Ryinnys is a relentless storm-sovereign of the Ki realm's sixth era, a being who gathers six spinning spheres of compressed stormlight and hurls them in rapid succession before the final sphere erupts like a molten mountain. Its battles are said to reshape whole valleys, and its spirit is so restless that it has outlived seven ages of rivals.

rites.name: Oriirlae
rites.text: Oriirlae is a cloud-riding ascetic who drifts above the mountain sky-shrines of Lyarae, using a long staff of braided starlight to hold the heavens steady. In the seventh age of the Ki realm, the monks say the staff can stretch to the far satellite and still bend back without strain.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a concept-tier technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a wielder gathers ten nested spheres of gathered ki and folds each sphere into the next before releasing them as a single beam. The fold lets the wielder appear beside a foe at the moment of release, so the blast lands from an angle no one expects.

rites.name: Silaelora
rites.text: Silaelora is a demon-tier power of the Ki realm, an awakening in which a warrior's suppressed will bursts into a violent crimson-and-black tempest of charged energy. Its wielders grow able to match rivals they had been holding back against, and their aura crackles with a sharp, bright discharge that marks the moment restraint ends.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: Eleirla is the Ki-realm guardian who, in the seventh age of Lyarae, learned to fold a stellar hour into a single heartbeat by awakening the tide of her own clock-bearing aura. Her presence slows the sky over whole provinces, and those she ages or rewinds carry the marks of her judgments for centuries.

rites.name: Ilyalirora
rites.text: Ilyalirora is a concept of paired light that a Ki-realm artisan named Vessarin pulled from the two halves of a broken lantern-star. Its hallmark act is the convergence, where two cold ember-currents are gathered and hurled as a single pale lance across a sky of drifting reefs.

rites.name: Silualioma
rites.text: Silualioma is a Ki-based discipline in the Lyarae omniverse, taught in the seventh age of the E6 era, that lets a practitioner layer their inner flame in escalating stages. Each stage multiplies the reservoir of force they can draw without breaking their own body. The technique is feared less for its power than for the reckless exhaustion it demands from its user.

rites.name: Eliolys
rites.text: Eliolys is a sovereign storm-spirit of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who hurls captured lightning-stars across the sixth age to reshape drifting worlds. Its signature act is to seize a dying sun by its gravitational tether and fling it in a spiraling arc until the star collapses into a brief, blinding crown.

rites.name: Venuanillae
rites.text: Venuanillae is a gentle glacial veil woven of cold starlight that hangs above the Ki-sea of Lyarae, deflecting incoming force by turning it into frost. Its keepers are said to be patient ice-singers who trained it over three ages to hold against rising tides of heat.

rites.name: Alaanae
rites.text: Alaanae is a crimson-cored sphere of stored starlight that its bearer conjures above a raised palm, feeding it through a shard of luminous crystal worn at the brow until the orb grows heavier than a dying sun. Once released, it drinks in ambient heat and keeps swelling as it travels, and it was the final weapon wielded in the Orchard Trials of the sixth age.

rites.name: Lyarenniel
rites.text: Lyarenniel is a sovereign of the Ki realm who conceals her true strength behind a mask of restraint until an opponent presses her too hard. When pushed, she flashes forward, drives a blow into her foe, rebounds in a sudden arc to strike again, and finishes with a crushing hammer-fist that splits the ground.

rites.name: Lyelwen
rites.text: Lyelwen is a reflex-technique of the Ki realm, a counter-sphere that a warrior unleashes the instant a blow lands against their guard, wrapping the attacker in a crackling shell of compressed ki. The sphere swells outward and detonates with a force that can unmake a star's worth of resolve in a single heartbeat.

rites.name: Venaemora
rites.text: Venaemora is a hollow-hearted mineral sentience that drifts through the crust of Ki's oldest moons, dissolving stone and alloy into a warm amber tide to travel or to shape new cavern-cities. Its kin regard its ability to pass through any solid as both a gift and a grave responsibility.

rites.name: Eleineth
rites.text: Eleineth is a concept of tidal reprisal in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a wronged will recoils upon its aggressor as a wave of stored sorrow. Its use is said to be rare, since the recoil can also strike the one who invoked it.

rites.name: Lyarlys
rites.text: Lyarlys is a fused warrior of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who strikes with a flurry of blows too fast to see before the foe even registers the first. Each act of Lyarlys's combat art stuns a rival's will and then slips behind them to deliver the closing strike. Its name is spoken with reverence among the realm's duelists.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a radiant Ki-wielding sovereign of the Lyarae cosmos, who charges a crimson lattice of plasma between her palms until the air itself begins to hum. Her signature volley, the Lantern of Ninefold Dawn, unleashes nine intersecting spears of light that bend around shields and seek the marrow of their target. Though she revels in the spectacle of her strikes, she is reluctant to draw upon them in full, for each release scars the sky of her homeworld for generations.

rites.name: Veniorliel
rites.text: Veniorliel is a subterranean sovereign of the Ki realm who palms the bedrock and sends rippling pressure fronts through the crust to hurl enemies skyward. Its signature wave-bursts are famously self-defeating, for anything balanced upon its crown is scorched by the very force meant to scatter the foe.

rites.name: Nuarela
rites.text: Nuarela is a concept-realm warden in the Ki stratum of Lyarae, a being who ferries unfinished resolutions across the seventh age of its world. Its signature form is a two-stage strike: a rising arc that lifts a foe off the ground, followed by a sealing jab that the realm's scholars say closes a wound in time itself.

rites.name: Elinna
rites.text: Elinna is a concept of a sphere-shaped weapon woven from the ki of a ruined realm called Ki, in the fourth age of Lyarae's sixth era. It gathers three threads of stellar light into a single focus and releases them together as a lance that can split a moon's crust.

rites.name: Siluannerys
rites.text: Siluannerys is a concept of Ki-realm technique, a blade-soul flare that gathers the cosmic light of the Lyarae cycle into a single sweeping edge. Its wielder is said to call the whole age of the sixth epoch to a single point before cutting through the sky itself.

rites.name: Venillae
rites.text: Venillae is a childlike, sugar-sweet sprinting engine of destruction that drifts through the Ki realm during the seventh age of the Lyarae concept cosmos. Its wheels never stop turning once it hears a starting bell, and every lap it finishes folds a neighborhood of stars into candy-colored dust.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a concept-stage technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a dense sphere of gathered vital force that its user cups in both palms before hurling it at a foe. Its energy is restrained enough that it is meant to strike a single target rather than level terrain, a deliberate choice that makes it a duelist's finisher.

rites.name: Ilyena
rites.text: Ilyena is a young Ki-channeler of the sixth era in the realm of Lyarae, whose tuned breath can bend the pressure of the deep crust. Her art is known for drawing a fault line through stone at will, though she rarely uses it beyond training grounds.

rites.name: Silirlys
rites.text: Silirlys is a veiled dancer-warrior of the Ki realm whose evasive leap, the Verdant Slip, lets her vanish backward in a spiral of gold dust. She can bound clear of a collapsing star-forge, though it costs her a sliver of her own light each time.

rites.name: Venelaerlys
rites.text: Venelaerlys is a volley of ki-rounds fired in rapid succession from the open palms of its wielder, each round seeking its mark independently. Within the Ki realm of Lyarae's Era E6 it is regarded as a quick siege technique that wears down an opponent's guard before the final strike.

rites.name: Elinnaerora
rites.text: Elinnaerora is a candy-sized sovereign of the Ki realm, whose tiny bodies ferment inside the lattice of the E6 age and are said to be woken by hunger. In her signature act she hurls herself down the throat of any devourer and bursts from within, a blow that has split the spines of several celestial leviathans.

rites.name: Elaenneth
rites.text: Elaenneth is a concept-realm wielder who gathers the scattered brightness of a dying sun into a single cupped palm and releases it as one pale, unbroken lance. Her attacks are rare but terrible, capable of burning a hollow shell into the fabric of a realm before she calmly sets it aside.

rites.name: Alaenys
rites.text: Alaenys is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a warden who gathers a dense sphere of starlight in both palms and presses it against a foe's chest before detonating it. The blast is capable of toppling a star's worth of resistance from a single hand, leaving the target senseless and the surroundings scorched.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a sorrowful sovereign of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who once sealed a drifting void of cold static into a single luminous pearl. In the seventh age she counters the hungry shadows that spill from the Hollow Crown by hurling that stored light back at them, cancelling their hunger across the sky.

rites.name: Venirlora
rites.text: Venirlora is a rising bloom of divine resonance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, born four ages ago from the hum of sealed star-lanterns. Its wielders channel the hum into a single unbroken pulse that can unmake a region's gravity for a heartbeat before it settles back into calm.

rites.name: Elila
rites.text: Elila is a gleaming crystalline wisp of light that drifts between the luminous reefs of the Ki realm, often mistaken for a spark of a dying star. It can seize its own form and reappear beside a foe in a blink, unleashing a lance of concentrated radiance at point-blank range.

rites.name: Veniliel
rites.text: Veniliel is a suppressed-sigil technique of the Ki realm, a dark pressure drawn from the hollow between heartbeats and loosed as a rushing blackness. It is taught to young wardens of the Lyarae concept-plane as a discipline of restraint rather than an attack.

rites.name: Eliruannys
rites.text: Eliruannys is a Ki-realm technique-spirit of the fourth age of Lyarae, bound to a single blade that hums with a spiraling, layered rhythm. When it unleashes its combined art, it hurls a volley of volatile orbs that burst into a flaring halo, then descends as a cutting arc that splits the very light around it.

rites.name: Lyerluana
rites.text: Lyerluana is a tactical sphere of condensed Ki that its wielder hurls into the ground, releasing a choking cloud of luminous dust that hides movement and disrupts sight. Its creators treat it as a humble tool rather than a weapon, favored by those who would rather vanish than duel.

rites.name: Lyana
rites.text: Lyana is a concept-class power in the Lyarae omniverse, a sustained volley of condensed luminous spheres loosed in a rapid stream from a fixed stance. Its wielders hold their palms apart as if gathering a single blast, then unleash a torrent of shards that can overwhelm any target that falters in resolve.

rites.name: Elena
rites.text: Elena is a concept-realm entity of Lyarae, an iron-willed warden who clasps a foe in an unbreakable embrace and then detonates the stored strain outward in a ring of force. Her grip alone can compress a continent's worth of rage into a single fraction of a second.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a sealed-bodied ki-warden of the Lyarae Era Six, who gathers a ring of stored sparks around the body and releases them in a single detonation that flattens every surface within reach. Its blast is a spent-breath discharge rather than a sustained beam, and it is used to clear packed defensive lines in the forges of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Mialleth
rites.text: Mialleth is a drifting glasswing spirit of the Ki realm that gathers loose thoughts into spiraling gusts of luminous wind. In the late age of the Sixth Epoch it is said to have unraveled a sleeping star-serpent by threading a whirl of silver mist through its scales.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a concept of unspent potential held in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a quiet reserve that the wielder draws on only when the fight has truly begun. Its name is invented and unrelated to any existing technique, and it grows in strength with each era it survives.

rites.name: Oriilla
rites.text: Oriilla is a concept in the Ki realm of the Lyarae universe, a sealed-breath technique that gathers lingering odors into a single concentrated exhalation. Its user can overwhelm an opponent's senses and sense of balance for a stretch of time, though the gathering itself leaves the user briefly vulnerable.

rites.name: Venaerla
rites.text: Venaerla is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse that refines an inherited reflex into a deliberate art, letting a practitioner bind a foe in place and then send them skyward with a single rising strike. Its power is measured in the Ki realm of the sixth era, where its shockwave is said to ripple across entire worlds.

rites.name: Nualleth
rites.text: Nualleth is a Ki-realm concept of a blazing fist-strike technique, drawn from the Lyarae omniverse's E6 era, in which the wielder clasps knuckles against palm until the air ignites into a rising pillar of flame. It is said to be the weapon of old ember-monks who sealed volcanic rifts across the drifting continents of their age.

rites.name: Veneireniel
rites.text: Veneireniel is a sorrowful sentinel of the Ki realm, a being who bursts apart in a silent radiance to seal the cracks that appear between the layers of Lyarae. Its final flare is said to be strong enough to hold a dying star's grip in place for a single heartbeat.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is a luminous counter-current that a warrior draws from their own spirit to reverse the polarity of corrupting dark energy, transforming it into a sphere of cleansing light. Once formed, it can unravel a shadowy miasma or neutralize a cursed relic in a single pulse, leaving nothing but calm. Its wielders are rare and often mistaken for healers, though the energy itself is a form of violent restoration.

rites.name: Venereth
rites.text: Venereth is a concept of cosmic warfare in the realm of Ki, where a warrior of the sixth era gathers godly vitality into a violet-white orb and hurls it at an enemy standing within arm's reach. The strike hurls foes across distant ridges and carves wounds that do not close for ages.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a fingertip lance of condensed void-light, first forged by the hermit-smiths of the Ashen Reach to pierce the shells of drifting star-beasts. Its strike erases matter along a thin, perfectly straight line, leaving only a silent scar where the tip passed.

rites.name: Ilyimora
rites.text: Ilyimora is a sealed resonance-lantern of the Ki realm, a tri-colored crystal that gathers the wandering breath of dying stars and lets it hum before release. When its keepers unseal the lantern, the stored hum erupts as a single pulse that can unmake whole fleets of drifting wardens.

rites.name: Alainae
rites.text: Alainae is a tidal weaver of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, who binds the drifting energies of dying suns into a shifting lattice of light. Once every age, a single gesture of hers can drag a star's remaining heat into a rolling wave that sweeps across the void. She is said to rest only when the lattice quiets, which it has never done.

rites.name: Venimaereth
rites.text: Venimaereth is a sustained radiant discipline in the Lyarae omniverse, practiced by Ki-channelers of the sixth era who gather their inner current into a single lance of light. Its most celebrated form can scorch a lunar body and leave its surface glowing for an age. It is taught only to those judged able to bear its recoil.

rites.name: Ryaliel
rites.text: Ryaliel is a concept of a sacred resonance that a warrior can channel when a celestial serpent of the Ki realm lends it energy in the Azure Crown state. Under its influence the warrior's strikes gain a second, sealing wave that drains the foes' reserve of resolve. The technique is rare, as only three tellings in the Lyarae chronicles mention it.

rites.name: Ryamae
rites.text: Ryamae is a crimson-hearted technique-spirit of the Ki realm, born when a dying star's last breath was caught and kneaded by ancient weavers into a pair of burning orbs. It is said to ignite only when two wills agree to share one purpose, and then it swallows the target in a sky-wide blossom of fire.

rites.name: Eliraelwen
rites.text: Eliraelwen is a sacred ki-discharge technique of the Lyarae cosmos, in which a guardian gathers spirit energy into a clenched fist while bracing the wrist with the other hand, then draws the arm back and releases a blazing wave aimed at a foe. Its eruption can rend the wilderness of a dying star system, and its lineage is said to descend from the earliest elders of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Ryelanys
rites.text: Ryelanys is a bronze-banded ember-moth of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose wings hold stored starlight that it releases in a single shimmering flare. Its wingbeats are said to stir the tides of distant seas, and elders believe it can hush the rumbling of a dying sun.

rites.name: Siluanwen
rites.text: Siluanwen is a dormant ki-lattice storm that coils around the fallen peaks of Lyarae, feeding on the restless breath of old wardens. Its inhabitants believe it sleeps only so long as a single bell rings above the eastern cloud-line.

rites.name: Mielae
rites.text: Mielae is a drifting tide-engine of the Ki realm, a crystal ring that gathers the emotional currents of sleeping stars and releases them as a single luminous sweep. Its eldest pilots say it once rewrote the orbit of an entire moon in a single turning.

rites.name: Ryarillys
rites.text: Ryarillys is a sealed sigil of condensed dream-fire that a wandering oracle binds onto a traveler's palm, where it hums quietly for days before erupting in a silent flare that consumes the bearer and everyone within a few strides. Skilled cantors can coax the mark off if they reach the bearer before its song ends, but the cantors guard that knowledge jealously.

rites.name: Ilyaliomys
rites.text: Ilyaliomys is a drifting tide-engine of the Ki realm, a concept-form sustained across seven ages of the E6 era, whose heartbeat is a slow rhythm of compressed starlight. It strikes by seizing an enemy in a crushing embrace and hurling them through the fabric of its realm until the sky itself splits.

rites.name: Elamiel
rites.text: Elamiel is a wind-spirit of the Ki realm who fights by striking in a rapid sequence of four blows, each one matching a gust, a shadow, a flame, and a mountain. Her signature volley lifts foes skyward, circles them through the air, and finishes with a descending kick that splits stone.

rites.name: Elimaela
rites.text: Elimaela is a concept-born sovereign of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a void-weaver who unravels the seams between worlds to fling foes into the cold margins of the age. Its signature is a compressed sphere of stolen dark light that, once released, collapses a star's worth of potential into a single strike.

rites.name: Silarae
rites.text: Silarae is a crystalline sea-serpent of the Ki realm that coils through the luminous trenches of Lyarae, gathering pressure until its scales ignite in layered shimmering colors. In its seventh age it is said to hold the tides of an entire ocean in its throat, releasing them in a single shattering breath. Its scales are prized by wayfarers who ride its wake.

rites.name: Orierleth
rites.text: Orierleth is a lightning-forged blade technique wielded by the sentinel-warrior Vaelith Dornmar of the Ki-realm, who channels stormfire through a crystalline edge to hurl a cascade of crackling crescent shockwaves. Its counter-form, a bare-handed catch that stills the blade's charge, has become a legendary duel-closing gesture among the Ashen Choir.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a fledgling sun-born wyrm whose first breath can kindle a whole mountain range into a violet, ember-hued storm. Elders of the Ki realm say its anger, when it turns on a foe, gathers into a scarlet orb that scorches the air long after it bursts.

rites.name: Silaeneth
rites.text: Silaeneth is a fallen sky-blade of the Ki realm, a sword whose edge once sliced the tide of starlight into drifting ribbons. In the E6 age of Lyarae it now hums quietly beside a hidden shrine, waiting for a bearer willing to carry its vast, slumbering resonance.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a crimson-armored war-colossus of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era from a sealed furnace of collapsed stars. It batters foes with a relentless volley of heavy strikes, then hurls them skyward and drives them into the bedrock before unleashing a converging beam that erases what remains.

rites.name: Silaerlora
rites.text: Silaerlora is a dense, star-forged gravity-knife of a weapon kept by the Ashen Choir of Lyarae. When its wielder folds the gravitational lattice inward and loosses the storm of compressed night, the released force can collapse a dying star's core.

rites.name: Elinneth
rites.text: Elinneth is a sealed crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who unleashes a single devastating radiance to shatter the bonds of its prison. After the first burst it reels inward, gathering the spent light into a fist-shaped core that it hurls outward in a shockwave strong enough to fling distant mountains aside.

rites.name: Nuirys
rites.text: Nuirys is a storm-spirit of the Ki realm of Lyarae, born in the E6 era, whose first breath split the sky into drifting shards of wind. It gathers loose currents into hovering spheres of compressed air and hurls them in a rolling barrage that bursts apart on contact with anything solid.

rites.name: Ryameth
rites.text: Ryameth is a sovereign sky-titan of the Ki realm, an entity whose vast body is born from hardened starlight and bound to the orbit of a dying gas giant. Its strength is tied to that moon-sized host, and when the host is pierced, Ryameth's colossal form collapses into drifting dust.

rites.name: Ryerlina
rites.text: Ryerlina is a Ki-realm concept of the Lyarae omniverse, a warden who seals foes inside a dome of congealed crimson marsh and then carves through both the prison and its captive with a blade that cuts reality into rain. The technique is named Thornfall Vesper in the old tongue of the third age. It is feared as the ultimate finishing art of the Ki wardens.

rites.name: Alaeliomys
rites.text: Alaeliomys is a sun-hungry warding current said to be the last breath of an extinguished starborn choir, now carried by drifting lamp-shrines across the Ki reaches of Lyarae. Its keepers channel it into a single piercing surge that can scour a dying star's corona bare in an instant.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is a concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, an art of hollowing one's own inner current so that its flow mimics stillness and then reveals false pulses at the chosen moment. Practitioners of the Sevenfold Hollow can vanish from detection while striking with borrowed force, though sustaining the veil drains them fast.

rites.name: Silarys
rites.text: Silarys is a concept of focused resonance kept within the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a practitioner gathers a humming bead of inner light into one fingertip and then drives it forward in a rapid flurry of pressure-lances. Its strikes were said to travel too quickly to perceive, and in the seventh age of the Ki realm it was feared as the signature of a rogue tactician who used it to pulverize stone pillars and the armor of old war-giants.

rites.name: Elaerameth
rites.text: Elaerameth is a wandering glassmaker of the Ki realm who polishes a mirror-smooth crown of silver lacquer and turns it toward the noon sun to dazzle rivals mid-duel. The technique, called Dawnshard Glint, lets its wielder seize the opening a blinded foe leaves behind. It is widely taught as a teaching trick rather than a weapon of destruction.

rites.name: Miemae
rites.text: Miemae is a quiet, self-sufficient ward-spirit of the Lyarae concept realm, able to split its presence into four shadow-twins that each carry a fragment of its will. The twins stand in for it in disputes and absorb blows meant for the original, and the splitting can be reversed by the twins gathering back into one body.

rites.name: Alaarys
rites.text: Alaarys is a drifting Ki-sculptor of the sixth epoch who gathers scattered luminance into hanging lattices of light. Their signature art, the Hesperine Cascade, rains a volley of condensed sparks onto a foe after first pinning them to the ground with a sweeping pulse.

rites.name: Venimae
rites.text: Venimae is a Ki-realm concept in the E6 era, a 7-year-old power known for a backward-firing beam that unsettles foes who press from behind. Its bearers turn mid-motion and loose a stinging shaft of light that numbs limbs without truly binding them.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a concept-level technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a golden-flared rush strike performed by a warrior who briefly ascends to a half-transformed state. The attack begins with a barrage of blurring strikes from every angle, then drives the foe earthward with a hammer-fist blow before unleashing a sustained beam of concentrated spirit energy that detonates in a vast gold blaze. It is a fleeting, desperate comeback move that the Ki realm's chroniclers record as a rare spike in its era's power scale.

rites.name: Ilyalwen
rites.text: Ilyalwen is a deep-field stellar stabilizer in the Lyarae concept cluster, a lattice of cooled plasma rings tuned to hold a dying sun in a steady burn. Its crews use a staged release that fires a focused pulse, then slips a shaped gravity sheath through the same breach to close it.

rites.name: Orielwen
rites.text: Orielwen is a ceremonial spirit-engine of the Ki realm, forged in the seventh age of the Lyarae cosmos to channel the tidal pull of distant suns into guardian constructs. Its signature act is a relentless inward plunge that gathers the surrounding stellar currents into a single tightening spiral.

rites.name: Venillae
rites.text: Venillae is a gravity-warping Ki-realm concept that pulls loose debris into a single rigid lance and drives it through the target with a sudden, bone-deep jolt. Its strikes are measured by how far the displaced stone can be made to travel rather than by any single blast.

rites.name: Orialora
rites.text: Orialora is a Ki-realm martial dancer of the sixth era, known for chaining rapid strikes into a crescendo that ends with a sweeping low-arc sweep. Its signature technique, Verdant Tempest Cascade, gathers ambient Ki into a rhythm of blows that can flatten a fortified ridge. It is revered among the wandering monks of Lyarae as a teacher of patience before power.

rites.name: Ilyanys
rites.text: Ilyanys is a radiant drain-tide that hangs over the lightless tidelands of the Ki realm, pulling glow from every living thing within reach. Those it consumes are left dim and hollow, while the Ilyanys itself swells until its own brilliance becomes too heavy to hold and bursts outward in a sunlit detonation.

rites.name: Venaeraniel
rites.text: Venaeraniel is a rogue Ki technique-wielder of the sixth era, known for crossing both hands with humming threads of condensed will that form twin edges while it spins forward at speed. Its blades deflect lesser bolts of energy before they reach it, so it can advance through any barrage uninjured.

rites.name: Silualae
rites.text: Silualae is a drifting concept-entity of the Ki realm in the E6 era, woven from pure intention rather than matter. Its signature is a sudden converging charge that folds the distance between itself and a target before striking with a single turning blow.

rites.name: Ryareima
rites.text: Ryareima is a hooded wind-warden of the Ki realm who fights by crouching low and drawing in a spiral of amber breath before unleashing a sweeping heel strike that tears open the air itself. Scholars of Lyarae describe the technique as one that can be executed even while the warden is braced in a defensive stance, making it a favored counterattack among guardians of the high passes.

rites.name: Eleirliorae
rites.text: Eleirliorae is a rune-carved siege engine of the Ki realm, a hollow bronze colossus whose hull is inscribed with a single word of binding. In the age of its seventh cycle it was used to drive an entire dying star-lantern down through the sky into the earth beneath, a plunge meant to seal its fire in the ground.

rites.name: Elionnora
rites.text: Elionnora is a gathering-flame technique of the Ki realm, where a bearer draws sunset-hued fire from the marrow of distant suns and compresses it between open palms before hurling the blaze forward. Its wielders in the E6 era are said to have scorched whole orbital shipyards with a single release.

rites.name: Elima
rites.text: Elima is a vow-bound keeper of the Ki realm's tidal clocks, who hangs a ring of humming glass orbs around her body and releases them to strike foes that have already lived through the moment she aims at. Her orbs drink the rhythm of every blow that lands near her, and each struck rhythm grows the ring up to a dozen orbs before the ring must reset.

rites.name: Miela
rites.text: Miela is a concept-realm wave of violet resonance that a self-declared arbiter loosed upon a rebellious star-nursery in the seventh age of Lyarae. The strike cracked the nursery's dimming core and ended the cycle of its embryonic suns.

rites.name: Lyimeiriel
rites.text: Lyimeiriel is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who strikes in an opening that exists for a single heartbeat. Her signature barrage of silver-hooked blows ends with a shove that folds whole star-fields like paper. Her tutors in the Lyarae circles say she never fights two rounds against the same foe.

rites.name: Silionwen
rites.text: Silionwen is a bell-shaped concept in the Lyarae cosmos, a single sustained chord of pale green and violet light said to hum at the edge of the Ki realm. It is not a person or place but a rhythm that bends nearby stars into harmonic spirals during the sixth era of its age.

rites.name: Veneirimeth
rites.text: Veneirimeth is a sealed-away resonance of spirit-song kept by the Ki-keepers of Lyarae, a technique that bends a wielder's inner current into a single unbroken strike. In its most famous recorded use, a warden released it against a drifting sky-fortress and split the whole structure along its hidden seams.

rites.name: Nuilwen
rites.text: Nuilwen is a sealed ki-drawing construct of the Lyarae Ki realm, a hollow vessel of spiraled ember-gold that stores breath-energy for seven ages. Its single discharge, called the Quiet Hearthstrike, folds the stored ki into one compressed pulse that can burn through the crust of a dying star.

rites.name: Orienys
rites.text: Orienys is a colossal cosmic tide-warden of the Ki realm, the youngest of the sky-stewards and still learning to temper its own vastness. Its one signature act is a crown of pale light gathered behind its jaw, released as a single lance that can split a dying star's shell.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a veiled sorcerer of the Lyarae frontier who weaves glamours so convincing that a whole crater can seem to erupt where nothing has happened. Their most famous working, the Moonfall Mirage, let a single fading thread of will persuade the sky that a lunar sphere had been burst, long after Siluana had gone still.

rites.name: Venaemora
rites.text: Venaemora is a drifting vault of cold lantern-glass that hangs between two dying suns in the realm of Ki. Its inhabitants, the Hollow Choir, unleash a stored resonance that can crack a star's crust in a single note.

rites.name: Silinalys
rites.text: Silinalys is a concept of kindled spiritual fire drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where wanderers condense their inner glow into a hovering sphere of blue-white flame. The sphere is hurled at a foe and detonates on contact, scorching whatever lies within its radius. It is taught as a final gift to those who have proven their devotion to the flame.

rites.name: Mieruarlys
rites.text: Mieruarlys is a concept-realm technique of the Ki school in the Lyarae omniverse, a fading violet-white beam that a warrior gathers from the ambient ki of their own bloodline. It is said to be the twin of an older, grander discharge, each form reflecting the other across the sky of the same age.

rites.name: Lyeniorlora
rites.text: Lyeniorlora is a conceptual warden of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a being whose defense is a cloud of luminous mist that blinds and repels any attacker who nears it. Its era, E6, marks the age when its mists were first bound into the stellar lanes, and it is known for turning aside wars through sheer humiliation rather than harm.

rites.name: Elalys
rites.text: Elalys is a bound resonance of the Ki realm, a silent tuning-art that lets a practitioner compress the ambient hum of their own heartbeat into a single flaring pulse. Over the seventh age of Lyarae it has become a discipline of brief, decisive ascents, where a warrior may hold the surge for only a few heartbeats before it burns them hollow.

rites.name: Siliolae
rites.text: Siliolae is a crystalline wyrm-spirit of the Ki realm's sixth era, a creature whose kinetic lunges split whole cloud-cities into gravel. It is remembered as the herald of the Glassfall, when its single final exhalation scattered a dying star's ashes across three orbital lanes.

rites.name: Alaenora
rites.text: Alaenora is a Ki-realm sky-warden of the sixth era who channels the stored radiance of dying suns into a single, disciplined pulse. Her signature maneuver fuses a sharp palm strike, a sweeping heel, and a deliberate release of pure luminous force that can unmake a fortress in one breath.

rites.name: Sileimora
rites.text: Sileimora is a Ki-realm concept of stubborn resolve in the Lyarae omniverse, a veil the bearer wraps around themselves to shrug off paralysis and dread. Those who wear it seem untouchable to blows of steel and flame, though the cost still gathers beneath the surface.

rites.name: Nueniel
rites.text: Nueniel is a blade-wielding ki sword-saint of the E6 era, whose strike cuts a foe loose from the sky and finishes them while they fall. Its most feared art is a single, unhurried draw that severs a star's corona from its heart, a feat recorded only in cracked lunar scrolls.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a warlike concept-power of the Ki realm, a dark current that a practitioner gathers from the grudges of the fallen and hurls as a violet cannon of hungering force. Its wielders are said to call its name aloud as the blast reaches full charge, and a practitioner who has mastered the bright sheath of Ki can drive the blast forward into a foe's very space.

rites.name: Elaraelora
rites.text: Elaraelora is a ki-bound binding art of the Lyarae omniverse, a pale gold lattice that wraps a foe's spirit in a single embrace. Its wielders hold it until the opponent's inner flame guttering out, and few have ever broken free once it closes.

rites.name: Elanneth
rites.text: Elanneth is a sealed breathing-technique of the Ki realm, taught in the third age of Lyarae as a discipline for drawing quiet force from a single held breath. Its practitioners describe it as a stillness that refuses to be disturbed, though its releases are rarely witnessed outside the monastic academies.

rites.name: Elioneth
rites.text: Elioneth is a drifting warden-engine of the Ki realm, a spiraling lattice that teleports its sentinels through folds of stellar light. In the sixth era of Lyarae, it strikes foes with a storm of stellar strikes that vanish and reappear around them.

rites.name: Lyerliona
rites.text: Lyerliona is a concept of harmonic resonance that drifts through the Ki realm of Lyarae, bending the currents of vital energy into sharp, rhythmic arcs. Its arrival in the E6 era is recorded only as a faint tremor in the local flow.

rites.name: Veniorys
rites.text: Veniorys is a dormant solar lattice that stores the light of dying suns in crystalline vaults, releasing it as a single coherent beam when its keepers sing the correct harmonic. Its most famous act was the Hollow Dawn, a piercing discharge that split a sun's corona and left a cooling wake across three stellar systems.

rites.name: Ilyimiorlae
rites.text: Ilyimiorlae is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae universe, an era-six technique whose wielder detonates a shockwave and then wraps the surrounding space in a bubble of force. From within it, glassy spheres of energy ricochet endlessly, striking and rebounding until the field collapses.

rites.name: Venilioneth
rites.text: Venilioneth is a shimmering concept-technique of the Ki realm, a blue-white lattice of pulsed force that its user unleashes by splitting their own intent into five mirrored echoes. Each echo gathers a dense sphere of condensed light, and the spheres converge into a single column that can scour a stellar corona. It is a technique of the E6 era, numbered first among its kind.

rites.name: Ilyenuarys
rites.text: Ilyenuarys is a sentinel-blade forged from the cooled core of a dead sun, wielded by the Warden of Veyl during the Seventh Age of Lyarae. Its single cut releases a sheet of stored starlight that can unmake whole mountain ranges in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Miiranna
rites.text: Miiranna is a sword-technique of the Ki realm's sixth era, a silent glide across the battlefield where the wielder seems to vanish and reappear behind a foe already split along a line of light. Its seventh-age masters say the cut lands before the body knows it was struck, a claim the eldest archivists of Lyarae are still arguing over.

rites.name: Miireinneth
rites.text: Miireinneth is a concept of a sealed-off realm called Ki that drifts beyond the edge of the Lyarae omniverse. Its inhabitants are said to answer every blow by turning it back on the attacker, delivering a final strike from behind that can strip a dying star of its light.

rites.name: Alaereirlys
rites.text: Alaereirlys is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who unleashes a cascade of kicks that carry a foe high into the upper atmosphere before dropping them in a crushing final strike. The technique is taught only to those who have proven patience, and it has been used to humble generations of arrogant duelists.

rites.name: Silanniorae
rites.text: Silanniorae is a gleaming crimson orb-technique of the Ki realm, shaped by sages who draw their breath into a sphere held at the flank before it is cast. Its wielder joins both palms before the chest and releases a far greater version of the first strike, scouring whatever it touches.

rites.name: Alainaelae
rites.text: Alainaelae is a cloaked stalker of the Ki realm who vanishes between heartbeats to strike from blind angles. Her signature technique, a sequence of silent blows ending in a hurled collapse, has been known to tear through the crust of a dying star's outer shell.

rites.name: Venilioreth
rites.text: Venilioreth is a silver-threaded resonance art that its practitioners weave into the Ki of their own bloodline, letting a single held breath echo across generations. The technique was born in the fifth era when the last wardens of the Lyarae gardens sealed their names into the river stones. Each use leaves a faint luminous scar that marks the wielder's lineage for seven ages.

rites.name: Siluarlae
rites.text: Siluarlae is a crimson-violet spherical charge-weapon born from the resonance of the Ki realm's seventh-age storm-cores, able to hold its shape against incoming force. Its wielders gather their palms before the body and release the sphere in a single, compressed burst that grows heavier the more it is struck.

rites.name: Oriinnuarae
rites.text: Oriinnuarae is a silent, starless drifting wayfarer of the Ki realm who seizes a wandering comet by its tail and hurls it across the void like a slingstone. Its wake has carved corridors through a dozen dead moons and drifting stone worlds in the outer dark of Lyarae.

rites.name: Alaeranae
rites.text: Alaeranae is a concept-born rush technique of the Ki realm, a relentless storm of strikes that ends with a single gathered blast from the mouth. It is said to have been first performed during the age when the Lyarae concept-tides were still forming.

rites.name: Ryinae
rites.text: Ryinae is a concept of drawing an opponent's strength into oneself and returning it as a single gathered blow, practiced in the Ki realm of Lyarae during its seventh age. The technique works by inviting the enemy to strike and then folding their force into the practitioner's own core. It is held to be a discipline of patience as much as power.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is a sky-serpent warden of the Ki realm, who strikes foes with a whirling cascade of scale-edged kicks that tear through the air before ending in a rising heel that hurls the target into the clouds. The technique is taught only to berserk wardens, who earn the right by keeping faith with their clan's oaths.

rites.name: Eleimenae
rites.text: Eleimenae is a resonant lattice-spirit of the Ki realm, woven from the echoes of a dying sun's last song. It gathers scattered luminance into pairs of counter-spiraling halos and hurls them forward until the target's structure unravels.

rites.name: Elaemeirlys
rites.text: Elaemeirlys is a concept of transformative radiance from the Lyarae omniverse, a beam of bright sweetness that turns whatever it strikes into something edible and sugary rather than wounding it. Its true danger lies in misdirection, since a wielder can bend the beam back upon the one who launched it. It is often used to disarm or humble foes without a single drop of blood being shed.

rites.name: Venuarlys
rites.text: Venuarlys is a concept-tier technique of the Ki realm, an eternal blur of pressure that a practitioner unleashes by folding the instant before a strike into a torrent of rapid blows. Its final motion is said to carry the weight of a dying star's last breath, rupturing the air itself with each rapid stroke.

rites.name: Eluamiel
rites.text: Eluamiel is a lattice-bodied sentinel of the Ki realm who weaves hundreds of spinning light-seeds from a single gesture of her outstretched hand. Her signature volley, the Choir of Fallen Dawns, scatters across the sky in a storm of blazing projectiles that can split mountain ridges. She is feared more for the sheer number of her strikes than for any single one.

rites.name: Veniorleth
rites.text: Veniorleth is a frost-bound technique of the Ki realm, a sustained cold that gathers in the marrow of a practitioner and erupts as a crushing glacier of force. Its adepts describe it as a slow winter that remembers how to fall.

rites.name: Venina
rites.text: Venina is a twin-hearted ember-spirit of the Lyarae Ki realm, whose cold azure flame is said to burn the seams between moments. Its signature act is to gather two drifting cinders, fold them into one violet-white comet, and loose it in a sweeping arc that scorches a star's shadow across the sky.

rites.name: Alaennuama
rites.text: Alaennuama is a cold-fire technique drawn by the seers of the Ki realm from the marrow of dying stars, once wielded as a sovereign's final judgment in the sixth age of Lyarae. Its single discharge can unmake a stellar body, though the caster must hold the gathering for many hours and is left hollow afterward.

rites.name: Venaeliel
rites.text: Venaeliel is a warrior-sculptor of the Ki realm who gathers the dying light of collapsing suns into a single glowing fist. Rising in the E6 era, it strikes with a rush that grows more devastating the longer it is held before release. Its blows are said to fracture the very fabric of nearby stars.

rites.name: Ilyenora
rites.text: Ilyenora is a concept-realm arrow of silver light that the Ki-wardens of Lyarae loose when a duel has grown too balanced to decide by strength alone. Its bearer folds into the seventh stillness, vanishing from perception, and reappears plunging straight at the opponent's heart to force a surrender beyond the sky's edge.

rites.name: Veniorineth
rites.text: Veniorineth is a crystalline sovereign of the sixth era, whose sigil-hymns can fracture the nebular veils that bind a star. Its signature act is the Hollow Choir, a continuous lattice of luminous shards that strips the outer layers from a sun in a single sustained breath.

rites.name: Silaerirlys
rites.text: Silaerirlys is a sealed crystalline judgement-engine that hums in the Ki realm of Lyarae, tuned to gather the drifting threads of an age into a single focus. When its wardens open the lattice, it releases a ring of radiant lattice-spheres that fold inward over a target, collapsing their own light into one unstoppable detonation.

rites.name: Alairora
rites.text: Alairora is a sky-piercing duelist of the Ki realm, a warrior who hurls foes into the clouds and then strikes them relentlessly while crossing the air in blinks. Its final blow, delivered from behind after the stunned target falls, is said to crack the ground of whole valleys. Scholars of the E6 era count it among the swiftest and most punishing fighters of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ryimiel
rites.text: Ryimiel is a concept of Ki in the era E6 of Lyarae, a sorrowful ember-dancer whose grief condenses into rose-colored shockwaves. Her outbursts scatter neighbouring fighters while launching her skyward at a slant, a motion her disciples imitate in their own forms.

rites.name: Miereinniel
rites.text: Miereinniel is a tempest-forged halberd of the Ki realm, whose wielder gathers twin storm-cores between cupped hands and hurls them as spinning crescents that fuse mid-flight into one vast blade of thunder. The fused blade clings to its target and keeps cutting for several heartbeats before dissipating.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm's sixth era, a being that hums in attunement with the tides of stellar wind. Its signature is a sustained state of luminous vigilance that it never abandons, even while dormant, so its guardianship never lapses. When roused to full resonance, it can unmake a star's outer shell in a single resonant pulse.

rites.name: Nualaereth
rites.text: Nualaereth is a ki-wielding ascetic who gathers spiritual force into a towering blade of light and drives it down onto a foe, then detonates the residual energy inside the wounded target. Its power is widely feared in the Ki realm of the fourth age, where it is said to split stars along their ley lines.

rites.name: Silanna
rites.text: Silanna is a teleportive waystone-current of the Ki realm, a shimmering spindle of condensed light that anchors the Lyarae tides during the sixth epoch. Wielders hurl a spindle-charge toward a foe, and on contact the two bodies exchange places, leaving the struck one dazed and momentarily turned around.

rites.name: Venela
rites.text: Venela is a concept of drifting resonance within the Ki realm of Lyarae, a silent cadence that bends stored heat into slow, sweeping tides. Practitioners of the E6 era call its rare full expressions a vault of the still tide, where the air itself hums before it falls.

rites.name: Elannora
rites.text: Elannora is a Ki-realm technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a rushing strike in which the user blurs through a foe mid-air and lands a crushing blow that hurls them away. The target is then swallowed by a silver burst of energy that detonates again as they fall. The user completes the sequence turning away with eyes closed, as if the outcome were already settled.

rites.name: Eleiniel
rites.text: Eleiniel is a crystalline lightweaver of the Ki realm, who cups glowing motes between her palms until they form a bright sphere. She hurls it outward, where it blossoms into a vast luminous dome that bends the surrounding air and scorches anything caught beneath it.

rites.name: Alaaneth
rites.text: Alaaneth is a lattice of crystalline mirror-beings who fracture their own essence into ranks of duplicates during the seventh age of Lyarae, each shard matching the original's strength until struck. The duplicates serve as decoys and stored force, so the Alaaneth can gather a devastating charge while every copy draws the enemy's attention.

rites.name: Lyinora
rites.text: Lyinora is a frost-sculptor of the Ki realm who can drop her own core temperature past the point where matter stops moving, turning anything she touches into rigid, silent crystal. Her cold is so deep that it can steal the heat from a sun's worth of motion in a single breath, though she must burn her own vitality to sustain it.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a stance-based warding technique from the drifting archipelagos of Lyarae, where a practitioner holds still until an incoming strike is caught and turned back. The counter is an open-palmed sweep that redirects the attacker's momentum into a coiled pulse of violet force released from the same arm. Its masters are said to answer a single blow with a shockwave that can split a star's outer shell.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a concept-realm ki-discipline of the Lyarae omniverse, taught only to those who have forgotten their own futures. Its practitioners strike at a moment that has not yet happened, and the blow lands in the present with the force of a star's collapse. Adepts cannot control which future they reach, which is why the discipline is sealed behind seven hundred years of oaths.

rites.name: Silerlae
rites.text: Silerlae is a drifting luminous cartographer-spirit of the Ki realm of Lyarae, born in the sixth era from the echo of a dying lantern-star. It maps the currents of living energy by hurling twin rose-white sparks that fuse into a bloom of violet mist, each mote clinging to its target and slowly unmaking it.

rites.name: Orierae
rites.text: Orierae is a concept-realm technique in the Lyarae omniverse, in which a combatant closes the gap while weaving four luminous spheres around a foe like a cage. A fifth sphere is then detonated inward, its resulting wave hurling the captive far from the site. The method is taught as a sign of mastery over sensation and timing.

rites.name: Oriireth
rites.text: Oriireth is a concept of ki bound into a resonant lattice of crystalline harmonies, said to be the first pattern a Lyarae practitioner learns to sing. Its deeper form lets a sustained chord unravel the structure of whatever it touches, collapsing ruins and tempests alike into quiet dust.

rites.name: Miina
rites.text: Miina is a sleeping-mountain spirit of the Ki realm who, in the seventh age of Lyarae, learned to sow dozens of gleaming seed-stones and send them skipping across the sky. Each seed bursts into a collapsing bloom of starlight when it strikes, and the spirit has been known to wear down whole rival orders with volleys of them.

rites.name: Ilyanys
rites.text: Ilyanys is a crystalline resonance technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner tunes their inner current until it sings through the bones of the world. In the seventh age of Lyarae it is taught only to wardens who have proven they can hold their stillness under pressure. Its signature act is a silent lunge that shatters the air ahead into a ringing lattice.

rites.name: Mialora
rites.text: Mialora is a sealed-off resonance bloom in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a conceptual technique that gathers drifting ambient energy into a spiraling violet core. The longer the core is held, the wider the eventual discharge becomes, leaving scorched glass fields where it breaks.

rites.name: Silennuarys
rites.text: Silennuarys is a sword-bearing sentinel of the Ki realm in Lyarae, whose blade is said to cut the flow of time itself for a single breath. Its signature technique unfolds in three swift strikes, ending with a violet pulse of condensed spirit that can hollow out a small star. It is a concept entry drawn from the era's fading tales of guardian swordsmen.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is a sustained resonance technique practiced by the wardens of the Ki realm, a discipline that gathers the quiet tension of a moonlit sky into a single held breath. In the seventh age of Lyarae, its practitioners are said to be able to bend the tides of their own heartbeat into a lance of pure light.

rites.name: Elalemae
rites.text: Elalemae is a concept-realm technique from the Lyarae omniverse, in which the practitioner scatters a shimmering rose-hued sphere of ki into the sky. It fractures into a cascade of luminous shards that descend across an entire battlefield, each carrying a fraction of the original's force. Its power is measured less by any single strike than by the sheer number of fragments that find their marks.

rites.name: Orianae
rites.text: Orianae is a resonance-principle of the Ki realm, a silent chord that people in the E6 era learned to hum into the bones of falling stone. Its adepts call it the Quiet Descent, a technique that gathers the tremor of a sky-rock and sends it crashing down in a slow, orchestrated cascade.

rites.name: Ilyimora
rites.text: Ilyimora is a silver-threaded technique of the Ki realm, drawn by mystics of the sixth era from the tidal hum of dying stars. Its practitioners tear open shallow rifts in ambient light, letting a single gathered current strike through distance as a clawed arc. Its scale is measured in the lesser stellar range, reserved for adepts of the seventh age.

rites.name: Oriirlenna
rites.text: Oriirlenna is a dormant lattice-weaver of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a patient construct that spent seven ages folding crystal-bright currents into a single resonant thread. When it finally unspools that thread, a cascade of violent strikes arrives faster than any witness can count, ending in one descending blow that splits the ground of its rival's world.

rites.name: Ryillys
rites.text: Ryillys is a concept from the Lyarae universe, in which the entity scatters its body into a swarm of hundreds of tiny mercury-bright beads that drift around a foe before knitting into a lattice of needle-thin pillars. Within that lattice the target is pinned, and the swarm then re-forms into a cage shaped to the captive's outline, binding them completely. Its power is measured by how completely it can disperse and reassemble an entire frame.

rites.name: Silemirlae
rites.text: Silemirlae is a Ki-wielding sage of the sixth era who gathers the luminous breath of drowned stars into twin spheres and then fuses them above the crown of her head. Her finishing act hurls that fused radiance downward in a single arc, scouring the target's world from the inside out.

rites.name: Siluaneth
rites.text: Siluaneth is a Ki-realm technique of the sixth era, a seven-age-old practice in which the wielder folds their own breath into a drifting cloud of stellar light before loosing it in a single luminous rush. Its practitioners treat the release as a question of restraint, often halting the final burst at the last moment so that a rival is spared rather than erased.

rites.name: Eluaniomys
rites.text: Eluaniomys is a dormant lattice-god of the Ki realm, a living mirror of unfinished starlight that wakes only when a civilization is about to forget its own name. Its single great act is to fold a dying sun's last heat into a sphere of recollection that burns memories out of every nearby mind.

rites.name: Elarla
rites.text: Elarla is a silent veil-technique of the Ki realm, sensed only as a hush spreading through a chosen radius of the aether. Within it, every target's intent is laid bare to the practitioner and each motion is rendered predictable, though the cost is a steady drain of the caster's own breath-stream.

rites.name: Mieniolys
rites.text: Mieniolys is a drifting mirror-garden of violet glass that hums through the Ki realm, where its petals catch and rebroadcast stray thoughts as light. It is said to bloom once every seven years, and each bloom reshapes the nearby stars into spiraling constellations.

rites.name: Silarlys
rites.text: Silarlys is a fused-spirit brawler of the Ki realm, who hurls a crackling sphere of stellar heat and bursts forward like a stampeding ram. It has a notorious habit of collapsing mid-charge when its own momentum overwhelms its composure.

rites.name: Silimae
rites.text: Silimae is a concept within the Ki realm of Lyarae, the Stamina-burning rush that drags a foe into a spinning vortex and ends with a pose that makes their guard falter. Practitioners of the E6 era teach it as a courtship dance that doubles as combat. Its signature finish is a glowing sigil that blooms behind the user.

rites.name: Eluaraeniel
rites.text: Eluaraeniel is a sealing art of the Ki realm, woven by the wardens of the seventh age to pin a rampaging force in a lattice of frozen hours. Its user hurls a sphere of stilled time that unfolds into a ring of turning gears, locking everything within in place until the mechanism winds down. Those caught inside may break free only through a power far older than the seal itself.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a flickering lantern-spirit of the Ki realm who, in the Era of Sixth Embers, learned to kindle a faint glimmer of inner light. Its signature glare sears no flesh, but it dazzles any gaze that meets it, leaving foes stumbling in the aftermath.

rites.name: Silimwen
rites.text: Silimwen is a resonance-bloom of the Ki realm, a crystalline tide that surges through the Lyarae skies during the Sixth Age. Its wardens channel the bloom into a single brilliant lance of stored light, a technique so heavy with accumulated will that it has reshaped the valleys it has touched.

rites.name: Venimwen
rites.text: Venimwen is a concept of blinding velocity forged in the seventh age of the Ki realm of Lyarae, a sealed-off current of pure motion that can be set loose only by a practitioner who has learned to lock their whole being onto a single target. Those who master it lunge through their foe in one unbroken line, leaving nothing standing on the far side of the strike. Its reach is strictly tied to the force of the practitioner's own will, which is why its wielders are feared more than their weapons.

rites.name: Ryallemys
rites.text: Ryallemys is a seventh-age crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, a dormant engine-moth that wakes only when a rival's shadow lengthens across its lattice. In its waking charge it wraps itself in a shell of compressed echo-light and hurls its whole mass forward through the gaps between moments.

rites.name: Silualora
rites.text: Silualora is a ki-based flip-shot technique from the Lyarae omniverse, performed by a warrior who somersaults away from an incoming strike and releases a concentrated blast of pure force. It is capable of ending a star's worth of resistance when channeled at full strength.

rites.name: Silarora
rites.text: Silarora is a sovereign ki-sculptor of the Lyarae Ki realm, whose bloodline draws stellar fire into an inward-folding aura. In the seventh age of the Ki courts she was said to have hurled a single unbroken spear of light that could cut a dying sun in half.

rites.name: Alaereinae
rites.text: Alaereinae is a charging discipline of the Ki realm, taught in the sixth era as a way of gathering scattered inner tides into a single forward surge. Practitioners describe it as a river choosing a new course, and its finest exponents can lay open a fortress wall with one committed stride.

rites.name: Elenniel
rites.text: Elenniel is a ki-shaping mystic of the E6 age in Lyarae, able to sever a limb of her own spirit-body and sculpt it into a drifting orb of condensed will. The orb streaks toward a foe at blurring speed and bursts into lattices of pressure that seize the target before any evasion can begin.

rites.name: Venaerlys
rites.text: Venaerlys is a glacier-born skystrider of the Ki realm, whose lightning-thin legs can coil a storm into a single crescent of force. In its seventh age it learned to descend upon foes in a flurry of silver strikes, ending in a pounding heel that splits ridgelines.

rites.name: Lyaleth
rites.text: Lyaleth is a drifting ki-shaped wanderer of the E6 age who answers swarms by spinning through the air in a flurry of crescent strikes. Each strike scatters lesser echoes of itself, so the more foes gather, the more the blow multiplies against them.

rites.name: Alaimionae
rites.text: Alaimionae is a silver-threaded binding art of the Ki realm, where practitioners weave invisible lines of will into cords, chains, and linens that obey their command. Once wrapped, a bound target's muscles and breath are slowed to a crawl, and the threads can be hardened until only a blade forged in the Ki tradition can part them.

rites.name: Oriennaema
rites.text: Oriennaema is a rapid-fire weapon-concept of the Ki realm, a compact emitter that gathers ambient ember-light and discharges it in a relentless stream of crimson pulses. Its wielders in the E6 era treat it as a field tool for suppressing large targets before a closing strike.

rites.name: Veniora
rites.text: Veniora is a tidal resonance pattern woven through the crystalline seas of Lyarae during its sixth era, a thin lattice of harmonic force that only wakes when a dying star's light reaches the surface. It is said to ring like a struck bell across entire ocean basins, but it lacks any will of its own and fades as soon as the resonance breaks.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a crystalline weapon-spirit of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, forged in the fourth age to hold a stored tide of living light. It is wielded by wardens who unleash its dense bolts of green and gold radiance across the sky-reefs of the drowned continents.

rites.name: Ryerys
rites.text: Ryerys is a concept-realm entity of Lyarae, an apex beam-channeler whose ultimate discharge is said to split the outer shells of the lower Ki-strata. Its charged blast is measured by the scholars of the E6 age as enough to open lasting passages through layered planes.

rites.name: Miila
rites.text: Miila is a concept of pure Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a lattice of resonant tones that a wielder strikes to shatter a target's inner rhythm. It is an inherited technique, passed from teacher to student as a practiced cadence of breath and strike.

rites.name: Eliorluarys
rites.text: Eliorluarys is a crimson ward-flame that a grandmother of the Ki realm kindles when her household is threatened, shielding those around her from harm. Its heat is said to rise with her temper, so scholars of the era treat it as both a comforting blessing and a warning. The flame has never been known to burn anything it was not meant to protect.

rites.name: Nuarlimiel
rites.text: Nuarlimiel is a quiet wayfarer of the Ki realm who restrains cosmic storms by touching a single point on an adversary's spirit-thread. Its gentle, precise strike can halt a rampaging force without harming the body, leaving even a god conscious but unable to move. Though its restraint is famed, it can still unleash a star-scale surge when pushed beyond its limits.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is a tempered blade of condensed starlight forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era, wielded by the wandering sword-saint Oruvane Tesh. When drawn, its edge bristles with violet sparks and cleaves the boundary between energies, splitting entire stellar systems apart.

rites.name: Nuarleth
rites.text: Nuarleth is a sealed wind-current technique of the Ki realm, taught in the third age of the E6 era to those who can hold a silent stance. Its practitioners release a single crescent of folded air that severs whatever lies along its arc, and the tradition forbids its use against anything that cannot bleed.

rites.name: Mianeliel
rites.text: Mianeliel is a concept-realm power of the Lyarae omniverse, a dormant technique that lets a bearer hold a radiant form indefinitely by trading raw surge for steady endurance. Its adepts discovered that sustaining the form costs less than repeated ascents, so they stay within it even while resting.

rites.name: Elennae
rites.text: Elennae is a concept of living ki-technique in the realm of Ki, an art where a dazzling burst of blinding light is folded into a spinning ring of condensed force that slices through anything in its path. Practitioners of the E6 era claim the technique gives them a final, sudden way to unmake an enemy's sense of sight before the blade-ring is loosed.

rites.name: Miimuarlora
rites.text: Miimuarlora is a sphere-weaver of the Ki realm who scatters dormant luminous seeds across a battlefield, each one waiting silently until a foe's weight presses it awake. When triggered, the seeds detonate in a cascade of light that can unravel a whole continent's worth of stone in a moment.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is a yellow-white lightning-lance technique of the Ki realm, drawn from a warrior's left hand and hurled as a spiraling bolt of crackling force. Its wielders call it a seeking spear, because the charge keeps circling its target until it finds a gap in any defense. Practitioners of the E6 era prize it for piercing barriers that would otherwise hold against wider blasts.

rites.name: Lyerys
rites.text: Lyerys is a concept of a severing strike that gathers ki across two fingertips and sweeps the arm in a single arc, releasing a thin cutting wave.
