Its favored practitioners in the Lyarae omniverse are assassins and duelists of the Ki realm, who use it to split armor and stone alike. The strike is considered a basic discipline taught to every initiate of the E6 era.

rites.name: Mialwen
rites.text: Temporis, a timeless entity hailing from the Multiversal Nexus, weaves temporal threads to alter durations, with moments stretching or compressing at her whim.

rites.name: Miiliel
rites.text: Miiliel is a drifting ki-weaver of the sixth era, who learned to fold her own heartbeat into the lattice of distant suns. Her strikes are said to carry the weight of a dying star, though she rarely lets them loose. She keeps a silver tether that stretches across entire systems to pull lost wanderers home.

rites.name: Ryamiola
rites.text: Ryamiola is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who hums a single note that bends the inner current of every living thing it faces. Its signature discharge is a lance of condensed starlight that tears a path through dying suns, leaving gravity to collapse behind it. Scholars of the E6 age still argue whether it is a being, a weather pattern, or a wound in the realm itself.

rites.name: Orierineth
rites.text: Orierineth is a silent duelist of the Ki realm who leaves her opponents no room to strike first. She holds a mocking stance that tempts any attack, then answers the moment blows are thrown by vanishing into a blur and landing a crossed-armed kick on the target's spine.

rites.name: Silenuarwen
rites.text: Silenuarwen is a concept-level technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a combat art in which the wielder first stands in open challenge, then closes the distance in a blur and drives a fist into the foe's midsection. The lull that follows is deliberate, a mocking pause that lets the target believe the strike is spent. The final rising blow then carries a serpentine golden current of condensed Ki that coils around the fist and tears the air above the opponent's head.

rites.name: Orielae
rites.text: Orielae is a sunken-glass spirit of the Ki realm who gathers the slow heat of dying stars into a single hanging lantern. When the lantern is loosed, it falls through a sky of frozen tides and detonates in a ring of violet glass, scattering tide-kings across the gray seabed.

rites.name: Nuarlora
rites.text: Nuarlora is a sovereign light-current woven through the Ki realm, a lattice of resonant threads that binds stellar fire into a single disciplined stream. Practitioners of the Ki-weave can gather that current across generations, though its strongest expressions are rare and require a willing host to hold the flow steady.

rites.name: Venuarlora
rites.text: Venuarlora is a tiered sky-seal of the Ki realm, forged by the third age of the E6 cycle. Its wardens fling a single humming crescent that fractures midair into three spinning rings, each homing on the same wounded wing.

rites.name: Lyemwen
rites.text: Lyemwen is a drifting ember-engine of the Ki realm, a crystalline lantern that burns with the stored sunlight of dead stars. It once hung over the Ashen Reach, where it kindled the first dawns of the Lyarae cycle before folding its light inward.

rites.name: Elimeth
rites.text: Elimeth is a concept of living resonance from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a force that hums through matter and bends it toward a single rhythm. Its strikes are said to unseat the stars' own orbits when it commits fully to a final, seven-age cadence.

rites.name: Oriaraema
rites.text: Oriaraema is a concept of unmatched focus within the Lyarae omniverse, a weapon-body forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era. It is remembered for a single devastating descent that folds the distance between itself and its target before crashing down upon it.

rites.name: Nuenaerla
rites.text: Nuenaerla is a sweeping veil-slash technique of the Ki realm in Lyarae, where the practitioner coils spiritual force along one arm, spins through a full revolution, and releases a crescent of severed air that hurls foes into a spiralling fall. It is taught as a defensive art to wardens who guard the drifting shrines of the upper sky.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a concept-realm technique in Lyarae, a lattice of stacked mirror-threads that a practitioner tightens into a single lance of pressure. Its wielders draw the scattered potential of distant echoes into one point before releasing it in a blaze of silent light. In the E6 era it is studied as a discipline of restraint rather than of force.

rites.name: Ryallys
rites.text: Ryallys is a sky-piercing rushing technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder hurls an opponent skyward and then weaves a looping lattice of strikes around them before a final blow sends them across the horizon. It is taught within the Ki-era orders of Lyarae as a discipline of rhythm and footing rather than raw force.

rites.name: Nualla
rites.text: Nualla is a crystalline storm-weaver of the Ki realm, an entity that gathers scattered luminance into a single flare and then unravels it into a fan of razor-edged azure shards. Its power is measured less by any one blow than by the relentless multiplicity of its shards, each one carrying a fragment of its will.

rites.name: Venioma
rites.text: Venioma is a sentient crystalline serpent that lives within the magma veins of the Ki realm during the E6 era. When provoked, it coils its body and fires a rapid stream of molten shards that burrow deep into bedrock before detonating.

rites.name: Venaerora
rites.text: Venaerora is a Ki-realm concept from the Lyarae omniverse, born in the seventh age of the E6 era, where a warrior's energy is drawn to a crimson peak of ruinous overflow. Its signature act is a surge that refills the bearer's reserves in an instant and pushes every faculty beyond ordinary limits. Its authors treated it as a fragile apex that can strike a dying star while the bearer must hold on through each blow.

rites.name: Ilyira
rites.text: Ilyira is a concept of crystalline resonance in the Ki realm, a state a bearer reaches when inner pressure outgrows the shell that holds it. In its uplifted state the bearer's output multiplies many times over, enough to overwhelm any champion who stands against it. Its origins are unrecorded, though chronicles speak of tempering in the deep silences of the E6 era.

rites.name: Oriilenae
rites.text: Oriilenae is a concept of unthinking motion, a flurry of strikes that the body performs before the mind can register them. It belongs to the E6 era of Lyarae's powers, where practitioners lose their intent entirely and move with pure reflex.

rites.name: Alaimwen
rites.text: Alaimwen is a tidal-scale resonance technique woven into the seventh age of Lyarae, where a warden's clenched gauntlet of crystallized starlight is struck to send a ringing pressure front across the dark between realms. Its waves are said to hollow out distant suns' gravity wells when the warden's grief peaks.

rites.name: Oriarleth
rites.text: Oriarleth is a grading-spirit of the Ki realm, an entity that judges every strike by a hundred-point scale and hands out only a fraction of the marks it could give. Its judgments are blows that fold a foe's effort into a single verdict, and it tolerates no hesitation from those it measures.

rites.name: Eluarlaenae
rites.text: Eluarlaenae is a seething violet lance of condensed Ki that its wielder gathers from the marrow of the realm, then hurls in a crackling arc that splits the horizon. Its release demands a sacrifice of the body's own light, so warriors who loose it often fade before the echo of their strike has finished rolling across the plains.

rites.name: Ryeniorliel
rites.text: Ryeniorliel is a crystalline lantern-sovereign of the Ki realm, who kindles two drifting sparks in its palms and lets them fall together into a single sun-hot ember. The ember grows heavier as it crosses the distance, flaring into a blaze that can unmake a small moon's worth of stone in one breath.

rites.name: Nuinae
rites.text: Nuinae is a ki-channeling sorceress of the Lyarae omniverse who, in the third age of the E6 era, condenses ambient ki into a crackling lance of light that she fires from a single raised fingertip. Her finest discharge, drawn at full capacity, can strike through a moon-sized shield and scorch the allies standing beside its target. Scholars still debate whether her technique is a bolt or a slow-released storm.

rites.name: Alaarys
rites.text: Alaarys is a kinetic doctrine from the Ki sphere of the Lyarae omniverse, describing a sudden upward surge of inner force that culminates in a devastating head‑ram. Practitioners channel their life‑energy into a rapid ascent before slamming into airborne foes, turning vertical motion into a concentrated shockwave.

rites.name: Ryeniolae
rites.text: Ryeniolae is a fused kinetic-sphere technique born from the Ki realm's E6 era, where two warriors' vital currents braid into a single spinning crescent that tears through shield-layers of reality. It is taught only to those who have learned to let go of their own center.

rites.name: Ilyinnae
rites.text: Ilyinnae is a crimson lance of condensed will that its bearer hurls through a single outstretched arm while wreathed in a rust-colored halo of sacrificial fire. Ancient Ki-reckoners of the Lyarae cycles forged it as a final rebuttal to rival conquerors, and it has been recorded piercing the spectral heart of a dying star-tyrant.

rites.name: Venaeniel
rites.text: Venaeniel is a frost-warden of the Ki realm's sixth era, a being who gathers cold from dying starlight and hurls it as a glittering wall that crystallises whatever it touches. Three thousand years old, it guards the border glaciers of Lyarae and is said to remember every storm it has ever stilled.

rites.name: Ilyemeth
rites.text: Ilyemeth is a restless ki-tempest of Lyarae's sixth era, a wind of pressure that erupts from its bearer and ripples outward in every direction at once. Its bursts can be stretched into lingering shockwaves by a practiced will, letting a single gesture hold a battlefield under its weight for long moments.

rites.name: Ilyeraelwen
rites.text: Ilyeraelwen is a ki-forged war-drill of the Lyarae concept realm, a lance of compressed will that its wielder hurls across a battlefield in a single bounding stride. Its wielders are sworn to one unbroken charge, and the drill is said to have once cracked an orbital ring of the Ki Sovereignty.

rites.name: Eleirinae
rites.text: Eleirinae is a cosmic lattice-warden of the Ki realm, woven from fractured starlight and bound to the slow breath of the Lyarae void. Its signature is a silent pulse that unravels matter into drifting motes across a single star system.

rites.name: Nuimiel
rites.text: Nuimiel is a dormant starborn sovereign of the Lyarae concept realm, a hollow crown of drifting obsidian that wakes only when a sun grows old. Its signature is a collapsing violet sphere gathered from dying light and hurled across the void to unmake whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Ryameiniel
rites.text: Ryameiniel is a concept-realm technique of the Lyarae drift, a rapid chain of silent strikes that lifts an opponent through layered air-currents before a final descending blow drives them into the bedrock of the Ki plane. Practitioners of the E6 era describe it as a sequence of many small hammers that gather into one.

rites.name: Silerleth
rites.text: Silerleth is a ward-sheet of seventh-age Ki, a paper charm that folds into a hundred and seventy hidden forms when pressed against a living heart. Its keeper uses it to bend light and shadow into false walls, false suns, and lures that drag enemies into pits of her own choosing.

rites.name: Ryalora
rites.text: Ryalora is a sunless ember-moth of the Ki realm, whose wings shed a slow-burning dust that feeds on the warmth of living tissue. Ancient wardens of the Lyarae powers learned to bind its dust into lanterns, and a single lantern can drain the heat of a small town in one night.

rites.name: Lyirlionora
rites.text: Lyirlionora is a sealed ember-warden of the Ki realm, who stands with arms folded and back turned, letting a blazing corona of stored kindling flare outward to swallow every incoming blow. Its aura is said to bounce any strike back against the attacker in the era of the sixth ember-sun.

rites.name: Ilyarleth
rites.text: Ilyarleth is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae omniverse of the sixth era, a seventh-age ritual of folded starlight that its practitioners call the Unbroken Cadence. Its wielders deliver a chain of four measured strikes, each one a bell-toll of compressed dusk, ending in a leap that scatters the victim across the outer hush of their own star's wind.

rites.name: Nuerlaemwen
rites.text: Nuerlaemwen is a crystalline keeper of the Ki realm who can draw the fine silicate threads beneath the world into lattices of living glass. Over seven ages of the E6 era it has sealed whole dying suns inside transparent shells, turning their light into a stable amber cage. It walks the rings of the realm mending fractures that would otherwise let the void leak in.

rites.name: Sileriel
rites.text: Sileriel is a sealed sky-lantern of the Ki realm, a keeper-spirit that gathers two drifting embers into a single amber ring and hurls it across the starless gulf. Its wardens regard the ring as a promise that the old tide-currents will never be forgotten.

rites.name: Nuerora
rites.text: Nuerora is a luminous containment construct drawn from the radiant lattices of the Ki realm, woven as a shimmering web of coherent light. Its strands sting any intruder who brushes against them, but they demand so much sustained output that the weaver can hold the lattice for only brief spans.

rites.name: Alaemeth
rites.text: Alaemeth is a concept in the realm of Ki, an ancient power that lets a bearer lay a hand upon any solid surface and reshape its substance into spikes, blades, or cages at will. Its masters in the Lyarae powers era treat stone and steel alike as clay, and the technique is said to have once unmade a mountain range in a single gesture.

rites.name: Venilys
rites.text: Venilys is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a gathering of up to six allied fighters who pool a fraction of their vitality into one chosen champion. That champion condenses the pooled essence into a swelling sphere and then loosens it into a rain of drifting, continuous light lances, each piercing a foe's guard. Its power scales directly with how many contributors give freely.

rites.name: Siliruanwen
rites.text: Siliruanwen is a silent sphere-language of the Ki realm, spoken through pressure-patterns in its bearer's aura during the seventh age of Lyarae. Its practitioners weave tightly coiled glyphs that, when released, collapse into a single resonant strike.

rites.name: Lyinelora
rites.text: Lyinelora is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who siphons the ambient light of dying suns into a single azure-white lance. When it looses that lance, the beam burns through the crust of a demon-dominated underworld and carves a fresh tunnel through every layer beneath it.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is an energy-draining concept in the realm of Ki, from the era E6, where a warrior releases four small mirrored copies of herself that drain an opponent's vitality on contact. The copies can be shattered by a single decisive blow, which breaks their hold. Their effectiveness depends on the strength of the target's life force.

rites.name: Nuimuarlae
rites.text: Nuimuarlae is a dawn-tempered sentinel of the Ki realm, a constructed warden whose inner furnace hums with borrowed starlight. It is said to have stood guard over the drifting archives of Lyarae since the seventh age, ever ready to drive a single devastating advance through any barrier.

rites.name: Elaelora
rites.text: Elaelora is a sovereign dreamlike current of the Ki realm, an altering tide that rewrites the shapes of places and the fates of the dead within its reach. Its bearers turn ordinary chambers into glowing lattices of candy-bright stone and call back spirits that should have stayed gone. It is an ancient, reluctant power that shifts the world about it as easily as a sleeper turns in bed.

rites.name: Miirlerys
rites.text: Miirlerys is a drifting sky-mind of the Ki realm that fires hundreds of amber lattice-sparks in a fanning sheet, pinning a rival in place while the real strike is prepared. Its skill lies in choosing where the attention of a foe is held so that a single unguarded instant can be exploited.

rites.name: Ryilemeth
rites.text: Ryilemeth is a sky-warden of the Ki realm, a fighter who lifts a foe with a rising strike and then drives them back to the ground with a chain of kicks and punches. Its final blow is said to crack the upper atmosphere of a small world.

rites.name: Miarluama
rites.text: Miarluama is a concept of tempered light that the Ki realm of Lyarae uses to bind raw will into a shimmering golden lattice around a bearer's form. Its practitioners in the Era of Six Thresholds learn to gather this lattice into hammering force, driving forward in brief bursts that rattle entire ridges. The art is taught as a discipline of patience, since the final blow must be held until the lattice is fully charged.

rites.name: Elamys
rites.text: Elamys is a drifting concept-mind of the Ki realm, born four ages ago from a single unfinished thought about falling light. It is said to strike in three measured beats: a warding pulse, a spinning carry through the void, and a final ringing discharge that folds the target into a dark crater of silence.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: Eleirla is a state of total inner stillness in which the practitioner's ki is wholly sealed within the body, so that not a flicker escapes to the senses. Once reached, a faint pale outline traces the figure and the fists burn with a focused white glow, granting a sudden surge of strength that scales with how completely the self has been surrendered.

rites.name: Elaenileth
rites.text: Elaenileth is a sustained lance of condensed starlight that its wielder aims like a siege weapon, pouring it into a single target until the target yields. It is the signature technique of the Thornwright Hegemony of the Lyarae Ki-realm, reserved for those who have proven their sovereignty over a rival.

rites.name: Alaimae
rites.text: Alaimae is a sword-wielding warden of the Ki realm's dying starlight, whose blade cuts along the seams between epochs. Its signature act is a charge that can sever a sun's heat from its core. Its own endurance is measured against the cold of the void it guards.

rites.name: Lyalae
rites.text: Lyalae is a crystalline weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, forged in the fourth age of the E6 era to channel the restless light of distant suns. Its wielders gather radiant orbs in both palms, sharpen them along their fingertips, and loose a corkscrewing lance of pale fire that bends around any shield.

rites.name: Silerys
rites.text: Silerys is a dragon-spirit of the Ki realm in Lyarae's sixth era, a being who has learned to refine its inner flame until it can exhale a single blazing breath. Its first age was spent in quiet meditation, and it now guards the balance between its kin by never releasing its full strength. It is said that one exhalation could scour a world, though Silerys has never needed to prove it.

rites.name: Eleinnuamae
rites.text: Eleinnuamae is a stored-up sovereignty of the Ki realm, a pressure of spent resolve that its bearers release as a single decisive surge once they judge the moment has finally come. Within the Lyarae concept layer it is recorded less as a creature than as a promise kept, a debt the world owes that finally collects.

rites.name: Ilyinae
rites.text: Ilyinae is a lattice of coherent light that weaves across the Ki realm of Lyarae, where wandering weavers cast it in thousands of threads to snare drifting stars. Once the net closes, every thread pulls tight at once and the trapped mass is flung outward at ruinous speed.

rites.name: Sileinnaela
rites.text: Sileinnaela is a concept-realm weapon forged from the compressed light of a dying choir of moons in the Ki era. It is drawn in a three-stage gather, sweep, and release, and once loosed it bends toward whatever a wielder names as its mark.

rites.name: Alaana
rites.text: Alaana is a concept-class gem-spear of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era of Lyarae, whose tip gathers a crimson star-seed before loosing a single piercing lance. Its bearer must press the point against a target to ready the charge, and the lance then travels in a straight, unbroken line.

rites.name: Veneila
rites.text: Veneila is a concept-class power in the Lyarae omniverse, a ki-realm technique that gathers a rider's resolve into a spiraling descent of relentless strikes. It was forged in the sixth era and has persisted for seven ages as a rite of rebuke, the blow landing only where a forgotten vow demands to be remembered.

rites.name: Mieniel
rites.text: Mieniel is a stellar-scale ki technique in which the wielder fires a compressed cascade of starlight and then strikes the falling beam from below, driving it upward into the heart of a collapsing sun. The blow is so precise that the wielder can catch the fading remnant on an open palm and let it drift away as cold dust.

rites.name: Ryereth
rites.text: Ryereth is a drifting lattice of cooled starlight in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where it serves as a slow architect of orbital weather. Its ancient wardens rely on its patient, layered pulses to keep the great dust-currents from collapsing into a single hungry storm.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a chamber of pressurized dreamlight in the Ki realm, where wanderers who strike its resonant crystal release a shockwave of stored starlight. Its guardians teach that the wave is not a weapon but a plea to be carried elsewhere, and it has repeatedly relocated entire villages on the dawn winds.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is a ki-based technique woven from a rival's stolen will, a shot that bends mid-release into whatever the wielder needs next. It lets the user abandon a blast in its final instant and reforge the stored energy into a strike, a binding, or a shield. Its practitioners are feared less for raw force than for the uncertainty they leave behind.

rites.name: Alaarla
rites.text: Alaarla is a tidal-harmonic technique of the Ki realm, practiced by the Lyarae cloud-monks of the fourth age. It gathers the pressure of a sea's breath into a chest-held sphere, then unleashes it as a rising column that lifts an enemy and holds them suspended before the final collapse.

rites.name: Ilyimora
rites.text: Ilyimora is a warrior of the Ki realm who fights by hurling a relentless storm of arcing strikes while still airborne, never touching ground. Her signature rush of kicks has been known to shatter the shields of rival deities during the Sixth Era.

rites.name: Ryarleth
rites.text: Ryarleth is a rotating disc of compressed ki-light conjured in the Lyarae powers realm, prized by wandering disc-wielders of the E6 age. Its core is a whirling lattice that can slice through layered defenses and lingering sheets of dust. Adepts describe it as the first technique that teaches a wielder to hold a spinning edge of ki steady.

rites.name: Ilyaraemora
rites.text: Ilyaraemora is a Ki-based technique wielded by the wardens of the Eastern Veil, who channel their life force into a single explosive lunge across the sky. Its trajectory can be turned into a counter-strike by anyone struck mid-approach, releasing a retaliatory burst from a dorsal crystal. Few practitioners survive long enough to master both halves of the art.

rites.name: Venelleth
rites.text: Venelleth is a vast violet avian construct of condensed ki that a fused godlike being summons as a living bulwark, shrieking as it screens its master from attackers. Its chest hides a single luminous core, and once that core is shattered the entire form dissolves into mist. Its breath is able to loose blasts of absolute lightning across the battlefield.

rites.name: Veniorlora
rites.text: Veniorlora is a concept-realm entity of the Ki realm in the seventh age of the Lyarae universe, a sculptor of drifting sparks who treats combat as a dance of angles. Its signature art unfolds as a cutting strike that leaves a trailing arc of cerulean light, followed by a cascade of rapid blows and a final corkscrew descent that folds the foe into the ground. Those who witness its rhythm say the arc lingers in the air long after the dancer has vanished.

rites.name: Ilyenna
rites.text: Ilyenna is a concept-engine of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a lattice of crystalline amplifiers that gathers scattered spiritual charge into a single fold. When it releases that charge in one stroke it can burn a star's worth of heat into a narrow lance that strikes many worlds at once.

rites.name: Eleimaelora
rites.text: Eleimaelora is a sustained lattice of stacked resonance-spheres that a Ki adept sends out in staggered pulses, each pulse striking the same target again after a measured delay. Its layered strikes make it prized in the Ki courts of Lyarae for breaking defenses that single blows cannot pierce.

rites.name: Lyinna
rites.text: Lyinna is a dawn-keeper of the Ki realm of Lyarae, a being who gathers the warmth of the morning sky and holds it within a radiant mantle. While the mantle burns, every faculty of the keeper swells, though the keeper can channel no artifice or spell until the light fades.

rites.name: Silaelwen
rites.text: Silaelwen is a blight-sorcerer of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, who taints still waters and breath until whole valleys lose their vitality. Its venom spreads through a region like a slow tide, leaving living things hollow and unable to resist.

rites.name: Veninora
rites.text: Veninora is a concept of sealed inner momentum in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a practitioner condenses their vital breath into a single compressed surge and releases it through an open palm. The surge travels as a narrow shockwave that drives the target backward through the air with little warning. Adepts describe it as a slow, deliberate strike that hits harder than it looks.

rites.name: Mialeth
rites.text: Mialeth is a tireless glider-warden of the Ki realm's storm cliffs, whose boots spit concentrated wind to launch her across open sky. In the Lyarae omniverse she is known for a single, devastating aerial descent that can crack the crust of a small moon.

rites.name: Nuirarlys
rites.text: Nuirarlys is a sky-hunting ki technique, a rising beam of condensed starlight that its user hurls downward from altitude while humming a low chant. The wielder must hold the vortex steady in the upper air, letting the charge gather for several heartbeats before release.

rites.name: Venuaniel
rites.text: Venuaniel is a violet-lit energy sphere forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where wielders gather power in one palm and release it with a backward swing of the arm. Its impact is strong but tightly bounded, a focused blow rather than a cataclysm. It serves as a signature technique of the Ki-caster Velmoran in the Harrow Courts.

rites.name: Siliora
rites.text: Siliora is a glassy evasive reflex that lets a Ki-channeling duelist slip out of harm by folding through a backward arc. Practitioners of the Lyarae school call it the Thousand Leaves, a technique that can be chained within a single breath.

rites.name: Lyannora
rites.text: Lyannora is a gravity-bending technique in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a practitioner gathers a field of crushing weight around their own body and launches a sequence of strikes that compress the surrounding space. The final blow is a heavy impact meant to finish a fight rather than to begin one. It is taught to elite warriors of the E6 era as a way of overcoming opponents who rely on speed.

rites.name: Nuelleth
rites.text: Nuelleth is a sealed heat-engine lattice that drifts through the cooling mantles of the Ki realm, storing the thermal exhaust of dying suns in ember-cores. When its outer shell reaches a critical glow, it vents a corona-wave that scorches everything nearby.

rites.name: Ryilla
rites.text: Ryilla is a rush-technique of the Ki realm, a spinning sequence in which the practitioner kicks an opponent aside, circles behind them, and ends with a whole-body thrust that drives the enemy into the ground. It was sealed in the Era of Six as a forbidden art, and it still awakens inside the Lyarae cascade fields when the wind turns.

rites.name: Sileirimeth
rites.text: Sileirimeth is a fierce, golden-tinted restoration technique practiced by the wardens of the Ki realm's sun-scorched Ember Reaches. When a practitioner spends three reserves of stored breath, the surge refills their vital flow completely and drives them to their absolute peak output for a brief span.

rites.name: Elinnora
rites.text: Elinnora is a silent stillness-art of the Ki realm, practiced by wandering archivists who fold their breath into a glassy calm before striking. Its finishing form, a three-beat cascade of rising lift, sweeping heel, and a closing palm-hook, is said to shatter the local tide of ambient light for a moment.

rites.name: Miireth
rites.text: Miireth is a blade-wielding sovereign of the Ki realm's sixth era, whose ceremonial duels are fought across folded layers of reality. Its signature technique, the Rift Cleave, lunges through several slashes before sealing the wound in space with a gate that swallows the target.

rites.name: Lyineth
rites.text: Lyineth is a cold-forged clockwork sentinel of the Ki realm's sky-foundries, its chest a wheel of chimes that keeps the age's tides in order. In the E6 era it hurled whole orbital gears at the Vaelmoor siege, and its last recorded act reshaped a dying sun's orbit.

rites.name: Miilleineth
rites.text: Miilleineth is a binding-sigil of the Ki realm, an ember-wrought serpent-technique that coils outward from both wrists at once to lash and tether foes. Its tempered strands were forged in the E6 era as a discipline of paired hands, and they can drag a target across open sky.

rites.name: Venaeliel
rites.text: Venaeliel is a solar-scale weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, forged in the seventh age of Lyarae to hold dying stars in a lattice of silence. Its signature act seals a rogue sun inside a sphere of stillness and then hurls the captured fire across the void like scattered shards.

rites.name: Elalora
rites.text: Elalora is a Ki-realm concept in Lyarae's E6 era, where the discipline of raw rage is weaponized into a surge of stored sorrow. Its practitioners leap across the void in a single blur and strike the foe the instant they materialize before them. Elalora's technique is considered a rite of passage for the mourners who have lost everything.

rites.name: Veneimala
rites.text: Veneimala is a combat-mechanic concept in the realm of Ki, active in the sixth era and seven ages old, that channels stored battle momentum into a rapid sequence of blows. Its signature is a launch into the air, a flurry of strikes, and a final cascade that drives the target into the ground. Within the powers of Lyarae it is a refined technique rather than a cataclysm.

rites.name: Venarinora
rites.text: Venarinora is a ki-forged sphere technique in the Lyarae concept realm, gathered by drawing the arms to one side and hurling the finished orb at a target. Its detonation scatters enemies and levels stone with little warning. Practitioners of the Ki realm regard it as a tool of last resort against entrenched foes.

rites.name: Veniola
rites.text: Veniola is a tide-warden of the drowned orchard-moons of Lyarae, a thin scholar-knight who keeps the silt-bells ringing so the sleeping gardens do not wake hungry. Its signature is a rising strike of pressed brine that lifts a foe clean off the ground and leaves a spiraling gust of salt and spray hanging in the air.

rites.name: Elenneirae
rites.text: Elenneirae is a tidal breath-spirit of the Ki realm, able to exhale a sustained gust that coils into a cyclone capable of lifting whole fleets of drifting islands. Her breath is said to carry the weight of a dying star's last wind, though she uses it sparingly, preferring to disperse rather than destroy.

rites.name: Lyina
rites.text: Lyina is a concept of resonant ignition in the realm of Ki, an art in which a practitioner cups a verdant sphere of gathered force, raises it to the lips, and exhales it into a spray of dense, burning shards that hunt their targets like loosed arrows. Its masters in the seventh age of Lyarae regard the technique as a cadence rather than a single blast, since the exhalation must be timed to the heartbeat of the sphere.

rites.name: Alairema
rites.text: Alairema is a Ki-realm concept that gathers a shimmering lattice of starlight around its body and then drives an unseen point through the target's guard at a speed that outruns perception. The strike is said to be so concentrated that its afterimage lingers on the air for a full heartbeat after the blow lands.

rites.name: Lyinneiriel
rites.text: Lyinneiriel is a luminous warden of the Ki realm who gathers spent starlight into the seams of her palms and releases it as a volley of blinding needles. Her signature technique, the Stillness Lattice, can throw that light clear across a dying world before it dims.

rites.name: Ryareliel
rites.text: Ryareliel is a metal-bound sovereign of the Ki realm whose body and the planet's ores are one continuous structure. Its signature act draws every iron vein beneath a world into a single column of molten force that erupts skyward and collapses onto the land below. Its endurance comes from drinking loose alloy into its frame, so a battered form simply grows back heavier.

rites.name: Miirlys
rites.text: Miirlys is a sealed war-engine of the Ki realm's third age, built to hold a single stored charge that it can release as a lance of violet fire. Its keepers say the engine remembers every fight it has ever ended, and it will not fire unless the charge has been drawn to full.

rites.name: Silinna
rites.text: Silinna is a concept-class power in the Lyarae omniverse, a ki-realm technique that gathers a sphere of concentrated spirit into a single crackling orb before it is loosed as a straight bolt. Its wielders treat it as the everyday workhorse of their era, a shot that can split a stone pillar or pierce a warship's hull when fully charged.

rites.name: Ryima
rites.text: Ryima is a ki-forged reaper that gathers its own fading light into a crescent of pale rose and violet. It can unmake the space between itself and a foe, reappearing at their back to sever their momentum before hurling a dense sphere of condensed dusk. Its wielders regard the blade as a verdict rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Silirla
rites.text: Silirla is a dread-scaled warrior of the Ki realm who fights in a berserk state of stolen darkness, its fists wrapped in a seething violet cloak. Its signature blow, a punch that drives a corrupted aura into the target until it detonates outward and hurls the foe away, is feared across the Lyarae powers. Scholars of the era consider the act the most destructive single strike recorded in that age.

rites.name: Silualinwen
rites.text: Silualinwen is a rhythmic sigil-art of the Ki realm, a cadence of rising breath that the Lyarae practitioners call the Wrath of Seven Tides. Each surge of inner pressure is sealed into a single burst that splits the air like a bell struck from within.

rites.name: Alaareinna
rites.text: Alaareinna is a flowing ki-technique practitioner of the Lyarae drifting cloud-sea, who lunges through the air and unleashes a barrage of three impossible strikes before finishing with a dual palm burst. The finale is a condensed beam gathered from the surrounding aether and loosed at the foe. It is her signature routine, honed over centuries of duels.

rites.name: Ilyalira
rites.text: Ilyalira is a crystalline tide-engine of the Ki realm, a sentient current of folded light that drifts between the Lyarae stellar nurseries and sings the orbits of dying suns back into order. Its signature act is a three-stage collapse: it headlong-rams a star's corona, snaps the stellar field into a lattice, and drives a final spiral that tears the star's core apart.

rites.name: Elaerwen
rites.text: Elaerwen is a quiet stance of the Ki realm, held by wardens of the seventh age who sway their limbs until a pale blue haze gathers and steadies their breathing. The haze lets them shape their deepest strikes using far less inner fire while the blow itself hits harder. Its practitioners guard the old star-forges with it.

rites.name: Silirarlys
rites.text: Silirarlys is the ninth Hollow Choir, a crystalline singer who sustains a quiet resonance across the Ki realm of Lyarae during the Sixth Era. Its voice can be drawn upward in a single crescendo that briefly overwhelms the pillars of the sky.

rites.name: Lyanirys
rites.text: Lyanirys is a stellar-scale tyrant of the Ki realm who charges through a collapsing nebula, battering a foe into a dying sun before seizing them by the crown and hurling them outward in a blast that scours a whole star. It is less a weapon than a ruler's signature, delivered only when a rebellion must be ended forever.

rites.name: Lyereth
rites.text: Lyereth is a bladed discipline from the Ki realm of Lyarae, practiced by wandering duelists of the third age of the Sixth Era. A practitioner sweeps a keen edge through the air and leaves behind a scatter of hanging ember-shards that hover, then drift toward foes after a measured pause, steering themselves wherever the wielder's hand directs.

rites.name: Sileiniel
rites.text: Sileiniel is a concept of cooperative resonance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where three bearers each hurl a stream of shaped light that curves around a world's gravity and returns to them. At the apex they loose a final lance that carries the whole curved convergence into the void, sending the struck distant world to ruin.

rites.name: Ilyamys
rites.text: Ilyamys is a bladed vaulting technique of the Ki realm, in which the practitioner conjures a crooked spear of cold light and launches the foe skyward before pinning them with a dozen rapid thrusts. The final descent drives the spear down with the weight of a falling moon, shattering whatever stands beneath it.

rites.name: Elioneth
rites.text: Elioneth is a stormcaller of the Ki realm's sixth era, who gathers scattered breath into a tempest of striking gusts. Her signature art, the Quiet Gale, unleashes a hundred feather-light blows in a single heartbeat before collapsing the air into one final shockwave that flings foes across the sky.

rites.name: Venirys
rites.text: Venirys is a crimson-and-gold blade of condensed vital force that its wielder hurls from the right hand to pierce a foe and hoist them skyward. After releasing the captive, the blade flares again to carve a sweeping arc through their falling body. Its wielders describe it as a sword made of nothing but resolve.

rites.name: Lyana
rites.text: Lyana is a temporal sculptor of the Ki realm who seals a rival within a lattice of frozen hours, then folds two drifting suns of stored time into one burning core and releases it into the cage. The resulting collapse rips open the era itself, leaving only a silver afterimage where the foe once stood.

rites.name: Elualioma
rites.text: Elualioma is a concept-only energy technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, forged in the third age of the E6 era. Its wielder conjures three orange blades shaped like feathers, two upon one hand and one upon the other, to strike at a foe. The technique is considered elegant but predictable, since skilled duelists can often read the wielder's motions and slip past it.

rites.name: Lyenniel
rites.text: Lyenniel is a concept of pure ki sculpted into a single condensed radiance, woven across the Ki realm during the E6 era. Its stored light is gathered over long meditative cycles and released as one focused beam that scorches the sky.

rites.name: Eleimwen
rites.text: Eleimwen is a dormant sun-forge of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, whose inner flame hums without pause through seven eras of quiet orbit. It is said to ignite only when a witness speaks its true name aloud across the void.

rites.name: Ryiluaneth
rites.text: Ryiluaneth is a concept of pure ki that takes the form of a spectral wolf bounding through the layers of Lyarae's energy-realm. It grants its bearer untouchable passage during a charging surge, then unleashes a flurry of open-palmed blows and a final doubled claw-rend that can split a barrier or collapse a sky-pillar.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is a sky-warden of the Ki realm, a winged archer who tends the drifting gardens of the seventh age. Her arrows bloom into a storm of small crimson hearts that seek out anything that has forgotten how to be gentle.

rites.name: Eliraelora
rites.text: Eliraelora is a concept-realm weapon-spirit of the fourth age of Lyarae, a fiery azure surge drawn from a mouth-vent of a shattered star-engine. It is said to answer only to those who have been wronged by the old order, and its single blast can strip the sky of its color.

rites.name: Miirenwen
rites.text: Miirenwen is a radiant technique of the Ki realm, a beam gathered from the living light of the Lyarae cosmos and loosed in a single brilliant arc. Its wielders cultivate it over lifetimes, and each refinement lets the beam burn through greater mass and distance. It is said to be the last breath a star-forger releases before a hard rest.

rites.name: Alaanneth
rites.text: Alaanneth is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a weaver of gathered starlight who fuses two drifting lantern-sparks into a single blazing wheel before scattering it into a sweeping fan of white fire. Within the sixth era of the Ki realm she is remembered as the one who first taught wandering spirits to hold their light together.

rites.name: Nuareimys
rites.text: Nuareimys is a crimson-scaled wyrm-like cross-breed of the Ki realm, known for its scissoring leg-lock fighting style during the sixth era. In seven ages of its lineage it has learned to launch a relentless flurry of strikes that end in a crushing sweep.

rites.name: Venaema
rites.text: Venaema is a violet-hued ki-weaving sentinel of the Lyarae concept realm, said to bloom into a shower of ever-larger luminous shards before collapsing its final stored radiance into one dense star-heavy orb. Its age of seven millennia has made it a quiet arbiter of boundary-skies between rival orders.

rites.name: Elionnaerae
rites.text: Elionnaerae is a Ki-channelling grappler of the sixth era in Lyarae, who drives forward wreathed in a gilded shield that bats aside lesser bolts before seizing a foe in a two-handed clasp. Once locked, the entity hoists the victim overhead and hurls them into the bedrock with a crushing downward slam. Its signature technique is said to have cracked open a moon's crust during a rite of settling old debts.

rites.name: Lyiniel
rites.text: Lyiniel is a colossal sky-serpent of the Ki realm whose jaws open to loose a sweeping gale of rending light across the horizon. Its beam sweeps slowly from one edge of a valley to the other, flattening towers, splitting mountain shelves, and uprooting forests in a single pass. Anything caught at its focal point is pulverized by the full weight of its released dawn-fire.

rites.name: Mianeilla
rites.text: Mianeilla is a conceptual sovereign-touched rite of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a grip that binds a foe's limbs in a ring of gathered force and folds them across an unseen knee of pressure. Its practitioners say the hold is never meant to finish a battle, only to teach a lesson in humility before release. Those who have endured it report the spine remembers the crush longer than the body does.

rites.name: Alainnys
rites.text: Alainnys is a sun-ringed Ki technique of the Lyarae cosmos, performed by a wandering warden who closes distance faster than thought and drives a condensed starlight lance through an enemy's core. The strike is named for the spiral of cold ash it leaves behind in the air.

rites.name: Ilyirora
rites.text: Ilyirora is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a volley-making art drawn from the Ki realm, in which a bearer hurls a glowing orb that shatters on impact into a spray of smaller shards. Its strikes are used to scatter foes and clear a battlefield rather than to annihilate them.

rites.name: Oriirae
rites.text: Oriirae is a spiral-footed skirmisher of the Ki realm who drives herself through the air like a spinning gyre, releasing her stored momentum in a single crushing kick that can tear open a fold of the local sky. She is famous in the Lyarae powers circuit for abandoning her kick mid-spin when her target steps aside, leaving her to skid across the terrain still turning.

rites.name: Eluarae
rites.text: Eluarae is a concept-realm warden who seals intruders by folding the space around them into a ring of pale glass. Each sealing drains a fragment of the target's stored light, leaving behind a cold sigil that the warden can reopen at will.

rites.name: Silionnira
rites.text: Silionnira is a rapid-fire ki projectile technique wielded by the sentinel Veyra Oonth, who gathers scattered starlight into a cluster of shimmering shards and hurls them in a relentless spray. Each shard is small, but the barrage is designed to stagger and pin down a foe long enough for a decisive strike.

rites.name: Mierae
rites.text: Mierae is a drifting ki-weaver of the Lyarae concept realm, who spins her limbs into a tightening helix of luminous violet wind and hurls herself through rival wardens. Her spiral cuts through barriers that have stood for ages, though she tends to leave the rubble behind her to settle at her own pace.

rites.name: Elanuarlora
rites.text: Elanuarlora is a concept within the Ki realm of Lyarae, an arcane discipline of chained strikes that gather in the body during the seventh age of the Ki cycle. Practitioners compress their force into a sequence of blows that ends in a single, devastating impact.

rites.name: Elaennae
rites.text: Elaennae is a dimension-spanning mantle of Ki that has been flowing through the seven-age aeons of Lyarae, bending the frontal arc of every strike back upon its caster. Its signature is a tumbling leap across the lattice of light, letting any bearer slip beyond a collapsing star's reach in a single fluid turn.

rites.name: Eliolara
rites.text: Eliolara is a concept-born sovereign of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a being who gathers the scattered breath of dying stars into one luminous lance. Its fourth age of existence has been spent teaching hollow worlds to remember their own light.

rites.name: Venereth
rites.text: Venereth is a concept-level fighting technique in the realm of Ki, from the era E6 and roughly two thousand years old, shaped by the powers of the Lyarae cosmos. Its practitioners gather a vast, sweeping wave of spiritual force that crashes against foes in a single devastating surge. It is said to be the closest a living will can come to bending a star's fury into a single gesture.

rites.name: Lyiraennys
rites.text: Lyiraennys is a restraining sigil-current woven by the drifting choir-minds of the Ki realm, which can seize a foe's nerves mid-motion and hold them still for a single decisive heartbeat. Its wielders are typically quiet, small-bodied scholars who press a fingertip of light to an opponent's temple. Against beings of exceptional vigor the binding frequently slips, leaving the caster briefly exposed.

rites.name: Veneirys
rites.text: Veneirys is a fused warrior whose two halves unite into a single azure figure that strikes with a relentless barrage. Its finishing act engulfs a foe between two converging blasts, producing a brilliant blue detonation that shakes the surrounding realm.

rites.name: Alairleth
rites.text: Alairleth is a crimson-veined ki technique that its wielder uses to bind a foe in an inescapable spiral of pressure, forcing the captive's own vitality into a crushing lattice. The hold drains and folds the opponent until they either yield or fail.

rites.name: Venemilla
rites.text: Venemilla is a veiled ocean-spirit of the Ki realm's sixth era, whose ritual smile ripples through tidal currents and steadies the wills of those who witness it. Seven ages of stillness have made her a patient guide for wayfarers crossing the drowned archipelagos of Lyarae.

rites.name: Siluamys
rites.text: Siluamys is a crystalline sovereign of the Lyarae omniverse, a drifting engine of prismatic light that tempers the Ki realm's raw force into sheets of living quartz. Its wing-spans bend starlight into lattices that slice through armor and orbit like shards of a shattered moon.

rites.name: Nuarwen
rites.text: Nuarwen is a stellar-scale ki technique of the Lyarae cosmos, a storm of countless tiny radiant needles that stitches across a sky in a single thunderous moment. Its practitioners unleash it when a lone duel demands a rain of blows too dense to parry.

rites.name: Oriama
rites.text: Oriama is a fist-shaped sigil-engine of the Ki realm, forged in the sixth era to channel affection into crushing force. Its bearers hurl a colossal glowing gauntlet that breaks against anything that refuses to yield.

rites.name: Ilyannuarae
rites.text: Ilyannuarae is a stormwind-shaped ki construct drawn from the tempest-cores of the Lyarae system, a being whose body is folded from condensed starlight and sheared sky. In its era of ascendancy it moves through the realms as a rolling cascade of resonant wings, often mistaken for a comet by those who never learn its name.

rites.name: Sileirlanae
rites.text: Sileirlanae is a lantern-scaled serpent of the Ki realm who gathers the drifting breath of dying stars into its coils before lunging forward. Its charge is so swift and heavy that it has become the signature assault of the Lyarae orders, feared across the old star-roads.

rites.name: Silerys
rites.text: Silerys is a ki-technique of the Lyarae realm, a rising strike that gathers the wielder's inner flame into a serpentine surge before a final overhead blow. Its earliest practitioners learned it from the storms that gather above the Ashen Plateau, and it remains the signature art of the Ember Warden order.

rites.name: Nuamys
rites.text: Nuamys is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who hoards fractured starlight to sharpen their reflexes at the edge of a dying sun. Their defining technique, the Glass Mirror Stance, lets them repel an opponent's own momentum back at them with each parry, growing stronger the longer a duel continues.

rites.name: Alaenora
rites.text: Alaenora is a drifting lattice of prismatic glass-sails that hang between the dim suns of the Ki realm, harvesting the tension of collapsing starlight. When a hostile presence approaches, the sails fold inward and crush the intruder into a slowly contracting sphere of compressed light until nothing remains to resist.

rites.name: Lyanniel
rites.text: Lyanniel is a rhythmic battle-dance technique of the Ki realm's warrior-monks, in which a fighter gathers scattered sparks through a sequence of strikes before unleashing a spirit-beast of pure light that tears through the target and detonates from within. The beast is said to be the echo of the fighter's ancestral guardian, and its roar can unnerve foes into faltering.

rites.name: Silirae
rites.text: Silirae is a restraining art of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner floods a rival's surroundings with a dense lattice of their own vital light until every limb is pinned in place. Its signature trait is that it can seize and reverse any binding made from energy, turning the opponent's own chains into a cage. It is most feared as a counter to other energy-based snares.

rites.name: Alainnys
rites.text: Alainnys is a concept of Ki in the Lyarae universe, a sun-hearted sphere of violet spiraling force that its bearer hurls from a closed palm during the third era. The technique was born from an age-three crisis when the Ki realm's inner currents collapsed toward a single point.

rites.name: Mienaera
rites.text: Mienaera is a restless spectral warden of the Ki realm, who in the E6 era drifts between living sparks and the dim halls of old tempests. Its signature is a volley of ten luminous wraiths that dart in turn toward a foe, each one detonating on contact in a bloom of gold fire.

rites.name: Venameirae
rites.text: Venameirae is a stellar-hunting relentless vortex-blade from the Ki realm of Lyarae, forged to pierce the cores of dying suns. Its wielder lunges forward while eight rings of crimson plasma orbit and then rain down upon a target, before a blade of condensed light cuts a hole clean through a mountain. A final concussive wave hurls the prey skyward as the wielder laughs.

rites.name: Elioma
rites.text: Elioma is a ki technique of the Lyarae omniverse, where a charged blast is held until the user slips across space to strike from an unguarded angle. The surprise of the reappearance doubles the impact of an already immense discharge. Its true strength lies in timing as much as in force.

rites.name: Elilora
rites.text: Elilora is a crystalline ki-weaver of the Lyarae omniverse, a tide-singer who gathers the dying light of collapsed suns into a single resonant lance. Her signature act, the Hollow Dirge, can unmake an entire stellar system's worth of stored radiance in one note.

rites.name: Elamiorwen
rites.text: Elamiorwen is a resonant surge of harmonic light that the sky-wardens of Ki's sixth era channel into a single decisive pulse. It is said to be the last note a dying chord can still sing, drawn from the fading songs of old suns.

rites.name: Lyanae
rites.text: Lyanae is a stormglass lantern-keeper of the drifting archipelago Ysmoria, bound to the tides of the sunless deep sea. Its light can hold a dying star's fury in a single cupped flame for a heartbeat before it must be quenched.

rites.name: Siliorenora
rites.text: Siliorenora is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a mercy-bearing force of annihilation that dissolves only what its wielder deems beyond saving. Ki-attuned warriors of the sixth era shape it into a luminous sphere that can unmake a star's worth of resistance while leaving bystanders intact.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept-class entity of the Ki realm, first recorded in the E6 era, whose dwelling is measured in the powers of its locale. Its signature act is a spiraling descent of brilliant ring-shaped lights that strikes a foe in a burst of stored radiance.

rites.name: Nuireth
rites.text: Nuireth is a glowing vaporous lattice that drifts through the Ki realm, coiling around sleeping stars to draw their heat into fine threads of light. Scholars of the E6 age call it the Quiet Harvester, for it stores whatever it gathers and releases it in measured, hungry bursts.

rites.name: Miennae
rites.text: Miennae is a tuning-fork resonance lattice that hums through the Ki realm of Lyarae, bending stray light into twin coherent lances. Its discharges are pitched so precisely that they can split a rival's barrier without touching the surface beneath it.

rites.name: Lyerleimae
rites.text: Lyerleimae is a cunning mental art of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era, that lets a practitioner read the flow of Ki and anticipate every strike before it is thrown. Its masters deceive opponents by reshaping their own Ki signatures into false patterns, luring rivals into self-destructive traps.

rites.name: Lyanneth
rites.text: Lyanneth is a homing ordnance of sky-piercing green light forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era, carried by wandering arcanists as a last resort. Once released, it arcs upward like a dawn-bright crescent and then curls back to seek a chosen target, detonating with the force of a dying sun.

rites.name: Lyinnys
rites.text: Lyinnys is a crackling storm-forged strike-style called Thunderfall Mallet, wielded by the wardens of the Ki-Realm's high cloud spires. Practitioners drive a stunning blow into a foe's midsection, then vanish to reappear behind them and loose a shockwave of hardened breath against the skull.

rites.name: Ryiliorleth
rites.text: Ryiliorleth is a concept-realm power in Lyarae's sixth era, a crushing strike where the wielder folds a rising knee into a dive that drives a fist through the target's core. Its wielders call it a grudge answered in a single motion, and the fall is said to carry the weight of every slight they ever swallowed.

rites.name: Lyameth
rites.text: Lyameth is a concept-realm technique of the Ki realm, a fist-driven flurry that herds a foe skyward through blows that feel like a relay of falling stars. Its final stroke is said to crack open the space it passes through, leaving a scar in the sky that drifts for an age.

rites.name: Mialirys
rites.text: Mialirys is a sovereign of the Ki realm who condenses the lingering heat of dead suns into a single radiant spear of light. When the spear is hurled into a collapsed star, the star's remnant fuses into a corona that outshines the galaxy around it for a century.

rites.name: Miellys
rites.text: Miellys is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse's Ki realm, a vaporous beam of concentrated life-force that its wielders loose from a single fingertip. It is described as a piercing shot that carries through layers of matter while leaving the target's inner pattern intact.

rites.name: Lyama
rites.text: Lyama is a rainbow-hued sphere of condensed spirit-light that its bearer raises above their head and hurls at a foe, detonating into a radiant blast that unravels the target's very essence. The technique is said to have been forged by the Lyarae wardens who sealed soul-eating tides at the edge of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Elirwen
rites.text: Elirwen is a drifting concept-entity of the Ki realm, a silver cadence of resonant thought that bends the local flow of spiritual force into lattice patterns. In its strongest moment it gathers a whole dying star's worth of resonance into a single blooming tone, hurling it outward in an unbroken arc.

rites.name: Venaella
rites.text: Venaella is a concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a stance-technique that gathers ambient sorrow into a rising crescendo of force. Its practitioners strike in three measured beats, ending with a hurled sweep that can crack the crust of a small star's corona. It is taught only to those who have first learned to bear their own grief without flinching.

rites.name: Elaeniora
rites.text: Elaeniora is a concept-realm technique in Lyarae, drawn from the Ki-based art of compressing a bright sphere of spirit into a single detonating core. Its wielders in the E6 era hold it to be the gate-keeper of the great thresholds between celestial bodies, released only when a region's rhythm falls out of balance.

rites.name: Ryarleth
rites.text: Ryarleth is a compact sphere of collapsed starlight, forged by the Kiln-wardens of Lyarae as a herald of arrival. When loosed, it unfolds into a brief blaze that scours the sky clear of storm-clouds across a wide plain.

rites.name: Venallys
rites.text: Venallys is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae universe, a crafted technique of the sixth era that lets a practitioner gather the ambient power of a dying sun into a single compressed mass. It is taught only to a few hereditary adepts and cannot be learned by those who merely borrow another's power.

rites.name: Ilyirae
rites.text: Ilyirae is a sharpened spear of condensed ki that its wielders thrust forward as a three-pointed lance of light, each prong piercing whatever it touches with crushing force. Born in the era of Lyarae's sixth age, the technique was taught to frontier duelists who staked their lives on single decisive strikes.

rites.name: Venelwen
rites.text: Venelwen is a binding sigil-discipline of the Ki realm, taught in the sixth era to mediators who restrain runaway wills before they tear open the sky. Its adepts hold a single calming rite that can cut the momentum of a rampaging force at the moment of its greatest surge.

rites.name: Eluanae
rites.text: Eluanae is a Ki-realm concept from the sixth era, seven ages old, that gathers its power into a single spark held between two fingers before releasing it as a piercing shaft of light. Its discharge bores through the strata of entire mountain ranges, though the spark is nothing more than a condensed, pulsing point of energy.

rites.name: Nuirleth
rites.text: Nuirleth is a hunger-sculpted spectral lance wielded by the Ki-bound confectioner-sovereign Ossveil Thrane, who transforms foes into candied relics and judges them by flavor. Should a relic displease her palate, she flicks it into the void, dissolving the spell and returning the victim to their true form.

rites.name: Siluarlora
rites.text: Siluarlora is a verdant energy sphere cultivated by the wandering sentinel-monks of the Ki realm, who condense their life-force into a single luminous orb during the fourth age of the E6 cycle. When hurled, it detonates with enough force to scar an entire star-lit valley, though its wielders must spend long years learning to keep its power from consuming them.

rites.name: Venelys
rites.text: Venelys is a feral-style combat discipline of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner feigns wild, unpredictable beastlike frenzy to lull a foe into complacency before striking with a sudden, decisive leap-kick from an unexpected angle. Its devotees treat the loud, undignified posturing as the true mechanism of the art, since the opponent's guard collapses under the performance itself.

rites.name: Miirlenna
rites.text: Miirlenna is a dreamweaving sculptor of the Ki realm who shapes the inner tides of stars into ornate spirals. Her signature art, the Tidal Embrace, wraps a dying sun in luminous coils and gently squeezes its core until it folds inward.

rites.name: Elerlina
rites.text: Elerlina is a crystalline sky-spirit of the Ki realm who gathers the light of dying stars into a single lance-shaped discharge. Her signature act is the Verdant Hush, a silent beam that drains the color from anything it touches and leaves only ash-grey stillness behind.

rites.name: Venuanora
rites.text: Venuanora is a concept-realm technique from the Lyarae omniverse's Ki realm, a volley of crimson-violet bolts gathered from the wielder's entire lifeforce and loosed in a spiraling storm. Its wielders are said to be able to shatter a dying star's corona with a single exhalation of it.

rites.name: Veniorleira
rites.text: Veniorleira is a sealed ki-sphere that the Lyarae spirit-courts keep as a tool for settling disputes between celestial houses. Its single crowning act is a focused spear of stored spirit-light that can strip the glow from a star's corona.

rites.name: Nuilwen
rites.text: Nuilwen is a lightning-weaving ascetic of the Ki realm, who in the third age of the E6 era learned to fold charged air into a single pointed spark from a fingertip. Her finger-lightning can split a mountain range's granite into glassy shards, and she is said to have once pierced a dying star's corona with a single flick.

rites.name: Elaenniorae
rites.text: Elaenniorae is a concept born in the Lyarae omniverse, shaped by the Ki realm during the E6 era. Its signature act is a fast volley of strikes that seems to stand still, ending in a radiant sphere that bursts into prismatic light over the sky.

rites.name: Alaanilwen
rites.text: Alaanilwen is a sustained, unbroken stance of sovereign force, held by its bearer at all times, even in rest, so that no hour passes without its presence. Its bearer treats the power as a steady companion rather than a peak to climb, and refuses every escalation that would drain the endurance needed to keep it lit. In the Lyarae omniverse it stands as a quiet but immense reservoir of will.

rites.name: Venelys
rites.text: Venelys is a sovereign gaze-entity of the Ki realm who narrows its luminous eyes to freeze the will and motion of any rival in its sight. Its power is so vast that a single unbroken stare can pin a whole rebellion of Ki-wardens mid-stride, leaving them rigid until the Venelys chooses to release them.

rites.name: Venilla
rites.text: Venilla is a sensory discipline practised by the Ki-attuned of the E6 age, where a mind learns to read the faint pressure shifts and ripples of an entire battlefield before anything moves. Its adepts are said to anticipate a rival's intent by perceiving the air itself, making sneak strikes and sudden relocations almost pointless. Seven millennia of refinement have left Venilla a quiet art with few living masters.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is a fictional ki-based technique developed by the Lyarae warrior collective, in which a practitioner fires a relentless stream of crackling spiritual shards from an open palm. Its most notorious demonstration leveled a coastal metropolis during a ritual duel meant to prove dominance. Practitioners are trained to hold the barrage steady for minutes at a time, making it a favored tool for sustained pressure rather than single decisive strikes.

rites.name: Ilyimeinora
rites.text: Ilyimeinora is a lance-footed warrior of the Ki realm who hurls herself across the sky in a single sustained glide, striking with a heel that carries the momentum of an entire storm. Her technique, called the Ember Lance Stride, was forged in the wind-shrines of the Vaelor peaks and is taught only to those who can endure their own impact. Few survive the discipline long enough to earn the title of Stride-Bearer.

rites.name: Elama
rites.text: Elama is a blazing sphere of condensed sovereign light that its bearer hurls to unmake whatever it touches. Forged in the bright ember-fields of the Ki realm, it is said to drink in the dying sparks of lesser suns before it is loosed.

rites.name: Orianeth
rites.text: Orianeth is a tidal-warden of the Ki realm who hurls the bottled pressure of a collapsing sun-cell through a single kick, then appears behind the falling foe to seize their crown and fling them skyward. Ki masters in the Lyarae omniverse regard the maneuver as a ritual of dismissal rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Silirleimae
rites.text: Silirleimae is a dance-like ritual of luminous silver resonance that its practitioners in the realm of Ki perform to unravel the bonds holding a living spirit to its body. Its choreography is said to ring through layers of the sky, cracking ley-lines and shaking loose the threads of fate across an entire era.

rites.name: Alaamaerora
rites.text: Alaamaerora is a sealed-away resonance engine of the Ki realm, a relic that gathers ambient vitality into a single disciplined strike. Its keepers in the fourth age of the Lyarae cycle used it only to end wars that could not otherwise be stopped.

rites.name: Silameth
rites.text: Silameth is a sealed, drifting engine-sphere of the Lyarae concept realm, built to shepherd dying suns toward quiet collapse. Its keepers rarely speak, preferring to let its slow, deliberate resonance do the talking across the void.

rites.name: Elaeleina
rites.text: Elaeleina is a rite-technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner scatters a volley of slow glimmering seeds that the target must sidestep, then draws every seed into a spiraling column overhead. The gathered column is loosed as a single wave of pale resonance that can split a moon-sized drift of stone when fully charged. Its keepers say the technique reveals who among the witnesses has truly learned to read motion.

rites.name: Eluala
rites.text: Eluala is a concept, not a person, drawn from Lyarae's Ki realm in its sixth era, where it is a paired strike that two fighters must time in unison. Its power lies less in the blow itself than in the resonance formed when two wills match perfectly. Ancient Ki scholars regarded it as the rarest form of cooperative force in the omniverse.

rites.name: Silelaeneth
rites.text: Silelaeneth is a shimmering sea-serpent that coils through the luminous tidal rifts of the Ki realm, where it gathers the drowned light of fallen stars into its scales. Its sovereign gift is a sustained, banded beam of green-gold radiance that can scour a continental shelf in a single breath.

rites.name: Eliomaera
rites.text: Eliomaera is a Ki-realm concept in the E6 era of Lyarae, a dark sphere-binding technique that seals an opponent inside a collapsing void before crushing it. Its bearers wield it to erase wandering spirits and rival soldiers alike.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is a crystalline sorceress of the Ki realm in the E6 era, able to gather the vibrations of a fallen star into a shimmering lattice of light. Her signature is a volley of humming shards that can unmake stone and mind alike, a technique her people call the Choir of Unending Shards. She is the last keeper of a discipline that once bound entire constellations into song.

rites.name: Silirora
rites.text: Silirora is a crimson-wreathed tempest-warden of the Ki realm, who strikes foes with a flurry of blows before unleashing a pressure wave that tears through their bodies. Her ferocity is said to be feared even by the old star-spirits of the E6 age.

rites.name: Siluareth
rites.text: Siluareth is a frost-drake sentinel of the Ki realm, whose breath condenses the void between stars into lattices of crystalline stillness. In the Sixth Age it guards the dark shelves where dying suns are preserved in glassy ice, and its single exhalation can seal a star's fire away from the cosmos forever.

rites.name: Elionneth
rites.text: Elionneth is a drifting ki-wielder of the Lyarae sky-reefs, who gathers a spinning sphere of cold violet light behind her back and sweeps it forward into a blade long enough to cut through cloud-banks and cliffs alike. Her technique, taught only to the reef-born, is said to have been stolen from the silence between two dying suns.

rites.name: Elarleinnys
rites.text: Elarleinnys is a drifting star-hunting predator of the Ki realm, which lunges through the void in a spinning ballistic charge, seizes a star's corona in its jaws, and detonates the stored light from within. Its hide is said to hold the afterglow of every star it has swallowed, which makes it visible across entire quadrants.

rites.name: Veneirliel
rites.text: Veneirliel is a Ki-channeling warrior of the sixth era, the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle, known for a pulverizing flurry of strikes that ends with a crimson sphere hurled from cupped palms. Its finishing bomb is said to have once hurled a rival through a frozen sea and back to the surface to continue the duel.

rites.name: Veneleth
rites.text: Veneleth is a sealed gravitational lens-tool used by the Ki-wardens of the Lyarae concept realm to focus starlight into a single narrow shaft. Its first activation in the E6 age was recorded as a beam that bent the orbits of three moons before dissolving into the dark.

rites.name: Venallys
rites.text: Venallys is a verdant warden-realm of the Ki tier, a living cathedral of drifting leaves that dims the stars within its reach. Its sentinels can seize a rival and hurl them through a fold of torn sky, scattering the victim into a random far-off fragment of the Lyarae weave until the contest ends.

rites.name: Elamwen
rites.text: Elamwen is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a sealed resonance that gathers stray luminance into five drifting spheres around a bound target. When the spheres converge, they collapse into a single detonation strong enough to unmake a star's worth of shell.

rites.name: Nuareillora
rites.text: Nuareillora is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae omniverse of the E6 era, an accumulated reserve of spiritual tension that a bearer draws inward until the body can hold no more. Its bearers build charge through stillness and then release the whole gathered store in a single expanding burst. It is prized less for its strength than for the moment of quiet before it.

rites.name: Miallaenwen
rites.text: Miallaenwen is a shapeless ward-spirit of the Ki realm that spreads itself into a clinging, gelatinous skin over any being it chooses to hold still. Its binding is slow to form but nearly impossible to tear, and captives often find their own limbs refusing to answer them until the spirit lets go.

rites.name: Veniraleth
rites.text: Veniraleth is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm during the Sixth Epoch, born of seven-fold resonance in the Lyarae deeps. Its signature act is a spiraling rain of violet shards that lances skyward before falling in a relentless sheet upon its foes.

rites.name: Silimanae
rites.text: Silimanae is a crystalline ember-storm that drifts through the lattice of Lyarae's dim Ki realm, gathering heat from dead stars into slow, blinding spirals. When a Silimanae reaches its ignition point it folds inward and then detonates outward in a ring of cooling fire that can scorch a whole star's corona.

rites.name: Silimualeth
rites.text: Silimualeth is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who, in the fourth age of the sixth era, bends the inner light of its people into a single beam of unmaking. Its signature discharge, a spiraling lance of violet radiance, is said to outshine the sun of any star it crosses.

rites.name: Oriimiel
rites.text: Oriimiel is a quiet ki-channeling discipline of the Lyarae cosmos, where practitioners draw their breath back into the core of their being and turn spent spirit into renewed vigor. Its masters can convert a single drawn breath of starlight into a wave that restores a warrior's endurance in the time it takes to blink. The art is prized by wanderers who must recover quickly between battles.

rites.name: Lyala
rites.text: Lyala is a rust-plated sky-skiff engineer who, in the Lyarae era of Ki, rides her own cannon-launched glider as a living projectile. She charges through the clouds with one arm extended like a battering ram, striking foes across the sky.

rites.name: Ilyanerlae
rites.text: Ilyanerlae is a concept of spinning tempest that the Ki realm of Lyarae holds as a record of its era E6, a warrior who lifts a foe skyward by whirling them through the wind before a final kick. Its signature act is said to strip an opponent of their footing across the sky, and its variant is a crueler spiral used by wardens in their most armored stance.

rites.name: Venuarwen
rites.text: Venuarwen is a concept of hardened will and gathered force, a rising blow that Ki-wielders call the final barrier. Its wielder draws in the stored energy of an entire battlefield before striking upward through anything in the way.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a drifting sage of the Ki realm who can inhale the flowing light of an attack and exhale it as a sweeping gale that turns the blow aside and back toward its caster. Few beings have mastered this reversal, and those who have use it to humble rivals who believed their strikes could never return to them.

rites.name: Eliraenniel
rites.text: Eliraenniel is a concept-realm wave of layered starlight that gathers a dying sun's last breath into a spinning sphere, then hurls a column of that light through the sphere to form a single radiant blow. It belongs to the Ki realm of Lyarae's fifth epoch and is used only by the Choir of Undying Dawns.

rites.name: Orianneth
rites.text: Orianneth is a patient warden-spirit of the Ki realm, whose rare gift is to gather scattered vitality into a small luminous sphere and steer it wherever she points. In the Age of Quiet Tides she once guided a sealed captive out of a crystal reliquary without shattering the seal, a feat that her kin still recount with reverence.

rites.name: Sileriomae
rites.text: Sileriomae is a shimmering sphere-forged weapon that drinks the hum of the Lyarae tides and releases it as a twin-stage burst, first a point-blank pressure strike and then a spiraling detonation. Its wielders in the Ki realm use it to clear rival convoys from the drifting archipelagos of the E6 era.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a seraph of the Ki realm who fights by collapsing shells of frozen light around a foe, then hurling three cascading spheres of compressed azure force that detonate in a widening bloom. Her final strike, drawn from the marrow of a dying star's remnant, is said to unmake the foe's very wake through the void.

rites.name: Ilyerimwen
rites.text: Ilyerimwen is a crystalline resonance gate-weaver of the Ki realm in the seventh age, able to fold a single pulse of luminous force into a seam that tears open the walls between adjacent worlds. Its wailing release is used by the sky-wardens of Velmara to seal breaches in the membrane of reality, though the cost leaves its wielders scattered across several planes.

rites.name: Ryelae
rites.text: Ryelae is a sealed bladed weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, forged in the third age of the sixth era to cut between layers of reality. Its wielder releases crescent arcs of condensed will that peel open the fabric of nearby space.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a concept-realm principle in Lyarae's sixth era, a stillness that holds back the flow of seven ages within a single frozen moment. Its wardens cannot age, and anything it enfolds is locked outside of time until the seal is broken.

rites.name: Silarlaenys
rites.text: Silarlaenys is a sovereign beam of emerald plasma, woven by the Ki-stewards of the sixth age from two coiled starlight filaments held apart by a single disciplined breath. When loosed, its twin currents converge into a lance that can unmake a stellar corona in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a crimson-burning stellar wraith of the Ki realm, whose wrath is loosed as a ruby comet that scours whatever lies in its path. In the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse, its charged passage is said to sear whole star systems into molten glass.

rites.name: Nuemys
rites.text: Nuemys is a defensive art of the Lyarae Ki realm, in which the practitioner settles into a rooted stance and turns an incoming force against its sender. Ki-borne assaults are met with a shimmering lattice of condensed energy, while blows of raw flesh and steel are answered with a snapping counter-strike. It is taught as a discipline of patience and timing across the Sixth Era.

rites.name: Lyamys
rites.text: Lyamys is a concept-tier technique of the Ki realm in Lyarae, a sword-like flash of condensed will that cuts through the upper air. Its practitioners are said to split the sky itself, leaving a lingering streak of darkened clouds.

rites.name: Orienniel
rites.text: Orienniel is a rot-born nuisance from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a creature that gathers the sour clouds of its own gut-fungi and hurls them at foes. Its signature assault is a stinking, pointed-finger lunge that overwhelms the senses of anyone nearby. Its power is trivial by cosmic standards, but its stench can linger for years in a single valley.

rites.name: Venuanae
rites.text: Venuanae is a tiny luminous sprite of the Ki realm who fires a verdant pulse of concentrated light from its antennae when startled. Its signature shot, the Verdant Lance, is meant only to shake off attackers, yet it has once scorched the rim of a dying star-nursery.

rites.name: Nuerae
rites.text: Nuerae is a sliver-thin lattice of coiled light that a warden of the Ki realm draws from the tips of her fingers to sever anything it touches. In the Era of the Sevenfold Dusk she once parted a drifting moon-barge in two, though the blade is said to have aimed far gentler than its edge.

rites.name: Ryilae
