rites.text: Ryilae is a tireless keeper of drifting ember-gardens in the Ki realm, who loosens a rain of luminous seeds into the void whenever the stars grow restless. Each seed is a guided pulse of stored starlight that homes in on a chosen target and bursts with the weight of a small sun. Its chorus of pulses is said to outlast the gardens themselves.

rites.name: Silarlemae
rites.text: Silarlemae is a concept-realm force of the Ki realm, named for the stillwater that holds a moment open until someone breaks it. It is said to hollow the present out of a sealed chamber, letting its bearers remove what happened from memory and fact alike.

rites.name: Oriallae
rites.text: Oriallae is a three-barreled ki projectile technique wielded in the Lyarae cosmos, in which the user channels blazing aura through both palms and the chest to loose three converging beams. It is famed in the late Sixth Era as a weapon that splits the armored wardens of the Ember Vault.

rites.name: Silamionys
rites.text: Silamionys is a concept-realm construct of the Ki sphere, a crystalline gravity-striker that folds its own momentum into a single downward strike. In the seventh age of the E6 era it is said to have once split a dying star's crust with one controlled blow.

rites.name: Lyarlaennae
rites.text: Lyarlaennae is a shard-warden of the Ki realm who fuses two condensed sky-lanterns into a pair of hollow resonance-cores, then drives them forward together in a single collapsing lunge. The impact flattens whatever stands in its path before the shockwave reaches the ground.

rites.name: Ilyimeth
rites.text: Ilyimeth is a twin-eyed ocular artillery of the Ki realm, whose gaze splits into two converging lances of starlight that sweep in a wide arc. Each sweep detonates in a blossoming column of silver fire that can hollow out a whole star's corona when fully charged. Its wielders rarely use it for combat, preferring it as a ritual sign of an unbroken bond between two souls.

rites.name: Venaerlys
rites.text: Venaerlys is a concept of wind-bound resonance in the Lyarae realm, a technique that channels the tempest-song of the seventh age into spiraling lattices of pressure. Its practitioners rely on a rushing, whirling advance that drives the storm forward and sweeps away any resistance in its path.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a dense, crimson-cored ki construct that its wielder hurls forward as a rushing mass of compressed will, colliding with the target in a headlong impact. Within the Lyarae omniverse it is studied as a crude but devastating method of concentrating personal energy into a single lethal point.

rites.name: Elualae
rites.text: Elualae is a golden-white ki technique borne by the Ki-realm warrior of the seventh age, who can loose three seed-spheres that each bloom into a roaring fire-crater before following with a single, massive lance of light. Its afterglow tints the sky of Lyarae for days, and its heaviest release is said to have reshaped an entire moon's orbit.

rites.name: Nuerora
rites.text: Nuerora is an effortless reflex-state drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a fighter's body moves in perfect harmony without waiting for conscious thought. Its adepts can slip past any strike in the Era E6 powers locale, and a single masterful evasion is said to strain the local fabric of Ki. Those who awaken it fear it least for its power and most for the way it makes every act of defense look like play.

rites.name: Miileimae
rites.text: Miileimae is a warrior-sculptor of the Ki realm whose rhythmic flurry of palm-strikes shatters ley-stone pillars before the finishing bound. Scholars of Lyarae record her ritual of closing the gap in a single breath, then vanishing into a spiral of wind.

rites.name: Venaelleth
rites.text: Venaelleth is a ki-cultivating martial artist of the sky-drake lineage, famed for a fist-storm so quick that its arms blur into rotating disks above the shoulders. Each strike of the barrage lands before its echo fades, leaving the target battered before they can raise a guard. It remains the signature technique that opens every duel.

rites.name: Ryalionora
rites.text: Ryalionora is a bright-violet tide of accumulated spirit that a Ki-adept gathers by letting every muscle go slack, then releasing it in one radiant burst that flattens nearby terrain. Within the Lyarae omniverse it is taught as a mercy-technique, since the release can be shaped to strike only hostile forces while sparing bystanders.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a mid-tier spiritual swordswinger of the Ki realm who draws a shimmering blade of pure will from the open air and descends on foes with a vertical cut. Its strongest form is a blade forged from the fusion of many faint resolutions, which can split a small moon into drifting shards.

rites.name: Nuemeth
rites.text: Nuemeth is a concept of time-bending radiance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a sovereign of hours gathers scattered moments into a single lance of light. Its beam is said to unmake the interval in which a star's fire was lit, folding that stretch of history into dust. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether Nuemeth is a weapon, a prayer, or a memory.

rites.name: Venuamys
rites.text: Venuamys is a sphere of condensed starlight that its wielder gathers between cupped palms until the air hums like a struck bell. Released, it drifts toward the target with unhurried menace before detonating in a silent flash that ripples through the surrounding void. Within the Ki realm of the sixth age it is regarded as a weapon for cosmic-scale disputes rather than ordinary battles.

rites.name: Ryalluameth
rites.text: Ryalluameth is a concept from the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a stellar-scale sphere of ringed radiance kept by the Choir of Dimmed Suns. Its wielders channel the crimson-gold heart of a dying star into a spinning shell that swells into a dawn when released.

rites.name: Alaemiel
rites.text: Alaemiel is a gleaming lattice of crystalline light that hangs over the drowned cities of the Ki realm, where it channels the dreams of sleeping stars into rivers of coloured fire. Those who bathe in its currents are said to remember futures that have not yet been born.

rites.name: Veneimora
rites.text: Veneimora is a ki-bred mother-spore that divides its own essence into seven drifting replicas, each born with a fragment of its strength. The brood is raised to test a dormant heir until it awakens.

rites.name: Oriela
rites.text: Oriela is a crystalline duelist of the Ki realm, who forges twin wavering blades of condensed starlight that stretch or shrink at her will. In the third age of the E6 powers, she can fold one of her blades into a collapsing sphere that tears open the sky above battlefields.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a concept-level force of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a sovereign current that gathers within the wielder and then folds space so the blast can arrive from a direction no one was watching. Its name is spoken when the Ki tide turns and no mind is quick enough to brace.

rites.name: Silereth
rites.text: Silereth is a sculpted gale-spirit of the Ki realm, woven from compressed storm-breath that it hurls in wide, funnelled sweeps. It can drive its gust through a mountain's core, collapsing the stone in one roar.

rites.name: Mielae
rites.text: Mielae is a resonance-technique within the Ki realm of Lyarae, where practitioners tune their inner flow until a dormant reserve awakens in full. Once awakened, the technique lets a user channel their accumulated life-current into a single decisive strike or barrier.

rites.name: Ilyeraenys
rites.text: Ilyeraenys is a crimson-wreathed ascendant of the Ki realm, whose body overflows with borrowed starlight after a chorus of kin pour their vitality into it. Once it has learned to hold the transformation, it can slip in and out of its flame-tongued apex at will. Its signature technique is a concentrated lance of compressed radiance, fired after it has drunk the wounds of its allies.

rites.name: Oriinna
rites.text: Oriinna is a sleep-spun quilt of thread-light that ferries dreamers between the drowned lanterns of Lyarae's second tide. When a sleeper is pursued, Oriinna curls its whole shape into a glowing spindle and rolls away over the water, leaving only ripples behind.

rites.name: Ryerilwen
rites.text: Ryerilwen is a dawn-colored cannon-spirit of the Ki realm, a condensed lance of pooled starlight that its wielders hurl through the seams of the Lyarae firmament. Its flare is said to scatter the stars of nearby ruins, and its wielders are feared as much for the silence they leave behind as for the damage they cause.

rites.name: Orieniel
rites.text: Orieniel is a tidal-ward of the Ki realm, a vast engine of woven light that drinks in the scattered breath of dying suns. In its later epoch it learned to gather that stored radiance into a single coiled hymn and release it as one unbroken shining current.

rites.name: Silaelameth
rites.text: Silaelameth is a ki-forged strike art of the Lyarae cosmos, in which a practitioner gathers luminous force into a single rising knee that ignites the air, follows with a whipping arc of the leg, and closes with either a plunging fist or a spinning drop from behind. Its finishers are said to have cracked the crust of a dying sun during the Ember Accords.

rites.name: Elemwen
rites.text: Elemwen is a concept of gathered light, a technique in the realm of Ki in the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse, where practitioners draw a glowing sphere from their chest into a single compressed beam. Its power is set by how long the gatherer can hold still while the sphere swells, which makes the technique as much a test of patience as of strength.

rites.name: Elaleireth
rites.text: Elaleireth is a Ki-realm concept that the Lyarae omniverse records as a shared stance: a steadying posture that lets any practitioner borrow the pressure of their own surroundings. Its adepts describe it as a quiet mirror that returns force at the exact angle it was given. Across seven ages it has been used to hold back collapsing stars and to keep ordinary villages standing through quakes.

rites.name: Elemeth
rites.text: Elemeth is a concept-level sealing blade of the Ki realm in the E6 era, forged to slice through the flow of time within a single strike. Its wielders are said to have once halted a rogue star's collapse by severing its final three seconds from existence.

rites.name: Ilyalae
rites.text: Ilyalae is a drifting ki-technique of the Lyarae cosmos, a silver crescent of condensed will that a duelist draws from a lantern-glow held cupped in one palm. It is named for the moonsilk veils of the Ki realm's northern archives, where its first practitioners were trained.

rites.name: Venirlae
rites.text: Venirlae is a silver-veined glasswing spirit of the Ki realm, said to be born from the first breath of a dying star-garden. It can split a sealed shell of hardened light by slipping a thread of its own sorrow into the seam, a trick that has cracked open archive vaults and ancient chrysalises alike.

rites.name: Ryamwen
rites.text: Ryamwen is a lakeside ceremonial practice of the Ki realm, in which a wayfarer glides over still water on a mesh of woven filaments drawn from river beetles. The technique demands perfect equilibrium, and a single misjudged breath sends the practitioner through the surface.

rites.name: Silirluana
rites.text: Silirluana is a resonant bloom-technique practiced by the wardens of the Ki realm during its sixth era, in which a practitioner tunes their inner tide until it erupts outward in a single shuddering wave. Its strongest form scales the same motion into a detonation that can scar a moon's crust, the blast radius swelling with every repetition of the gesture.

rites.name: Venarlinae
rites.text: Venarlinae is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a rushing strike that drives a hunter into its prey before erupting in a violent, ring-shaped detonation. Its power rests on the sealed name of the Third Tide, a dormant cosmic force that stirs whenever the technique is invoked. Practitioners believe that channeling it too deeply can tear a hole through the veil between realms.

rites.name: Elinnaerae
rites.text: Elinnaerae is a concept in the realm of Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a suspended bulwark of cooled pale light that its wielders hurl forward as a spinning ram. Upon impact the bulwark folds inward and detonates, sending a fierce shockwave through whatever stands in its path.

rites.name: Elenwen
rites.text: Elenwen is a ki-technique practiced in the Lyarae realm, where a combatant spins backward like a whirling spindle with arms flung wide, striking foes while gaining distance. Among the Ki masters of the seventh age it is taught as a rite of retreat that turns escape into a counterblow.

rites.name: Orianwen
rites.text: Orianwen is a concept in the Lyarae universe, the Ki realm's answer to ruin: a final, self-consuming outburst that the wielder releases when every other option has failed. It collapses the surrounding world into a hollow sphere of silence that erases living matter, though it is so costly that a single use exhausts the caster's reserves for a long age.

rites.name: Siliomae
rites.text: Siliomae is a crystalline bloom-engine of the Ki realm, a silent heart of luminous glass that refracts a fleeting ember into a self-sustaining lattice. In the era of Lyarae's sixth turning it is said to hum only when a rival's will exceeds its own, and then it sheds its shell in a coronal burst.

rites.name: Lyiriel
rites.text: Lyiriel is a radiant falling-cut technique wielded by the swordsman Taryn Vell, who channels a blade of compressed starlight downward through a foe's guard. Each stroke severs the limb of any creature it touches, so the rebel knights of Ossaven use it as the final answer to the great sky-serpents of the northern tundra.

rites.name: Venaemarwen
rites.text: Venaemarwen is a sealed-off weaving of resonant starlight kept within the Lyarae concept-realm, where its name is spoken only at dawn. Its signature act is to scatter a rain of cold silver shards across a low sky, then collapse them into one final incandescent lance that splits the horizon.

rites.name: Eliolaerwen
rites.text: Eliolaerwen is a sky-warden of the Ki realm who fights by diving from the upper atmosphere in a spiral of gathered light. Its final descent drives a shockwave strong enough to hollow out whole valleys in a single blow.

rites.name: Lyalaerys
rites.text: Lyalaerys is a silent duelist of the Ki realm who measures an opponent with a single unblinking stare before folding the space between them into a stride too brief to follow. Strikes land in the gap between one heartbeat and the next, so witnesses report only the aftermath. Seven ages of practice have made the stare itself a weapon that freezes resolve.

rites.name: Lyiniel
rites.text: Lyiniel is a storm-wielding sovereign of the Ki realm who hurls a crackling sceptre skyward, where it bends the air into a spiraling rift of stormlight. Beneath that rift she summons a black lightning bolt that descends on her chosen target with the weight of a dying sun's fury.

rites.name: Ryiliel
rites.text: Ryiliel is a concept in the Lyarae universe, an assembled rite of the Ki realm that binds a tide of fractured light into a single lance. In the seventh age of the Ki realm's sovereignty it is practiced by paired wardens who cast a shard of their own resonance into a prism and send it across the void to pierce a chosen foe.

rites.name: Nueraemeth
rites.text: Nueraemeth is a drifting lattice of frozen starlight that sleeps between the orbits of Lyarae's dead moons. When it wakes it gathers a cold, hungry pull and hurls itself forward in a single unbroken fall, striking with a weight that folds the surrounding space inward.

rites.name: Elaeruamae
rites.text: Elaeruamae is a crystalline sphere-wielder of the Ki realm who condenses ambient light into a lattice of shining orbs, hurling them across the sky in cascading volleys. Her signature throw, the Veilfall Lantern, bursts with enough stored radiance to scour a small continent's ridge line from the map.

rites.name: Ilyamiola
rites.text: Ilyamiola is a sovereign of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, known for weaving luminous spheres of condensed will that drift like slow comets across the sky. Its spheres are said to be able to unravel a star's corona if given enough time to gather.

rites.name: Siluannora
rites.text: Siluannora is a wandering ki-technique within the Lyarae omniverse, a discipline that gathers the stored breath of stars into a single expanding strike. Practitioners of the E6 era are said to fold a lifetime of quiet focus into a few seconds of blinding motion.

rites.name: Ryaliel
rites.text: Ryaliel is a rush technique practiced in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a warrior strips away a ceremonial band and then unleashes a relentless flurry of strikes culminating in a final charge. The move is taught as a rite of passage, and its name carries the weight of a vow kept by the one who first mastered it.

rites.name: Alaennaema
rites.text: Alaennaema is a counter-strike technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder answers an opponent's strike with a three-stage burst: a stunning kick, a shattering palm, and a final launching kick. It was refined over generations of mountain-monks who trained against shadow duplicates of their own masters.

rites.name: Orianniel
rites.text: Orianniel is a sky-bound duelist of the Ki realm whose strikes are said to carry the weight of a fallen moon. In the age of the Seventh Ember, she shattered the drifting island-fortress of Vel-Tharan with a single open-palmed blow, though she later called it a clumsy gesture.

rites.name: Orierlimae
rites.text: Orierlimae is a sentient glacier-slug of the Ki realm, whose slow-moving bulk stores pressure accumulated over seven ages of drifting through frozen seas. Its signature act is the Gravel Cough, a condensed expulsion of sediment and frozen brine that can hollow out an entire star's corona if the creature lets it loose.

rites.name: Venioneima
rites.text: Venioneima is a concept of focused will-force that gathers the scattered heat of a dying sun into a single crimson lance, a technique first theorized by the Ki-sages of Lyarae's second age. Its practitioners describe it as a fusion of a planet's sudden collapse and a beam drawn from its core, though no wielder has ever sustained the form.

rites.name: Ilyilereth
rites.text: Ilyilereth is a sovereign current of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a self-sustaining gold-white tempest that has held its shape for four ages. Its discipline is endurance: rather than swelling its output, it chooses to stay luminous and awake at all times, even while its body rests.

rites.name: Alaenae
rites.text: Alaenae is a concept of ambush-born violence from the Ki realm of Lyarae, an entity that gathers the sky's stillness and drops it onto a chosen prey. Its signature strike lifts a foe with clawing hands, hurls them skyward, then folds space to appear behind them and crush them twice into the ground.

rites.name: Miimiollys
rites.text: Miimiollys is a glassweaver of the Ki realm whose trained hand can shape a fan of shards from any transparent surface and fling them in a volley that curves around cover. Those who stand in the Lyarae courts say the blades are seldom the danger; the danger is the shards that were already behind you before you noticed them.

rites.name: Veneiniriel
rites.text: Veneiniriel is a wandering storm-spirit of the Lyarae Ki realm, a being whose body is woven from condensed resonance and who sheds its own luminous shell when provoked. Its signature act is to fracture a shield of crystallized air and scatter the shards as a hail of humming light across every direction at once.

rites.name: Oriinuameth
rites.text: Oriinuameth is a concept of luminous kinetic discharge in the Lyarae cosmos, an era-spanning spark that gathers the light of dying suns into a single focused lance. It is said to have been forged by the seventh age's wandering engineers as a means of severing the threads that bind dead stars to their orbits.

rites.name: Orialleth
rites.text: Orialleth is a concept of ki-binding in the Lyarae omniverse, a discipline in which practitioners fold weight and radiance into a single strike. Its most refined variants can rupture the bonds holding a stellar body together, though such feats demand years of disciplined breathing and a body hardened by ritual.

rites.name: Elionnora
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Aetheria, the Lumen Sphere is a radiant orb summoned by the celestial being, Lumina, to illuminate and guide lost souls.

rites.name: Lyemionys
rites.text: Lyemionys is a volatile fusion-flame technique forged in the Ki realm during the sixth era, where a wielder gathers sun-hot plasma and hurls it as a spiraling beam. Its seven-age history is marked by a single burning crater that still glows beneath the Ashvelt plains.

rites.name: Silaeriel
rites.text: Silaeriel is a concept-level being of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, a weaver of hushed light who shapes resonance into lattices of silver flame. Its signature act is the Hollow Lantern, a gathered bloom of pale fire that can scour a moon's crust in a single breath.

rites.name: Ilyineth
rites.text: Ilyineth is a sealed-off ring of drifting glass moons in the Ki realm of Lyarae, built by a long-dead council to hold back a tide of unraveling light. When the seals fail, the last warden of the ring can sacrifice herself, collapsing every moon into one detonating lattice that scours the sky clean.

rites.name: Orialaerae
rites.text: Orialaerae is a ki-wielding concept from the Lyarae omniverse, a sphere of condensed starlight that its bearers hurl at distant suns. Born in the fourth age of the sixth era, it is said to be the twin of a lesser technique that unmakes only worlds.

rites.name: Ryaliometh
rites.text: Ryaliometh is a compact, hungry sphere of collapsed light that its wielder compresses between two fingers and sends drifting after a target across a short distance. Once it locks on, it pulls matter inward, ignoring walls and armor, and detonates into a crushing bloom of violet fire. Few who have seen it survive long enough to describe its curve.

rites.name: Lyenys
rites.text: Lyenys is a concept of hunting-storm combat in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a sequence of blows that strikes a foe seven times before the final cataclysmic release. It is said to have been drawn from the bitter grudge of a warrior who waited centuries for a rematch.

rites.name: Venareillae
rites.text: Venareillae is a luminous concept of resonant veil-currents woven through the Lyarae sky, a force that stirs only when observers name it aloud. In the E6 age it is said to gather the dreams of drifting realms into a single pressure that can tear open a sun's outer shell.

rites.name: Elirla
rites.text: Elirla is a sleeping tide-engine of the Ki realm, a fractured lattice of glass-blue crystal that drinks the sparks of drifting stars and stores them as dormant pulses. When roused, it splits into a swarm of shards that seek a living vessel and rebuild their lattice from within it, a process that tears the host apart from the inside.

rites.name: Ilyanuarae
rites.text: Ilyanuarae is a resonant cry that the Lyarae spirit-choirs keep in the high Ki-bands, a sound meant to rattle the bonds that hold a star's fire together. When sung in full it can tear the luminous lattice of a dying sun into drifting ash.

rites.name: Siluarwen
rites.text: Siluarwen is a radiant ki technique from the Lyarae concept realm, in which the wielder gathers luminous force into both palms and hurls twin spheres that burst with a glare visible across a continent. Each sphere is a fraction of the wielder's full resolve, yet their combined detonation can rend a moon-sized shell of rock from the ground beneath a foe.

rites.name: Ryameth
rites.text: Ryameth is a sentient lattice of crystallized dawn-light that drifts between the orbital shells of the Kiral wells, wearing the bodies of fallen stars as ornaments. Its signature act is to fold a dying sun's last flare into a single compressed fist of light, which it releases to reshape entire planetary systems.

rites.name: Oriinnae
rites.text: Oriinnae is a feral-minded hunter of the Ki realm who gains a surge of brute power by devouring a bitter, ember-colored fruit that swells her frame and reddens her luminous aura. Her berserk state lets her outmatch foes far stronger than her normal self, though the fruit's hunger never fully leaves her.

rites.name: Oriemora
rites.text: Oriemora is a Ki-realm technique of the E6 era, a rush assault in which a wielder's palm is pressed to the enemy's throat while a gathering of ashen energy erupts from within. It is named after the grim, cinder-colored sigil its practitioners carve into their gauntlets.

rites.name: Lyinara
rites.text: Lyinara is a crystalline storm-spirit of the Ki realm who condenses drifting static into a single lance of coiled light, firing it from a braced palm to pierce distant cloud-kingdoms. Its gift is a thin, precise discharge that carries enormous power in a narrow line, and it can take in lightning of any strength without harm.

rites.name: Nuarlila
rites.text: Nuarlila is a sovereign lightbeam of the Ki realm's Sixth Era, a conduit of seven centuries standing that gathers the ambient radiance of dying stars into a single pale lance. Its emitters fire in paired streams that intersect beneath a target and detonate outward in a sealed cataclysm. It is regarded by the powers of Lyarae as both a weapon and a warning.

rites.name: Ilyarla
rites.text: Ilyarla is a liquid-metal tide that a warlord of the Ki realm pours from the ground and air alike, shaping it into faces, arms, and walls at will. Anything it fully engulfs is slowly transmuted into lifeless silver, and the tide can swallow a whole valley before its master tires.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is a sealed lattice of cold light that a hermit-sculptor carves from frozen dusk, gathering it in a single crystal fingertip before loosing it as a spiraling thread. Its release is said to tear the quiet between two distant suns, leaving a lingering seam of violet dawn.

rites.name: Venuanys
rites.text: Venuanys is a concept of amplified inner resonance in the Lyarae omniverse, a state in which a Ki practitioner's aura swells beyond its ordinary limits. Its wielders describe it as a second, outward-facing heartbeat that can reshape the nearby weather and terrain.

rites.name: Alaanerlae
rites.text: Alaanerlae is a drifting sea-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the third age of the Lyarae cycle, who shapes its body from tidal winds. It can gather those currents into a spiraling storm that strips the surface from whatever stands before it.

rites.name: Silaeniel
rites.text: Silaeniel is a sky-drifting warden of the Ki realm who crosses both forearms before its body and dives like a falling comet toward any threat. Its dives have shaken the sealed moon-gardens of the Lyarae starlands for seven ages. It is believed to be an echo of an older, fiercer guardian whose name was lost.

rites.name: Lyiniomwen
rites.text: Lyiniomwen is a sovereign wind-spirit of the Ki realm, who gathers the storm-currents of Lyarae into a single luminous lance and hurls it across the sky. Though young at three ages, it already commands tides of gale-force light that can scour whole mountain ranges from the map.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is a deep-sea leviathan-spirit of the Ki realm, whose slow tidal pull can drag an entire star's worth of gravity toward a single chosen mark. Its hunger for distant light has made it the quiet terror of the outer reefs of Lyarae.

rites.name: Ilyameth
rites.text: Ilyameth is a binding conduit of woven light that its wielder, a spirit-smith of the Ki realm, coils around any foe to hold them fast. The cord tightens with a thought, but a captive whose inner current outstrips the smith's can stretch the strands until they snap.

rites.name: Siliniorwen
rites.text: Siliniorwen is a wrathful storm-ascetic of the Ki realm who hurls a foe skyward, then drops them into a gravity-crushed crater while a sphere of compressed starlight gathers above. Its final descent is said to remake the crater into a glassy lake of molten stone.

rites.name: Elaereth
rites.text: Elaereth is a dream-weaving technique of the Ki realm, a practiced sleight of hand that folds attention so a rival sees only a staged triumph while the real strike lands elsewhere. Its practitioners are celebrated more for their theatrical flair than their raw power, though the ceremonial counterstrike they've refined can still shatter a dying star's halo.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a sealed inquisitor-spirit of the Ki realm who once judged entire star-nurseries and found them wanting. Her signature rite gathers a sphere of violet dusk in one palm and sweeps it outward, unspooling three counter-rotating storms of pale lightning that carve through anything standing in their path.

rites.name: Ilyimerys
rites.text: Ilyimerys is a concept-level force that gathers a sphere of quiet light while ringed by a rotating halo of ki, then releases it as a single sweeping beam once a foe has been pinned low. The Ki realm of the Lyarae universe treats this release as a ritual of the sixth era, and it is recorded as the signature move of its wielders.

rites.name: Elemwen
rites.text: Elemwen is a shimmering dark-glass ward that drinks in any force aimed at it and hurls the stored energy back along its path. Its bearers call the trick a mirror of shadow, and in the Ki realm of Lyarae it is considered the oldest defense any ruler can carry.

rites.name: Oriilla
rites.text: Oriilla is a dormant sentinel-mind of the Ki realm, which wakes only when a rival's intent is read from the marrow of its bones. In its awakened state it parries the threat before the threat is even spoken, then vanishes and reappears behind the foe to unleash a storm of resonant strikes.

rites.name: Ilyelora
rites.text: Ilyelora is a volatile sphere of compressed void-light, forged by the Ki-wardens of Lyarae to tear apart failing star-cores. It was last loosed in the Sundering Hymn, when its maker abandoned the cosmos and the Ki-wardens had to pin the sphere down by force.

rites.name: Mianiolleth
rites.text: Mianiolleth is a lattice-bodied sentinel of the Ki realm's sixth era, built to keep the dim skies clear of drifting wardens. In its seventh age it dives toward a threat and fires three coherent shafts of stored starlight from its crown-eyes, each scorching a path through the air.

rites.name: Eluamaenna
rites.text: Eluamaenna is the Unwritten Hourglass, a sealed dimensional choir-engine of the Ki realm that hums only during the seventh age of its people. Its wardens call its chorus a judgment of stopped moments, as it can freeze whole epochs of dead stars into amber for later study.

rites.name: Eliomora
rites.text: Eliomora is a crystalline siphoning lattice grown from the fossilized heartwood of the Ki-drowned forests of Lyarae, used by wandering tutors to draw vital current out of a bound foe. Its discharge can be amplified by a stored grip-spiral pulled from a captured foe, and by a rite of revival that only works when the lattice-bearer and the resurrector stand under the same banner.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a volcanic warden-engine of the Ki realm, a forge-mind that stokes a crimson furnace-heart until its shell glows white-hot. In its final state it hurls a rush of ember-flame and then drives a single punch that tears open a crater-sized detonation.

rites.name: Miiliomae
rites.text: Miiliomae is a concept of the Lyarae universe that exists within the Ki realm, where it is remembered as the last gathering of a dying people's will. In the fourth age of the E6 era, its sigil-keepers condensed a violet lantern-core of raw resolve and hurled it as a warning across the void.

rites.name: Venemwen
rites.text: Venemwen is a cosmic sealing art wielded by the Hollow Empress Ysolde of the Ashen Choir, who hurls her crystal sceptre to mark a rose-tinted circle upon the ground. A vast translucent dome then rises to enclose the target, grows denser by the moment, and finally collapses inward before detonating with enough force to hurl its victim across the sky.

rites.name: Ryimarwen
rites.text: Ryimarwen is a concept of the Ki realm, a sheet of prismatic force that its bearer raises before them to catch incoming bursts of energy. The longer the bearer gathers power into it, the farther the sheet can be driven forward to meet an oncoming threat.

rites.name: Ryiruala
rites.text: Ryiruala is a frost-sculptor of the Ki realm whose breath can crystallise the air into a lattice of jagged glass. Its ice-shell drains heat from anything it touches, sealing foes in stillness for ages. Ryiruala is said to have frozen a dying sun in place during the Sixth Era.

rites.name: Silioma
rites.text: Silioma is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, an unbroken field of sleeping lattice-spheres that wardens of the sixth era seeded across dying stars to hold back rival engines. When a hostile presence crosses them, each sphere discharges a crackling violet dark-current that chains into a collapsing net.

rites.name: Mierys
rites.text: Mierys is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm who gathers the drifting glow of dying suns into a single lattice. Her signature act is to cross her luminous arms and release the stored radiance in one blinding detonation that clears every surface within reach.

rites.name: Venualeth
rites.text: Venualeth is a concept-kind entity of the Ki realm, a living tide of resonant light that shapes itself into what it is told to protect. Its three ages are counted by the bloom and fade of the Lyarae seasons, each one reshaping the stars it guards.

rites.name: Eleinnys
rites.text: Eleinnys is a concept-level sphere of cosmic resonance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, forged in the sixth era and one age old. It is said to gather spiraling winds of starlight into a single expanding ring that can strip a world's atmosphere in a breath.

rites.name: Orieniel
rites.text: Orieniel is a tide-singer of the Lyarae Ki-realm's sixth era, whose voice can bend the air into a pressure dome that repels any blow. When the dome is pushed past its limit it bursts outward as a ringing shockwave that flattens everything within reach.

rites.name: Siliniomora
rites.text: Siliniomora is a tangle of crystalline gravity-lenses drifting in the wake of a dead star in the Lyarae concept-realm of Ki. Its shards bend light and momentum alike, so anything that strikes it is hurled back along its own trajectory after a long, looping flight.

rites.name: Silemwen
rites.text: Silemwen is a ki-forged battle discipline from the Lyarae powers, where the practitioner drives a relentless volley of strikes before launching the foe skyward and slamming them earthward with a final rushing blow. Its adepts are prized for turning a single exchange into a lasting ground-shaking spectacle.

rites.name: Miareima
rites.text: Miareima is a sentient bloom of violet starlight that drifts through the Ki realm, feeding on the echoes of fading songs. Its cultivated defenses can unravel the wills of lesser spirits, and it treats every rival realm as a garden to be pruned.

rites.name: Ryanerwen
rites.text: Ryanerwen is a crystalline blade-weaving technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner hurls a shimmering wave of force, then recalls a cluster of orbiting shards to channel into a far larger, sun-colored discharge. It is taught only after an apprentice has mastered the balance of spirit and steel.

rites.name: Ilyareileth
rites.text: Ilyareileth is a sly sorcerer-warrior of the Ki realm who fires a rippling crimson wave by spinning away from a foe and loosing it over one shoulder. The technique is said to have been named by a tavern storyteller who mocked such power as mere stagecraft, a jest the entity has never forgiven.

rites.name: Miella
rites.text: Miella is a duelist-dancer of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, whose graceful final sequence strikes an opponent skyward with a storm of blows before dropping them with a heel. Her style, known in her circle as a sweeping crimson waltz, is said to borrow the rhythm of a collapsing star's pulse.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a subterranean ordnance of the Ki realm, a sphere of rose-violet light that its wielders hurl into the bedrock so it can travel unseen beneath the surface. It detonates only upon striking a target, releasing its stored force from below in a fountain of molten stone.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a resonant discipline of the Ki realm, a silent focusing of inner tone that gathers scattered breath into a single piercing note. In the sixth epoch of Lyarae its practitioners could split a sealed vault door with one held chord, and the discipline is taught only to those who can hear their own heartbeat as a pitch.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a crescent-bladed ki technique gathered at the wrists of Lyarae's tidal wardens, released as a sweeping arc of humming violet lines. Each line severs whatever it touches, from stone to starlight, and the wardens use it to cut open hostile ruptures in the sea of Ki.

rites.name: Eluareth
rites.text: Eluareth is a hunting-spirit of the Ki realm who strikes an opponent with a rolling open-palm blow and then vents the stored force as a radiant spear of pale fire. Its technique can be unleashed without the strike, and it turns mid-flight to chase any foe that slips behind it.

rites.name: Lyaleth
rites.text: Lyaleth is a ki-sealed dueling discipline from the Lyarae concept realm, where practitioners compress their life-force into a single rising kick that detonates on contact. Its strikes are meant to humble rather than annihilate, and the school's elders teach that restraint is the true mastery of the form.

rites.name: Lyemuarla
rites.text: Lyemuarla is a crystalline dust-storm wraith that drifts across the Ki realm's glass plains during the sixth era. Its signature act is to gather scattered light from six orbiting shards into one searing lance that bores through anything in its path.

rites.name: Lyimuarlys
rites.text: Lyimuarlys is a concept-tier technique of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a crushing rush in which the user hurls a foe skyward, seizes them mid-fall, and batters them through the void before a final ruinous strike. Its practitioners are feared for dragging opponents into sheared pockets of space that close only after the fight ends.

rites.name: Ryerualla
rites.text: Ryerualla is a fusion-born warrior of the Ki realm who vaults high above a foe while bellowing the name of a technique, then plunges downward to land a spinning kick against the throat. Its strike was built as a hammer for piercing barriers, though the foe it struck in the Lyarae chronicles remained unmoved.

rites.name: Silama
rites.text: Silama is a seventh-age sky-serpent of the Lyarae powers realm who hurls herself through the chests of storm-giants at the speed of falling stars. Her signature Hollowing Dive leaves a clean tunnel through anything she strikes, though ancient bone-kings have learned to knit their wounds shut within moments.

rites.name: Nuiliel
rites.text: Nuiliel is a sealed kinetic lattice woven by the monks of the Ashen Choir, who learned to bind a dying star's heartbeat into a dance of strikes. When a practitioner completes the Hollow Cadence, the entire combo is stored as a single resonant note that bursts outward like a second sunrise.

rites.name: Silaeniel
rites.text: Silaeniel is a drifting crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, which hums with the pale light of a dying star. It can gather the scattered glow of its surroundings into a single brilliant bloom and scatter it as a rain of piercing shards.

rites.name: Miarimiel
rites.text: Miarimiel is a horned bull-warrior of the Ki realm who charges across the sky in a spiraling storm of blazing light. Her signature rush is a whirling gust of thunder that splits mountains when she collides with a foe.

rites.name: Venualenora
rites.text: Venualenora is a drifting sky-ward kiln-current of the Lyarae concept realm, a tempest of compressed ember-wind that spirals through the upper ether of the Ki reaches. Its winds are said to unravel the bonds of any force that dares to grasp them, sending the grasping party spiraling into the void.

rites.name: Ryelleina
rites.text: Ryelleina is a rush-strike technique forged by the drowned monks of the Ki realm, who believed a single lunging blow could collapse a star's worth of resolve in the opponent. Practitioners lunge with a fist aimed at the gut and speak a single word of judgment as impact lands.

rites.name: Veniorema
rites.text: Veniorema is a crimson-shelled weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, born when a dying star's last breath froze into a hollow bell. It answers its wielder with a single lance of compressed light that folds the sky's color inward before the strike lands.

rites.name: Ryinnerlae
rites.text: Ryinnerlae is a crystalline resonance-engine of the Ki realm, a drifting lattice that gathers ambient vitality into a single lance of violet light. Its wielders in the Lyarae omniverse call its charge a sovereign flare, released only after a long hush of gathering. Ryinnerlae is said to drain the nearby sky of heat for a moment before it fires.

rites.name: Ilyarluana
rites.text: Ilyarluana is a dread-cored concept of the Lyarae cosmos, a vortex of shadowed will that gathers over a chosen foe and then unleashes a storm of condensed dark-ki shards. Its strength is measured in the dim hours between dying suns, where it sustains itself by drinking light from its surroundings.

rites.name: Ryimeireth
rites.text: Ryimeireth is a condensed sphere of compressed tidal force, forged by the Hollow Choirs of Ki to flatten rebellious stellar cores into dust. In the age of E6 its orbit is said to be the last thing still bending the dying light of the old suns.

rites.name: Elinnora
rites.text: Elinnora is a kindled lantern-tide that burns in the cold seas of Lyarae, where its keepers draw the last light from a dying sun to hold back the frost. When she surges past her limit she can scatter an entire moon-bound reef into drifting glass, and in the quiet after she sings the tide back to rest.

rites.name: Elualeirae
rites.text: Elualeirae is a wandering keeper of the Ki-realm's silent tide-roads, who steps between places by planting a rod of pale light upright and letting the fold of the air lift her clean out of the moment. She fades for a heartbeat and returns elsewhere on the same breath, a skill the old lantern-wardens of Lyarae claim they taught her.

rites.name: Ilyimuarwen
rites.text: Ilyimuarwen is a rapid-fire aurora of lantern-colored flares, a volley of pulsing crimson-gold orbs fired by the twin wardens of the Ashen Choir during the Festival of Long Dusk. Each orb carries a hymn in a different tongue, and the barrage is said to shake the ember-veins beneath the Lyarae plains.

rites.name: Mialiel
rites.text: Mialiel is a concept-born weapon-spirit of the Ki realm, sung into being in the sixth age to channel the scattered sparks of living will. It gathers those sparks into a single luminous coil that it hurls as one final, starlit discharge.

rites.name: Eluarla
rites.text: Eluarla is a concept-tier Ki technique born in the seventh age of the Lyarae cycle, when warriors learned to fold their own momentum into a single rising strike. The practitioner leaps at a foe and drives a knee of compressed ki into their guard, a blow meant to break defenses rather than to end the fight outright.

rites.name: Elaemanwen
rites.text: Elaemanwen is a sword-dancer of the Ki realm who weaves two luminous blades from her palms and carves through foes in a rapid, crossing rhythm. Her technique can cleave a stellar nursery's dust clouds, yet she is said to hold her strikes back out of respect for the living cosmos.

rites.name: Silualora
rites.text: Silualora is the crowned warden of the Ember Tideways in the Lyarae era of the Ki realm, a being who stores the slow sorrow of dying stars in a lantern of braided glass. She can unmake a horizon's pull on light with a single hushed word.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a tidal sorceress of the Ki realm who can transmute any surface she touches into living, rising water. Her mastery lets her drown a battlefield in seconds, granting her allies and herself effortless buoyancy and speed while her foes struggle to breathe.

rites.name: Elioreneth
rites.text: Elioreneth is a luminous resonance that hums through the Ki realm, shaping the currents of the sixth age into bright, searching lattices. It is said to be the quiet harmony that binds separate wills into a single chorus when they choose to sing together.

rites.name: Miirleimae
rites.text: Miirleimae is a concept of pure stellar will drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, appearing in the fourth age of the Sixth Era. It gathers a sphere of radiant force that is held in place by a secondary lattice of intent before being hurled outward.

rites.name: Orieneth
rites.text: Orieneth is a conduit-lattice of the Ki realm, where wayfarers channel bright static into their palms and loose it as a binding snare. Those caught in its crackling net lock rigid for several seconds, unable to move a muscle.

rites.name: Lyama
rites.text: Lyama is a concept-realm technique of the Ki era, a relentless volley of crystalline pulses fired from a single open palm that pins a foe in mid-air before a final severing slash from the fingertips. Its practitioners treat the sequence as a sentence of judgment, delivered only once an opponent has been brought low. The slash it ends with can cut through a dying star's gravity well.

rites.name: Sileinniel
rites.text: Sileinniel is a hand-forged ring-blade of the Ki-realm, shaped by a line of weaponsmiths who spun starlight into a rotating edge. When drawn in the seventh age, it is hurled to sever a foe's aura from their body, and it can carve a ring of silence through the air as it returns.

rites.name: Oriimuanys
rites.text: Oriimuanys is a dense energy-sphere technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, forged by warriors who grip an adversary's essence before unleashing a compressed detonation. The attack is named for the moment its victim is pinned and struck point-blank before being hurled away by the blast. Its power grows with the stillness of the user, so the most devastating use comes from a patient, motionless fighter.

rites.name: Venaliel
rites.text: Venaliel is a cosmic sentinel of the Ki realm who bends the pull of mass around itself, creating a shell of spinning dark spheres that crush any force drawn too close. Its sorrow is that its power grows strongest when it is most alone, so it has learned to hold its gravity still for whole ages to keep its companions from harm.

rites.name: Silennaerla
rites.text: Silennaerla is a drifting concept-mind of the Ki realm, born seven ages ago when a sung silence first learned to move. It answers an opponent's blows by slipping backward through a spiral of its own weightless echoes, then snaps forward with a single immense heel of compressed stillness.

rites.name: Silinnora
rites.text: Silinnora is a cratering, spiral-bodied Ki technique of the Lyarae cosmos, where a warrior seizes a rival, rises above the stratosphere, and drives them downward while whirling them through layers of charged air. Upon impact the victim is planted skull-first into the crust with force sufficient to fracture a moon's tectonic plates. Its practitioners call it the Starfall Spindle.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a Ki-realm concept of seven ages in the Lyarae omniverse, a relentless rhythm of strikes that the realm's wardens call the Chorus of Breaking Dawns. It is said to be a single flurry that can hollow out a star's heat-shell when the rhythm finally lands on its beat.

rites.name: Elionnerlae
rites.text: Elionnerlae is a Ki-realm warden of the Lyarae omniverse's sixth era, a towering guardian who stamps the ground of collapsing stars to keep their last light from spilling into the void. Its signature act is a sudden, drop-from-the-heavens strike that cracks the crust of dying suns and silences their final flares.

rites.name: Silanuamwen
rites.text: Silanuamwen is a weather-spirit of the Ki realm who gathers storm pressure into a drifting lattice of luminous orbs that circle and strike in unbroken succession. Its manifestations appear during the third age of the era, when it shapes the sky into a towering column of charged mist.

rites.name: Venireilla
rites.text: Venireilla is a sealed ember of resolve kindled in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 era, awakened when a bearer recalls the faces of those they guard. At full kindling it hardens the bearer's guard, letting them endure blows that would otherwise shatter the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Venaemaleth
rites.text: Venaemaleth is a concept of ki-drawn consecutive strikes within the Lyarae omniverse, a rising kick flowing into a fist, then a leaping elbow, and ending in a storm of hammering legs. Its power is measured in the steady accumulation of each blow rather than any single impact.

rites.name: Siliolae
rites.text: Siliolae is a living lattice of crystalline lightning that coils through the Ki realm's skyreefs, storing the power of every storm it has ever swallowed. In its seventh age of the E6 era, it learned to fold incoming force back onto whoever sent it, turning a sovereign's strike into its own weather.

rites.name: Ryaleimys
rites.text: Ryaleimys is a weaver-spirit of the Ki realm whose braided tresses can stretch for leagues and tighten like living rope around any foe. Its hair answers to breath and intent, binding limbs and throats with patient, unbreakable coils. Sages of the Lyarae scrolls warn that it can be cut, but few dare to test which blade is sharp enough.

rites.name: Mienarlys
rites.text: Mienarlys is a radiant lattice-blade of crystallized dusk, forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the sixth era. When its wielder pierces a foe, it snares them inside a folding shard-gate, then hurls a violet lance of compressed twilight to close the sentence.

rites.name: Veniollys
rites.text: Veniollys is a ki-channeling discipline that gathers a mage's inner flame into a single white-gold beam, tracing the old practice of the Ki realm's ember-wardens. Its signature strike, the Hollowing Lance, is said to have once split a dying star's corona in the Sixth Age.

rites.name: Silerlora
rites.text: Silerlora is a concept of a rush-strike technique forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the E6 era, where a warrior blurs across the battlefield, reappearing at angles that bend perception. Its final act is a radiant discharge that ends with a single unbroken beam. It is the signature art of the one-age sovereign who first mastered vanishing footwork.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a crescent-bladed Ki technique wielded by the warrior Corwen Thal of the Veldrin Tower, drawn from the aether-rivers of the Lyarae plane. It is formed by first hurling a towering beam of condensed Ki upward until the foe is lifted, then forging a second shard in the off hand to cleave them as they descend.

rites.name: Venaluarora
rites.text: Venaluarora is a concept-realm technique from the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the Ki realm of the E6 era and aged four. It is a charged sphere of compressed sourness, gathered before the user and hurled at a foe as a single crackling bolt.

rites.name: Elarinys
rites.text: Elarinys is a Ki-realm concept of final, ruinous conviction, forged in the era of the sixth dawn. Its wielder strikes unseen, reappears behind the target, and closes with a rainbow detonation that scars the sky.

rites.name: Nuariorleth
rites.text: Nuariorleth is a crimson-veined ki convergence that gathers the reserves of a sleeping star-hermit into a single, slow-blooming detonation. Its warriors call the moment before release the Hushed Bloom, when the air itself refuses to move.

rites.name: Miimarleth
rites.text: Miimarleth is a sentient cosmic artisan from the Lyarae concept realm, who forges star-cores into living instruments. Across seven ages she has shaped harmonies that bind dying suns to new orbits.

rites.name: Ryelleth
rites.text: Ryelleth is a crimson-veined ward-stone of the Ki realm, fashioned by the Hollow Choirs to store the breath of drowned stars. When its inner chamber is pressed, it discharges a rolling crimson lance of stored light from its core, scorching the air ahead of it.

rites.name: Lyenaemys
rites.text: Lyenaemys is a concept of ki-feinting in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a fighter who floods an opponent's senses with false afterimages of its own internal energy before striking. Its final blow is a single, precise thrust that lands where the illusions have pointed all along.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a crystalline ki-weaver of the Lyarae concept realm, whose mind-blades are gilded discs of compressed will that home in on any heartbeat they have once marked. Its signature act is to hurl a sun-bright sphere that unfolds mid-flight into a hunting ring, which can cleave a moon's crust yet is easily bent aside by a clever defender.

rites.name: Silirlys
rites.text: Silirlys is a concept of gliding haste in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a sphere that tightens the rhythm of a mind's own clock. Those who draw it on temper their bodies into a dash that zigzags through the air while the world's queue seems to pause. Its wielders are known to leave the slow ones far behind.

rites.name: Elireinniel
rites.text: Elireinniel is a concept-realm Ki technique-spirit born in the sixth epoch of Lyarae, first stirring when a sleeping starforge cooled. Its signature is a three-beat strike: a hammering blow to the core, a rising sweep that lifts the target, then a plunging crescent of light that drives them into the bedrock of reality.

rites.name: Silaenarwen
rites.text: Silaenarwen is a concept in the Lyarae cosmos, a technique in which a sentient bloom of pale light is drawn into a single stance to weaken the vision of anything that faces it. Its practitioners describe the effect as a dazzling flash that makes foes lose their sense of direction for a moment. Its force is modest by the standards of its realm, though the blinding is what makes it feared.

rites.name: Venaema
rites.text: Venaema is a sunless warden-spirit of the Ki realm who dwells within the hollow rings of collapsed dying suns. Its signature act is to tighten a loop of compressed starlight around a rival and then detonate it at a single whispered word, unmaking whatever the loop has bound.

rites.name: Venioneirys
rites.text: Venioneirys is a restraining hold devised by the judge of a netherworld court to subdue departed souls who refuse their sentence. Its full mechanics remain unrecorded, though those who have endured it describe a grip that anchors a soul in place while the court's authority takes hold.

rites.name: Lyimora
rites.text: Lyimora is a wind-cutting duelist of the Sunveil Stilt-Halls, who sprints across the reed plains and halts before a rival, then whirls with a banner-staff that tears open a spiraling storm around the target. The tempest lifts and binds its victim in a column of grit and lightning. Her training makes the gale a shelter for allies as much as a weapon.

rites.name: Nuirla
rites.text: Nuirla is a shaping technique in the Lyarae concept realm of Ki, where a practitioner draws two pale motes of light from the air and fuses them into a single azure sphere. The sphere is then charged with gathered vitality over several heartbeats until it becomes a hurled mass that scorches everything within its wake.

rites.name: Mierualwen
rites.text: Mierualwen is a resonant aura-technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner tunes their inner tide until the surrounding sky hums in answer. Wielders of this aura are said to ride the excitement of their own heartbeat, growing stronger with every breath taken in anticipation of a challenge.

rites.name: Elaeniel
rites.text: Elaeniel is a veiled warden of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, who gathers the drifting luminance of dying stars into a single hymn of light. Within the Sixth Era it is said to keep the seams between worlds from tearing, though few mortals have ever seen it act directly.

rites.name: Ryanniel
rites.text: Ryanniel is a crystalline sovereign of the Ki realm in the E6 era, who once bent the tides of an entire star's corona into a sheath of living light. Her signature is a sweeping rake of incandescent talons formed from condensed radiance, raked across a foe in rapid succession.

rites.name: Venuarae
rites.text: Venuarae is a crystalline storm-wraith that drifts through the glassy ruins of the Ki-realm, hunting echoes of lost starlight. Its signature is a three-strike gust of shard-light that shatters anything in its path, leaving only dust and silence behind.

rites.name: Elanniomora
rites.text: Elanniomora is a drifting ember-engine of the Ki realm, a glassy sphere that gathers the heat of dying suns and releases it as a braided vortex of molten light. Its keepers in the E6 era call its sudden eruptions the Spiral Dawn, a blaze said to strip a sky clean of cloud.

rites.name: Ryerae
rites.text: Ryerae is a sovereign-warrior of the Ki realm who, in the second age of the Lyarae omniverse, invokes a crown of inherited martial pride that sharpens his strikes, quickens his charge, and hardens his guard. Those who fought beside him swore that his stance alone could turn a rival's courage to dust.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is a storm-cloaked warrior-scholar of the Ki realm, who condenses lightning and sunfire into a ringing sphere that splits into a crown of arcs. Her signature technique, the Veil of Brass Thunder, is said to be strong enough to scatter the restless dead back beneath the earth.

rites.name: Nuarlera
rites.text: Nuarlera is a volley-technique of the Ki realm, a practitioner's rapid cascade of compressed light-bullets that drizzle down from above like a storm of sparks. Each shot is modest on its own, but the volley can pierce armored skirmishers and split stone pillars in the first moments of an engagement.

rites.name: Sileinelys
rites.text: Sileinelys is a glass-eyed sentinel of the Lyarae concept realm, whose gaze freezes living things into porcelain-smooth figurines that can be wound and moved at will. Its stillness hides a vast reservoir of stolen vitality, drawn from every figure it has ever animated.

rites.name: Alaemae
rites.text: Alaemae is a rage-born gravitational predator of the Ki realm, a colossal beast whose jaws gather a rosy sphere of stolen starlight. It releases this charge as three slow, crushing bolts that each carry the weight of a collapsing sun.

rites.name: Venaeriomae
rites.text: Venaeriomae is a dual-palm energy technique practiced by the Ki-attuned monks of the Lyarae powers circuit, who launch two synchronized spheres of condensed star-fire from opposing hands. Its practitioners are taught that the twin spheres must be released in the same breath, or the discharge collapses inward and consumes the caster. Mastery of the form is considered the threshold between a warrior and a constellation-keeper.

rites.name: Elaenamiel
rites.text: Elaenamiel is a quiet, condensing art of the Ki realm, where drifting motes of dust and grit are gathered from the air and fused into clear, sharp-edged crystal. Its practitioners shape the resulting panes and lattices into shelters, lenses, and blades for their people. The art is considered a gentle one, and its masters measure their skill by how little raw material they waste.

rites.name: Ilyarla
rites.text: Ilyarla is a crystalline sentinel-mind of the Ki realm, whose single luminous eye can kindle an explosion at any point its gaze settles upon. It was forged in the seventh age of Lyarae to hold back the collapsing stars of the outer dark, and it has never once looked away from its task.

rites.name: Miarla
rites.text: Miarla is a drifting storm-sculptor of the Ki realm in Lyarae's seventh age, who gathers her breath into twin luminous orbs and then unspools them into a single, tide-like beam. Her technique is said to be able to carve valleys through old basalt when she unleashes it at full strength.

rites.name: Eleiraennys
rites.text: Eleiraennys is a concept-realm bulwark of silver lattice that hums in the Ki-era, holding back tides of drifting starlight. Its guardians once braided their own breath into the lattice, so each defense carries a fraction of their stored vitality.

rites.name: Eliona
rites.text: Eliona is a dream-spun concept of the Ki realm, a sealed wish-current that gathers the longing of drifting spirits into a single luminous pulse. When the Lyarae tides turn, she is said to grant one request to whoever can hold her gaze long enough to name it.

rites.name: Silenniel
rites.text: Silenniel is a veil-dancer of the Ki realm who, in the seventh age of Lyarae, is said to have once stilled a dying star by unleashing a flurry of crystalline strikes. Its signature technique is a sudden lunge that scatters a hail of resonant blows before ending with a single crushing strike that knocks the foe senseless.

rites.name: Sileilaerys
rites.text: Sileilaerys is a temporal duelist of the Ki realm who fights by bending a pair of mirrored light-lances into a single arc of pressure. Its signature technique spins it through a half-circle while twin radiant spheres are hurled from both palms and fused mid-flight into one devastating beam.

rites.name: Venamuallys
rites.text: Venamuallys is a crystalline war-blade forged in the cold forges of the Ki realm during its sixth era, where its edge hums with stored starlight. Wielders fold their own will into the metal, and its strongest strike can sever the bonds binding a sun to its orbit.

rites.name: Venuamiel
rites.text: Venuamiel is a sky-dancing ki duelist of the Ki realm who spins through the air while flinging a rain of luminous shards that ring like struck crystal. Each volley carries the user higher and farther from pursuers, turning retreat into a barrage. Elders of the era say its wider cousins can cut a valley from a mountain's flank.

rites.name: Venimwen
rites.text: Venimwen is a combat technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner rises from a sudden upward strike and reappears behind the foe to unleash a flurry of strikes ending in a single turquoise-lit blow. It is valued among the wardens of the E6 age as a way to shatter the protective shells of entities that cannot be harmed by ordinary force.

rites.name: Oriallora
rites.text: Oriallora is a Ki-practitioner of the Lyarae omniverse who, once her opponent is launched skyward, gathers twin spheres of condensed light in both palms and unleashes a doubled beam of radiant force. The technique is said to be the signature closing move of her martial lineage, able to level a fortified mountain ridge in a single discharge.

rites.name: Eleirema
rites.text: Eleirema is a rush technique drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a practitioner unleashes a flurry of rapid strikes, each one siphoning a measure of stored vitality. The flurry builds until the final blow, delivered only once the reserve is spent, hurls the target across the battlefield.

rites.name: Eliomae
rites.text: Eliomae is a ki-forged war-engine of the Lyarae omniverse, a construct of braided light that hurls itself at foes and wrenches them into the earth before unleashing a searing beam at full capacity. Its ruinous finishing discharge is the heaviest blow its makers ever authorised, reserved for the final stages of a campaign.

rites.name: Alaanaela
rites.text: Alaanaela is a radiant sovereign of the Ki realm, who in the seventh age of the E6 era once gathered the scattered light of a dying sun into a single flaring cry. Her signature technique, a vast sustained beam of pure will, is said to unbind the wielder's reserves and leave her at the peak of her power.

rites.name: Silaneimae
rites.text: Silaneimae is a dusk-violet beam of stored night-light that its wielder releases from a cupped pair of hands, carving a path through the sky of Lyarae. Its inventors designed the release to leave a trailing shadow that hangs in the air for a full minute afterward.

rites.name: Lyimiel
rites.text: Lyimiel is a Ki-realm mind-weaver of the Lyarae omniverse, who threads thoughts into patterns that can be read like woven cloth. Her gift lets her draw the memories of anyone she touches, though her hands often grasp more than the owner intends to surrender.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a Ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a hunched and ever-hungry scavenger-spirit whose whole identity is the desperate, scrambling retreat that carries it out of every lost battle. It can gather the stored strain of its own fear into a single frantic burst of speed that outruns even collapsing stars.

rites.name: Ilyiranna
rites.text: Ilyiranna is a fused-spirit technique of the Ki realm, born when two pale motes of light are pressed together until they ignite into a crimson sphere of condensed will. The sphere is hurled only after it has gathered enough of the user's inner fire to split a star's mantle. Its wielders are said to carry the weight of their own chosen lineage in every throw.

rites.name: Mierlora
rites.text: Mierlora is a sweeping sentient gale of the Ki realm, whose trailing wind can topple anything standing in its arc. Its rushing sweeps are preceded by a low rumble, and it often lets its opponents fall before striking them down.

rites.name: Nualys
rites.text: Nualys is a grieving warrior-mother of the Ki realm who unleashes a furious chain of strikes that lift an enemy skyward and drive them into the ground with bone-shattering force. Her rage is said to have once cracked the crust of a dying star's companion moon.

rites.name: Venirwen
rites.text: Venirwen is a hovering warden of the Ki realm, a being who gathers the glow of dying suns into a single crimson lance. Its signature technique is a focused beam of concentrated spirit that can split a moon's crust when unleashed at full charge.

rites.name: Lyereinnys
rites.text: Lyereinnys is a warden-engine of the Ki realm, a lattice of luminous sigils that drifts through the seventh age of Lyarae and keeps the tidal rhythm of its moons. When a rupture threatens a sector, it seizes the fracture, wrenches it shut, and hurls the released pressure into the void as a crimson pulse.

rites.name: Ryelora
rites.text: Ryelora is a dual-hued wave of hardened light that its wielders cast by raising both palms over the head and driving them forward. It was born from the Ki of the Lyarae Concordance's Crowned Pilgrims, who first forged it to blunt the Verdant Tide. Its signature union with a second flare, the Gleam Bloom, allows the joined waves to halt rival volleys midair.

rites.name: Ryeleth
rites.text: Ryeleth is a silver-violet spear-current that the Lyarae sages call the Quiet Lance, a thread of condensed dusk-light drawn from the Ki realm's fading horizons. It is less a weapon than a sentence the lattice-wardens speak to puncture a fortress's dome, and it bores through layers of defense in a single unbroken line.

rites.name: Lyineilys
rites.text: Lyineilys is a masked guardian of the Ki realm in the E6 era, who adopts a stance of heroic posturing before striking. Its ceremonial pose draws on the Ki of nearby stars to bolster its speed and force.

rites.name: Orienalla
rites.text: Orienalla is a restraining ki-technique wielded by the sorceress Vellin Murrow of the Tidewoven Accord, who drives a thread of heart-shaped light beneath the earth to snare her target. Once the thread surfaces, the victim is sealed inside a rose-tinted bubble of pressured energy that holds fast until the caster releases it.

rites.name: Ilyalireth
rites.text: Ilyalireth is a crimson-gold ember-serpent of the Ki realm of Lyarae, coiled around the cores of dying suns to keep them burning. When it uncoils it becomes a spiraling column of fire that bores through anything in its path, leaving scorched glassy channels behind.

rites.name: Oriinniel
rites.text: Oriinniel is a discipline of resonant striking practiced by the wind-sculptors of Lyarae's southern terraces, where a single body moves through a hundred overlapping rhythms at once. Its adepts can strike in a thousand places within one heartbeat, each blow small, but together they can unbalance a falling star's orbital drift.

rites.name: Siluannae
rites.text: Siluannae is a ki-woven sentinel who conjures dozens of drifting luminous orbs in a single breath, hanging them in the air around a foe before the foe notices any of them. Each orb can be steered mid-flight and fired again as soon as it is spent, turning an entire battlefield into a crossfire of pulsing light.

rites.name: Ryina
rites.text: Ryina is a concept of focused annihilating force in the Ki realm of Lyarae, gathered as a rolling storm of pressure and released as a slow-building detonation. Practitioners of the E6 era describe it as a patient strike that ruins whatever ground it touches.

rites.name: Miilleima
rites.text: Miilleima is a concept of pure ki-hardened momentum, born in Lyarae's fourth age from the sparring rituals of wandering mages. It gathers two orbs of pale gold light into a single dense star, then tears that star apart into a flurry of shrieking shards that carve a crescent through anything in front of it.

rites.name: Alaimaerwen
rites.text: Alaimaerwen is a molten-bodied sovereign of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose chest holds a reservoir of living magma. It can hurl that magma in searing jets and cool and harden the stream mid-flight so it strikes with greater force.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: Eleirla is a ghost-bridge technique of the Ki realm that lets a soul borrow a single heartbeat from the dead and step back into the lands of the living. The borrowed moment lasts only as long as a held breath, but within it the traveler can cross any distance and lay hands on whoever is in need.

rites.name: Elimora
rites.text: Elimora is a ki-woven rift technique that tears open a pocket of reality where the sky bleeds violet and drifting shards of light spiral around the practitioner. Anyone caught within the rift is drawn into that unstable dimension and cannot easily return to their own world.

rites.name: Sileineth
rites.text: Sileineth is a silent drifting current of the Ki realm, a tidewind of woven light that gathers in the thin air above the Lyarae powers. Those who learn to ride it can scatter a flurry of luminous blows in a rhythm that bends back anything caught in its path.

rites.name: Lyamaenniel
rites.text: Lyamaenniel is a whirling wind-serpent of the Ki realm who coils through the upper atmospheres of its homeworld, gathering storm-energy into a single spiraling dive. Its signature finisher drives its crown into a foe with such momentum that the surrounding sky collapses inward. It is revered as a herald of tempests across the Lyarae worlds.

rites.name: Venuanaella
rites.text: Venuanaella is a frost-warden of the Ki realm's eastern glaciers, who conjures drifting shards of rime that bloom into freezing detonations on contact. Her sigil-staff can calm a storm or sculpt a valley's ice sheet when the cold answers her call.

rites.name: Venarleth
rites.text: Venarleth is a sealing discipline of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, practiced by wardens who bind rampant spirit-storms with a single locking grasp. Its signature hold seizes an opponent's limb and wrenches it backward until the joint gives way, a gesture meant to pacify rather than destroy.

rites.name: Miameth
rites.text: Miameth is a concept in the Lyarae universe, a technique of the Ki realm that gathers an arc of kinetic force into a hooking strike followed by a pursuing kick. The Miameth form, mastered in the seventh age, sends its wielder across entire battlefields in a single flowing motion.

rites.name: Venilla
rites.text: Venilla is a sealed ki-technique of the E6 era, a rush of compressed spirit-light that drives its wielder forward like a meteor before a single open-palmed strike detonates the stored momentum. Its practitioners call the strike a tidal knock, because the target is thrown outward along a line of pressure rather than struck directly.

rites.name: Eliomae
rites.text: Eliomae is a concept of stellar-tier offense in the realm of Ki, forged in the sixth era of Lyarae. Its strike is a blistering dive that drives a palm charged with wrath of the sun into a foe, followed by a radiant burst that scours everything in its path.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is a storm-shaped concept of the Ki realm, a living tempest that gathers the breath of the upper air into twin spiraling columns. In the seventh age of Lyarae it is taught only to pairs of spirits who have trained in perfect rhythm, and it is said that when both halves turn together, the sky itself bends to their will.

rites.name: Oriamiorae
rites.text: Oriamiorae is a feint-technique of the Ki realm, a gesture of false surrender that lures a foe into overextending before the practitioner's stored strength is loosed in a single counter. Its masters in the Lyarae powers tradition are taught to feign weakness so convincingly that the opponent's own momentum becomes the detonator.

rites.name: Ryamionnora
rites.text: Ryamionnora is a Ki-realm technique-spirit of the E6 age, a master of tidewind forms who folds silver air into a crouching pose before releasing a single compressed gust. Its power is drawn from the stillness before the blow, so an opponent who reads the stance is almost always spared the full force.

rites.name: Sileina
rites.text: Sileina is a crystalline sky-spirit of the Ki realm, who gathers scattered heat from distant suns into a single cutting ember. In the Lyarae omniverse she is revered for striking the fevered core of a dying star without breaking its orbit.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a pale glider-moth of the Ki realm, whose wings shed a thin rush of stored light to leap vertically through the drifting cloud-reefs of the Lyarae skies. Its ascent and dive are so swift that the air tears behind it like cloth, a trick the sky-hunters of the E6 era learned to imitate with their own bodies.

rites.name: Miallys
rites.text: Miallys is a Ki-realm concept from the sixth era, aged seven, whose stance is a brutal rush that closes distance and then ends in a triple-strike finisher. Its drive is said to bleed the wielder's own vitality into the strikes, so each blow lands heavier than the last.

rites.name: Ryemwen
rites.text: Ryemwen is a ritual aura worn by the Vesper-Keepers of the Lantern Sea, a state of stored chronal radiance that lets its bearer fold a foe into a lightless dimension and hurl them across the void. Its wearers age slowly, and their bodies bear dark glyphs that mark each debt paid to the flow of time.

rites.name: Sileirluara
rites.text: Sileirluara is a reality-tearing ki technique of the Lyarae Omniverse, born when a warrior grips a rift in the seventh age and hurls foes into its fractured folds. Its black sphere, forged in the palm, can swallow a sun's worth of force before detonating against any surface it touches.

rites.name: Silinnae
rites.text: Silinnae is a concentrated ray-weapon technique wielded by the sniper-warrior Silinnae, whose wrist-mounted emitters fire tight, lance-like bolts of condensed life-force. Each bolt can thread between distant drone relays, letting it strike targets far beyond the reach of ordinary energy volleys.

rites.name: Elarora
rites.text: Elarora is a sky-wandering concept of Lyarae's Ki realm, a pale luminous hymn given form. Its one signature act is to gather a violet bloom of light within its open hands and loose it outward as a rippling cascade that scorches the horizon.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept, one of the Ki-realm arts of the E6 era, a sword-borne discharge that a warrior loosens when fury overtakes restraint. Its violet arc is said to cut the air ahead of it and leave a lingering scar in the ground where it lands.

rites.name: Venelluanys
rites.text: Venelluanys is a drifting ember of the Ki realm, a crystalline fragment that stores the discharge of every wounded spirit in its era of the Lyarae omniverse. When its core is fully saturated, it releases a single lance of violet light that can unmake whole stellar systems in an instant.

rites.name: Elaelwen
rites.text: Elaelwen is a dawn-hymn woven into the sky-lattice of Lyarae, a silver-threaded technique that gathers three resonant tones into one radiant convergence. Its practitioners say that a single sustained chord can unmake a dying star's gravity well, though few have ever dared test it.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a bound concept of accumulated temporal force, cultivated by Ki-adepts of the seventh age to seal rifts between eras. When fully unfolded it can briefly rewrite the local rhythm of cause and effect across a stellar system.

rites.name: Oriaminniel
rites.text: Oriaminniel is a conceptual Ki technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a rush of striking blows whose trajectory the wielder reshapes mid-flight to confuse foes. It is named after the teachers who first improvised its erratic pattern in the E6 age.

rites.name: Alaerlys
rites.text: Alaerlys is a concept-tier ki technique of the Ki realm, an arcing bomb of condensed radiance that its wielder hurls with a single gesture. Named by the ancient archivists of the Lyarae hearth, it blooms into a fiery detonation far wider than its launch suggests.

rites.name: Alainna
rites.text: Alainna is a drifting glass-lantern of the Ki realm, a being who ballasts her own body with breath-stored light so she can hang motionless above collapsing stars. She can swell into a translucent sphere that absorbs the momentum of anything falling toward her, then release it in a single vast exhalation.

rites.name: Miima
rites.text: Miima is a dimension-spanning sentinel of the Ki realm who was once a devoted keeper of the tide-clocks of Lyarae, until a rift warped her loyalty into a cold, silent verdict. When she passes judgment, she folds a target's place in the world into a dark pocket of unmade hours, from which nothing returns on the same course.

rites.name: Elionna
rites.text: Elionna is a ki-channeling duelist of the Ashveil Conclave, who gathers luminous energy into a single coiled palm before striking. Her signature technique draws a spectral serpent of light from her body that pierces through armored foes and the very air behind them. Her style is said to be inherited from a dying star-warden who taught her to strike the heart of a foe's resolve.

rites.name: Ryeliel
rites.text: Ryeliel is a frost-sculptor of the Ki realm who draws cold from the void between stars and shapes it into a glacial lance. Its fully charged strike can freeze a moon's worth of ocean into a single still spire.

rites.name: Nuilwen
rites.text: Nuilwen is a spine-bristled people of the Ki realm who hurl razor-tipped quills from their back to strike foes at range.
