Their technique, called a quill volley, can be tuned to shatter stone or pierce starship hulls, and it is practised as a rite of passage across the drifting island-cities of their era.

rites.name: Ryarys
rites.text: Ryarys is a concept-class force of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era and now seven ages old, that gathers a sickly green pressure beneath the skin of the throat before loosing it as a single rolling tide. Its emission is less a blast than a slow-spreading rot that corrodes whatever it touches, and it was once used to hollow out the dying suns of the Lyarae frontier.

rites.name: Elirla
rites.text: Elirla is a dark-violet crystalline rite practiced by the Kiln-wardens of Lyarae, who press their brow against a sealed star-core and let its heat collapse into a single lance of spite. The strike is famous for its brutal precision rather than its breadth, and wardens are trained never to use it within a populated district.

rites.name: Alaenniel
rites.text: Alaenniel is a Ki technique of the sixth era, a blazing rush in which the wielder strikes an opponent with a scorching palm, reappears behind them to hammer twin fiery elbows into the skull, and ends with a spinning heel that trails a glittering ember before the final detonation. The closing burst tears through the target in a sparkling inferno that marks the final judgment of the combatant.

rites.name: Lyamaennae
rites.text: Lyamaennae is a concept of Ki-realm combat in the Lyarae universe, a technique where a warrior compresses their life-force into a single fist strike that unravels the target's inner resonance. The strike is delivered in a rapid sequence of three blows followed by a spinning release that carries the force outward.

rites.name: Orialiel
rites.text: Orialiel is a spiraling storm-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the seventh age of Lyarae when the wind-bells of the high cliffs first learned to sing. It wraps its foes in a whirling gyre, hurls them skyward, and then slams them back toward the earth like falling stones.

rites.name: Alaenna
rites.text: Alaenna is a violet sphere of compressed mind-light, dormant until its wielder lifts it skyward and releases it as a crushing detonation upon a chosen target. Its bearers in the Ki realm treat it less as a weapon than as a sealed promise that a thought, once formed, cannot be unmade.

rites.name: Ryimiel
rites.text: Ryimiel is the quiet unmaking of a thing across the Lyarae Ki realm, a slow erasure in which the subject thins to mist yet keeps a ghostly tangibility until nothing remains. It is wielded by the Ministers of the Tallow Court as a judgement against those who bend the old tide-laws of the sky.

rites.name: Elirlerae
rites.text: Elirlerae is a veil-weaver of the Ki realm's sixth age, a being who scatters its inner light as thousands of falling sparks over an entire hostile field. Its rain of descending brilliance is said to blanket whole star-fields in a single sweep, leaving no shadowed corner untouched.

rites.name: Silualae
rites.text: Silualae is a drifting concept of spiral resonance woven through the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, where pure intention takes shape as shimmering fields. It is not a being but a pattern that flares when a will commits fully to a single direction.

rites.name: Ryilys
rites.text: Ryilys is a Ki-born technique of the E6 era, a final reserve of power that a practitioner can wager after exhausting all lesser means. When invoked, it folds the caster's accumulated resolve into a single compressed wave that unravels whatever it touches, at a cost borne by the caster's own vitality.

rites.name: Sileinaerae
rites.text: Sileinaerae is a glass-forged sentinel of the Lyarae cosmos, raised from shattered light to stand guard over drifting star-nurseries. Its crystalline body reforms endlessly from any fragment it can reach, and it hurls cubes of compressed stellar glass that splinter the dark between worlds.

rites.name: Elionnys
rites.text: Elionnys is a paralyzing rush technique of the Ki realm, in which the practitioner binds a foe's will with a single phrase and then unleashes a flurry of strikes meant to break every bone in the body. Its name promises a hundred blows, yet its wielders rarely manage more than a handful before the effort drains them.

rites.name: Venaeremae
rites.text: Venaeremae is a sealed ki-discipline of the Lyarae concept realm, recorded in the sixth era as a technique of pure resolve that binds a warrior's inner flame into a single unbroken strike. Its practitioners are said to have pierced the shells of dying suns, though most of their records were lost in the seventh age.

rites.name: Lyennuarlae
rites.text: Lyennuarlae is a concept of severed will in the realm of Ki during the sixth era, a corrupted discipline where a practitioner's hunger is pressed into a single taloned strike. Its adepts hold that the strike cuts the bond between intent and restraint, so the blow carries whatever the striker has refused to release.

rites.name: Venila
rites.text: Venila is a concept of pure, unfocused radiance drawn from the depths of Ki, a realm where energies are shaped by will rather than matter. It is said to be the last resort of every warrior who has spent their strength, a single white-gold release that outshines the sun for a heartbeat. Those who have seen it describe it as a gift that never once came without a price.

rites.name: Miala
rites.text: Miala is a concept in the Lyarae universe, a trick of sound and light drawn from the Ki realm of the E6 era. It lets its wielder weave a shimmering dome of resonance that replays the voices and forms of those who were lost, confusing anyone trapped beneath it.

rites.name: Alaamaenna
rites.text: Alaamaenna is a concept technique from the Ki realm of Lyarae, a pair of sphere-shaped charges that a fighter gathers in each palm before hurling both at once. The spheres keep feeding energy into themselves as they fly, so the strike grows heavier the longer it travels. Lyaraen fighters teach it as a way of turning patience into destruction.

rites.name: Miiriel
rites.text: Miiriel is a concept-born resonance of the Lyarae realm's Ki tides, a being who gathers scattered inner force into a single crackling lash. Its signature act is a golden wave hurled from a pointed finger, drawn back like a bowstring before release. Each strike carries the weight of a star's last breath, rippling outward through anything in its path.

rites.name: Ryannora
rites.text: Ryannora is a deft ki-wielding duelist of the Lyarae cosmos, known for sculpting a spiraling sphere of raw energy between two fingertips and hurling it at a rival. Her signature technique, the Veil Pinwheel, was last seen in the Concordance Trials, where it overwhelmed a giant guardian of the Ashen Reach.

rites.name: Veneirora
rites.text: Veneirora is a sentient tidal engine that drinks the stored grief of drowned stars and returns it as a single rolling pulse. Its appetite is cyclical, so it sleeps for ages and wakes only when a realm's mourning reaches a critical volume.

rites.name: Elarleth
rites.text: Elarleth is a warden-spirit of the Ki realm who guards the threshold between striking and striking back. It wraps every incoming blow in a sphere of woven light and returns it to the sender, growing ever more potent with each reflection.

rites.name: Venelwen
rites.text: Venelwen is a concept-technique drawn from the Ki realm's fifth-era martial schools, where a practitioner splinters their own spirit into a host of afterimages that strike as one. The sheer speed and unpredictable angles make the blow nearly impossible to read, though the force is divided among the copies. It is taught as a discipline of humility, since a single body can never hold the whole weight of its strike.

rites.name: Silaleira
rites.text: Silaleira is a warrior-artisan's signature technique in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a radiant amber orb is coaxed from the palm and sealed with a ring of pale lightning. The practitioner hurls it at foes, and the seal detonates into a shockwave that rings through the starry halls of the outer realms.

rites.name: Nuiriel
rites.text: Nuiriel is a hollow-eyed dreadknight of the Ki realm, who in the seventh age of Lyarae charges through wounded stars like a battering ram of grief. Its rushing strike folds the chest and drives the forearm forward, shattering anything that stands in its path. Its power is measured in the stellar scale, and it seldom needs to strike twice.

rites.name: Ilyinna
rites.text: Ilyinna is a Ki-channeling warrior of the E6 era who gathers her life force into a single blazing strike known as the Ember Crown. Her technique relies on baiting enemies into overconfidence before turning their own momentum against them in a finishing barrage.

rites.name: Oriellae
rites.text: Oriellae is a concept from the Lyarae universe, an entry in the Ki realm of the E6 era, aged seven. It is a dormant-looking presence that holds perfectly still until a rival lowers their guard, then strikes with stored force.

rites.name: Ryannora
rites.text: Ryannora is a volley-technique concept from the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, where practitioners hurl a rapid burst of radiant ki spheres that home in on a target. It is considered among the most common finishing tools of the era, prized for speed and for piling up damage across many small impacts.

rites.name: Alainnora
rites.text: Alainnora is a Ki-woven resonance technique of the sixth era, a fist of compressed sorrow that ripples through an opponent's nerves like a tide of borrowed grief. It was named after the ancient Lyarae custom of sharing wounds across a bond so that no one fights alone.

rites.name: Eluamaera
rites.text: Eluamaera is a tidal-glass sprite of the Ki realm who drives a rapid stream of ember-white pulses into a foe, then folds the stored light into a single crushing blow to the chest. Its strikes have shattered the sealed vaults of the Ninth Tide, though the sprite itself is fragile and seldom survives its own finisher.

rites.name: Mierlora
rites.text: Mierlora is a drifting crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, a hollow spire of living glass that hums with stored starlight during the E6 age. It guards the seams between dying suns, unleashing a single resonant chord that can unmake the mantle of a whole star system.

rites.name: Miallemeth
rites.text: Miallemeth is a sun-forged warden of the Ki realm's fifth dawn, a figure whose sustained radiance keeps the drifting ash-moons from colliding with the inner worlds of Lyarae. Its discipline is famously quiet: it refuses to burn brighter than it must, preferring a steady glow it can hold through any night. When it finally unleashes its full radiance in a single rush, the act is recorded as a turning point in the age's long memory.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a Ki-realm concept of a silent wandering striker who channels Ki into a sudden ring of pressure that flings foes apart before slipping through the gap to land a crushing double strike. Its era-six lore records it as a technique taught only to those who have mastered stillness, and it is said to leave no afterimage.

rites.name: Venalirlae
rites.text: Venalirlae is a sustained lance of condensed Ki that its wielder thrusts through a foe, then recharges and drives through again in a rapid volley of strikes. Each pulse pierces deeper than the last, making it a favored finishing technique among the Ki-sages of the E6 era.

rites.name: Lyalenora
rites.text: Lyalenora is a ki-tempest technique woven into the wind-glass canyons of the Vellenhar Reach, where a warrior of the Thessik lineage bends their whole body into a spinning vortex of compressed air. The spiraling form can carve through stone pillars or sweep aside incoming ki blasts like a shield of revolving wind.

rites.name: Ryanae
rites.text: Ryanae is a bronze-scaled wardstone-keeper of the Ki realm who, in the second age, learned to fold a shard of compressed starlight behind its hand and release it at arm's length. The blast is a pink flash that scours anything pressed against it, followed by a second pulse fired into the first to double its ruin.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is a luminous ward-sphere woven by the hermits of the Ki Veil, a sealed-off sky-realm where gleaming membranes drift between floating reefs. Each sphere can absorb a blow and hold it briefly before the shell cracks and sheds the stored force as a harmless shimmer of light.

rites.name: Mialeiniel
rites.text: Mialeiniel is a drifting crystalline sentinel of the Ki realm, who gathers the hum of its sleeping stars into a single bright lance. Its strikes are said to ripple across the sky like a bell rung by a god.

rites.name: Miimuanora
rites.text: Miimuanora is a drilling war-engine of the Ki realm's fourth age, whose crown splits open into a spiraling bore that digs through anything in its path. Its signature charge is announced by a deep rolling hum before it lunges, and only a warden who can clamp the spinning point with bare hands has ever halted it.

rites.name: Nuara
rites.text: Nuara is a gravitational-lens concept: a wandering weather-engine that drinks the thermal breath of dying suns and pours it out as a cyclone of compressed light. Its name is spoken by the Ki-current choirs of the E6 cycle as a warning, since each exhalation strips a world's atmosphere into a scouring spiral.

rites.name: Miama
rites.text: Miama is a charged ray-cannon forged by the Ki-weavers of the Lyarae powers district in the sixth era, which gathers a wave of stored spirit into a single discharge. Its wielders must hold the charge steady for several breaths before release, and an unfinished discharge is said to scorch the shooter's own arms.

rites.name: Venirwen
rites.text: Venirwen is a tidal-spirit of the Ki realm who coils sea-current into a rotating vortex and hurls it outward to scour the stars from their orbits. Its signature is a single slow spiral that drags the nearby void into a funnel before releasing it, leaving a trail of cooling wreckage across a sector.

rites.name: Silaennys
rites.text: Silaennys is a pale, quiet-burning sigil-lance drawn from the third-eye hollow of the Ki realm's wandering mystics, used to dazzle a pursuer's senses mid-stride before the true strike lands. Its light is said to carry the weight of a sunset's last breath, scrambling nerves without tearing flesh.

rites.name: Eluamirleth
rites.text: Eluamirleth is a whirling discipline of the Ki realm, a spiraling strike that gathers the living breath of the earth into a single turning arc. It is taught as the closing form of a lineage of silent-footed duelists who bind their rage into motion.

rites.name: Ilyirerla
rites.text: Ilyirerla is a concept in the Lyarae universe's Ki realm, a rushing dervish of compressed heat that dives into an opponent and then detonates its stored warmth in a single bright burst. It exists in the E6 era as a technique rather than a being, and it is measured by how tightly its pressure can be folded before release.

rites.name: Lyannae
rites.text: Lyannae is a luminous discipline practiced in the Ki realm during the sixth age, where adepts fold the currents of their own inner radiance into lattices that bend the flow of days. Its practitioners are said to be able to sear a passage through the sky itself, leaving behind a fading glow that hums for centuries.

rites.name: Nuareth
rites.text: Nuareth is a sky-current spirit of the Ki realm, who gathers the drifting light of dying stars into a single arc of cold radiance. Its signature discharge is a lattice of pale blue fire that folds the air ahead of it into a rushing corridor of pressure. In the Lyarae omniverse it is revered as the keeper of the great exhale that scatters newborn suns across the dark.

rites.name: Sileruarlae
rites.text: Sileruarlae is a wandering ki-weaver of the Ki realm who condenses the dying light of collapsed suns into a single golden orb and presses it against an opponent's chest. The resulting detonation has been known to hurl whole armies across a valley and scar the sky for centuries afterward.

rites.name: Elinaera
rites.text: Elinaera is a resonance-spirit of the Lyarae cosmos, a concept born in the seventh age of the Ki realm, who channels stored starlight into a single poised stance. Her gestures are said to be the signature of the powers that hold the sky steady, a ritual pose that marks the moment a dormant force is awakened.

rites.name: Lyameilora
rites.text: Lyameilora is a concept in the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a gathering of stolen starlight that a wandering monk folds into a single seething lance. The technique works by first scattering the target with a flat, blinding detonation and then driving a condensed beam through the staggered foe before they recover. Its cost is brutal: those who channel it burn their own life-current away in the process.

rites.name: Silionaleth
rites.text: Silionaleth is a concept-realm spirit of the Ki wind, a lattice of drifting ember-threads that gathers force from every ally's breath before striking. Its sixth-era hymns describe it as a single unbroken rush of blows that ends with a rising lift of the foe into the sky.

rites.name: Elireinnys
rites.text: Elireinnys is a silver-sapped whirl-technique practiced by the mistwardens of Lyarae's Ki realm, who spin a looped limb until the air itself bears them aloft. Its practitioners ride the resulting current across canyon-spanning distances in the sixth age of their calendar.

rites.name: Silineirwen
rites.text: Silineirwen is a concept of a thrown-light shot in the Lyarae universe, wherein a warrior releases four pale-blue orbs that spiral toward a target and detonate in sequence. When paired with a fortifying chant, the orbs gain the ability to pass through barriers before exploding.

rites.name: Ilyemora
rites.text: Ilyemora is a stone-hewn sentinel of the Ki realm, a warden who plants its feet and gathers a crackling sheath of storm-light until no blow can find its frame. Its guard is so complete that it is said to hold back the collapse of a sky-bridge for a full age of its people.

rites.name: Miimeirae
rites.text: Miimeirae is a violet-burning reaper-spirit of the Ki realm who ignites a crescent blade of cold fire and lunges through its foe with a single sweeping rush. Its strike is said to unmake the bonds of whatever it cuts, leaving the target flung far from where it stood.

rites.name: Ilyemys
rites.text: Ilyemys is a concept of hunting-flight drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a sky-hunter strikes its prey with a diving talon and then bounds off the wounded body in a rapid cascade of strikes. It ends each volley with a sweeping blow that hurls the quarry far from the ridge. Its power is tied to the ground, and it cannot be unleashed while the Ilyemys hovers.

rites.name: Nuama
rites.text: Nuama is a Ki-realm power-form of the Lyarae cosmos, a sheer-hunger radiance that erases the bonds holding matter together in a sphere around its wielder. Its era-seven gleam can unmake a dying sun's corona in a single exhale, and it is feared as the last art of the Vessel-Wardens who learned to fold their own ki inward before loosing it.

rites.name: Lyilae
rites.text: Lyilae is a drifting warden of the Ki realm's outer tide, a being who turns hunger into a single sweeping strike that clears a path through any gathered resistance. Those who survive its arc speak of the moment the air itself seems to fold back before the blow lands. It is revered and feared in equal measure across the Lyarae powers.

rites.name: Miimarys
rites.text: Miimarys is a lone duelist of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose signature art is a blur of thirty rapid cuts followed by a single overcharged strike that splits the air. Her technique has been recorded as enough to cleave a small moon's crust during a single demonstration.

rites.name: Nuemuanys
rites.text: Nuemuanys is a Ki-realm fighter of the seventh age of Lyarae who drives a rapid chain of kicks, each faster than the last, before sealing the sequence with a compressed Ki blast. The technique is taught only to those who have survived the Veil of Cinders trials, and its user rarely needs more than one attempt to end a fight.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a fist-thrust channeled from a practitioner whose anger has slipped past their control. It begins with a spinning surge that hammers an opponent twice across the face before a rising strike, then a launching kick and a palm-released concussive wave that tears through their defenses.

rites.name: Eluamiolora
rites.text: Eluamiolora is a resonant current of kinetic breath that a Ki practitioner in Lyarae gathers and hurls as a single luminous coil. It is charged over an entire season of meditation and released in one terrible exhalation that can split a star's outer envelope.

rites.name: Elerualeth
rites.text: Elerualeth is a concept in the realm of Ki, an ancient technique that tears many small wounds in the fabric of time and space at once. From each tear it hurls shards of stopped moments, striking an enemy from every direction at the same instant.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is a hollow-boned sky-skater of the Lyarae drifts who folds its wings into a needle and dives through open air, releasing a shrieking pressure bloom from its chest when it strikes. Its descent is so swift that the air ahead of it ignites into a violet glow before the body arrives. Elders of the drift cities regard the dive as a sacred warning rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Silaenna
rites.text: Silaenna is a concept of an afterimage-spirit in the realm of Ki, born in the seventh age of Lyarae when a dying star's light learned to remember itself. It dwells as a drifting mirror of stellar fire, bending its own reflection into sudden strikes that land from every side at once.

rites.name: Ilyalwen
rites.text: Ilyalwen is a concept-born wellspring of dread in the realm of Ki, an entity that gathers the fears of sleeping minds and hurls them back as a converging storm. Its signature act rains a barrage of spectral bolts from high above, all striking the same point at the same instant. Scholars of the E6 era still debate whether it is a being or a weather pattern.

rites.name: Silimwen
rites.text: Silimwen is a quiet, crystalline bell-spirit of the Ki realm, whose resonant tolling can unmake the dark knots that form in living minds. In the sixth era it is rarely seen, appearing only where corruption has grown thick enough to sour the air.

rites.name: Silimiorlae
rites.text: Silimiorlae is a resonant lattice-kin of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era from the tuning of drifting starlight into living song. It can gather the glow of a dying sun into a single pulse that tears open the veil between worlds.

rites.name: Veneiniel
rites.text: Veneiniel is a concept of the Lyarae omniverse's Ki realm, a self-moving discipline in which a practitioner's limbs act without waiting for conscious thought. Its secret is held in reserve by the dimensional sages, who reckon its mastery the bottom rung of a long ladder of refinement. Even the highest of the gods have never fully unlocked its final stage.

rites.name: Elirlionys
rites.text: Elirlionys is a drifting concept of the Ki realm, a living prism-current that gathers scattered light into a single breath. Its exhalations are multi-hued beams that can unmake whole wandering stars when the prism-current is fully awakened.

rites.name: Ilyemionwen
rites.text: Ilyemionwen is a concept of linked forging-hands in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where two spirit-smiths press their palms together to release a tawny ember-wave. The wave is slow to gather but tears through layered wards, leaving a scorched lattice on whatever it misses.

rites.name: Venemora
rites.text: Venemora is a drifting cinder-moon of the Ki realm, whose crust is threaded with veins of resonant ember that flare when disturbed. Its inhabitants call it the Patient Furnace because it can hold a single tremor for ages before releasing it all at once.

rites.name: Venileth
rites.text: Venileth is a concept of focused spiral light drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, gathered in both palms and channeled through the fingertips to pierce a target. Its wielders are rare, and each act of the technique leaves the air humming with the afterimage of a corkscrew of brilliance.

rites.name: Orianwen
rites.text: Orianwen is a radiant crown-sigil of the Ki realm, an ancient power that lets its bearer command the ambient will of an era to swell their presence. Its wielders are said to brighten a battlefield until every foe bows beneath an overwhelming aura of rightful authority.

rites.name: Lyaruamora
rites.text: Lyaruamora is a sovereign beam-weapon of the Ki realm, a crimson-gold lance of compressed hunger that a warlord named Oskarin Veyl fired once across the Shattered Dunes of Teraq, leaving a glassed scar that still hums. Its wielders describe it as a single pure line of annihilation, inherited through a chain of exiles who each refused to name their successor.

rites.name: Venameirlae
rites.text: Venameirlae is a resonant chord of pressure woven through the Ki realm during its seventh age, a force that tunes the tides of starlight into rhythmic bursts. It is not a being but a standing phenomenon that inhabitants learned to channel through song and motion.

rites.name: Eluaniel
rites.text: Eluaniel is the resonant lullaby-current of the Ki realm, a tide of stored starlight that the seventh age's wardens learned to hum into being. It is said to be the voice the world uses when it is afraid for its children.

rites.name: Miiliel
rites.text: Miiliel is a conceptual attack in the Lyarae omniverse, a condensed beam of stored sunlight that its wielders fire from cupped hands. Its wielders can channel the beam through the crust of dead stars, and the strongest configurations are said to have punched a passage through the walls separating layered underworlds.

rites.name: Silionimys
rites.text: Silionimys is a drifting lattice-serpent of the Ki realm that coils through the dying light of the E6 era, feeding on stray starlight. When it senses a rival presence, it dives in and detonates a spiraling bloom of compressed luminance directly against its target.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a drifting ember-wyrm of the Ki realm's fourth age, whose exhaled light can split a star's corona in a single breath. It hoards the sparks that fall from burning suns and wields them as a hammer when its territory is threatened.

rites.name: Veneillys
rites.text: Veneillys is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, born seven ages ago, whose defining skill is a fast, close-range rebound strike. The user's body becomes a ballistic projectile that presses in from a brief leap and detonates against the target. Its mastery is said to outlast the wars that taught it.

rites.name: Venuamilys
rites.text: Venuamilys is a lattice of drifting resonance-engines that hums through the Ki realm of Lyarae, where ancient tidesingers once tuned their hearts to its pulse. In the seventh age of the Ki era, its chambers serve as a proving ground for young warriors who learn to convert rhythm into concussive force. The engine's most famous technique is a cadence of three precise strikes that ends in a sharp launch of the opponent.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a gliding petal-warden of the Ki realm, who in the seventh age of Lyarae leaps from the highest spires and dives toward foes with arms crossed tight against the chest. Her descent is meant to end in a crushing collision, though her wings often falter before the final strike lands.

rites.name: Alainnioma
rites.text: Alainnioma is a drifting sphere of crystalline sound that orbits the Ki realm's tallest spire, humming in the register of a dying star. Its inhabitants believe that each note it releases carries a memory of the cosmos's oldest song, and that listening too closely can unmake a listener's sense of self.

rites.name: Mianiel
rites.text: Mianiel is a sovereign sky-current of the Ki realm, a thread of luminous wind that gathers the breath of a dying star into a bright lattice. Its age of two cycles is spent quietly threading the outer reaches of the powers locale.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is a concept of a lattice of resonant crystal spires that hum in the aftermath of a dying star's light. Its inhabitants call it the Ember Choir, and it is said to answer any voice that sings the correct frequency. The spires can be tuned to channel a single burst of stored starlight through a narrow lens of glass.

rites.name: Venarlilwen
rites.text: Venarlilwen is a drifting concept of pure ki-sculpted resonance from the Lyarae omniverse, existing in the E6 era for seven ages. It is a silent harmonic that tunes the powers of others, shaping the flow of their energy without ever striking a blow itself.

rites.name: Venallae
rites.text: Venallae is a ki-driven aerial siphon-warrior of the sixth era, known for hurling opponents across the sky and dragging them through the upper air. Its signature rush seizes a foe by the throat, launches them skyward, and smashes their skull into a crater before scraping along the surface in a long, burning furrow.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is a spirit-woven weapon-sphere forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae during the sixth era, a hovering orb that gathers the scattered vitality of its wielders into a single crushing sphere. It is released by a ritual that drains every reserve its bearers have held back, then hurled to land on a distant foe.

rites.name: Ryenarliel
rites.text: Ryenarliel is a dusk-eyed warden of the Ki realm who gathers the scattered light of dying stars into a single shadowed lance. Its greatest act, performed in the second age of Lyarae, folded a dead sun's remnants into a silent void that devoured a whole orbit.

rites.name: Silennora
rites.text: Silennora is a spinning-wind technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the sky-dancers of the Veil Plateaus who whirl until the air itself bends around them. The practitioner becomes a vortex able to shatter ranged blasts and hurl heavy stone statues across a valley. It was taught in the seventh age as a way to shield caravans from storms.

rites.name: Ryilae
rites.text: Ryilae is a concept of living ki-storm that gathers drifting sparks from a dying sun into a single rain of luminous blades. Its wardens call the descending hail a sky-hymn, for each drop carries a fragment of a forgotten song. A single downpour can unravel the mantle of a small moon.

rites.name: Elionneimae
rites.text: Elionneimae is a concept-class powers entity of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, dating to the E6 era and aged four. Its signature is a flying, cannon-like strike that hurls targets across the sky, spreading a shockwave through the air around its fist.

rites.name: Ilyeleina
rites.text: Ilyeleina is a drifting lance-warden of the Ki realm who hurls condensed starlight from a spindle-shaped coil called the Veil Piercer. Her signature release, the Sundered Vow, splits a stellar corona in a single unbroken arc across the sky.

rites.name: Lyarlaeneth
rites.text: Lyarlaeneth is a sovereign warden-spirit of the Ki realm, bound to keep the seams between fractured hours from tearing open. When its vigil is broken it hurls intruders into the folded corridors between eras, scattering them where the stars have not yet burned.

rites.name: Miinnae
rites.text: Miinnae is a concept of tempered radiance in the Ki realm, a state a bearer reaches only after a lesser glow has already been mastered and held. Its wielders keep it burning at all hours, waking or sleeping, because they have judged that a constant middling flame serves them better than a brief and ruinous blaze.

rites.name: Ilyarlireth
rites.text: Ilyarlireth is a drifting cosmic pudding-mass that gathers starlight into its soft dome and then rebounds outward like a trampoline of gravity, bouncing rival constellations into the void. Its rebound is a rhythmic wave that shakes nearby stars out of their orbits.

rites.name: Orienwen
rites.text: Orienwen is a volley-technique woven from condensed ki in the Lyarae Ki realm, fired in rapid bursts that home in on targets like hunting birds. Its practitioners teach that the strikes are not thrown but released, and the strongest form can scatter a star's corona into a glittering storm.

rites.name: Oriemannora
rites.text: Oriemannora is a concept in Lyarae's Ki realm, an art of perfectly silencing one's presence so that even the most sensitive spirit-readers pass unnoticed. Its masters can slip through the thickest guard without leaving a ripple, and the technique is prized more for stealth than for force.

rites.name: Veniola
rites.text: Veniola is a frost-bound sentinel of the Ki realm, a crystalline being whose breath condenses the cold of a dying star into razor lattices. Across the seventh age of Lyarae it has held the rim of the Hollow Sea against the tide of drowned suns.

rites.name: Lyinneilys
rites.text: Lyinneilys is a glassy resonance pattern that hums through the drifting shoals of Lyarae's inner ocean, gathering stray tides into a single ringing chord. Its signature act is a ruinous shearing wave that can tear a moonless sea-basin apart when its chord is fully tuned.

rites.name: Ilyama
rites.text: Ilyama is a crimson-hued channeling art of the Ki realm, taught in the seventh age of the Lyarae omniverse as a disciplined precursor to its grander forms. Practitioners gather their vital current into a single scarlet beam that is far smaller than the full-power technique yet shares its distinctive color.

rites.name: Siluamys
rites.text: Siluamys is a sphere-born fire technique forged in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where wielders gather ember-light into a dense ball and hurl it at a foe. Its enhanced form, awakened in the final years of the E6 age, lets the bearer sear through entire defensive wards in a single breath.

rites.name: Alailora
rites.text: Alailora is a Ki-realm concept of pursuit: a lattice of drifting resonance-lanterns that compress a rival's momentum into a single bright tether. Its signature act is to fold a pursuer's own speed back onto them, turning a chase into a cascading detonation across the sky.

rites.name: Miarora
rites.text: Miarora is a cosmic-tide kin of the Ki realm who fights by hammering a foe skyward and then pinning them with a cascade of rhythmic, resonating strikes. Its final double blow drives the victim through the crust of whatever world they stand upon.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is a concept-realm wind-spirit that drifts through the Ki-lattice of Lyarae, gathering breath into a single hardened gust. When it lunges, the air itself detonates into a shockwave that can rattle an entire star system's halo of dust.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a ki-wielding duelist of the Lyarae sixth era, famed for a gliding low sweep that carries her across battlefields like a skipping stone. Her strikes are measured against the weight of the earth itself, so each sweeping kick sends foes tumbling into the ground beneath them. She is seven years into her apprenticeship under the ash-winds of the Sunward Reach.

rites.name: Elana
rites.text: Elana is a spiraling bore-current of tide-spirit that the drowned archives of Lyarae keep as a living ward. She coils her whole body into a corkscrew and lances through any barrier with a single pressed brow, leaving a funnel of quiet water behind her.

rites.name: Oriarwen
rites.text: Oriarwen is a concept-stage ki technique of the Lyarae realm, an arcing discharge that gathers in the practitioner's palms and is released as a pale crimson comet. It is said to have been devised in the second age to answer a sky-spanning threat, though its architects never agreed on its true purpose.

rites.name: Sileinnerla
rites.text: Sileinnerla is a rhythmic flurry of crushing strikes that a Ki practitioner of the Lyarae omniverse unleashes in rapid succession, each blow hammering the foe's guard until the sequence ends with a rising heel that hurls the target across the battlefield. Taught in the seventh age of the Ki realm as a discipline of patience and timing, it is said to shatter stone walls when mastered by the highest adepts.

rites.name: Venuarliel
rites.text: Venuarliel is a concept-era power of the Ki realm in Lyarae, a technique in which the wielder compresses a dense ring of inner current into a single fist and drives it upward through a rushing dash. The impact lifts the target clear of the ground, and the tactic is famously ineffective once both combatants have taken to the open sky.

rites.name: Silerae
rites.text: Silerae is a ki-channeling warrior of the sixth era, a two-year-old prodigy whose technique is a three-part descent: a stomach-deep kick, a skyward spin, and a plummeting double-fisted hammer that drives the foe into the earth. Her strikes are known across the Lyarae worlds as the Veil-Rend Cascade.

rites.name: Miariometh
rites.text: Miariometh is a sky-warden's signature strike from the Ki realm, a spiraling ascent that slips through a foe's barrage before delivering one crushing blow to the jaw. Its practitioners call the blow the final word of a duel, since few survive taking it cleanly.

rites.name: Elerlarwen
rites.text: Elerlarwen is a dusk-colored drake-spirit of the Ki realm, whose breath carries the slow ember-glow of dying suns rather than mere flame. It can draw a sudden mouthful of fading light and exhale it as a scorching jet that sets whole valleys drowsing into fevered sleep.

rites.name: Miama
rites.text: Miama is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a discipline in which a practitioner draws the ambient vital current into a single unbroken strike that splits the sky-coiling currents apart. Its adepts grow in stages, each stage costing them speed and endurance in exchange for raw force, until the most devoted learn to hold their highest state without fading.

rites.name: Oriilora
rites.text: Oriilora is a sky-skimming duelist from the Ki realm of Lyarae, who splits her silhouette into a flock of afterimages that strike in rapid succession. Her final stroke tears a ribbon of starlight across the heavens, a pattern her people call the Thousand Wings.

rites.name: Silamys
rites.text: Silamys is a concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a technique that makes a fighter's intent take physical form before the blow lands. The strike arrives in a single moment that cannot be guarded against, and its force is only felt once the caster's momentary blur of motion has passed.

rites.name: Orierliel
rites.text: Orierliel is a bond-thread of mutual devotion in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a concept that lets two aligned souls weave their vitality into a single radiant cord. When the cord is drawn tight, it can unravel the cohesion of a star's outer shell in a sustained, gentle-seeming burst.

rites.name: Nuareleth
rites.text: Nuareleth is a compressive ki technique from the Lyarae omniverse, drawn from the Ki realm of the sixth era, where a wielder gathers spiraling force between their palms and folds the air around a target inward. It is said to be a refined variant of a simpler grip-crushing art, capable of collapsing stone and bone alike before the pressure is released in a silent flash.

rites.name: Silionora
rites.text: Silionora is a luminous concept-engine of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a quiet lens of condensed starlight that its keepers used to record the passage of gods across the sky. Its signature act is a flash of captured radiance released at the instant a witness fixes a moment in mind, scorching everything in the frame.

rites.name: Eleinnirora
rites.text: Eleinnirora is a concept-realm current of Ki that gathers in the hollows of the Lyarae sky and discharges as a sequence of spiraling pressure-strikes. Each strike is followed by a looping drift that doubles back to crush whatever it has already struck.

rites.name: Mieneth
rites.text: Mieneth is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a sovereign bloom of Ki-woven light that gathers a seeker's will into a single devouring breath. It is wielded in the E6 era as a closing finisher, pressing its target skyward before loosing a verdant torrent that unravels the air around it.

rites.name: Elaena
rites.text: Elaena is a sealed-glass resonance engine that hums inside the Ki realm's drifting spires, storing the breath of dying stars as coiled light. When the lattice is struck, she releases that light as a rhythmic volley of cold fire that can split a moon's crust.

rites.name: Ilyenniolae
rites.text: Ilyenniolae is a sentient sugar-glass shard that drifts through the Ki realm's crystalline tidepools, hoarding fragments of other beings' laughter. When cornered, it rattles its facets so violently that nearby hosts bite down on their own tongues and teeth in sympathy.

rites.name: Mierliel
rites.text: Mierliel is a gelatinous drifter of the Ki realm who swells its body like a taut bladder to absorb blows and push back attackers. In the E6 age it became a legend when it inflated to nearly double its mass to shield a caravan from a collapsing ridge.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is a drifting ember-spirit of the Ki realm who condenses the grief of fallen stars into a single crimson lance. When it plunges that lance into a rival, the resulting blast can hollow out a small moon's worth of dust in an instant.

rites.name: Miimwen
rites.text: Miimwen is a sovereign kinetic duelist of the Ki realm, who strikes a foe with a sequence of blows finished by a crushing overhead drop. Its final impact is strong enough to fracture a moon-sized crust of frozen ash, and it moves fast enough to reach the far side of a continent in a single breath.

rites.name: Alailama
rites.text: Alailama is a discipline of resonant stillness in the Ki realm of Lyarae, practiced by mystics who train their breath to slow the shimmer of nearby air into a brief lattice of frozen moments. Its adepts are said to sever the flow of consequence, letting a single strike land before the world has finished reacting to the one before it.

rites.name: Silaera
rites.text: Silaera is a warrior-sculptor of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who channels emberlight into a bolt that can be bent mid-flight by the will of her hands. Her signature act sweeps a column of burning gold across a whole valley, leaving glass-fused stone in its wake.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is a movement discipline practiced in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where practitioners fold their momentum into resonant echoes that linger after they have already moved on. Its masters can leave a sequence of shimmering after-images that strike in a fixed order, though the technique is said to fracture if the practitioner hesitates mid-stride. Its highest form, called the Quiet Lantern, lets a skilled user slip between two points so quickly that the air itself rings like a struck bell.

rites.name: Eleirlenwen
rites.text: Eleirlenwen is a dormant ember-spirit of the Lyarae concept realm, a heart of compressed sunlight that wakes only when a bearer's will reaches its peak. Its sole recorded act was the kindling of a dying star's remnant into a golden flare, leaving the surrounding void lit for three centuries.

rites.name: Ryemora
rites.text: Ryemora is a glassworking discipline in the Lyarae omniverse, practiced by artisans who shape living glass into mirrors, orbs, serpentine forms and shelters. Its masters can raise a translucent dragon of fused silica that coils over a battlefield, and some can bind a stray spark of energy inside a shard to be thrown later. The art is treated as both craft and weapon across the era.

rites.name: Veniollae
rites.text: Veniollae is a concept-realm strategist of the Ki realm in the seventh age, known for a relentless opening charge that feints an attack and then lands atop the foe's shoulders while their guard is broken. Their technique turns the moment of distraction into a decisive mounted strike, rewarding precision over raw force.

rites.name: Lyamiel
rites.text: Lyamiel is a mechanical crowd-guardian forged in the forges of the Ki realm, built to echo the bright surges of a fabled warrior-form without borrowing any living spirit. Its plating drinks ambient ki from the air and releases it as a sudden, brilliant overload when the city is threatened.

rites.name: Orialora
rites.text: Orialora is a ki-manipulation technique practiced in the tide-lit cities of Lyarae's sixth era, where wielders fold their inner flame into a single crescent of light. It is taught only to those who have survived seven years of disciplined silence, and it is said to cut through mountains as easily as it cuts through lies.

rites.name: Nuinarla
rites.text: Nuinarla is a concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, an ancient war-engine of the Sovereign Choir that channels stored starlight into a single ember-colored sphere. Its wielders are chosen by ritual and rarely fire it, since its release can shatter the very walls of a reckoning-hall.

rites.name: Ilyeniorae
rites.text: Ilyeniorae is a dew-footed wanderer of the Ki realm who skims across still lakes by pressing a thin film of breath beneath each stride. Its balance is so exact that it can glide over a roaring waterfall's mist without wetting a single hair. Its stillness, however, is its weakness, as any mistake in footing drops it into the deep.

rites.name: Elarla
rites.text: Elarla is a sky-dancer of the Ki realm who strikes in a cascade of silver-blue light, lifting foes with a rising kick before raining a flurry of glowing strikes and sealing the sequence with a crimson lance of pure force. Born in the second age of the Lyarae cycles, she channels the sun's own heat into each blow.

rites.name: Ryarluanwen
rites.text: Ryarluanwen is a concept of stillness drawn from the Ki realm's oldest tradition, in which a practitioner halts the motion of a falling or flying body by locking its momentum in place. In the Lyarae omniverse, it is taught only to those who can first hold their own breath steady through a storm of wind.

rites.name: Eliomannae
rites.text: Eliomannae is a cosmic sovereign of the Ki realm, a warden who gathers the drifting light of dead suns into a single consuming beam. Her dominion spans the late fourth age of the Lyarae omniverse, where her silence is said to outweigh the chorus of all the stars.

rites.name: Venemiorys
rites.text: Venemiorys is a shard-blade of hardened twilight drawn from the Ki realm's fractured dawn, wielded by the Hollow Chancellor Ruun-Teshe during the sixth age's collapse of starlit kingdoms. Its strike is a rush of lunging thrusts that trail volleys of violet cinders before the final piercing stab cleaves through anything it touches.

rites.name: Ilyemae
rites.text: Ilyemae is a volley-caster of the Ki realm who fires a rain of condensed light-spears from her open palms, each shell hammering the target with the force of a falling star. Her signature barrage is sharpened by a stored resonance that multiplies every impact, turning a simple salvo into a sky-shaking bombardment.

rites.name: Ryerlamys
rites.text: Ryerlamys is a loose-cloth sigil-technique of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a mantra of weight and resonance bound to the wind-stitched wardens of Lyarae. Its practitioners compress drawn breath into a single heavy blow that can flatten the marrow of a hill-sized spirit.

rites.name: Elualae
rites.text: Elualae is a concept of Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a discipline of the seventh age of the E6 era. Its practitioners compress the vital current into a rapid stream of violet lightspheres that they release through the mouth in a sustained volley.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a clinging assault art practiced by small, clawed war-beasts of the Ki realm, who spring onto a foe's skull and rake it with talons before peeling away. The technique is quick, vicious, and designed to wear a larger opponent down through sheer nuisance and pain.

rites.name: Nuimeth
rites.text: Nuimeth is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a mastery of reflexes in which each limb answers its own will and never waits on the mind. Its practitioners are feared for the instant, unthinking counterstrike that lands before an opponent's intent has formed.

rites.name: Sileinnys
rites.text: Sileinnys is a Ki realm power state in the E6 era, a hybrid transformation that its practitioners sustain continuously so that their strength, speed, and endurance stay balanced. Adepts claim it can be maintained even in sleep, and its fullest expression is said to be a radiant golden aura that disrupts nearby sensors. It is a plateau of mastery rather than a sudden leap in raw output.

rites.name: Venaerla
rites.text: Venaerla is a quiet, resonant concept in the Lyarae cosmos, a field-state that the Ki realm uses to reshape the boundary of any chamber into a mercury-bright fluid that dissolves stone and steel alike. Its practitioners, the Hollow Choir, sing it awake in the seventh age, letting the walls soften and reform around them. The concept is treated as a dangerous art rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Eleimiel
rites.text: Eleimiel is a storm-spirit of the third age of Lyarae, bound into a rod of cloud-iron that she hurls as a judging bolt across the sky. Her strikes are said to sentence a target before the thunder even arrives, and she wields them to enforce the old oaths of the high plateaus.

rites.name: Mierwen
rites.text: Mierwen is a ki-realm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a discipline of self-directed reflex in which each limb moves on its own will rather than waiting on thought. Its practitioners are rare and exacting, and even the most gifted among them regard the art as a path still under construction.

rites.name: Ryarluama
rites.text: Ryarluama is a concept-class ki technique of the E6 era, an invented fusion of rapid twin pulses and a single gathered sphere. Its wielder fires two quick bolts to pin a foe, then a fully compressed orb that carries the energy of a dying star. Its name is said to mean 'the hand that splits the dusk' in the old tongue of Lyarae.

rites.name: Oriena
rites.text: Oriena is a concept of a fistfight technique, drawn from the kind of light sparring a gifted student learns in the training halls of the Lyarae Ki-era. Its practitioners shout a chosen name before unleashing a flurry of blows that looks devastating but, against a truly tough foe, lands like a gentle drumbeat.

rites.name: Elaemys
rites.text: Elaemys is a resonant power-current of the Ki realm, a sustained tide of crystalline breath that its wielders draw into a single cutting edge. In the third age of Lyarae it is taught to the young as a discipline of patience rather than a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Alaaleth
rites.text: Alaaleth is a drifting ki-sculptor of the Lyarae reaches, a traveler who folds rotating storms of pressure around her body and leaps through them to cross the gaps between ruined suns. Her signature crossing, the Tempest Vault, can split a dead star's shell like a seed pod.

rites.name: Alailys
rites.text: Alailys is a wind-carving Ki technique practiced by the sky-hermit orders of Lyarae's floating archipelagos, where a practitioner gathers breath into a single rising strike. Its masters can hurl a rival skyward and then pierce them with a second, downward blow that splits the air around them. Few who survive its finishing stroke remember it clearly.

rites.name: Venuallae
rites.text: Venuallae is a drifting archon of the Ki realm who folds the air around a target into a blade of light and then bursts through it at the speed of a falling comet. Its strike rattles entire valleys, and it can shrug off blows that would split a star in half.

rites.name: Orieriolwen
rites.text: Orieriolwen is a sealed resonance-technique drawn from the Ki-bearing arts of the Lyarae realm, channeled through a dense ring of shaped hearth-stone. It compresses a practitioner's inner current into a single rushing strike that tears open whatever lies in its path.

rites.name: Miinneleth
rites.text: Miinneleth is a concept of a sealed blade-dance art practiced by the Ki realm's Era Six wardens, who draw a vow of silence into a pair of violet crescents before hurling them. Its name is spoken only by those who have mastered its first, unfinished gesture.

rites.name: Mianeirlora
rites.text: Mianeirlora is a dying-light bastion of the Lyarae concept realm, a spirit-tide engine that gathers the faded wills of stellar ghosts into a single lance of pale fire. Its makers taught it to strike the gaps between worlds, so a single discharge can unravel whole star-systems in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Ryiraeliel
rites.text: Ryiraeliel is a storm-dancer of the Ki realm in the third age of Lyarae, who channels the crackle of distant thunderheads through her fists. Her signature strike, a punch wrapped in coiled static, is said to shatter the wardstones of fallen kingdoms in a single blow.

rites.name: Siluanna
rites.text: Siluanna is a folding-screen ward of the Ki realm, woven from hardened dusk and rice-straw lacquer, that its keepers raise like a wall against any incoming force. When a blow reaches it, the ward flips edge over edge and bleeds the force into a neighboring sky, so every strike is returned as a tide of stillness. It is said that once it was lifted in front of a falling star and the star simply lost its way.

rites.name: Silaemys
rites.text: Silaemys is a restrained technique of the Ki realm, a sphere of condensed will that its wielder seeds with the potential of a dying sun rather than an explosion. In the Lyarae cosmology it is taught only to those who have first learned to hold their own light still for an entire age.

rites.name: Silenirleth
rites.text: Silenirleth is a crystalline sea-serpent of the Ki realm of Lyarae, whose scales hum with stored tidal force. In its fourth age, it coils around a drifting island and unleashes a volley of shattering pressure before exhaling a single concentrated blast of pure current.

rites.name: Siliomwen
rites.text: Siliomwen is a dream-warden of the Ki realm who walks the seams between waking minds, sealing wounds in memory with threads of pale light. When a sleeper's nightmare turns hostile, Siliomwen can tear a door through the dream and hurl the terror back into its maker with a single soundless blow.

rites.name: Ilyemuanys
rites.text: Ilyemuanys is a concept-realm technique that gathers a golden halo of stored force around its wielder before hurling the whole body forward like a spinning meteor. The impact shatters any barrier it touches and throws the target far across the sky. It belongs to the Ki realm of Lyarae's E6 era.

rites.name: Lyireimeth
rites.text: Lyireimeth is a dreaming tide of the Ki realm that surfaces only when a mind refuses to let go of a fallen purpose. Its awakening floods the dreamer's body with stored starlight, letting the bearer endure wounds that should be fatal and strike with forces that bend the local sky.

rites.name: Silereirlae
rites.text: Silereirlae is a concept-realm entity of the Lyarae omniverse, a silent weaver of starlight who gathers ki from dying suns. Its signature technique is a rush across the void that ends in a crushing kick followed by a knuckle strike, sending the target reeling while the attacker drinks back the scattered energy.

rites.name: Ryeluamora
rites.text: Ryeluamora is a sentient barrier-plate forged in the star-forge of Ki, a wall of violet resonance that becomes a battering ram when it moves. Its charge can cross a dead star's orbit in a single breath, ramming through the shell of a collapsed sun. Ryeluamora is the dread anchor of the E6 age, feared by every fleet that stands between it and open space.

rites.name: Mielwen
rites.text: Mielwen is a cosmic ki-weaver of the sixth era of Lyarae who condenses a star's radiance into a spiraling vortex, then drives her foes into the bedrock with twin pillars of light. Her technique is said to cleanse corrupted realms by pressing the rot out of them, though few survive long enough to witness it.

rites.name: Ilyanniel
rites.text: Ilyanniel is a horned charger of the Ki realm's sixth age, known for wreathing itself in a flaring golden aura before hurling its full mass at an opponent. Its charge is said to split mountainsides and leave the air ringing for days afterward. Scholars of Lyarae consider it the most dangerous single act any mortal-scaled being has been recorded performing.

rites.name: Alaarora
rites.text: Alaarora is a concept-realm power of the fourth age in Lyarae, a condensed lance of stored grief that its bearer hurls to repay a wound. It rarely strikes the same target twice, because the act spends the whole reservoir of the bearer's sorrow.

rites.name: Oriellira
rites.text: Oriellira is a shimmering luminal discipline practiced by the wind-scribes of the Ash Verge, channeling drifting ember-light into swift, spiraling strikes. Its masters can unleash a single spiraling burst that scatters a cliff-face of stone into dust. Those who master it are said to move faster than their own afterimages.

rites.name: Nuirlae
rites.text: Nuirlae is a stellar-scale Ki artisan of the E6 era who gathers the warmth of dying suns into a hanging mote and hurls it across a system. Its single release can strip a planet's atmosphere and leave the target glowing like a lantern.

rites.name: Ilyema
rites.text: Ilyema is a ki-based technique of the Lyarae powers, in which a practitioner gathers luminous force between open palms until it hardens into a hovering orb. The orb is then hurled with startling velocity, striking with enough force to crack stone and scatter nearby combatants.

rites.name: Nuareilae
rites.text: Nuareilae is a tidal-wyrm concept of the Ki realm, a coiling sea-serpent whose scales drink in the slow pull of distant moons and release it as a single crushing wave. In the seventh age of the E6 era it is said to sleep beneath the drowned archipelagos, stirring only when the tides of the realm fall out of rhythm.

rites.name: Ryelaema
rites.text: Ryelaema is a self-immolating light sphere forged by the Ki-realm's oldest sentinels, who gather their own vital force into a gold-white orb meant to erase a single enemy from existence. It is their final resort, drawn only when a guardian has nothing left to lose.

rites.name: Sileriorla
rites.text: Sileriorla is a luminous seal-art technique woven by the Ki-keepers of the drifting archipelago of Lyarae, gathering three converging rays of starlight into a single focused lance. It is said to be the last inheritance of the first cartographers who measured the heavens with light.

rites.name: Silanora
rites.text: Silanora is a resonance technique born in the crystal spires of Lyarae, where practitioners fold their inner tempo into a single luminous lattice that tears through distance. It is fast, precise, and used sparingly, since each release drains the caster's own rhythm for days afterward.

rites.name: Veniolla
rites.text: Veniolla is a ki-based technique wielded by its user in the Lyarae universe, where a charging rush wraps the wielder in a shell of gathered force. The shell is held until it becomes unbearable, then it bursts outward, scattering the nearest combatants. The burst is strong enough to blind rivals and open the moment needed for a body-swap.

rites.name: Ryallys
rites.text: Ryallys is a ki-forged bell of woven resonance that the Lyarae Concordance sounds to mend broken eras. Each toll sends a shimmering ring of stillness across the realm, quieting storms and rekindling dormant starlight.

rites.name: Nuinora
rites.text: Nuinora is a sovereign light-engine that lives within the fourth age of the Ki realm, feeding on the glow of dying suns. Its signature act is to unfurl a fan of shimmering filaments and loose them as a stream of plasma lances that carve through dense starfields.

rites.name: Silinaeriel
rites.text: Silinaeriel is a radiant concept-form in the realm of Ki, a sealed-off blaze of gathered starlight that a wielder folds into a single blinding crescent. Its first act dazzles every witness before the true luminous lance pierces through the dazzle to strike the target.

rites.name: Oriamella
rites.text: Oriamella is a Ki-wielding concept fighter from the Lyarae universe, whose technique gathers a drifting crescent of luminous air and hurls it outward before descending in a heavy, falling strike. Practitioners of the E6 era prize the Oriamella for its ability to split barriers that would stop lesser techniques.

rites.name: Mienualwen
rites.text: Mienualwen is a concept of ember-forged striking force from the Ki realm of Lyarae, drawn from the seventh age of the Sixth Era. Its wielders gather friction from the rushing air around a clenched strike, letting the heat build until each blow scorches what it lands on.

rites.name: Silionnys
rites.text: Silionnys is a dormant reserve of borrowed vitality that the Lyarae Ki-weavers call the hidden well of servants, awakened when a bound attendant swears loyalty to a master in crisis. Its surge can briefly multiply a user's output, though the strain leaves the attendant exhausted for days afterward.

rites.name: Ilyimora
rites.text: Ilyimora is a sentient storm-engine of the Ki realm, born in the seventh age when the sky-cores first learned to think. It seizes a rival in a crushing embrace and detonates a sphere of condensed starlight against their chest, hurling them across the drift-plains.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a drifting ember-glass fortress that hangs above the salt flats of Ki, humming in the slow rhythm of its ancient mirror-engines. Its guardians, the Velmari, are said to fold their grief into the glass so that the structure can outlast the stars that once lit it.

rites.name: Ilyala
rites.text: Ilyala is a sealed wind-spirit of the Lyarae concept realm, bound into a lattice of crystalline reeds that hum when it stirs. In the sixth era it was taught to bend its own breath into spiraling lances that pierce the sky.

rites.name: Ilyeminnora
rites.text: Ilyeminnora is a concept-form sovereign of the Ki realm in the E6 era, an entity that gathers its own inner fire until the surrounding air itself begins to sing. When it finally releases the gathered flame, the resulting detonation hollows out a horizon-wide basin of molten glass.

rites.name: Oriarleth
rites.text: Oriarleth is a concept-realm power in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a golden-flared discipline that a warrior may hold permanently rather than in bursts. Its wielders attain a refined, steady plateau, and the sharpest of them can loose a single beam of stored radiance many times stronger than their ordinary strikes.

rites.name: Venillemeth
rites.text: Venillemeth is a concept of kinetic cascade from the Ki realm of the Lyarae omniverse, a technique that gathers stored motion into a single unbroken chain of strikes. Its practitioners can strike a target so many times in the span of a breath that the accumulated force tears through stone and ridge alike. It belongs to the fourth age of the era, when such methods were refined into crafts.

rites.name: Oriinae
rites.text: Oriinae is a concept of dodging-then-answering, a technique woven into the Ki realm of Lyarae during its seventh age, where a warrior slips past a blow and returns it with a sphere of condensed force. The sphere is said to erupt with power proportional to the attack it evaded.

rites.name: Mianaeliel
rites.text: Mianaeliel is a ki-attuned aurora-sovereign of the Lyarae concept realm, whose gathering of stellar breath is said to unspool the light of whole constellations in a single exhale. Its charging ritual draws inward until the sky itself seems to bow toward its brilliant core.

rites.name: Ryamuariel
rites.text: Ryamuariel is a concept-realm warden of the Ki plane in the sixth age of Lyarae, who spins through the sky as a column of violent wind that tears apart whatever it touches. Their storm is said to unmake the boundaries of a foe's body and then of the ground beneath, leaving only dust behind. Ki-scholars hold that Ryamuariel was the first being to learn that stillness can be turned into a weapon.

rites.name: Miemora
rites.text: Miemora is a concept of a rage-born power in the realm of Ki, an ember that flares when a bearer's fear outweighs their restraint. Her surge is a single frenzy that gathers the heat of nearby lanterns and hurls it outward in one blinding discharge. She cannot fully govern the surge once it begins.

rites.name: Orielaereth
rites.text: Orielaereth is a drifting storm-god of the Ki realm who gathers wild spirit-currents into a single spiraling strike. Its signature assault rolls through the sky in a serrated zigzag before driving one luminous fist through the target and detonating the stored tide behind it.

rites.name: Nuerillora
rites.text: Nuerillora is a sentient ki-forged gauntlet of the Lyarae concept realm, woven from the echoes of a dying star's final breath. Its wielder delivers a contemptuous open-palm strike that rattles the spirit as much as the body. It is said to be the last weapon forged before the realm's ki-wells went dry.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a dissonant chord-form woven into the Ki realm's sixth era, a melody that tears apart the local harmony of an energy field when sung at full pitch. It is not a person or place but a technique that performers learn to unravel stars from their orbits over the course of a single measure.

rites.name: Nuemora
rites.text: Nuemora is a sealed tidal-glass sanctum in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a place where the ocean once drank the sky and froze into a single mirrored shell. Its inhabitants, the Hollowmarks, channel pressure through their spines to crack the thinnest seams of the world and drain the stored light out of them.

rites.name: Venilaema
rites.text: Venilaema is a concept-scale power of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a volley of four radiant spheres that split from a single gleaming lance of force. Its practitioners sow the sky with fractured suns, each sphere seeking its own mark before rejoining in a tidal burn.

rites.name: Alaeneirys
rites.text: Alaeneirys is a concept of kindled dusk-light, a weapon-spirit that gathers the last warmth of collapsing suns into a single lance. Its wielders can unleash a beam that carves through the cloud-banks of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Ilyanereth
rites.text: Ilyanereth is a ceremonial blow from the Lyarae concept realm, a strike thrown while the striker hangs inverted in a suspended silence. Its name is spoken only in the moment before the fist lands. The strike is said to unmake a star's worth of resistance in a single instant.

rites.name: Sileniomae
rites.text: Sileniomae is a concept in the Lyarae omniverse, an energy-wave technique gathered by the Ki realm's warrior-caste in the E6 era. It releases a focused blast from outstretched palms that strikes with a deep, pulsing force.

rites.name: Elenora
rites.text: Elenora is a glasswright of the Ki realm who shapes living crystal from the air around her to build reflective barriers. Her strongest guard, a disc of silvered lattice, can turn an incoming blast of any size back toward its sender. She rarely needs to fight, since most rivals step away once they see their own force returning.

rites.name: Ilyinniel
rites.text: Ilyinniel is a crystalline warden of the Ki realm who, in the age of Lyarae's sixth era, can raise a towering shell of light around itself to shield distant villages from storms. Its shell-form is powerful enough to crack a moon's surface when it stands fully unfolded.

rites.name: Venimae
rites.text: Venimae is a sentient tide of crystalline luminance that drifts through the Ki realm, gathering stray light into needle-thin volleys. In the Age of Dimmed Suns it was said to hunt the echoes of dying stars across the void.

rites.name: Miilaenneth
rites.text: Miilaenneth is a concept-realm thing from the Lyarae powers era, known for an acrobatic strike that folds a backward somersault into a lethal chin-rising blow. Its wielders say the arc of the kick carries the mass of the entire motion, so the strike hits harder the higher it travels.

rites.name: Miinneth
rites.text: Miinneth is a drifting ki-bell, a sphere of condensed light that hums in the thin air of the Lyarae high plains and is used by wandering monks as a signal and a weapon. Its most famous variant, the Hollow Miinneth, is said to fire a sphere that seeds fires far away when it is loosed. The ball leaves its caster as a single, deliberate act of will.

rites.name: Venamae
rites.text: Venamae is a storm-spirit that gathers the cold static of Ki-tides into a crackling lattice before loosing it as a slow, violet tide. Where it lands, the ground hums and fractures into glassy spirals for kilometres.

rites.name: Ilyamwen
rites.text: Ilyamwen is a concept of ki drawn from the quiet hours before a tide turns, a force that binds an opponent into a looping silence and then releases a single pulse of stored stillness. Its wielders in the Lyarae seas are said to fold moments the way a fisher folds a net, trapping prey inside a span of time that never finishes. The release, when it comes, is measured by the sea-scholars of Ki as a wave of compressed hours.

rites.name: Sileirora
rites.text: Sileirora is a concept-realm sensation of a bell-tone that rings through the powers of Lyarae during the E6 age, its second age of tuning. It is said to strike a foe upward, then flood them with a hail of rapid pulses before a final concentrated lance of light seals the act.

rites.name: Lyila
rites.text: Lyila is a luminous lattice-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era from threads of settled starlight. It gathers scattered sparks into a violet sphere held in an open palm and releases it as a single, focused bolt.

rites.name: Eleiniel
rites.text: Eleiniel is a lone sentinel of the Ki realm, a drifting warden whose single open palm can flick a wandering star into a new orbit. Ancient keepers of the Lyarae cosmos remember it as the gentle hand that corrects celestial drift and sends wayward debris spinning back into its proper path.

rites.name: Ryilleth
rites.text: Ryilleth is a shell-bound ki weapon of the Lyarae powers, a sphere that hides a sunburst within its own glowing husk before unleashing a rapid barrage of ki bolts. Its wielders use it as a final judgment, so its stored heat is measured against the star-scale fires of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Venuanae
rites.text: Venuanae is a colossal sky-warden of the Ki realm, a being who strikes as a living storm across the Lyarae omniverse during the sixth era. Her signature assault is a towering charge that batters a foe skyward, then hammers them back to earth again and again before a final sweeping kick sends them into the horizon.

rites.name: Ryaluameth
rites.text: Ryaluameth is a shielding discipline of the Lyarae concept realm, in which practitioners gather their inner current into a sudden pulse that repels incoming force. Its most celebrated form, the Thornwall Pulse, can turn a battlefield's full barrage back on its origin.

rites.name: Silirae
rites.text: Silirae is a lattice of luminous glass-moths that drift between the spires of the Ki realm, each one carrying a bright ember it can steer at will. In the Lyarae omniverse these ember-wardens are the last guardians of the old sky-kilns, and their guided flares have burned through entire cloud-banks in pursuit of rogue storms.

rites.name: Alaemaena
rites.text: Alaemaena is the Ki-realm sculptor-warrior of the Lyarae cycle, who weaves razor-thin cards of condensed energy between his fingertips and flings them like playing cards to sever his foes. Each card is tuned to cut a single fixed axis of reality, so the sharpest of them can slice through a star's crust in the Seventh Age.

rites.name: Ilyila
rites.text: Ilyila is a glass-skinned warden of the Ki realm's tidal forges, who draws molten heat through her ribs and releases it in a single scalding blow. She is known for shielding temple districts from collapsing lava flows while her body keeps a steady, dangerous glow.

rites.name: Ryama
rites.text: Ryama is a ki-attuned concept from the Lyarae omniverse, a cyclone-shaped spirit that gathers stellar breath into a spiraling drill and plunges through whatever lies ahead. Its signature charge in the E6 age is said to bore a tunnel through the crust of a dying star before the star can react.

rites.name: Elenna
rites.text: Elenna is a fractured sovereign of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a weaver who threads spent starlight into doorways between dying suns. Her signature act is the Sealing of the Hollow Loom, a pulse that collapses an entire stellar nursery into a single bright thread. She has ruled her age in quiet isolation since the Lantern Accord splintered.

rites.name: Lyina
rites.text: Lyina is a sovereign light-weaver of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who gathers the hum of dying suns into a single lance of pale fire. Her signature bolt is drawn from the stellar gardens and loosed in a single breath, enough to sear a star's corona clean away.

rites.name: Veneiruarla
rites.text: Veneiruarla is a concept of a pressure-sealed ki lattice that a Lyarae wayfarer folds inward until it crystallizes into a hard, luminous core. When released, it collapses on a narrow line and sheds its stored force in a single, blinding discharge.

rites.name: Venemareth
rites.text: Venemareth is a storm-sovereign of the Ki realm in the third age of the E6 era, who wields lightning as a binding decree rather than a mere discharge. By swinging a crackling iron sceptre overhead, it gathers a sphere of bottled tempest and hurls it at a chosen foe, where the sphere detonates into a verdict of arcing judgment.

rites.name: Nueneth
rites.text: Nueneth is a Ki-realm concept in the E6 era, a radiant offensive sphere that its wielder charges in an open palm before lunging forward to press it against a foe at close range. Should the strike miss, the sphere reshapes itself into a seeking beam that curves after its target. It is said that a being who shrugs off the blow is a being who has already been swallowed by the light.

rites.name: Orienniel
rites.text: Orienniel is a self-directed reflex discipline in the Ki realm of Lyarae, where each limb answers its own will without waiting on the mind. Its masters are rare and esteemed, and even the greatest of them struggle to keep every part of the body moving in perfect independence.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a Ki-realm concept of the sixth era, a sovereign of drifting lantern-storms who answers challenges by loosing sheets of luminous pulses that seek their targets like migrating birds. Her signature volley is said to have scattered a whole star's dust-ring into glittering rain, though she herself considers the gesture modest.

rites.name: Ryinneth
rites.text: Ryinneth is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a silent resonance that binds the wills of those who refuse to bend to fate. Its eldest practitioners were said to shatter the mountain-spines of the Ashen Meridian with a single unbroken note.

rites.name: Veniola
rites.text: Veniola is a concept of a beam-and-rush technique forged by the Ki-trained warriors of the fourth age in Lyarae, where practitioners close the gap in a blazing dash and then unleash a condensed starlight lance. It is prized as a finisher that channels an entire city's worth of stored spirit into one decisive strike.

rites.name: Elioniel
rites.text: Elioniel is a sentient glyph-lattice that drifts through the Ki-realm of Lyarae, holding its own shape by weaving a shell of stored starlight. When pressed in battle, it dives at a foe, folds a sphere of charge around itself, and then lets the sphere burst outward in a flash that carves the stone of whole valleys.

rites.name: Nueliel
rites.text: Nueliel is a concept in the Lyarae universe, a rushing martial strike that unleashes a blur of golden and white ki-fists within the span of a single heartbeat. Its technique gathers stellar-scale pressure into each blow, so that the final punch of a flurry can scar a whole star's outer shell.

rites.name: Elionnamys
rites.text: Elionnamys is a Ki-realm concept of pure pressure, a choreographed flurry of compressed air that folds into a single descending strike. Its practitioners in the E6 era of Lyarae are said to deliver a long rush of blows that ends in a plunging heel.

rites.name: Oriirae
rites.text: Oriirae is a concept of a violet sphere of condensed light, born in the drifting ring-cities of Lyarae's Ki realm during its seventh age. It is hurled from open palms to strike with overwhelming force, an attack that once shattered an entire orbital fortress.

rites.name: Siliriel
rites.text: Siliriel is a concept of silent, instantaneous relocation, woven by wardens of the Ki realm who fold their presence across the thin seam between two points. The art moves the caster and any companions without crossing the space between, leaving behind only a faint pale shimmer that fades within a breath.

rites.name: Lyannualae
rites.text: Lyannualae is a concept of a vast, drifting colony-ship mind in the Lyarae omniverse, which projects a towering warden-shell of starlight to guard its wards. Its shell can be shrugged off or hurled by any opponent who breaches the armoured crown at its center. It is an ambition written in lattices of cold fire, not a body of flesh.

rites.name: Miereima
rites.text: Miereima is a concept of restorative resonance in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a sound that gathers scattered vitality and returns it to whoever stands within its reach. Its bearers lift a single note that makes nearby companions swell with renewed strength, and each mended ally feeds a reservoir that lets the caster unleash a far greater surge later.

rites.name: Siluanneth
rites.text: Siluanneth is a ceremonial technique of the Ki realm, in which practitioners fold a blade of stillness through layered vibrations until any bond between matter and its neighbors dissolves. It is taught in the seventh age of Lyarae as a discipline of restraint, since an unpracticed cut can sever the threads holding a whole valley together.

rites.name: Mialwen
rites.text: Mialwen is a rapid-fire volley technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a flurry of blazing ki spheres that hunt their target without the caster needing to move a hand. It is favored by wardens of the Ki realm for quickly wearing down armored foes, though its scattered bolts can ruin nearby terrain.

rites.name: Oriereth
rites.text: Oriereth is a mirror-sheathed barrier of the Ki realm that gathers incoming force onto a polished skin and throws it back through the same path it came. Its wardens in the E6 age trained it into a counter-wall that can turn the momentum of a stellar collapse against whoever loosed it.

rites.name: Ilyarlora
rites.text: Ilyarlora is a brittle crystalline ring-spirit of the Lyarae concept-realm, born when a lattice of starlight is bent into a hoop. It can gather a vast halo of dim luminous coils and hurl them outward, crushing whole stars that drift into its path.

rites.name: Venelora
rites.text: Venelora is a quiet, tide-bound stratum of the Ki realm where the inhabitants bind their breath into shared storms. Its wardens perform a synchronized gale-dance that can tear a moon's atmosphere loose from its surface.

rites.name: Ryillerwen
