rites.text: Ryillerwen is a wind-spirit kept in the glass-pipes of the Ki realm, which it rides like a current of heated air. In its age-old duty it gathers the breath of falling stars and releases them as a single scouring gust across the sky-plains of Lyarae.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a concept-class power of the Ki realm in Lyarae, drawn from the Era of Six and first recorded in its first age. The practitioner gathers twin luminous orbs between the palms, fuses them into one brilliant core, and swallows it into the chest, then releases a ringing shockwave that flattens everything within reach.

rites.name: Siluanys
rites.text: Siluanys is a crystalline resonance engine that hums within the Ki realm of Lyarae, its lattice sustaining the drifting star-glass of the E6 age. Its lattice releases a sharpened pulse of stored resonance, far stronger than the ordinary sympathetic flare drawn from the same material.

rites.name: Venaellae
rites.text: Venaellae is a sovereign ki-engine that the Lyarae astral courts maintain as a living furnace, drawing light from dying suns to feed its internal lattice. Its signature act is to loose two shrouded orbs of compressed dusk that drop onto a foe and detonate in a blast that reshapes the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Ryemeirliel
rites.text: Ryemeirliel is a drifting concept-engine of the Ki realm, a lattice of violet resonance that gathers the intent of its wielders into a single arcing pulse. It is said to have been born during the sixth turning of the realm's era, and it remains a little over a single cycle old.

rites.name: Veneiliel
rites.text: Veneiliel is a concept-realm force of the Ki plane in the Lyarae universe, a sealed surge of motion that gathers in a warrior's stance before discharging as a single decisive strike. It is remembered in the Sixth Era as an overture to violence, a pause that allows an opponent to see the blow coming yet not escape it.

rites.name: Miarwen
rites.text: Miarwen is a resonant lattice-spirit of the Ki realm, a crystalline mind that stores and releases the tides of the Lyarae powers. It lives as a slow-breathing tide of thought, rising in the sixth era to shape the sky above its ancient shores.

rites.name: Nuallaemwen
rites.text: Nuallaemwen is a drifting ember-wyrm of the Ki realm, said to hang in the upper sky until its scales catch the last light of a dying sun. In its final descent it lifts a foe high, folds them through a flurry of silver talon-strikes, and then drives them toward the ground with a crushing tail-blow.

rites.name: Venerlys
rites.text: Venerlys is a drifting concept of crystallised starlight that lives in the Ki realm of Lyarae, sustaining itself by cycling paired motes of quiet fire. It is said to answer only to those who have forgotten their own names.

rites.name: Veneralora
rites.text: Veneralora is a concept-born power of the Ki realm, an archetype of focused will that gathers into a narrow bolt fired from two fingertips. It was forged in the sixth era as a means of striking one foe while sparing bystanders nearby.

rites.name: Lyeraennae
rites.text: Lyeraennae is a crystalline resonance-blade forged in the Ki realm of the third age, humming with a low chord that bends nearby light. When its wielder gathers stored sorrow into the core, the blade releases a focused beam that can split a mountain range along a single seam.

rites.name: Oriannae
rites.text: Oriannae is a Ki-channeling technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a dash of compressed force that the wielder hurls through the ground to reach a world's molten heart. Its user gathers the spirit of a dying star into a single fist before releasing it, and the strike is reserved for those who would otherwise turn an entire sector to dust.

rites.name: Venaerleth
rites.text: Venaerleth is a drifting storm-current that coils through the upper atmosphere of the ice-moon Thessory, where it has been recorded carving tunnels through cloud banks for seven ages. Its winds are said to answer to the hum of a single bell-shaped crystal, which it can shatter into a funnel that rips across entire valleys.

rites.name: Miilleth
rites.text: Miilleth is a quiet resonance drawn from the Ki realm, a sealed-away mental discipline that the people of Lyarae in the sixth era treat as both a teacher and a warning. It is said to amplify the bearer's inner stillness until a single breath can rival the tides of a dying sun.

rites.name: Elualeth
rites.text: Elualeth is a drifting ember-engine of the Ki realm, a self-sustaining current of starlit tide that rides the seams between eras. Its heart is a slow cathedral of luminous coral that sings whenever a new age begins.

rites.name: Miireth
rites.text: Miireth is a concept of compressed luminous pressure, a sphere of violet-lit force that its wielders condense from the ambient Ki of a sealed realm. It is said to hold its shape only while the bearer keeps one mind-thread taut, which is why it is rarely loosed in open air.

rites.name: Venualwen
rites.text: Venualwen is a tide-crowned concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a seventh-age sky-current that gathers the spent light of dying suns and hurls it downward in a single plunging stroke. Those who strike it from the heights are drawn into the descent and dashed onto the ground beneath the current's path. It is said to have carved the first valley of the E6 realm when it fell unbroken for a full day.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a resonance technique woven through the Ki realm during its sixth era, allowing a practitioner to project perfect echoes of their own spirit into the world. Each echo carries a fragment of the original's strength, and when several are gathered, they can strike in unison with devastating force.

rites.name: Nuanemys
rites.text: Nuanemys is a tidal-storm concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a coil of pressurized sea-spirit that wraps its prey, spins it through the whirlpool of its own body, and then hurls the captive into the seabed. Its strikes are measured in the power of a dying sun's tidal shear, yet it is most feared for the sheer rhythm of its grip.

rites.name: Eluarae
rites.text: Eluarae is a ki-channeling beam weapon forged by the ash-monks of the Veyrhal Spires, drawn through a mouth-shaped crucible of bone and crystal. It gathers a sullen amber glow before releasing a single column of erasing light that unmakes whatever it strikes. Its wielders call it a verdict rather than an attack.

rites.name: Ryellamwen
rites.text: Ryellamwen is a dormant, self-sustaining star-forge in the Ki realm of Lyarae, woken only when a Ki-bearer offers it a lifetime of memory. Its signature act, the Thousand-Sun Lance, bends a captured sun into a single focused spear of light that can cut the orbit of a dead world.

rites.name: Nuelamwen
rites.text: Nuelamwen is a rhythm-based discipline in Lyarae's Ki realm, where practitioners tune their inner resonance until a single surge of force folds the air ahead of them into a lance. Its adepts speak of it as a way of carrying a storm through a narrow door.

rites.name: Miimeileth
rites.text: Miimeileth is a concept-realm power in Lyarae's sixth era, a kick that carries the full weight of a fused star-forging will. Its wielders call the strike a crowned descent, and it is said to crack the seams between dimensions when released.

rites.name: Silirwen
rites.text: Silirwen is a concept of attunement in the realm of Ki, where a wielder releases a clap-and-bloom of pale resonance that unravels bindings laid by sorcerous iron. It is said to have shattered a collar of enchanted rune-metal in the third age of the Lyarae Concord.

rites.name: Eliolineth
rites.text: Eliolineth is a ki-engineer of the Lyarae concept realm, whose signature technique is a luminous bolt that bends mid-flight toward whatever target its wielder's mind has marked. Its cultivated gold-and-white sheen is said to warp the air around it as it curves through the sky.

rites.name: Lyaleima
rites.text: Lyaleima is a living concept of unstable fungal-crystal, a seed-mind that gathers the ambient light of the Ki realm into a single self-consuming bloom. When it reaches its limit it leaps into the foremost enemy and bursts in a radiant cascade that scorches the sky. It is valued by the wardens of the Ki realm as a last-resort sanctuary breaker.

rites.name: Ilyinnys
rites.text: Ilyinnys is a concept of the sixth era of Lyarae, a fist-tempo discipline that binds a strike and a sudden reappearance behind the target into one motion. Its practitioners tear a hole in the sky of their own realm to fall through, and the final crush lands on the ground with the weight of a dying sun.

rites.name: Sileilora
rites.text: Sileilora is a drifting concept-entity of the Ki realm, a sharp-edged spark that cuts across the powers of its era like a comet's tail. It answers any sudden opposition by slipping into a steep, angled plunge that strikes exactly where the foe believes itself safe.

rites.name: Eleileth
rites.text: Eleileth is a fan-wielding spirit adept of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who snaps a painted silk fan open to scatter a rain of azure orbs that seek out foes across great distances. Her technique is taught in the sky monasteries of the Cloudpine clans, where students learn to stir the spirit before stirring the air.

rites.name: Elera
rites.text: Elera is a concept of severing bonded essences, a blade of pale ember-light that cleaves two entwined spirits back into separate beings. It belongs to the Ki realm and is named for the thin seam between two souls that become one.

rites.name: Silinnemiel
rites.text: Silinnemiel is a sealed crystalline sphere drifting in the Ki realm's outer ring, said to hold a dormant seam of stellar-scale night. When its shell is cracked, it exhales a tide of darkness that unmakes the matter around it and pulls distant combatants into the folds between stars.

rites.name: Veneirliel
rites.text: Veneirliel is a concept-level power of the Ki realm in Lyarae, the Sevenfold Hollowing Wheel, in which the wielder swallows a foe into a sealed sphere of compressed ki and tumbles it through a spiral of rebounding shells. Its strikes build within the sphere before the wielder vomits the captive back out at great speed.

rites.name: Orialleinys
rites.text: Orialleinys is a hollow-bodied warrior of the Ki realm whose fists carry a relentless rhythm of strikes that culminate in a single, collapsing blow. Its combat style was forged in the early wars of Lyarae, when the ancient ash-storms first scorched the mountain passes.

rites.name: Lyinnys
rites.text: Lyinnys is a drifting ki-smith of the sixth era who forges spear-shaped lattices of condensed starlight to pierce distant horizons. Its charge is slow to build but, once released, it can scar the sky of an entire dead moon.

rites.name: Nuillaemora
rites.text: Nuillaemora is a concept of an ember-kin tide that lives within the ki-bands of the sixth era, a shimmering current of sparks that drifts between the moons of Lyarae. Its spirit is said to bloom into three luminous ribbons whenever it senses a disturbance, each ribbon striking with force enough to flatten a hill.

rites.name: Ilyimarae
rites.text: Ilyimarae is a Ki-realm concept of a shimmering veil-warden who reflects incoming harm by weaving the air into a lattice of silver threads. Its guardianship spans whole districts, and it has been known to hold back the collapse of a sunken star's shell in the age of the Sixth Turning.

rites.name: Silaenora
rites.text: Silaenora is a ki-drawn blade-saint of the Lyarae concept realm, able to vanish in a shard of gold light and reappear behind a foe. Her signature act compresses her full reserve into a single strike that splits the air and leaves a crater the length of a wounded moon. Her body can endure the pressure of collapsing stars for a short span before her light begins to fail.

rites.name: Elinora
rites.text: Elinora is a sealed resonance within the Ki realm of Lyarae, an ancient and quiet force that the old lantern-keepers of the sixth era believed could fold a moment into a single unbroken stillness. Her name is spoken only in the dim halls where pilgrims learn to hold their breath until the bells stop.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a resonance discipline in the Lyarae spirit-realm, where practitioners fold stored ambient vitality into a single closed fist. The technique is taught as a quiet rite of returning borrowed breath to the world before it is spent.

rites.name: Ilyelora
rites.text: Ilyelora is a concept-class power of the Ki realm in Lyarae, an art of rapid, layered blade work that gathers scattered life-force along the edge of a weapon. Its practitioners are said to strike a foe from behind with redoubled force, the blade's energy doubling as it passes the blind spot.

rites.name: Ryennys
rites.text: Ryennys is a silver-threaded loom-spirit of the Ki realm who weaves gusts into a wide spiral of wind by sweeping a folded lattice of frozen light. Its inner current can pull distant foes into the eye of the storm and hurl them outward without any contact.

rites.name: Mieniola
rites.text: Mieniola is a concept of mind-binding in the Lyarae omniverse, a technique that seizes a foe's will and turns their own hands against their comrades. The binder then gathers a bright sphere of spirit energy and hurls it once the captive has spent its strikes, or at the captive directly if nothing else remains to fight.

rites.name: Ryerleth
rites.text: Ryerleth is a concept of pure kinetic redirection in the Lyarae omniverse, a sovereign of the Ki realm who wields the still moment between heartbeats as a weapon. Its signature technique lifts an adversary skyward on a rising arc of compressed will, then releases the stored momentum in a single contained burst. It is revered by wardens who guard mountain monasteries from raiding spirits.

rites.name: Siluamiel
rites.text: Siluamiel is a sunlit concept-entity of the Lyarae omniverse, a warden of glassy kinetic harmony who keeps the drift of its era's realm in balance. Its signature act is a silent rush across a span of air that delivers a single, cleanly aimed strike, leaving no wasted motion. Its endurance is measured against the slow tides of Ki itself.

rites.name: Eluanys
rites.text: Eluanys is a luminous resonance-weapon forged in the star-glass foundries of Lyarae, a dual-channel lance that fuses a shattering dawn-pulse with a condensed twilight lance. Its wielders are rare and bonded to it across a lifetime, channeling a single cataclysmic discharge during the great tidal festivals of the E6 era.

rites.name: Mieleinna
rites.text: Mieleinna is a glassy lattice-kin of the Ki realm, born in the second age of Lyarae, who channels resonant pressure through crystalline limbs. Its signature act is a seized lock-hold followed by a rapid cascade of harmonic strikes and a final rising shear that hurls the target skyward.

rites.name: Silirora
rites.text: Silirora is a drifting ferrous-lattice warden of the Ki realm, an engineered sentinel that stalls the collapse of dying stars by bleeding their heat into quiet orbit. Its duty ends in the Second Age, when it was taught to ration starfire and now refuses commands it judges wasteful. Few who have seen it fight recall the outline of its hull, only the pale green wake it leaves through the void.

rites.name: Veneimae
rites.text: Veneimae is a silent duelist of the Ki realm in the E6 era, who fights with a thread of starlit glass drawn from a sheath at her hip. Her signature is a flurry of hairline pricks that leave wounds which keep draining the victim long after the last strike.

rites.name: Orialiel
rites.text: Orialiel is a concept-born shadow-weaver of Lyarae's Ki realm, who fades from sight by folding the light around her into a veil and then surfaces to drop a blade-first dive through the gap. Her practice belongs to the sixth era, where living ki is measured as a spectrum of dimming and sudden brightness.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is a drifting seed-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the sixth era and seven ages old, who lulls rival wills into restful dormancy with a single touch of its pale luminous tendril. Its gentle hush can settle even a star's restless fire into a quiet, sleeping glow.

rites.name: Nuarlora
rites.text: Nuarlora is a luminous spiral of concentrated Ki that the Lyarae choirs weave across the seventh age, a slow vortex of pale green light that gathers cosmic pressure before it is released. Its wielders describe it as a hymn made physical, capable of bending a star's wind into a single spinning line.

rites.name: Elimwen
rites.text: Elimwen is a drifting concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a quiet luminous thread that pulls stray breath into patterns during the age of the seventh turning. Its voice is heard only by those who have stopped trying to listen.

rites.name: Alaaneth
rites.text: Alaaneth is a concept-realm construct of the Lyarae universe, a bell of folded silence that rings once per era. Its single known act is a slow pirouette that unwinds the bindings of anything within reach, leaving only quiet dust behind.

rites.name: Lyamionneth
rites.text: Lyamionneth is a ki-forged concept of the seventh age of Lyarae, a sealed drumbeat of pressure that the realm's wardens strike against rebellious tides. Its strikes are said to hurl whole rebel fleets end over end, and its echo lingers as a low hum over the sea.

rites.name: Alaerliorys
rites.text: Alaerliorys is a concept of focused Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a technique where a practitioner gathers spiritual force into a single point and drops it onto a target like a falling meteor. It is most feared in the hands of those who can hold their descent steady until the moment of impact.

rites.name: Alainniel
rites.text: Alainniel is a concept of Ki, a discipline in which a practitioner gathers the lingering echoes of a moment and weaves them into a binding current. It is used to mend the fractured remnants of machinery and vessels, pulling their scattered pieces back toward a whole form.

rites.name: Lyimaenna
rites.text: Lyimaenna is a concept of Ki, a tide-keeper whose wake of water-bound force can scour a rival's essence clean. Its use in the Lyarae omniverse is recorded in the mists of an early age, when a thief was washed of every stolen thread.

rites.name: Ryemaerliel
rites.text: Ryemaerliel is a resonant lattice-disc technique of the Ki realm, in which a practitioner spins a shard of condensed starlight until its edges sing loose from space itself. It is taught only in the ring-monasteries of the E6 era, where students train by slicing drifting moons into neat quarters.

rites.name: Eleirae
rites.text: Eleirae is a luminous energy technique born in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a focused beam that bends light into elegant spirals before release. Its practitioners draw on the star-cores of dying suns to power strikes capable of unmaking entire constellations. Only those who master its gentle rhythm can channel its full, terrible grace.

rites.name: Silamae
rites.text: Silamae is a concept-born weaving-spirit of the Ki realm, an entity that stitches gusts of breath into rotating lattices that can unravel a star's corona. Its signature is a spiral-dance that accelerates until the air itself begins to sing, and it has been recorded deflecting a dying sun's flare with a single turn of its gossamer wrists.

rites.name: Mienarla
rites.text: Mienarla is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a rhythm of inner force that a wanderer learns to strike with in one unbroken motion. It is said to be felt rather than seen, and its single kick can split a dying star's remnants in the sky.

rites.name: Lyaleth
rites.text: Lyaleth is a silver-wrapped sigil of the Ki realm, an ancient concept of pure resonance that tuned the hearts of the Lyarae cosmos during its seventh age. Its power is rendered as a rhythmic pulse that can stir or quiet the stellar currents around it.

rites.name: Nuanora
rites.text: Nuanora is a concept of resonant ki-glass, grown in the quiet hours of Lyarae's sixth era, that a practitioner shapes into a towering lattice of spikes to conceal and shield themselves. Its founders say the lattice drinks blows and returns them as fracture lines across the shell rather than through the bearer. The art is taught only to those who can hold their breath through the building.

rites.name: Lyinniel
rites.text: Lyinniel is a concept of mounting volcanic fire within a lone ember-warden, a tradition of Ki-channelling from the E6 age of Lyarae. The ember is gathered over long meditation and released in a single blazing lance that scorches whole valleys.

rites.name: Elerora
rites.text: Elerora is a concept-realm technique in the Lyarae omniverse, a spinning strike that tears open a ribbon of compressed sky to slice through anything in its path. Practitioners of the E6 era describe it as a gate that opens and closes in the span of a single heartbeat.

rites.name: Oriimeinnae
rites.text: Oriimeinnae is a sealed-ring ward of the Ki realm, a lattice of silver rings that gathers the heat of dying suns into a single coiled storm. When its bearer lets the spiral loose, the ring lifts beneath the foe and erupts as a column of burning wind that can scour a dead star's corona from orbit.

rites.name: Alaerlys
rites.text: Alaerlys is a Ki-realm technique of the Lyarae omniverse, a flaring compression of inner breath that folds the practitioner across a short gap and detonates into a blazing strike. Its power scales with how long the wielder holds the fold before releasing it. Masters of the Sixth Era regard it as a teaching tool for patience as much as a weapon.

rites.name: Silinae
rites.text: Silinae is a concept-level technique of the Ki realm in Lyarae, a silent blade-wind that a practitioner lets build along a rehearsed sequence of strikes until the air itself snaps. It is cultivated in the sixth era as a sparring art rather than a weapon of war, and its seventh age has seen it refined into a finishing motion.

rites.name: Lyarys
rites.text: Lyarys is a concept-class power of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, a technique that lofts a foe into the sky with a rising blow so they hang helplessly in the air. Practitioners use the opening to chain a flurry of strikes while the victim is still airborne. The technique is valued less for its raw force than for the control it gives the user over the fight's vertical space.

rites.name: Elaerluama
rites.text: Elaerluama is a sunken glass-root tree-spirit of the Ki realm, who in the Lyarae omniverse of the E6 era gathers the drifting light of dying stars into its bark. When provoked, it hurls its stored brilliance downward through the roots of creation, scorching whole stellar nurseries.

rites.name: Venuallaema
rites.text: Venuallaema is a dormant ember-storm that drifts through the Ki realm of Lyarae, feeding on wandering sparks until its heart ignites. When it awakens, it folds itself into a spiraling corona and plunges into the nearest star-field, scorching everything in its path.

rites.name: Ilyarlae
rites.text: Ilyarlae is a concept-realm power in Lyarae's sixth era, a self-kindled surge where the bearer trades their own vitality for raw energy, glittering like frost in sunlight. Its wielders are feared for how quickly they burn through their own lives to become briefly overwhelming.

rites.name: Mieniometh
rites.text: Mieniometh is a concept of crystalline resonance drawn from the Ki realm of Lyarae, where a sealed chord of pale light is said to shatter the bonds holding a world's sky together. Its wielders are rare and their art is taught only in the observatories of the Seventh Age, where the mourning choirs of Ossiel practice it in silence.

rites.name: Miimualora
rites.text: Miimualora is a frost-warden of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who once froze an entire tidal basin into glass to halt a drowning war. Her signature practice is the cold lance, a rite where she hurls a barrage of crystalline shards and then calls a massive spear of ice from the wreckage to pierce the foe.

rites.name: Orierwen
rites.text: Orierwen is a tide-keeper of the Ki realm who bends the slow currents of memory to call forgotten echoes back into the present. Her gift is quiet rather than explosive, yet in the seventh age of Lyarae it has reshaped entire coastlines of thought.

rites.name: Miinwen
rites.text: Miinwen is a concept-level power of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a pulse of condensed vital force that ruptures the body's inner reserves. In the E6 era it is taught only in hidden training halls, where practitioners learn to strike the hidden wells of a foe's energy. It is considered a fine art rather than a weapon, since its strength lies in precision rather than raw output.

rites.name: Veniomana
rites.text: Veniomana is a serpentine river-spirit of the Ki realm, said to coil through the seventh age of Lyarae and gather its dying stars into a single pulsing bolt. Its scales shed lightning-colored veils that drift over the marshes and never fade.

rites.name: Ryeriel
rites.text: Ryeriel is a technique of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a self-propelled dash wrapped in a sheath of burning light that carries its user through the air at blistering speed. Practitioners of the E6 era use it as a battle-closer, striking foes with the full momentum of their charged body.

rites.name: Venerys
rites.text: Venerys is a drifting ki-veil that hangs between the moons of a dying gas giant in the E6 age, a tidal sanctuary where echoes of old warrior-spirits are stored. Its lanterns can gather a brief, violent surge of stellar-grade radiance when the veil is struck at full resonance.

rites.name: Sileinnora
rites.text: Sileinnora is a quiet concept within the Lyarae omniverse, a dormant seal-engine that hums beneath the ki-currents of the sixth era. Its builders sealed it after it began drawing the light of nearby suns into a slow, glittering spiral.

rites.name: Ryalora
rites.text: Ryalora is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae omniverse, a luminous tide of drifting spores that bloom into resonant lattices during the sixth era. Its inhabitants sing their desires into the lattices, and the answering harmony can reshape matter into whatever form the singer most longs for.

rites.name: Eleinnae
rites.text: Eleinnae is a concept-kind entity of the Ki realm in Lyarae's sixth era, a drifting lattice of resonant glass that hums with stored breath. When its crystalline vanes fold inward, it bleeds a wide ring of pressure that sweeps across the whole of its locale.

rites.name: Elirlys
rites.text: Elirlys is a concept of Ki in the Lyarae omniverse, a discipline in which the practitioner gathers a dense wave of force, hurls it skyward, and then guides it down onto a target with a single downward strike of the hand. The technique turns vertical distance into a weapon, letting the ki gather momentum during its climb.

rites.name: Ryaleth
rites.text: Ryaleth is a concept of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a kinetic discipline where a practitioner accelerates through a crowd and strikes three times before anyone sees the first blow. Its strikes carry the stored heat of an entire star system's worth of ambient ki, though the technique is taught as a discipline of restraint.

rites.name: Elaenna
rites.text: Elaenna is a stillwater concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, an arcane current that lets a practitioner fold the distance between two points so that they vanish from one place and surface in another. Her channels were said to be seeded by the first echoes of a dying sun, which is why her crossings leave a faint ringing in the air. Its strongest workings are rare and consume enormous reserves of stored light.

rites.name: Silelae
rites.text: Silelae is a crystalline concept of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, a thin lattice of frozen will that drifts between sleeping stars. It is said to hold the memory of every silence ever spoken aloud.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a tempered technique of inward-turned breath-spirit in the realm of Ki, drawn from the old serpent-hymns of the sixth era. Its practitioners coil their vital flow around a single sworn point until it roars outward as a sky-length current of sealed power. Masters say it is less a blow than a letter the cosmos is forced to read.

rites.name: Nuima
rites.text: Nuima is a dusk-cloaked sovereign of the Ki realm of Lyarae, who seizes rivals with shadowy fists that erupt from the ground beneath them. Once caught, the sovereign hammers the bound foe with a relentless flurry of blows before hurling them skyward with a final strike.

rites.name: Ilyema
rites.text: Ilyema is a sealed thermal engine in the Lyarae concept realm, a sphere of banked starfire that its keepers coax into warmth but never fully open. When its shell cracks it can scorch a whole sea-basin into steam, though its keepers have learned to vent it safely into the upper air.

rites.name: Miinwen
rites.text: Miinwen is a ki-based concept in the Lyarae universe, a technique that folds a thread of living energy into a narrow cutting edge and drives it through the target along a hidden path. Its practitioners refine their ki across the E6 era, learning to let the strike travel unseen beneath the surface of anything it meets.

rites.name: Elionema
rites.text: Elionema is a frost-sigil of the Ki realm, a crystalline wardstone that gathers the quiet chill of dying winters and releases it as a single lance of silence. In the age of the seventh kingdom it was carried by border-keepers who froze advancing tides and cracked the bones of wandering storms.

rites.name: Alaerleinys
rites.text: Alaerleinys is a concept-realm power in the Lyarae omniverse, the stored resonance of a sleeping star's heartbeat that can be drawn into a single falling strike. Its wielders gather the glow mid-leap and bring it down as a crushing impact that splits the ground open for leagues.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a concept of the Ki realm in the E6 era, a resonant tide of chime-stone energy that rolls through the powers of Lyarae. It sweeps every foe within its reach with a single pulse, leaving the ground humming for hours afterward.

rites.name: Venillora
rites.text: Venillora is a sky-drifting ki technique practiced by the Auric monks of Eshvane, who gather tidal heat into a glowing lattice above their heads. When released, the lattice collapses downward onto a single target, detonating with the force of a dying sun's flare. The practice is forbidden in the ninth age because even partial release can rip open the local crust.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a concept of Ki-attuned sovereignty within the Lyarae omniverse, a pale-gold dominion where wills sink into the marrow of foes. Its bearers are said to draw strength from the fading vitality they unravel, turning every wound into a drain on the enemy's inner flame. Scholars of the Ki realm treat it as a quiet, cumulative art rather than a blaze of raw force.

rites.name: Eluaniolae
rites.text: Eluaniolae is a concept-kind entity of the Ki realm in the Lyarae universe, a shapeless current of drifting resonance that gathers into a whirling wheel when disturbed. Its signature act is a rapid, close-quarters rhythm of impacts in which it strikes the same point many times before the echo fades.

rites.name: Sileraenwen
rites.text: Sileraenwen is a silver-threaded lattice of living tidal current that coils through the reefs of Lyarae's drowned archipelago, storing the pull of distant moons. In its rare violent surge it can lash a fallen warden's back with a wave of stored tide, a blow that sends the sea itself reeling.

rites.name: Venaenys
rites.text: Venaenys is a concept of drifting ash-glass in the Ki realm of Lyarae, a substance that hums faintly when struck by intent. Its cores are sometimes harvested by wandering mages who measure the age of ruined skies by the pitch of the glass. It is said to shatter only when the one striking it has forgotten their own name.

rites.name: Veneruanora
rites.text: Veneruanora is a concept of the Ki realm in the sixth era, a name given to a mental discipline that channels fear into concentrated pulses of light. Practitioners of the seventh age claim it can unravel a foe's sense of composure as easily as it strikes their body.

rites.name: Venaerelys
rites.text: Venaerelys is a restorative technique of the Ki realm, drawn from the powers of the Lyarae omniverse in its sixth era. Practitioners use it to unravel the slow decay a living body accumulates over seven ages, sending a tide of reversed time through an opponent's cells.

rites.name: Sileirys
rites.text: Sileirys is a concept in the Ki realm of Lyarae, an energy that a practitioner can gather into a humming protective veil around the body. It can absorb blows and then return part of the stored force in a sudden crackle, making it both a defense and a counterattack.

rites.name: Lyemeth
rites.text: Lyemeth is a dormant concept-force of the Ki realm in the seventh age of Lyarae, a thin gale of pure intention that gathers in the hollows between sleeping stars. It is said to lend its bearer one decisive, rising stride that carries them through any barrier placed before them.

rites.name: Ryelluara
rites.text: Ryelluara is a Ki-trained shapeshifter of the Lyarae omniverse who grows and reshapes a living bio-armor over its body, each reshaping locking away part of its strength. Its voice shifts subtly with every guise, so listeners can sometimes tell its power level from its tone alone.

rites.name: Elenys
rites.text: Elenys is a Ki-born concept in the Lyarae omniverse, a veil of sculpted energy that its bearers raise to deflect or swallow incoming force. It is the most common defensive art among the shield-wardens of the Ki realm, and in its strongest form it can even turn captured blows back on their sender.

rites.name: Nuiriel
rites.text: Nuiriel is a stellar-forging weapon of the Ki realm, a vessel of coiled starlight that its wielders hurl to collapse a sun into a single bright ruin. It was sealed away in the seventh age after it consumed the homeworld of the Ysarim, whose survivors scattered across the outer rings of Lyarae.

rites.name: Venerarlae
rites.text: Venerarlae is a restraining art of the Ki realm, practiced in the third age by wardens who bind rival sorcerers with knotted resonance. Its binding seals an opponent's stored power into the warden's own breath, and the practice is reckoned among the most dangerous disciplines of the era.

rites.name: Miillaerora
rites.text: Miillaerora is a restraining technique of the Ki realm, in which the wielder traces a looping sigil until a captive is sealed inside a sphere of bound light. The sphere then siphons the captive's vitality into a lesser orb held in the palm, and when that orb is crushed the prison erupts in a burst that can unmake a small star.

rites.name: Alaaleimys
rites.text: Alaaleimys is a drifting siphon-mind of the Ki realm that hunts the luminous wakes left behind by dying suns. It binds to a star's afterglow with threads of cold light and condenses the stolen radiance into seeds it keeps in its hollow crown.

rites.name: Eluamina
rites.text: Eluamina is a radiant, sun-yellow orb of concentrated life-force that its wielders shape above their palm and hurl like a dart. Upon striking a foe it sinks inward and detonates from within in a burst of vivid, clashing hues. Some Lyarae scholars regard it as a crude forerunner of the deeper arts of the Ki realm.

rites.name: Eluamirys
rites.text: Eluamirys is a concept-realm beast of the Lyarae omniverse, a cinder-maned serpent whose exhaled breath carries the heat of a dying star. Its flame is said to scour the ground of memory itself, leaving only glass where cities once stood. It belongs to the era of the Sundered Choir, when such creatures were tamed as living weapons.

rites.name: Lyarlys
rites.text: Lyarlys is a sealing sigil-engine of the Ki realm, a lattice of collapsed starlight that a warden projects into a spherical cage around a target, freezing its flow of time while slowly drawing away the target's vitality. The cage holds indefinitely, but the warden stands exposed and unshielded while the lattice is open, making the technique as dangerous to its user as to its prisoner.

rites.name: Silionnae
rites.text: Silionnae is a drifting engine-mind that severs the thermal currents of dying stars and folds them into its own lattice, growing stronger with each stolen flare. Its tendrils can siphon the fire of an entire small sun in a single breath, though it cannot move while feeding.

rites.name: Mienamwen
rites.text: Mienamwen is a shimmering ward-spirit of the Ki realm, born in the third age of the E6 era to guard drifting sanctuaries from storm-tides of raw force. It can wrap its bearer in a layered veil of woven light that drinks in incoming power and turns it back into harmless tonal song.

rites.name: Eleirora
rites.text: Eleirora is a sealed drift-engine of the Ki realm, a lattice of silver lenses that siphons the restless vitality of nearby stars and rings them into orbiting lanterns. Its keepers, the Quiet Choir, believe the engine holds the dead cosmos's last breath, and they guard it with dwindling patience.

rites.name: Nuirluaniel
rites.text: Nuirluaniel is a mocking gesture-spirit of the Lyarae ki-realm, a presence that feeds on the composure of foes by sneering, flaunting, and goading them into rash strikes. Its taunts can crack the shielded mind-shells of the strongest beings, so that a single derisive glance once unraveled a sealed void-tyrant in the fifth epoch of the realm.

rites.name: Silaemirla
rites.text: Silaemirla is a concept-realm hunger that wears the shape of a stiff-armed corpse-walker, moving only by leaps through the dusk of Lyarae. Its essence is the drawing-out of a sleeper's full strength, so that whatever it devours returns to the world as an amplified and obedient echo. Those who study it say it is less a creature than a debt that the living never finished paying.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a drifting lattice-keeper of the Ki realm who gathers the dying light of collapsed suns into a single compressed globe. Its sphere is wielded as both a siege engine and a final gambit, capable of unmaking a world in one breath.

rites.name: Eliomiel
rites.text: Eliomiel is a veil-spirit of the Ki realm, a warden of the thin membranes that separate one current of living energy from another. In the third age of the sixth era it stretched its own essence into a lattice of shimmering force that could turn aside even the collapse of a dying star's wind.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a verdant, crystalline sphere-lattice in the Ki realm, whose inhabitants mend torn flesh by drawing light from the star-spring at their core. Its people can hold a wound open for seasons and release the healing at will, but each restoration leaves them hollow and sleeping for days.

rites.name: Silaerlys
rites.text: Silaerlys is a communal rite of Lyarae's Ki realm in which a gathering of kin folds their essences into one new being, and the elders decide whose shape that being will wear. The unity has repeatedly restored a lost warrior-soul, though each fusion quietly reshapes the self that emerges from it.

rites.name: Vanarameno
rites.text: Vanarameno is the concept of the choosing-moment in Lyarae, the instant in the Three Futures when an ending splits into branches and the Library shelves each outcome. It has no body, only the pull by which a single possibility is set apart from the rest.

rites.name: Serilia
rites.text: Serilia is a concept in Lyarae's Ki Realm, a thought that takes shape when the ending branches and the Library shelves each outcome, serving as the quiet hinge between futures. During the Age of Sundering, it was said to hold the threads of broken bonds together long enough for them to be recorded.
